```go
package main

// Credit-policy config that is identical across dev / prod and never
// rotates. Hard-coded here so the Cloud Run service config doesn't need to
// carry a dozen env vars; only the per-environment secret
// (CREDIT_POLICY_BITBUCKET_AUTH) and the approver list stay as env.
const (
	creditPolicyRepoURL        = "https://bitbucket.org/unibos/credit-policy-config.git"
	creditPolicyRepoBranch     = "master"
	creditPolicyGitUserName    = "Ujuzi Bot"
	creditPolicyGitUserEmail   = "ujuzi-bot@unifi.credit"
	creditPolicyBQProject      = "df-fs-insights"
	creditPolicyBQDataset      = "INSIGHTS"
	creditPolicyBQChangesTable = "CREDIT_POLICY_CHANGES"
	creditPolicyBQActiveTable  = "CREDIT_POLICY"
	creditPolicyBQPendingTable = "CREDIT_POLICY_PENDING"
)

func main() {
	l := logx.New("UJUZI")

	if err := run(l); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("ERROR: %s\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("done.")
		os.Exit(0)
	}
}

func run(l *log.Logger) error {

	// =============================================
	// CONF

	l.Println("loading config")

	cfg := struct {
		Port                      int `conf:"default:8080"`
		GoogleKey                 string
		GoogleSecret              string `conf:",mask"`
		GoogleProjectID           string
		GoogleKeProjectID         string
		GoogleZaProjectID         string
		GoogleUgProjectID         string
		GoogleZmProjectID         string
		GoogleTzProjectID         string
		GoogleFsInsightsProjectID string // New config field
		GoogleDfFrontendProjectID string
		Dev                       bool
		Host                      string
		SessionSecret             string `conf:",mask"`
		ServiceAcc                string `conf:",mask"`
		JasperHost                string
		JasperReportsBase         string // user-facing Jasper URL, e.g. https://jasper.unifi.credit/jasperserver — differs per env
		JasperUname               string
		JasperPassword            string `conf:",mask"`
		UnifiDbUser               string
		UnifiDbPassword           string `conf:",mask"`
		UnifiDbZaHost             string
		UnifiDbZmHost             string
		UnifiDbUgHost             string
		UnifiDbKeHost             string
		UnifiDbTzHost             string
		BqDatasetID               string `conf:"default:ujuzi_events"`
		BqTableID                 string `conf:"default:report_ratings"`
		FsDbID                    string
		CreditPolicyBitbucketAuth string `conf:",mask"`
		CreditPolicyApprovers     string
		CreditPolicyAutoApprovers string
		CreditPolicyQuorum        int `conf:"default:1"`
	}{}

	// const prefix = "UJUZI"
	help, err := conf.Parse("", &cfg)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, conf.ErrHelpWanted) {
			fmt.Println(help)
			return nil
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("parsing config: %w", err)
	}

	confStr, err := conf.String(&cfg)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// if running in Dev mode, load the yaml env and reload config
	if cfg.Dev {
		f, err := os.Open("env.dev.yaml")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		env := map[string]string{}
		if err := yaml.NewDecoder(f).Decode(env); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		for k, v := range env {
			os.Setenv(k, v)
		}

		if _, err = conf.Parse("", &cfg); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("parsing config: %w", err)
		}

		if str, err := conf.String(&cfg); err != nil {
			return err
		} else {
			confStr = str
		}
	}

	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("CONFIG")
	fmt.Print(confStr)
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println()

	// =============================================
	// FIRESTORE & BIGQUERY

	ctx := context.Background()

	fsDb := must(fire.Store(ctx, cfg.GoogleProjectID, cfg.FsDbID))
	defer fsDb.Close()

	// BigQuery service
	bqService, err := bq.NewService(ctx, l, cfg.GoogleProjectID, cfg.BqDatasetID, cfg.BqTableID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create BigQuery service: %w", err)
	}
	defer bqService.Close()

	// =============================================
	// COUNTRY MySQLs

	countryDBsConf := []country.DB{
		{Host: cfg.UnifiDbZaHost, CountryCode: country.ZA},
		{Host: cfg.UnifiDbUgHost, CountryCode: country.UG},
		{Host: cfg.UnifiDbZmHost, CountryCode: country.ZM},
		{Host: cfg.UnifiDbKeHost, CountryCode: country.KE},
		{Host: cfg.UnifiDbTzHost, CountryCode: country.TZ},
	}

	countryDBs, err := country.OpenDBs(ctx, fsDb, cfg.UnifiDbUser, cfg.UnifiDbPassword, countryDBsConf...)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	defer countryDBs.Close()

	// =============================================
	// COUNTRY DATASTORES

	dbZA := must(fire.DataStore(ctx, cfg.GoogleZaProjectID))
	defer dbZA.Close()

	dbKE := must(fire.DataStore(ctx, cfg.GoogleKeProjectID))
	defer dbKE.Close()

	dbZM := must(fire.DataStore(ctx, cfg.GoogleZmProjectID))
	defer dbZM.Close()

	dbUG := must(fire.DataStore(ctx, cfg.GoogleUgProjectID))
	defer dbUG.Close()

	dbTZ := must(fire.DataStore(ctx, cfg.GoogleTzProjectID))
	defer dbTZ.Close()

	// New Datastore client for df-fs-insights
	dbFsInsights := must(fire.DataStore(ctx, cfg.GoogleFsInsightsProjectID))
	defer dbFsInsights.Close()

	// =============================================
	// SERVICES

	serviceAcc, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(cfg.ServiceAcc)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	gg, err := ggroups.NewService(ctx, fsDb, l, serviceAcc)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	gDriveService, err := gdrive.NewService(ctx, l, serviceAcc)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	jasperClient := jasper.NewClient(cfg.JasperHost, cfg.JasperUname, cfg.JasperPassword)
	jasperService := jasper.NewService(jasperClient, l, fsDb)

	// =============================================
	// DAILY SYNC SCHEDULER

	startDailySyncScheduler(l, gg, countryDBs, fsDb)

	// =============================================
	// RELOAD & SCHEDULES PAGE CACHE

	reloadCache := base.NewReloadCache(l, dbZA, dbUG, dbKE, dbZM, dbTZ)
	reloadCache.StartBackgroundRefresh(15 * time.Minute) // Refresh every 15 minutes

	// Initialize and start the schedules cache
	schedulesCache := admin.NewSchedulesCache(l, jasperService)
	schedulesCache.StartBackgroundRefresh(60 * time.Minute)

	// Dataform batch execution cache
	dataformCache := admin.NewDataformCache(l)

	// BigQuery client for df-frontend (Dataform history storage)
	dfFrontendProjectID := cfg.GoogleDfFrontendProjectID
	if dfFrontendProjectID == "" {
		dfFrontendProjectID = "df-frontend"
		l.Printf("GoogleDfFrontendProjectID not set — using default: %s", dfFrontendProjectID)
	}
	bqDfFrontend, err := bigquery.NewClient(ctx, dfFrontendProjectID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create df-frontend BQ client: %w", err)
	}
	defer bqDfFrontend.Close()

	// =============================================
	// OAUTH

	// Goth will cause issues if multiple instances of Ujuzi is deployed
	goth.UseProviders(
		google.New(
			os.Getenv("GOOGLE_KEY"),
			os.Getenv("GOOGLE_SECRET"),
			fmt.Sprintf("%s/auth/google/callback", cfg.Host),
		),
	)

	authService := auth.NewService(l, cfg.SessionSecret)

	store := sessions.NewCookieStore([]byte(cfg.SessionSecret))
	sessionStore := auth.NewFireStore(l, fsDb, authService)

	if cfg.Dev {
		store.Options.Secure = false
	} else {
		store.Options.Secure = true
	}

	gothic.Store = store

	// =============================================
	// SERVER

	app := web.NewApp()

	staticHandler := webx.StaticHandler(assets, l, true)

	app.HandleStd(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/assets/{filepath...}",
		staticHandler.ServeHTTP,
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	)

	// =============================================
	// MODULES
	dashboardConfigCache := base.NewDashboardConfigCache(ctx, l, fsDb)

	admin.InitModule(l, app, sessionStore, fsDb, countryDBs, jasperService, gg, reloadCache, schedulesCache, dbFsInsights, dataformCache, bqDfFrontend, serviceAcc)

	publishCfg := tools.PublishConfig{
		BQHistory: bq.CreditPolicyTable{
			Project: creditPolicyBQProject,
			Dataset: creditPolicyBQDataset,
			Table:   creditPolicyBQChangesTable,
		},
		BQActive: bq.CreditPolicyActiveTable{
			Project: creditPolicyBQProject,
			Dataset: creditPolicyBQDataset,
			Table:   creditPolicyBQActiveTable,
		},
		GitRepoURL:     creditPolicyRepoURL,
		GitBranch:      creditPolicyRepoBranch,
		GitAuthorName:  creditPolicyGitUserName,
		GitAuthorEmail: creditPolicyGitUserEmail,
		BitbucketAuth:  cfg.CreditPolicyBitbucketAuth,
	}
	bqPending := bq.CreditPolicyPendingTable{
		Project: creditPolicyBQProject,
		Dataset: creditPolicyBQDataset,
		Table:   creditPolicyBQPendingTable,
	}
	tools.InitModule(l, app, sessionStore, countryDBs, fsDb, dashboardConfigCache, cfg.CreditPolicyApprovers, cfg.CreditPolicyAutoApprovers, cfg.CreditPolicyQuorum, bqService, bqPending, publishCfg)
	base.InitModule(
		l,
		app,
		sessionStore,
		fsDb,
		countryDBs,
		jasperService,
		jasperClient,
		dbZA,
		dbUG,
		dbKE,
		dbZM,
		dbTZ,
		bqService,
		gDriveService,
		dashboardConfigCache,
	)

	// =============================================
	// RUN SERVER

	host := fmt.Sprintf("0.0.0.0:%d", cfg.Port)

	server := http.Server{
		Addr:    host,
		Handler: app,
	}

	shutdown := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	serverErr := make(chan error)

	signal.Notify(shutdown, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)

	go func() {
		serverErr <- server.ListenAndServe()
	}()

	if cfg.Dev {
		l.Printf("listening at http://localhost:%d\n", cfg.Port)
	} else {
		l.Printf("listening at :%d\n", cfg.Port)
	}

	select {
	case err := <-serverErr:
		return fmt.Errorf("server error: %s", err)
	case sig := <-shutdown:
		l.Printf("starting server shutdown: %s", sig)
		defer l.Println("server shutdown complete")

		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), web.DefaultShutdownTimeout)
		defer cancel()

		if err := server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
			server.Close()
			return fmt.Errorf("could not gracefully shutdown server: %s", err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func must[T any](t T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	return t
}

func syncAllUserGroups(ctx context.Context, l *log.Logger, dbs *country.DBs, fsDb *firestore.Client) {
	l.Println("Starting daily user group sync for all countries...")
	for _, c := range country.List {
		if err := syncUserGroupsForCountry(ctx, l, dbs, fsDb, c); err != nil {
			l.Printf("ERROR syncing user groups for %s: %v", c.Code, err)
		}
	}
	l.Println("Finished daily user group sync.")
}

func syncUserGroupsForCountry(ctx context.Context, l *log.Logger, dbs *country.DBs, fsDb *firestore.Client, c country.Country) error {
	l.Printf("Starting user group sync for country: %s", c.Code)

	countryDb, ok := dbs.GetDB(c.Code)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("database connection for country %s not found", c.Code)
	}

	const getGroupsQuery = `SELECT id, group_name FROM sec_groups;`
	rows, err := countryDb.QueryContext(ctx, getGroupsQuery)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("querying sec_groups for %s failed: %w", c.Code, err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	type secGroup struct {
		ID   string
		Name string
	}

	groupsFromDB := make(map[string]string) // map[id]name
	for rows.Next() {
		var g secGroup
		if err := rows.Scan(&g.ID, &g.Name); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("scanning sec_group row failed: %w", err)
		}
		groupsFromDB[g.ID] = g.Name
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("error during rows iteration for sec_groups: %w", err)
	}
	l.Printf("Found %d groups in sec_groups for %s", len(groupsFromDB), c.Code)

	existingGroupsFirestore := make(map[string]string) // map[UnibosID]doc.Ref.ID
	iter := fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).Documents(ctx)
	for {
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to retrieve existing usergroups from Firestore: %w", err)
		}
		unibosID, _ := doc.Data()["UnibosID"].(string)
		if unibosID != "" {
			existingGroupsFirestore[unibosID] = doc.Ref.ID
		}
	}
	l.Printf("Found %d existing usergroups in Firestore for %s", len(existingGroupsFirestore), c.Code)

	batch := fsDb.Batch()
	newGroupCount := 0
	deletedGroupCount := 0

	defaultFunctionalAreas := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, fa := range reporting.FunctionAreas {
		if !fa.Hidden {
			defaultFunctionalAreas[fa.ID] = false
		}
	}

	for unibosID, name := range groupsFromDB {
		if _, exists := existingGroupsFirestore[unibosID]; !exists {
			newID := randx.UID()
			docRef := fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Doc(newID)
			newUserGroup := country.UserGroup{
				ID:              newID,
				Name:            name,
				UnibosID:        unibosID,
				CC:              c.Code,
				FunctionalAreas: defaultFunctionalAreas,
			}
			batch.Set(docRef, newUserGroup)
			newGroupCount++
			l.Printf("Staging new usergroup for creation: %s (UnibosID: %s)", name, unibosID)
		}
	}

	for unibosID, docID := range existingGroupsFirestore {
		if _, exists := groupsFromDB[unibosID]; !exists {
			docRef := fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Doc(docID)
			batch.Delete(docRef)
			deletedGroupCount++
			l.Printf("Staging usergroup for deletion: %s (UnibosID: %s)", docID, unibosID)
		}
	}

	if newGroupCount > 0 || deletedGroupCount > 0 {
		if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to commit usergroup changes to Firestore: %w", err)
		}
		l.Printf("Successfully created %d and deleted %d usergroups for %s", newGroupCount, deletedGroupCount, c.Code)
	} else {
		l.Printf("No usergroups to create or delete for %s.", c.Code)
	}

	return nil
}

func startDailySyncScheduler(l *log.Logger, gg *ggroups.Service, countryDBs *country.DBs, fsDb *firestore.Client) {
	l.Println("Setting up daily sync scheduler using standard library")

	go func() {
		for {
			// Calculate the time until the next 6:00 AM server time.
			now := time.Now()
			year, month, day := now.Date()
			nextRun := time.Date(year, month, day, 6, 0, 0, 0, now.Location())

			// If it's already past 6:00 AM today, schedule it for tomorrow.
			if now.After(nextRun) {
				nextRun = nextRun.Add(24 * time.Hour)
			}

			durationUntilNextRun := nextRun.Sub(now)
			l.Printf("Next daily sync scheduled for: %s (in %s)", nextRun.Format(time.RFC1123), durationUntilNextRun)

			// Wait until the next scheduled time.
			timer := time.NewTimer(durationUntilNextRun)
			<-timer.C

			// Run the sync tasks.
			l.Println("Starting daily sync...")
			ctx := context.Background()

			// Sync users from Google Workspace
			if err := gg.Sync(ctx, time.Now()); err != nil {
				l.Printf("ERROR during daily user sync: %v", err)
			}

			// Sync user groups from Unibos DBs for all countries
			syncAllUserGroups(ctx, l, countryDBs, fsDb)

			l.Println("Daily sync finished.")
		}
	}()
}
```

```js
const typeDropdown = document.querySelector('select[name="Type"]');
const lookerFieldsContainer = document.getElementById('looker-fields-container');

const toggleLookerFields = (show) => {
    if (lookerFieldsContainer) {
        if (show) {
            lookerFieldsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            lookerFieldsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    }
};

if (typeDropdown) {
    // Initial state check
    toggleLookerFields(typeDropdown.value === 'LOOKER');

    typeDropdown.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        toggleLookerFields(e.target.value === 'LOOKER');
    });
}
```

## File: app\assets\scripts\ajax_form.js
```js
const form = document.querySelector("form[data-ajax-file]");

if (form) {
	const toggleLoading = (isLoading) => {
		const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
		if (submitBtn) {
			submitBtn.dataset.loading = isLoading;
			submitBtn.disabled = isLoading;
		}
	};

	const addErrAfter = (element, title, message) => {
		const existingError = element.nextElementSibling;
		if (existingError && existingError.classList.contains("ajax-error")) {
			existingError.remove();
		}

		const errorDiv = document.createElement("div");
		errorDiv.className =
			"ajax-error mt-4 p-4 border rounded border-red-300 bg-amber-100 text-amber-700";
		errorDiv.innerHTML = `<p class="font-bold">${title}</p><p>${message}</p>`;
		element.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", errorDiv);
	};

	// onConfirmReturnHome navigates the user back to the home dashboard
	// after a successful Jasper export. When the form is embedded inside the
	// dashboard iframe (the standard path now that /reporting/{id} renders
	// the dashboard), redirecting the iframe would nest the dashboard inside
	// itself — so we just close the popup and leave the Jasper form visible.
	const onConfirmReturnHome = () => {
		if (window.self !== window.top) {
			return;
		}
		const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
		const cc = urlParams.get("cc");
		window.location.href = cc ? `/?cc=${cc}` : "/";
	};

	const showScheduledPopup = () => {
		window.showUjuziPopup(
			"Report Scheduled",
			"Your report has been scheduled successfully and will be emailed to you shortly.",
			onConfirmReturnHome,
		);
	};

	const emailCheckbox = form.querySelector('input[name="email_report"]');
	const sheetsCheckbox = form.querySelector('input[name="google_sheets"]');
	const fileTypeDropdown = form.querySelector('select[name="file_type"]');

	function updateCheckboxStates() {
		if (!emailCheckbox || !sheetsCheckbox || !fileTypeDropdown) return;

		const isEmailChecked = emailCheckbox.checked;
		const isSheetsChecked = sheetsCheckbox.checked;
		const isFileTypeXLSX = fileTypeDropdown.value.toUpperCase() === 'XLSX';

		const shouldDisableSheets = isEmailChecked || !isFileTypeXLSX;
		const shouldDisableEmail = isSheetsChecked;

		emailCheckbox.disabled = shouldDisableEmail;
		sheetsCheckbox.disabled = shouldDisableSheets;

		if (shouldDisableSheets) {
			sheetsCheckbox.checked = false;
		}
		if (shouldDisableEmail) {
			emailCheckbox.checked = false;
		}
	}

	if (emailCheckbox && sheetsCheckbox && fileTypeDropdown) {
		emailCheckbox.addEventListener('change', updateCheckboxStates);
		sheetsCheckbox.addEventListener('change', updateCheckboxStates);
		fileTypeDropdown.addEventListener('change', updateCheckboxStates);
		
		updateCheckboxStates();
	}

	form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
		e.preventDefault();
		toggleLoading(true);

		const formData = new FormData(form);
		const endpointURL = form.action;

		const data = {};
		for (const key of formData.keys()) {
			const values = formData.getAll(key);
			data[key] = values;
		}

		const response = await fetch(endpointURL, {
			method: "POST",
			headers: {
				"Content-Type": "application/json",
			},
			body: JSON.stringify(data),
		});

		if (sheetsCheckbox && sheetsCheckbox.checked) {
			toggleLoading(false);
			if (response.ok) {
				const result = await response.json();
				if (result.sheetURL) {
					window.showUjuziPopup(
						"Sheet Created Successfully",
						`Your Google Sheet is ready. <br/><br/> <a href="${result.sheetURL}" target="_blank" class="font-bold underline text-blue-600">Click here to open it.</a>`,
						{
							confirmText: "Return to Main Screen",
							onConfirm: onConfirmReturnHome,
							cancelText: "Stay on screen",
							onCancel: () => {},
						}
					);
				} else {
					addErrAfter(form, "Error", "Server did not return a valid sheet URL.");
				}
			} else {
				addErrAfter(form, "Error", "Could not process the report for Google Sheets.");
			}
			return; 
		}

		if (emailCheckbox && emailCheckbox.checked) {
			toggleLoading(false);
			if (response.ok) {
				showScheduledPopup();
			} else {
				addErrAfter(
					form,
					"Error Scheduling Report",
					"Could not schedule the report. Please try again.",
				);
			}
		} else {
			if (!response.ok) {
				let body;
				try {
					body = await response.json();
				} catch (e) {
					addErrAfter(
						form,
						"Internal Server Error",
						"There was an unexpected error on the server.",
					);
					toggleLoading(false);
					return;
				}

				if (body?.Msg === "timeout") {
					addErrAfter(
						form,
						"Report Processing Timeout",
						"The report you attempted to process seems to be very large. Unfortunately the process timed out.",
					);
				} else if (body?.Msg === "forbidden") {
					addErrAfter(
						form,
						"Forbidden",
						"You do not have the necessary permissions to download the report.",
					);
				} else {
					addErrAfter(
						form,
						"Internal Server Error",
						"There was an unexpected error on the server.",
					);
				}
				toggleLoading(false);
				return;
			}

			const fileName = form.dataset.ajaxSaveAs;
			const fileType = formData.get("file_type").toLowerCase();

			const fileBlob = await response.blob();
			const objURL = URL.createObjectURL(fileBlob);
			const a = document.createElement("a");
			a.href = objURL;
			a.download = `${fileName}.${fileType}`;
			document.body.appendChild(a);
			a.click();
			a.remove();
			URL.revokeObjectURL(objURL);

			toggleLoading(false);
		}
	});
}
```

```js
const dropdown = document.getElementById("cc-dropdown");

if (dropdown !== null) {
	const dropdownBtn = document.getElementById("cc-dropdown-btn");

	dropdownBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
		if (dropdown.dataset.open === "true") {
			dropdown.dataset.open = "false";
		} else {
			dropdown.dataset.open = "true";
		}
	});

	// close dropdown on click-away
	document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
		const target = event.target;

		// Check if the clicked element is not inside the dropdown
		if (!dropdown.contains(target)) {
			dropdown.dataset.open = "false";
		}
	});
}
```

## File: app\assets\scripts\checkbox_dropdown.js
```js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
	document.querySelectorAll("[data-checkbox-dropdown]").forEach((container) => {
		const trigger = container.querySelector("[data-trigger]");
		const panel = container.querySelector("[data-panel]");
		const selectionText = container.querySelector("[data-selection-text]");
		const searchInput = container.querySelector("[data-search-input]");
		const selectedValuesDisplay = container.querySelector(
			"[data-selected-values-display]",
		);
		const checkboxes = container.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');
		const optionLabels = container.querySelectorAll("[data-option-label]");

		// Search functionality
		if (searchInput) {
			searchInput.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
				const searchTerm = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
				optionLabels.forEach((label) => {
					const labelText = (
						label.querySelector("span")?.textContent || ""
					).toLowerCase();
					if (labelText.includes(searchTerm)) {
						label.style.display = "flex";
					} else {
						label.style.display = "none";
					}
				});
			});
		}

		const updateSelectionTextAndDisplay = () => {
			const selectedCheckboxes = Array.from(checkboxes).filter(
				(cb) => cb.checked,
			);
			const selectedCount = selectedCheckboxes.length;

			// Update the button text (e.g., "3 selected")
			if (selectedCount === 0) {
				selectionText.textContent = "Select Options";
			} else {
				selectionText.textContent = `${selectedCount} selected`;
			}

			// Update the display text below the dropdown
			if (selectedValuesDisplay) {
				if (selectedCount === 0) {
					selectedValuesDisplay.textContent = "All has been selected.";
				} else {
					const selectedLabels = selectedCheckboxes.map(
						(cb) => cb.nextElementSibling?.textContent.trim() || "",
					);
					selectedValuesDisplay.textContent = `Selected: ${selectedLabels.join(", ")}`;
				}
			}
		};

		trigger.addEventListener("click", () => {
			panel.classList.toggle("hidden");
			if (!panel.classList.contains("hidden") && searchInput) {
				searchInput.focus();
			}
		});

		document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
			if (!container.contains(e.target)) {
				panel.classList.add("hidden");
			}
		});

		checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
			checkbox.addEventListener("change", updateSelectionTextAndDisplay);
		});

		// Initial update on page load
		updateSelectionTextAndDisplay();
	});
});
```

```js
import van from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/vanjs-org/van/public/van-1.5.0.min.js";

const slideover = document.getElementById("slideover");
const slideoverClickaway = document.getElementById("slideover-clickaway");

let slideoverOpen = false;
const slideoverContent = document.getElementById("slideover-content");

const userData = JSON.parse(
	document.getElementById("userdata").dataset.userdata,
);

const { div, h2, button, a, span, nav, ul, li } = van.tags;

});

						{
							class:
								"text-gray-600 text-sm group-hover/link:text-gray-400 transition-colors",
						},
						r.Description,
					),
				);
			}),
		);
}

const navOptions = [
	{
		Option: "dashboards",
		Title: "Dashboards",
	},
	{
		Option: "reports",
		Title: "Reports / Lists",
	},
	{
		Option: "tools",
		Title: "Tools",
	},
];

function SlideoverHeader() {
	return div(
		div(
			{ class: " px-4 sm:px-6 pt-6 pb-2 bg-green-x-light" },
			div(
				{ class: "flex items-start justify-between" },

							class: "text-2xl font-semibold leading-6 text-white",

							},
							path({
								"stroke-linecap": "round",
								"stroke-linejoin": "round",
								d: "M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12",
							}),
						),

				),
			),
			div(
				{ class: "mt-10" },
				nav(
					ul(

	);
}

function SlideoverContent() {
	return div(

			class: "flex h-full flex-col overflow-y-scroll shadow-xl bg-white",
		},
		SlideoverHeader(),
		div({ class: "relative mt-6 flex-1 px-4 sm:px-6" }, Reports()),
	);
}

van.add(slideoverContent, SlideoverContent());

function toggleSlideover() {
	if (slideoverOpen) {
		// closing
		slideoverOpen = false;
		slideover.dataset.opening = false;

		// TODO: should this use requestanimationframe??
		setTimeout(() => {
			slideover.dataset.open = slideoverOpen;
		}, 500);
	} else {
		// opening
		// - first show the elements
		// - then transition

		slideoverOpen = true;
		slideover.dataset.open = true;

		// run in next render
		setTimeout(() => {
			slideover.dataset.opening = true;
		}, 0);
	}
}

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
	if (slideoverOpen && e.code === "Escape") {
		toggleSlideover();
	}
});

const slideovers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-slideover]");

for (const s of slideovers) {
	s.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
		const option = e.currentTarget.dataset.option;
		const faID = e.currentTarget.dataset.faid;
		const fa = e.currentTarget.dataset.fa;

		setSlideoverContent(option, fa, faID);
		toggleSlideover();
	});
}

function setSlideoverContent(option, fa, faID) {
	optionState.val = {
		Option: option,
		Fa: fa,
		FaID: faID,
	};

	// filter reports on fa and kind
	reportsState.val = userData.Reports.filter((r) => {
		const isFa = faID === r.FunctionalArea;
		if (!isFa) {
			return false;
		}

		switch (option) {
			case "dashboards":
				if (r.Type === "LOOKER" || r.Type === "HEX") {
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case "reports":
				return r.Type === "JASPER";
			case "tools":
				return r.Type === "TOOL";
			default:
				console.log(`invalid option ${option}`);
				return false;
		}
	});
}

function setSlideoverOption(option) {
	setSlideoverContent(option, optionState.val.Fa, optionState.val.FaID);
}

slideoverClickaway.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
	if (!slideoverContent.contains(e.target)) {
		toggleSlideover();
	}
});
```

```js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const previewBtn = document.getElementById("preview-btn");
    const modal = document.getElementById("preview-modal");
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById("close-preview-btn");
    const modalBackdrop = modal.querySelector(".fixed.inset-0.bg-gray-500");

    const previewContent = document.getElementById("preview-content");

    if (!previewBtn || !modal || !closeBtn || !previewContent) {
        return;
    }
    
    // Get the target textarea from the button's data attribute
    const textareaId = previewBtn.dataset.target;
    const textarea = document.getElementById(textareaId);

    if (!textarea) {
        return;
    }

    const openModal = () => {
        previewContent.innerHTML = textarea.value;
        modal.classList.remove("hidden");
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
        modal.classList.add("hidden");
        previewContent.innerHTML = ""; // Clear content
    };

    previewBtn.addEventListener("click", openModal);
    closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
    modalBackdrop.addEventListener("click", closeModal);

    // Optional: Close modal with Escape key
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape" && !modal.classList.contains("hidden")) {
            closeModal();
        }
    });
});
```

## File: app\assets\scripts\html_toolbar.js
```js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-toolbar-for]').forEach(toolbar => {
        const textareaId = toolbar.dataset.toolbarFor;
        const textarea = document.getElementById(textareaId);
        if (!textarea) return;

        const insertTag = (tag) => {
            const start = textarea.selectionStart;
            const end = textarea.selectionEnd;
            const selectedText = textarea.value.substring(start, end);
            let replacement = '';

            switch (tag) {
                case 'a':
                    const url = prompt('Enter URL:', 'https://');
                    if (url) {
                        replacement = `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${selectedText || 'link text'}</a>`;
                    } else {
                        return; // User canceled prompt
                    }
                    break;
                case 'img':
                    const imgUrl = prompt('Enter Image URL:', 'https://');
                    if (imgUrl) {
                        const altText = prompt('Enter Alt Text:', selectedText || 'image description');
                        replacement = `<img src="${imgUrl}" alt="${altText}" />`;
                    } else {
                        return;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'video':
                    const videoUrl = prompt('Enter Video URL:', 'https://');
                    if (videoUrl) {
                        replacement = `<video controls width="100%"><source src="${videoUrl}" type="video/mp4">Your browser does not support the video tag.</video>`;
                    } else {
                        return;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'ul':
                case 'ol':
                    const items = selectedText.split('\n').map(line => `\t<li>${line}</li>`).join('\n');
                    replacement = `<${tag}>\n${items || '\t<li>List item</li>'}\n</${tag}>`;
                    break;
                 case 'hr':
                    replacement = '\n<hr>\n';
                    // For hr, we insert at the end of the line
                    const currentLineStart = textarea.value.lastIndexOf('\n', start - 1) + 1;
                    textarea.setRangeText(replacement, currentLineStart, currentLineStart, 'end');
                    textarea.focus();
                    textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                    return; // exit early
                case 'blockquote':
                     const quotedText = selectedText.split('\n').map(line => `\t<p>${line}</p>`).join('\n');
                     replacement = `<blockquote>\n${quotedText || '\t<p>Quote...</p>'}\n</blockquote>`;
                    break;
                default:
                    replacement = `<${tag}>${selectedText}</${tag}>`;
            }

            textarea.setRangeText(replacement, start, end, 'select');
            textarea.focus();
            
            // Trigger an input event so any other scripts listening for changes will update
            textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        };
        
        const formatTextareaContent = () => {
            // This is a simple formatter and may not work perfectly with badly-formed HTML.
            const format = (html, indentChar = '  ') => {
                let indent = '';
                let result = '';
                // Split by tags, but keep the tags and handle text nodes correctly
                const lines = html.split(/(<[^>]+>)/g).filter(s => s.trim().length > 0);
        
                lines.forEach(line => {
                    const trimmedLine = line.trim();
                    if (!trimmedLine) return;

                    // Closing tag: decrease indent before printing
                    if (trimmedLine.startsWith('</')) {
                        indent = indent.substring(indentChar.length);
                    }
                    
                    result += indent + trimmedLine + '\n';
                    
                    // Opening tag (but not self-closing): increase indent after printing
                    const isOpeningTag = trimmedLine.startsWith('<') && !trimmedLine.startsWith('</');
                    const isSelfClosing = trimmedLine.endsWith('/>') || ['<br>', '<hr>', '<img>', '<input>'].some(tag => trimmedLine.startsWith(tag));
                    
                    if (isOpeningTag && !isSelfClosing) {
                        indent += indentChar;
                    }
                });
                
                return result.trim();
            };

            const formattedHtml = format(textarea.value);
            textarea.value = formattedHtml;
            textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        };

        toolbar.querySelectorAll('button[data-tag]').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                insertTag(button.dataset.tag);
            });
        });

        toolbar.querySelectorAll('button[data-action]').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (button.dataset.action === 'format') {
                    formatTextareaContent();
                }
            });
        });
    });
});
```

```js
        p(() => `Showing ${filteredJobConfigs.val.length} of ${jobConfigs.val.length} job configs.`),
        div({ class: "mt-4" },
            div(
                label({ for: "search-jobs", class: "block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-gray-900" }, "Search Job Configs"),
                input({
                    id: "search-jobs",
                    class: "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 p-2 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                    placeholder: "Search by name...",
                    type: "text",
                    value: fuzzyFilter,
                    oninput: (e) => { updateFilter(e.target.value); },
                })
            )
        )
    );
}

function createKeyValueEditor({ outputAsArrayOfObjects = false, showCronDescription = false } = {}) {
        const pairs = van.state([]);
        const lastJobKey = van.state(null);
    
        return function KeyValueEditor({ objectKey, initialValue, onUpdate, jobKey }) {
           van.derive(() => {
                if (lastJobKey.val !== jobKey) {
                    lastJobKey.val = jobKey;
                    
                    pairs.val = Object.entries(initialValue || {}).map(([key, value]) =>
                        van.state({ id: Math.random(), key, value: String(value) })
                    );
                }
            });
    
            const notifyUpdate = () => {
                if (outputAsArrayOfObjects) {
                     const newArray = pairs.val.map(pairState => {
                        const pair = pairState.val;
                        if (pair.key.trim()) {
                            return { [pair.key.trim()]: pair.value };
                        }
                        return null;
                    }).filter(p => p && Object.keys(p).length > 0);
                    onUpdate(objectKey, newArray);
                } else {
                    const newObject = pairs.val.reduce((acc, pairState) => {
                        const pair = pairState.val;
                        if (pair.key.trim()) {
                            acc[pair.key.trim()] = pair.value;
                        }
                        return acc;
                    }, {});
                    onUpdate(objectKey, newObject);
                }
            };
    
            const addPair = () => {
                const newPair = van.state({ id: Math.random(), key: "", value: "" });
                pairs.val = [...pairs.val, newPair];
            };
    
            const removePair = (id) => {
                pairs.val = pairs.val.filter(pState => pState.val.id !== id);
                notifyUpdate(); // Notify on removal
            };
    
            const updatePair = (id, part, value) => {
                const pairState = pairs.val.find(p => p.val.id === id);
                if (pairState) {
                    pairState.val = { ...pairState.val, [part]: value };
                }
            };
    
             return div({ class: "space-y-2" },
                () => div(pairs.val.map(pairState =>
                    div({ key: pairState.val.id, class: "space-y-1" },
                        div({ class: "flex items-center gap-2" },
                            input({
                                type: "text",
                                class: "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                                placeholder: "key",
                                value: () => pairState.val.key,
                                onchange: (e) => {
                                    updatePair(pairState.val.id, 'key', e.target.value);
                                    notifyUpdate();
                                }
                            }),
                            input({
                                type: "text",
                                class: "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                                placeholder: "value",
                                value: () => pairState.val.value,
                                onchange: (e) => {
                                    updatePair(pairState.val.id, 'value', e.target.value);
                                    notifyUpdate();
                                }
                            }),
                            button({
                                type: "button",
                                class: "mt-1 p-2 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 flex items-center justify-center",
                                onclick: () => removePair(pairState.val.id)
                            }, span({ class: "text-2xl font-mono leading-none" }, "−"))
                        ),
                        () => showCronDescription ? p({ class: "text-xs text-gray-500 ml-1" }, (() => {
                                const cronValue = pairState.val.value;
                                if (!cronValue) return "";
                                try {
                                    return cronstrue.toString(cronValue);
                                } catch (e) {
                                    return e.toString();
                                }
                            })()
                        ) : null
                    )
                )),
                button({
                    type: "button",
                    class: "mt-2 px-3 py-1 text-sm border rounded hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-1",
                    onclick: addPair
                },
                    span({ class: "text-lg font-mono leading-none" }, "+"),
                    "Add"
                )
            );
        }
    }

const CronOverrideEditor = createKeyValueEditor({ showCronDescription: true });
const UstcOverrideEditor = createKeyValueEditor({ outputAsArrayOfObjects: true });
const UstcExclusionsEditor = createValueListEditor();
const CountryEmailListEditor = createCountryEmailListEditor();

function createCountryEmailListEditor() {
    const pairs = van.state([]);
    const lastJobKey = van.state(null);

    return function CountryEmailListEditor({ objectKey, initialValue, onUpdate, jobKey }) {
        van.derive(() => {
            if (lastJobKey.val !== jobKey) {
                lastJobKey.val = jobKey;
                pairs.val = Object.entries(initialValue || {}).map(([key, value]) =>
                    van.state({ id: Math.random(), key, value: Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : "" })
                );
            }
        });

        const notifyUpdate = () => {
            const newObject = pairs.val.reduce((acc, pairState) => {
                const pair = pairState.val;
                if (pair.key.trim()) {
                    acc[pair.key.trim()] = pair.value.split(',').map(email => email.trim()).filter(email => email);
                }
                return acc;
            }, {});
            onUpdate(objectKey, newObject);
        };

        const addPair = () => {
            const newPair = van.state({ id: Math.random(), key: "", value: "" });
            pairs.val = [...pairs.val, newPair];
        };

        const removePair = (id) => {
            pairs.val = pairs.val.filter(pState => pState.val.id !== id);
            notifyUpdate();
        };

        const updatePair = (id, part, value) => {
            const pairState = pairs.val.find(p => p.val.id === id);
            if (pairState) {
                pairState.val = { ...pairState.val, [part]: value };
            }
        };

        return div({ class: "space-y-2" },
            () => div(pairs.val.map(pairState =>
                div({ key: pairState.val.id, class: "flex items-center gap-2" },
                    select({
                        class: "mt-1 block w-1/3 rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                        onchange: (e) => {
                            updatePair(pairState.val.id, 'key', e.target.value);
                            notifyUpdate();
                        }
                    },
                        option({ value: "", selected: () => !pairState.val.key }, "Country..."),
                        option({ value: "all", selected: () => pairState.val.key === "all" }, "all"),
                        ...countries.map(c => option({ value: c, selected: () => pairState.val.key === c }, c.toUpperCase()))
                    ),
                    textarea({
                        rows: 2,
                        class: "mt-1 block w-2/3 rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                        placeholder: "Comma-separated emails",
                        value: () => pairState.val.value,
                        onchange: (e) => { // Changed from oninput
                            updatePair(pairState.val.id, 'value', e.target.value);
                            notifyUpdate();
                        }
                    }),
                    button({
                        type: "button",
                        class: "mt-1 p-2 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 flex-shrink-0",
                        onclick: () => removePair(pairState.val.id)
                    }, span({ class: "text-2xl font-mono leading-none" }, "−"))
                )
            )),
            button({
                type: "button",
                class: "mt-2 px-3 py-1 text-sm border rounded hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-1",
                onclick: addPair
            },
                span({ class: "text-lg font-mono leading-none" }, "+"),
                "Add Recipient Group"
            )
        );
    }
}

function createValueListEditor() {
    const items = van.state([]);
    const lastJobKey = van.state(null);

    return function ValueListEditor({ objectKey, initialValue, onUpdate, jobKey }) {
        van.derive(() => {
            if (lastJobKey.val !== jobKey) {
                lastJobKey.val = jobKey;
                // initialValue is expected to be an array of strings
                const initialArray = Array.isArray(initialValue) ? initialValue : [];
                items.val = initialArray.map(value =>
                    van.state({ id: Math.random(), value: String(value) })
                );
            }
        });

        const notifyUpdate = () => {
            const newArray = items.val
                .map(itemState => itemState.val.value.trim())
                .filter(value => value); // Filter out empty strings
            onUpdate(objectKey, newArray);
        };

        const addItem = () => {
            const newItem = van.state({ id: Math.random(), value: "" });
            items.val = [...items.val, newItem];
        };

        const removeItem = (id) => {
            items.val = items.val.filter(itemState => itemState.val.id !== id);
            notifyUpdate();
        };

        const updateItem = (id, value) => {
            const itemState = items.val.find(item => item.val.id === id);
            if (itemState) {
                itemState.val = { ...itemState.val, value };
            }
        };

        return div({ class: "space-y-2" },
            () => div(items.val.map(itemState =>
                div({ key: itemState.val.id, class: "flex items-center gap-2" },
                    input({
                        type: "text",
                        class: "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                        placeholder: "value",
                        value: () => itemState.val.value,
                        onchange: (e) => {
                            updateItem(itemState.val.id, e.target.value);
                            notifyUpdate();
                        }
                    }),
                    button({
                        type: "button",
                        class: "mt-1 p-2 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 flex items-center justify-center",
                        onclick: () => removeItem(itemState.val.id)
                    }, span({ class: "text-2xl font-mono leading-none" }, "−"))
                )
            )),
            button({
                type: "button",
                class: "mt-2 px-3 py-1 text-sm border rounded hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-1",
                onclick: addItem
            },
                span({ class: "text-lg font-mono leading-none" }, "+"),
                "Add"
            )
        );
    }
}

function MailingListConfigEditor({ objectKey, initialValue, onUpdate, jobKey }) {
    const config = van.state(initialValue || { send_email: false, receipt_emails: {} });

    const lastJobKey = van.state(null);
    van.derive(() => {
        if (lastJobKey.val !== jobKey) {
            lastJobKey.val = jobKey;
            config.val = initialValue || { send_email: false, receipt_emails: {} };
        }
    });

    const notifyParent = (newConfig) => {
        onUpdate(objectKey, newConfig);
    };

    const updateField = (field, value) => {
        const newConfig = { ...config.val, [field]: value };
        config.val = newConfig;
        notifyParent(newConfig);
    };

    const isEnabled = () => config.val.send_email;

    return div({ class: "space-y-4 border border-gray-200 p-3 rounded-md" },
        div({ class: "flex items-center" },
            input({
                type: 'checkbox',
                class: "h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light",
                checked: isEnabled,
                onchange: e => updateField('send_email', e.target.checked)
            }),
            label({ class: "ml-2 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, fieldLabels['send_email'])
        ),
        () => isEnabled() ? div({ class: "pl-6 space-y-4 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4" },
            div(
                label({ class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, fieldLabels['receipt_emails']),
                CountryEmailListEditor({
                    objectKey: 'receipt_emails',
                    initialValue: config.val.receipt_emails,
                    onUpdate: (key, value) => updateField(key, value),
                    jobKey: `${jobKey}-receipt_emails`
                })
            )
        ) : div()
    );
}

function UpdateSourceTablesConfigEditor({ objectKey, initialValue, onUpdate, jobKey }) {
    const config = van.state(initialValue || { is_enabled: false, max_staleness: '', override: {}, exclusions: {} });

    const lastJobKey = van.state(null);
    van.derive(() => {
        if (lastJobKey.val !== jobKey) {
            lastJobKey.val = jobKey;
            config.val = initialValue || { is_enabled: false, max_staleness: '', override: {}, exclusions: {} };
        }
    });

    const notifyParent = (newConfig) => {
        onUpdate(objectKey, newConfig);
    };

    const updateField = (field, value) => {
        const newConfig = { ...config.val, [field]: value };
        config.val = newConfig;
        notifyParent(newConfig);
    };

    const isEnabled = () => config.val.is_enabled;

    return div({ class: "space-y-4 border border-gray-200 p-3 rounded-md" },
        div({ class: "flex items-center" },
            input({
                type: 'checkbox',
                class: "h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light",
                checked: isEnabled,
                onchange: e => updateField('is_enabled', e.target.checked)
            }),
            label({ class: "ml-2 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, fieldLabels['is_enabled'] || "is_enabled")
        ),
        () => isEnabled() ? div({ class: "pl-6 space-y-4 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4" },
            div(
                label({ class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, fieldLabels['max_staleness'] || "max_staleness"),
                input({
                    type: "number",
                    placeholder: "e.g., 30",
                    class: "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                    value: () => config.val.max_staleness ?? '',
                    onchange: e => updateField('max_staleness', e.target.value === '' ? null : Number(e.target.value))
                })
            ),
            div(
                label({ class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, fieldLabels['override'] || "Override"),
                UstcOverrideEditor({
                    objectKey: 'override',
                    initialValue: config.val.override,
                    onUpdate: (key, value) => updateField(key, value),
                    jobKey: `${jobKey}-override`
                })
            ),
            div(
                label({ class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, fieldLabels['exclusions'] || "Exclusions"),
                UstcExclusionsEditor({
                    objectKey: 'exclusions',
                    initialValue: config.val.exclusions,
                    onUpdate: (key, value) => updateField(key, value),
                    jobKey: `${jobKey}-exclusions`
                })
            )
        ) : div()
    );
}

function JobConfigTable() {
    return div({ class: "overflow-x-auto" },
        table({ class: "min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-300" },
            thead(
                tr(
                    th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900" }, "Name"),
                    th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900" }, "Active"),
                    th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900" }, "Type"),
                    th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900" }, "Update Source"),
                    th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900" }, "Email Sending"),
                    th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900" }, "Schedule/Cron"),
                    th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900" }, "Country Cron Override"),
                    th({ class: "relative py-3.5 pl-3 pr-4 sm:pr-0" }, span({ class: "sr-only" }, "Edit"))
                )
            ),
            () => tbody({ class: "divide-y divide-gray-200 bg-white" },
                filteredJobConfigs.val.map(job =>
                    tr(
                        td({ class: "whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500" }, job.Properties.name || ""),
                        td({ class: "whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500" }, job.Properties.active ? "✅" : "❌"),
                        td({ class: "whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500" }, job.Properties.type || ""),
                        td({ class: "whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500" }, 
                            (job.Properties.update_source_tables_config && job.Properties.update_source_tables_config.is_enabled) ? "✅" : "❌"
                        ),
                        td({ class: "whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500" },
                            (job.Properties.mailing_list && job.Properties.mailing_list.send_email) ? "✅" : "❌"
                        ),
                        td({ class: "whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500" }, () => {
                            let schedule = job.Properties.schedule_tags;
                            if (Array.isArray(schedule)) {
                                schedule = schedule[0];
                            }
                            return schedule || job.Properties.cron_default || "";
                        }),
                        td({ class: "whitespace-normal px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500 text-left" }, () => {
                            const overrides = job.Properties.cron_override;
                            if (overrides && typeof overrides === 'object' && Object.keys(overrides).length > 0) {
                                return div(
                                    Object.entries(overrides).map(([country, cron]) => 
                                        div(`${country.toUpperCase()}: ${cron}`)
                                    )
                                );
                            }
                            return ""; // Return empty string if no overrides
                        }),
                        td({ class: "relative whitespace-nowrap py-4 pl-3 pr-4 text-right text-sm font-medium sm:pr-0" },
                            button({ class: "text-green-x-light hover:text-green-x-dark", onclick: () => openEditSlider(job) }, "Edit")
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    );
}

function EditSlideover() {
        const slideoverContainer = div({ class: "pointer-events-none fixed inset-y-0 right-0 flex max-w-full pl-10" },
            div({ class: "pointer-events-auto w-screen max-w-md transform transition ease-in-out duration-500 sm:duration-700 translate-x-full group-data-[opening=true]:translate-x-0" },
                () => {
                    if (!slideoverOpen.val) return div();
    
                      const formFields = allJobConfigFields.map(key => {
                    const schema = jobConfigSchema[key];
                    const labelText = fieldLabels[key] || key; // Get the friendly label, fallback to key

                    const isVisible = () => {
                        const type = tempJobData.val.type;
                        if (!type) return true;
                        if (type === 'cloud-function') {
                            return 
!['repository', 'unique_tag', 'update_source_tables_config'].includes(key)

;
                        }
                        if (type === 'dataform') {
                            return key !== 'link';
                        }
                        return true;
                    };

                    const containerProps = { class: () => isVisible() ? "" : "hidden" };

                    if (key === 'type') {
                        return div(
                            label({ for: key, class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText),
                            select({
                                id: key,
                                class: "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                                onchange: (e) => handleInputChange(key, e.target.value)
                            },
                                option({ value: "", selected: () => !tempJobData.val[key] }, "Select type..."),
                                option({ value: "dataform", selected: () => tempJobData.val[key] === 'dataform' }, "dataform"),
                                option({ value: "cloud-function", selected: () => tempJobData.val[key] === 'cloud-function' }, "cloud-function")
                            )
                        );
                    }
                    if (key === 'update_source_tables_config') {
                        return div(containerProps,
                            label({ for: key, class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText),
                            UpdateSourceTablesConfigEditor({
                                objectKey: key,
                                initialValue: selectedJob.val?.Properties[key],
                                onUpdate: handleInputChange,
                                jobKey: selectedJob.val?.EncodedKey || 'new-job'
                            })
                        );
                    }

                    if (key === 'mailing_list') {
            return div(containerProps,
                label({ for: key, class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText),
                MailingListConfigEditor({
                    objectKey: key,
                    initialValue: selectedJob.val?.Properties[key],
                    onUpdate: handleInputChange,
                    jobKey: selectedJob.val?.EncodedKey || 'new-job'
                })
            );
        }

                    if (key === 'schedule_tags') {
                        return div(containerProps,
                            label({ for: key, class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText),
                            select({
                                id: key,
                                class: "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm",
                                onchange: (e) => handleInputChange(key, e.target.value)
                            },
                                option({ value: "", selected: () => (tempJobData.val[key] || "") === "" }, ""),
                                option({ value: "cyclical", selected: () => tempJobData.val[key] === 'cyclical' }, "cyclical")
                            )
                        );
                    }

                    if (key === 'countries_override') {
                        const isOpen = van.state(false);
                        const selected = () => new Set(Array.isArray(tempJobData.val[key]) ? tempJobData.val[key] : []);

                        const toggleCountry = (countryCode, checked) => {
                            const currentSelection = selected();
                            if (checked) {
                                currentSelection.add(countryCode);
                            } else {
                                currentSelection.delete(countryCode);
                            }
                            handleInputChange(key, Array.from(currentSelection));
                        };

                        return div(containerProps,
                            label({ class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText),
                            div({ class: "relative mt-1" },
                                button({
                                    type: "button",
                                    class: "relative w-full cursor-default rounded-md bg-white py-1.5 pl-3 pr-10 text-left text-gray-900 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm sm:leading-6",
                                    onclick: () => isOpen.val = !isOpen.val
                                },
                                    () => `${selected().size} selected`,
                                    span({ class: "pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center pr-2" },
                                        svg({ class: "h-5 w-5 text-gray-400", viewBox: "0 0 20 20", fill: "currentColor", "aria-hidden": "true" },
                                            path({ "fill-rule": "evenodd", d: "M10 3a.75.75 0 01.53.22l3.5 3.5a.75.75 0 01-1.06 1.06L10 4.81 6.53 8.28a.75.75 0 01-1.06-1.06l3.5-3.5A.75.75 0 0110 3zm-3.72 9.28a.75.75 0 011.06 0L10 15.19l3.47-3.47a.75.75 0 111.06 1.06l-4 4a.75.75 0 01-1.06 0l-4-4a.75.75 0 010-1.06z", "clip-rule": "evenodd" })
                                        )
                                    )
                                ),
                                () => isOpen.val ? div({ class: "absolute z-10 mt-1 max-h-60 w-full overflow-auto rounded-md bg-white py-1 text-base shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black ring-opacity-5 focus:outline-none sm:text-sm" },
                                    countries.map(c => label({ class: "relative flex items-center py-2 pl-3 pr-9 text-gray-900 cursor-pointer select-none hover:bg-gray-100" },
                                        input({
                                            type: "checkbox",
                                            class: "h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light",
                                            checked: () => selected().has(c),
                                            onchange: (e) => toggleCountry(c, e.target.checked)
                                        }),
                                        span({ class: "ml-3 block truncate" }, c.toUpperCase())
                                    ))
                                ) : div()
                            )
                        );
                    }

                    if (key === 'cron_override') {
                        const isCyclical = () => tempJobData.val.schedule_tags === 'cyclical';
                        const containerProps = { class: () => isVisible() ? "" : "hidden" };

        return div(containerProps,
            label({ for: key, class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText),
            () => {
                if (isCyclical()) {
                    return div({ class: "mt-1 p-2 bg-gray-100 rounded-md text-sm text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed border border-gray-300" },
                        "Disabled when schedule_tags is cyclical"
                    );
                }
                return CronOverrideEditor({
                    objectKey: key,
                    initialValue: tempJobData.val[key],
                    onUpdate: handleInputChange,
                    jobKey: selectedJob.val?.EncodedKey || 'new-job'
                });
            }
        );
    }

                    if (schema.type === 'boolean') {
                        return div({ ...containerProps, class: () => (isVisible() ? "flex items-center" : "hidden") },
                            input({
                                id: key,
                                type: 'checkbox',
                                checked: () => !!tempJobData.val[key],
                                class: "h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light",
                                onchange: (e) => handleInputChange(key, e.target.checked)
                            }),
                            label({ for: key, class: "ml-3 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText)
                        );
                    }

                    const isJson = schema.type === 'object';
                     const Tag = isJson ? textarea : input;
                        const isCronField = key === 'cron_default' || key === 'cron_override';
                        const isCyclical = () => tempJobData.val.schedule_tags === 'cyclical';

                    const valueFunc = () => {
                        const currentValue = tempJobData.val[key];
                        if (currentValue === undefined || currentValue === null) return '';
                        if (isJson) {
                            try { return JSON.stringify(currentValue, null, 2); } catch { return String(currentValue); }
                        }
                        return String(currentValue);
                    };

                    const inputEl = Tag({
                            id: key,
                            type: isJson ? undefined : "text",
                            rows: isJson ? () => Math.min(20, (valueFunc().match(/\n/g) || []).length + 2) : undefined,
                            class: () => "mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border-gray-300 shadow-sm focus:border-green-x-light focus:ring-green-x-light sm:text-sm" +
                                (isJson ? " font-mono text-xs" : "") +
                                ((isCronField && isCyclical()) ? " bg-gray-100 cursor-not-allowed" : ""),
                            value: valueFunc,
                            disabled: () => isCronField && isCyclical(),
                            oninput: (e) => handleInputChange(key, e.target.value)
                        });
    
                        const cronDescription = () => {
                            if (key !== 'cron_default' || (isCronField && isCyclical())) return null;
                            const cronValue = tempJobData.val[key];
                            if (!cronValue) return "";
                            try {
                                return cronstrue.toString(cronValue);
                            } catch (e) {
                                return e.toString();
                            }
                        };

                    return div(containerProps,
                            label({ for: key, class: "block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700" }, labelText),
                            inputEl,
                            p({ class: "mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500"}, cronDescription)
                        );
                    });

                const formEl = van.tags.form({ class: "space-y-6" }, ...formFields);

                return div({ class: "flex h-full flex-col overflow-y-scroll bg-white shadow-xl" },
                    div({ class: "bg-green-x-light px-4 py-6 sm:px-6" },
                        div({ class: "flex items-center justify-between" },
                            h2({ class: "text-base font-semibold leading-6 text-white" }, () => selectedJob.val ? `Edit: ${selectedJob.val?.Properties?.name || 'Job'}` : 'Add New Job Config'),
                            button({ type: "button", class: "relative rounded-md bg-green-x-light text-white hover:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white", onclick: toggleSlideover },
                                svg({ class: "h-6 w-6", fill: "none", viewBox: "0 0 24 24", "stroke-width": "1.5", stroke: "currentColor" },
                                    path({ "stroke-linecap": "round", "stroke-linejoin": "round", d: "M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" })
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                    div({ class: "relative flex-1 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6" }, formEl),
                    div({ class: "flex flex-shrink-0 justify-end px-4 py-4" },
                        button({ type: "button", class: "rounded-md bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50", onclick: toggleSlideover }, "Cancel"),
                        button({ type: "button", class: "ml-4 inline-flex justify-center items-center rounded-md bg-green-x-light px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-green-x-dark focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-x-light", onclick: saveChanges, disabled: isSaving },
                            () => isSaving.val ? LoadingSpinner() : "Save"
                        )
                    )
                );
            }
        )
    );
    
    return div({ class: "group relative z-50", "data-open": slideoverOpen, "data-opening": slideoverOpening, "aria-modal": "true" },
        div({
            class: "hidden group-data-[open=true]:block fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity opacity-0 group-data-[opening=true]:opacity-100",
            onclick: toggleSlideover
        }),
        slideoverContainer
    );
}

// --- Logic ---
function toggleSlideover() {
    if (slideoverOpen.val) {
        slideoverOpening.val = false;
        setTimeout(() => {
            slideoverOpen.val = false;
            selectedJob.val = null;
        }, 500);
    } else {
        slideoverOpen.val = true;
        setTimeout(() => slideoverOpening.val = true, 10);
    }
}

function openEditSlider(job) {
    selectedJob.val = job;
    const properties = { ...job.Properties };

    // Normalize schedule_tags which might be an array from older data
    if (Array.isArray(properties.schedule_tags)) {
        properties.schedule_tags = properties.schedule_tags[0] || "";
    }

    tempJobData.val = properties;
    toggleSlideover();
}

function openAddSlider() {
    selectedJob.val = null; // Mark as new job
    tempJobData.val = { active: true }; // Start with empty data, but active true
    toggleSlideover();
}

function handleInputChange(key, value) {
    const newData = { ...tempJobData.val };
    newData[key] = value;
    tempJobData.val = newData;
}

async function saveChanges() {
    if (isSaving.val) return;
    isSaving.val = true;

    const isNew = !selectedJob.val;
    const key = isNew ? '' : selectedJob.val.EncodedKey;
    const url = isNew ? '/api/admin/jobconfig' : `/api/admin/jobconfig/${key}`;
    
    const payloadToSave = {};
    try {
        for (const field of allJobConfigFields) {
            const rawValue = tempJobData.val[field];
            const schema = jobConfigSchema[field];

            if (rawValue === undefined || rawValue === null || rawValue === '') {
                if (schema.type === 'boolean') {
                    payloadToSave[field] = false;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if (schema.type === 'boolean') {
                payloadToSave[field] = Boolean(rawValue);
            } else if (schema.type === 'object' && typeof rawValue === 'string') {
                 payloadToSave[field] = JSON.parse(rawValue);
            } else {
                 payloadToSave[field] = rawValue;
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        alert(`Invalid JSON format in one of the fields. Please correct it before saving. Error: ${e.message}`);
        isSaving.val = false;
        return;
    }


    try {
        const response = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Auth': authToken },
            body: JSON.stringify(payloadToSave)
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            const errorText = await response.text();
            throw new Error(`Failed to save: ${response.status} ${errorText}`);
        }
        
        if (isNew) {
            const newJob = await response.json();
            const newJobs = [...jobConfigs.val, newJob];
            newJobs.sort((a, b) => (a.Properties.name || "").localeCompare(b.Properties.name || ""));
            jobConfigs.val = newJobs;
        } else {
            jobConfigs.val = jobConfigs.val.map(job =>
                job.EncodedKey === key ? { ...job, Properties: payloadToSave } : job
            );
        }

        toggleSlideover();
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Save failed:", error);
        alert(`Error saving changes: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
        isSaving.val = false;
    }
}

// --- App Initialization ---
const App = () => div(
    Filters(),
    div({ class: "mt-4" }, JobConfigTable()),
    EditSlideover()
);

van.add(container, App());

const addJobBtn = document.getElementById("add-job-btn");
if (addJobBtn) {
    addJobBtn.addEventListener("click", openAddSlider);
}
```

```js
		},

				},
				slideoverContent,
			),
		),
	);

	slideoverClickaway.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
		if (!slideoverContent.contains(e.target)) {
			toggleSlideover();
		}
	});

	return div(
		{
			id: "slideover",
			"data-open": () => (slideoverOpen.val ? "true" : "false"),

function updateLoadJobEnabled(db, table, enabled) {
	syncingState.val = true;

	const uri = "/api/updateloadjobenabled";

	const body = {
		Database: db,
		Table: table,
		CC: cc,
		Enabled: enabled,
	};

	fetch(uri, {
		method: "POST",
		body: JSON.stringify(body),
		headers: {
			"Content-Type": "application/json",
			Auth: authToken,
		},
	})
		.then((response) => {
			if (!response.ok) {
				throw new Error(`Failed to update: ${response.statusText}`);
			}
			// Update local state on success
			loadJobsData.val = loadJobsData.val.map((job) => {
				if (job.Name === table && job.Database === db) {
					return { ...job, HasGcsData: enabled };
				}
				return job;
			});
		})
		.catch((error) => {
			console.error("Error updating load job:", error);
			alert("Update failed. The page will be reloaded to ensure data consistency.");
			window.location.reload();
		})
		.finally(() => {
			syncingState.val = false;
		});
}
```

```js
const popup = document.getElementById("ujuzi-popup");
const popupTitle = document.getElementById("ujuzi-popup-title");
const popupMessage = document.getElementById("ujuzi-popup-message");
const popupConfirmBtn = document.getElementById("ujuzi-popup-confirm-btn");
const popupCancelBtn = document.getElementById("ujuzi-popup-cancel-btn");
const popupContainer = popup.querySelector(".fixed.inset-0.z-10");

let onConfirmCallback = null;
let onCancelCallback = null;

function hidePopup(isConfirm = false) {
	popup.classList.add("hidden");
	if (isConfirm) {
		if (onConfirmCallback) onConfirmCallback();
	} else {
		if (onCancelCallback) onCancelCallback();
	}
	onConfirmCallback = null;
	onCancelCallback = null;
}

popupConfirmBtn.addEventListener("click", () => hidePopup(true));
if (popupCancelBtn) {
    popupCancelBtn.addEventListener("click", () => hidePopup(false));
}
popupContainer.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (e.target === popupContainer) {
        hidePopup(false);
    }
});

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
	if (e.key === "Escape" && !popup.classList.contains("hidden")) {
		hidePopup(false);
	}
});

/**
 * Shows a custom popup modal.
 * @param {string} title - The title of the popup.
 * @param {string} message - The message to display in the popup.
 * @param {object|function} [options] - Options for the popup or a single onConfirm callback.
 * @param {string} [options.confirmText='Confirm'] - Text for the confirm button.
 * @param {function} [options.onConfirm] - Callback for confirm button.
 * @param {string} [options.cancelText] - Text for the cancel button. If provided, the button is shown.
 * @param {function} [options.onCancel] - Callback for cancel button.
 */
window.showUjuziPopup = (title, message, options) => {
	if (!popup || !popupTitle || !popupMessage || !popupConfirmBtn) {
		console.error("Popup elements not found!");
		alert(`${title}\n\n${message}`);
		if (typeof options === 'function') {
			options();
		} else if (options && options.onConfirm) {
			options.onConfirm();
		}
		return;
	}

	popupTitle.textContent = title;
	popupMessage.innerHTML = message;

	if (typeof options === 'function') {
		options = { onConfirm: options };
	}
	options = options || {};

	onConfirmCallback = options.onConfirm || null;
	onCancelCallback = options.onCancel || null;

	popupConfirmBtn.textContent = options.confirmText || 'Confirm';
	
	if (popupCancelBtn) {
        if (options.cancelText) {
            popupCancelBtn.textContent = options.cancelText;
            popupCancelBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            popupCancelBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    }
	
	popup.classList.remove("hidden");
};
```
