```js
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const ratingWidget = document.getElementById("rating-widget");
    if (!ratingWidget) return;

    // Add this to get the auth cookie
    const COOKIE = "UJUZI_AUTH";
    let authToken = "";
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(cookie => {
        const parts = cookie.split('=');
        const name = parts[0].trim();
        if (name === COOKIE) {
            authToken = parts[1];
        }
    });

    const toggleButton = document.getElementById("rating-toggle");
    const closeButton = document.getElementById("rating-close");
    const thumbButtons = ratingWidget.querySelectorAll(".rating-thumb");

    const feedbackForm = document.getElementById("feedback-form");
    const feedbackTextarea = document.getElementById("feedback-textarea");
    const feedbackSubmit = document.getElementById("feedback-submit");

    // New function to send data to the backend
    async function sendRating(rating, feedback = "") {
        const pathParts = window.location.pathname.split('/');
        const reportId = pathParts[pathParts.length - 1];
        
        // Extract report title and country code
        const reportTitle = document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent || 'Unknown Report';
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
		const cc = urlParams.get("cc");

        const payload = {
            reportId,
            reportTitle,
            cc,
            rating,
            feedback,
        };

        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/rate-report', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Auth': authToken,
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
            });
            return response.ok;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Error sending rating:", error);
            return false;
        }
    }

    function toggleWidget(open) {
        ratingWidget.dataset.state = open ? "open" : "closed"
        if (!open && feedbackForm) {
            feedbackForm.classList.add("hidden");
        };
    }

    toggleButton.addEventListener("click", () => toggleWidget(true));
    closeButton.addEventListener("click", () => toggleWidget(false));

    thumbButtons.forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", async () => { // Make async
            if (button.dataset.selected === "true") return;
            
            thumbButtons.forEach(btn => btn.dataset.selected = "false");
            button.dataset.selected = "true";
            
            const rating = button.dataset.rating;
            console.log(`User rated: ${rating}`);

            // Call the new sendRating function
            const success = await sendRating(rating);
            if (!success) {
                window.showUjuziPopup("Error", "Could not save your rating. Please try again.");
                // Revert UI changes if needed
                button.dataset.selected = "false";
                return;
            }

            if (feedbackForm) {
                if (rating === 'down') {
                    feedbackForm.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    feedbackForm.classList.add('hidden');
                    window.showUjuziPopup("Thank You!", "Your rating has been submitted.");
                    toggleWidget(false);
                }
            } else {
                window.showUjuziPopup("Thank You!", "Your rating has been submitted.");
                toggleWidget(false);
            }
        });
    });
    if (feedbackSubmit) {
        feedbackSubmit.addEventListener("click", async () => { // Make async
            const feedback = feedbackTextarea.value;
            const rating = ratingWidget.querySelector('.rating-thumb[data-selected="true"]')?.dataset.rating;

            if (feedback.trim() && rating) {
                console.log(`Feedback submitted: ${feedback}`);
                
                // Call sendRating with feedback
                const success = await sendRating(rating, feedback);

                if (success) {
                     const onConfirm = () => {
                        feedbackTextarea.value = "";
                        feedbackForm.classList.add("hidden");
                        toggleWidget(false);
                    };
                    window.showUjuziPopup(
                        "Feedback Submitted",
                        "Thank you for your feedback!",
                        onConfirm
                    );
                } else {
                     window.showUjuziPopup(
                        "Error",
                        "Could not submit your feedback. Please try again."
                    );
                }
            } else {
                window.showUjuziPopup(
                    "Input Required",
                    "Please enter your feedback before submitting."
                );
            }
        });
    }
});
```

## File: app\assets\scripts\report_search.js
```js
import Fuse from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fuse.js@7.0.0/dist/fuse.mjs";

// =============================================================================
// REPORT SEARCH — INLINE DROPDOWN
//
// Used by the home dashboard's header search input. As the user types,
// fuzzy-match against the userdata Reports list and render up to 5 results
// in #report-search-dropdown directly below the input.
//
// Behaviour:
//   - Empty input → dropdown hidden.
//   - Input with no matches → "No reports found" placeholder.
//   - Click a result → swap the home #report-iframe to that report (with
//     embedded=true), clear the input, hide the dropdown. Falls back to a
//     full navigation when no #report-iframe is on the page (e.g. someone
//     drops the same input on a non-home page).
//   - Click outside the input or dropdown → hide.
// =============================================================================

const trigger = document.getElementById("report-search-trigger");
const dropdown = document.getElementById("report-search-dropdown");
const userdataEl = document.getElementById("userdata");

if (trigger && dropdown && userdataEl) {
	const userData = JSON.parse(userdataEl.dataset.userdata);
	const reportsData = userData.Reports || [];

	const fuse = new Fuse(reportsData, {
		keys: ["Title", "FunctionalArea", "Type"],
		threshold: 0.3,
	});

	const qs = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
	const cc = qs.get("cc") || "";
	const branch = qs.get("branch") || "";

	const escapeHtml = (s) => {
		const div = document.createElement("div");
		div.textContent = s == null ? "" : s;
		return div.innerHTML;
	};

	const close = () => {
		dropdown.classList.add("hidden");
		dropdown.innerHTML = "";
	};

	const renderResults = (q) => {
		const hits = fuse.search(q).slice(0, 5);
		if (hits.length === 0) {
			dropdown.innerHTML =
				'<div class="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-400 italic">No reports found</div>';
			dropdown.classList.remove("hidden");
			return;
		}
		dropdown.innerHTML = hits
			.map(({ item: r }) => {
				let href = `/reporting/${r.ID}?cc=${cc}&embedded=true`;
				if (branch) {
					href += `&branch=${encodeURIComponent(branch)}`;
				}
				if (r.Type === "GOOGLE_DOC" && r.Link) {
					href = r.Link;
				}
				return `<button type="button" data-href="${escapeHtml(href)}" class="block w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100">${escapeHtml(r.Title)}</button>`;
			})
			.join("");
		dropdown.classList.remove("hidden");
	};

	trigger.addEventListener("input", () => {
		const q = trigger.value.trim();
		if (q === "") {
			close();
			return;
		}
		renderResults(q);
	});

	trigger.addEventListener("focus", () => {
		const q = trigger.value.trim();
		if (q !== "") renderResults(q);
	});

	dropdown.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
		const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-href]");
		if (!btn) return;
		const href = btn.dataset.href;
		const iframe = document.getElementById("report-iframe");
		if (iframe) {
			iframe.src = href;
		} else {
			window.location.href = href;
		}
		trigger.value = "";
		close();
	});

	document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
		if (!trigger.contains(e.target) && !dropdown.contains(e.target)) {
			close();
		}
	});

	document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
		if (e.key === "Escape") {
			trigger.value = "";
			close();
			trigger.blur();
		}
	});
}
```

```js
async function toggleDeployment(reportID, reportTitle, countryCode, shouldDeploy) {
	const reportIndex = reportsData.val.findIndex(r => r.ID === reportID);
	if (reportIndex === -1) {
		console.error("Report with ID " + reportID + " not found for deployment toggle.");
		return;
	}

	// Create a deep copy of the entire list for potential revert
	const originalReports = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(reportsData.val));

	const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const currentCC = urlParams.get("cc");

	// 1. Optimistic UI update
	if (!shouldDeploy && countryCode === currentCC) {
		// If undeploying from the current country view, remove the item from the list
		reportsData.val = reportsData.val.filter(r => r.ID !== reportID);
	} else {
		reportsData.val = reportsData.val.map((report, index) => {
			if (index === reportIndex) {
				// Create a new report object with a new DeployedCountries object
				return {
					...report,
					DeployedCountries: {
						...report.DeployedCountries,
						[countryCode]: shouldDeploy,
					},
				};
			}
			// Return original objects for all other reports
			return report;
		});
	}

	// FIX: Update Fuse.js index immediately after optimistic update
	reportsFuse.setCollection(reportsData.val);

	try {
		const response = await fetch("/api/admin/toggle_report_deployment", {
			method: "POST",
			headers: {
				"Content-Type": "application/json",
				"Auth": authToken,
			},
			body: JSON.stringify({
				Title: reportTitle,
				CountryCode: countryCode,
				Deploy: shouldDeploy,
			}),
		});

		if (!response.ok) {
			const errorText = await response.text();
			throw new Error(errorText || `Server responded with ${response.status}`);
		}
		
		// On success, no need to update Fuse again as it's already in sync.

	} catch (error) {
		console.error("Failed to toggle deployment:", error);
		alert(`Failed to update deployment status: ${error.message}. Reverting change.`);
		
		// On failure, revert to the original state
		reportsData.val = originalReports;
		// And revert the Fuse.js index as well
		reportsFuse.setCollection(reportsData.val);
	}
}

function updateReportFA(reportID, faID) {
	const url = `/api/admin/updatefa/${reportID}`;

	fetch(url, {
		method: "POST",
		headers: {
			"Content-Type": "application/json",
			Auth: authToken,
		},
		body: JSON.stringify({ FunctionalAreaID: faID }),
	})
	.then(response => {
		if (!response.ok) {
			// If the response is not ok, we read the error body and throw an error.
			// This will pass control to the .catch() block.
			return response.text().then(text => {
				throw { status: response.status, text: text };
			});
		}
		// If the response is ok, this .then() block resolves successfully,
		// and the next .then() block will execute.
	})
	.then(() => {
		// This block runs only on a successful response.
		// UI Update Logic:
		const updatedReports = reportsData.val.map(report => {
			if (report.ID === reportID) {
				return { ...report, FunctionalArea: faID };
			}
			return report;
		});
		reportsData.val = updatedReports;
		reportsFuse.setCollection(reportsData.val);
	})
	.catch(error => {
		// This catches both network errors and the custom error thrown above.
		if (error.status) { // This is our custom error from a bad HTTP response
			alert("Failed to update report on the server. Please check the console for details and refresh the page.");
			console.error("Server responded with error:", error.status, error.text);
		} else { // This is likely a network failure
			alert("An error occurred while trying to update the report. Please check your connection and try again.");
			console.error("Error updating Report:", error);
		}
		window.location.reload();
	})
	.finally(() => {
		// This block runs regardless of success or failure.
	});
}
```

## File: app\assets\scripts\targets_approvals.js
```js
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const approvalsTable = document.getElementById('approvals-table');
    if (!approvalsTable) {
        return;
    }

    const COOKIE = "UJUZI_AUTH";
    let authToken = "";
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(cookie => {
        const parts = cookie.split('=');
        const name = parts[0].trim();
        if (name === COOKIE) {
            authToken = parts[1];
        }
    });

    const handleApprovalChange = async (checkbox, row, isApproved) => {
        const payload = {
            country: row.dataset.country,
            cycle: row.dataset.cycle,
            type: row.dataset.type,
        };

        checkbox.disabled = true;
        row.classList.add('opacity-50');

        const endpoint = isApproved ? '/api/targets/approve' : '/api/targets/disapprove';
        const action = isApproved ? 'approve' : 'disapprove';

        try {
            const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Auth': authToken,
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
            });

            if (!response.ok) {
                console.error(`Failed to ${action} target group`);
                window.showUjuziPopup("Error", `Failed to ${action} targets. Please try again.`);
                checkbox.checked = !isApproved; 
            } else {
              window.location.reload();
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Error ${action}ing targets:`, error);
            window.showUjuziPopup("Error", `An error occurred while ${action}ing. Please check the console.`);
            checkbox.checked = !isApproved; 
        } finally {
            checkbox.disabled = false;
            row.classList.remove('opacity-50');
        }
    };

    approvalsTable.querySelectorAll('.approval-checkbox').forEach(checkbox => {
        checkbox.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            const isApproved = e.target.checked;
            const row = e.target.closest('tr');
            handleApprovalChange(e.target, row, isApproved)
        });
    });
});
```

```js
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const toggleButton = document.getElementById('toggle-dashboard-btn');
    const iframeContainer = document.getElementById('dashboard-iframe-container');
    const dashboardIframe = document.getElementById('dashboard-iframe');

    if (!toggleButton || !iframeContainer || !dashboardIframe) {
        return;
    }

    let isDashboardOpen = false;

    const lookerParamIds = {
        country: 'df76',
        cycle: 'df91',
        type: 'df40',
        branch: 'df75' 
    };

    const typeValueMapping = {
        'ACTIVATIONS': 'Activations',
        'CONSULTANT_COLLECTIONS': 'Debt Buster: Recencies',
        'CONSULTANT_RECOVERY': 'Debt Buster: Recoveries',
        'CONSULTANT_DISBURSEMENT': 'Performance Disbursements',
        'PULL_COLLECTIONS': 'Pull Collections',
        'RECENCY_0': 'Recency 0',
        'RECENCY_1': 'Recency 1',
        'RECENCY_2': 'Recency 2',
        'RECENCY_3': 'Recency 3',
        'RECOVERY': 'Recovery',
        'SALES': 'Sales',
    };
    
    const updateDashboardSource = () => {
        const baseUrl = 'https://lookerstudio.google.com/embed/reporting/7e47cda4-61ef-4a21-a84a-626000f16e38/page/hEtPF';
        const params = {};
        const lookerValuePrefix = "include%EE%80%800%EE%80%80IN%EE%80%80";

        const countrySelect = document.querySelector('select[name="cc"]');
        const cycleSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="cycle"]');
        const typeSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="type"]');
        const branchSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="branch"]');

        const countryValue = countrySelect.options[countrySelect.selectedIndex]?.text;
        const cycleValue = cycleSelect.value;
        const typeValue = typeSelect.value;
        const branchValue = branchSelect.value;
        
        if (countryValue && countryValue !== 'All') {
            params[lookerParamIds.country] = `${lookerValuePrefix}${countryValue}`;
        }
        if (cycleValue) {
            params[lookerParamIds.cycle] = `${lookerValuePrefix}${cycleValue}`;
        }
        if (typeValue) {
            const mappedTypeValue = typeValueMapping[typeValue] || typeValue;
            params[lookerParamIds.type] = `${lookerValuePrefix}${mappedTypeValue}`;
        }
        if (branchValue) {
            params[lookerParamIds.branch] = `${lookerValuePrefix}${branchValue}`;
        }

        let finalUrl = baseUrl;
        if (Object.keys(params).length > 0) {
            const paramsString = JSON.stringify(params);
            finalUrl = `${baseUrl}?params=${encodeURIComponent(paramsString)}`;
        }

        if (dashboardIframe.src !== finalUrl) {
            dashboardIframe.src = finalUrl;
        }
    };
    
    const countrySelect = document.querySelector('select[name="cc"]');
    const cycleSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="cycle"]');
    const typeSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="type"]');
    const branchSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="branch"]');
    
    if (countrySelect) countrySelect.addEventListener('change', () => dashboardIframe.src = '');
    if (cycleSelect) cycleSelect.addEventListener('change',  () => dashboardIframe.src = '');
    if (typeSelect) typeSelect.addEventListener('change',  () => dashboardIframe.src = '');
    if (branchSelect) branchSelect.addEventListener('change',  () => dashboardIframe.src = '');


    const toggleDashboard = () => {
        isDashboardOpen = !isDashboardOpen;
        
        if (isDashboardOpen) {
            updateDashboardSource();
            iframeContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            iframeContainer.classList.add('h-[100vh]');
            iframeContainer.classList.add('w-[100%]');
            iframeContainer.classList.add('top-0');
            iframeContainer.classList.add('left-0');
            iframeContainer.classList.add('absolute');
            toggleButton.textContent = 'Close Dashboard';
            toggleButton.classList.remove('bg-green-x-light', 'hover:bg-green-x-dark');
            toggleButton.classList.add('bg-red-600', 'hover:bg-red-500');
        } else {
            iframeContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            iframeContainer.classList.remove('h-[100vh]');
            iframeContainer.classList.remove('w-[100%]');
            iframeContainer.classList.remove('top-0');
            iframeContainer.classList.remove('left-0');
            iframeContainer.classList.remove('absolute');
            toggleButton.textContent = 'Targets Dashboard';
            toggleButton.classList.add('bg-green-x-light', 'hover:bg-green-x-dark');
            toggleButton.classList.remove('bg-red-600', 'hover:bg-red-500');
        }
    };

    toggleButton.addEventListener('click', toggleDashboard);
    

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (isDashboardOpen && e.key === 'Escape') {
            toggleDashboard();
        }
    });

   // updateDashboardSource();
});
```

## File: app\assets\scripts\targets_overrides.js
```js
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const overridesTable = document.getElementById('overrides-table');
    if (!overridesTable) {
        return;
    }

    const COOKIE = "UJUZI_AUTH";
    let authToken = "";
    document.cookie.split(';').forEach(cookie => {
        const parts = cookie.split('=');
        const name = parts[0].trim();
        if (name === COOKIE) {
            authToken = parts[1];
        }
    });

    const displayFormat = (value) => {
        const number = parseFloat(value);
        if (isNaN(number)) return '';
         return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2,
            useGrouping: true,
        }).format(number);
    }
    
    const storageFormat = (value) => {
        return String(value).replace(/,/g, '');
    }

    const handleUpdate = async (row) => {
        const targetOverrideInput = row.querySelector('.target-override-input');
        const commentInput = row.querySelector('.comment-input');

        const payload = {
            country: row.dataset.country,
            cycle: row.dataset.cycle,
            branch: row.dataset.branch,
            type: row.dataset.type,
            targetOverride: parseFloat(storageFormat(targetOverrideInput.value)) || 0,
            comment: commentInput.value,
        };
        
        row.classList.add('opacity-50');

        try {
            const response = await fetch('/api/targets/override', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Auth': authToken,
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
            });

            if (!response.ok) {
                console.error('Failed to update override');
                targetOverrideInput.style.borderColor = 'red';
                commentInput.style.borderColor = 'red';
                window.showUjuziPopup("Error", "Failed to save override. Please try again.");

            } else {
                 targetOverrideInput.style.borderColor = '';
                 commentInput.style.borderColor = '';
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error updating override:', error);
            targetOverrideInput.style.borderColor = 'red';
            commentInput.style.borderColor = 'red';
            window.showUjuziPopup("Error", "An error occurred while saving. Please check the console.");
        } finally {
            row.classList.remove('opacity-50');
        }
    };

    overridesTable.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(row => {
        const targetOverrideInput = row.querySelector('.target-override-input');
        const commentInput = row.querySelector('.comment-input');

        if (targetOverrideInput) {
            targetOverrideInput.value = displayFormat(targetOverrideInput.value);

            targetOverrideInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                e.target.value = e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9.,]/g, '').replace(/(\..*)\./g, '$1');
            });

            targetOverrideInput.addEventListener('blur', (e) => {
                const numericValue = parseFloat(storageFormat(e.target.value));
                 if (!isNaN(numericValue)) {
                    e.target.value = displayFormat(numericValue);
                } else {
                    e.target.value = '';
                }
                handleUpdate(row);
            });
        }
        
        if (commentInput) {
            commentInput.addEventListener('blur', () => {
                handleUpdate(row);
            });
        }
    });
});
```

```js
import Fuse from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fuse.js@7.0.0/dist/fuse.mjs";

// Inline fuzzy search for the common-terms header (mirrors report_search.js).
// No-ops on the owner view, where these elements are absent.

const trigger = document.getElementById("term-search-trigger");
const dropdown = document.getElementById("term-search-dropdown");
const dataEl = document.getElementById("term-search-data");

if (trigger && dropdown && dataEl) {
	const terms = JSON.parse(dataEl.dataset.terms || "[]");

	const fuse = new Fuse(terms, {
		keys: ["term", "desc"],
		threshold: 0.3,
	});

	const escapeHtml = (s) => {
		const div = document.createElement("div");
		div.textContent = s == null ? "" : s;
		return div.innerHTML;
	};

	const close = () => {
		dropdown.classList.add("hidden");
		dropdown.innerHTML = "";
	};

	const renderResults = (q) => {
		const hits = fuse.search(q).slice(0, 8);
		if (hits.length === 0) {
			dropdown.innerHTML =
				'<div class="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-400 italic">No terms found</div>';
			dropdown.classList.remove("hidden");
			return;
		}
		dropdown.innerHTML = hits
			.map(
				({ item }) =>
					`<button type="button" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}" data-section="${escapeHtml(item.section)}" class="block w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100">${escapeHtml(item.term)}</button>`,
			)
			.join("");
		dropdown.classList.remove("hidden");
	};

	trigger.addEventListener("input", () => {
		const q = trigger.value.trim();
		if (q === "") {
			close();
			return;
		}
		renderResults(q);
	});

	trigger.addEventListener("focus", () => {
		const q = trigger.value.trim();
		if (q !== "") renderResults(q);
	});

	dropdown.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
		const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-id]");
		if (!btn) return;
		trigger.value = "";
		close();
		if (window.goToTerm) window.goToTerm(btn.dataset.id, btn.dataset.section);
	});

	document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
		if (!trigger.contains(e.target) && !dropdown.contains(e.target)) {
			close();
		}
	});

	document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
		if (e.key === "Escape") {
			trigger.value = "";
			close();
			trigger.blur();
		}
	});
}
```

```js
import van from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/vanjs-org/van/public/van-1.5.0.min.js";
import Fuse from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fuse.js@7.0.0/dist/fuse.mjs";

const loadingSpinner = document.getElementById("loading-spinner");
const container = document.querySelector("#container");

const {
	div,
	table,
	tbody,
	thead,
	tr,
	th,
	td,
	input,
	p,
	select,
	option,
	label,
} = van.tags;

const COOKIE = "UJUZI_AUTH";

let authToken = "";

cookieStore
	.get(COOKIE)
	.then((cookie) => {
		if (cookie) {
			authToken = cookie.value;
		} else {
			console.log("Cookie not found.");
		}
	})
	.catch((error) => {
		console.error("Error retrieving cookie:", error);
	});

// Note(ferdz): looks like we can delete this?
// const reportFaSelectors = document.querySelectorAll(
// 	"[data-report-fa-selector]",
// );

const pageData = JSON.parse(container.dataset.page);

const usersData = pageData.Users;

const users = van.state(usersData);
const totalUserCount = Object.keys(usersData).length;

const fuzzyFilter = van.state("");
const departmentsFilter = van.state("All");

const fuseOptions = {
	keys: ["FirstName", "LastName"],
};

const usersFilter = new Fuse(usersData, fuseOptions);

van.derive(() => {
	let updatedState = [];

	if (fuzzyFilter.val === "") {
		updatedState = usersData;
	} else {
		const filteredUsers = usersFilter.search(fuzzyFilter.val);

		updatedState = [];
		for (const i of filteredUsers) {
			updatedState.push(usersData[i.refIndex]);
		}
	}

	if (departmentsFilter.val !== "All") {
		updatedState = updatedState.filter((u) => {
			return u.OrgUnit === departmentsFilter.val;
		});
	}

	users.val = updatedState;
});

const filteredUserCount = van.derive(() => {
	return users.val.length;
});

const tableHeadings = [
	"Firstname",
	"Lastname",
	"Email",
	"Department",
	"Last Sync"
];

const dataKeys = ["FirstName", "LastName", "Email", "OrgUnit", "LastSyncTime"];


function THead() {
	return thead(
		tr(
			tableHeadings.map((c) =>
				th({ class: "px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm text-gray-900 w-40" }, c),
			),
		),
	);
}

function TBody() {
	// return a function to bind the state
	return () =>
		tbody(
			users.val.map((u, i) =>
				tr(
					{ class: "even:bg-gray-50 group" },
					dataKeys.map((k) =>
						td(
							{ class: "whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500" },
							div({ class: "w-56 truncate" }, u[k]),
						),
					),
				),
			),
		);
}

function Filters() {
	return div(
		{ class: "p-4 bg-gray-100 rounded-lg" },
		() => p(`Showing ${filteredUserCount.val} of ${totalUserCount}`),
		div(
			// Change: Use grid layout
			{ class: "grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-4 items-start" },
			div(
				label(
					{ class: "block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-gray-900" },
					"Users",
				),
				input({
					// Change: Make input full-width
					class: "mt-2 block w-full border p-2 rounded",
					placeholder: "search...",
					type: "text",
					oninput: (e) => {
						fuzzyFilter.val = e.target.value;
					},
				}),
			),
			div(
				label(
					{ class: "block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-gray-900" },
					"Departments",
				),
				select(
					{
						// Change: Make select full-width
						class: "mt-2 block w-full border p-2 rounded",
						onchange: (e) => {
							departmentsFilter.val =
								e.target.options[e.target.selectedIndex].value;
						},
					},
					option("All"),
					pageData.Departments.map((s) => option(s)),
				),
			),
		),
	);
}

function UserSettingsTable() {
	return div(
		Filters(),
		div(
			{ class: "overflow-x-auto mt-4" },
			table(
				{
					class: "min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-300",
				},
				THead(),
				TBody(),
			),
		),
	);
}

van.add(container, UserSettingsTable());
```

```go
package auth

import (
	"net/http"
)

func TokenFromHeader(r *http.Request) (string, bool) {
	x := r.Header["Auth"]

	if len(x) < 1 {
		return "", false
	}

	return x[0], true
}

func TokenFromCookie(r *http.Request) (string, bool) {
	c, err := r.Cookie(Cookie)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false
	}

	return c.Value, true
}
```

```go
package auth

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/dustin/go-humanize"
)

const Cookie = "UJUZI_AUTH"

type User struct {
	ID                string
	FirstName         string
	LastName          string
	Email             string
	Name              string
	GoogleID          string
	LastSyncTime      int64
	SyncFailed        bool
	Admin             bool
	IsAnalyst         bool
	IsSuper           bool
	IsTarget          bool
	Thumbnail         string
	Country           string
	CC                string // country code
	OrgUnit           string
	Address           string
	FunctionalAreas   FunctionalAreas
	Countries         []string
	CountriesSyncTime int64
}

func (u *User) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	// Alias avoids infinite loop since MarshalJSON isnt defined for Alias.
	type Alias User
	return json.Marshal(&struct {
		*Alias
		LastSyncTime string
	}{
		Alias:        (*Alias)(u),
		LastSyncTime: humanize.Time(time.Unix(u.LastSyncTime, 0)),
	})
}

type FunctionalAreas struct {
	FinancialReporting  bool
	FinancialOperations bool
	Productivity        bool
	Sales               bool
	Collections         bool
	Recoveries          bool
	Activations         bool
	InternalAudit       bool
	KYC                 bool
	CreditAndPolicy     bool
	Operations          bool
	HumanResources      bool
	DataMetrics         bool
}

func (u User) LastSyncHumanTime() string {
	return humanize.Time(time.Unix(u.LastSyncTime, 0))
}
```

```go
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/flash2"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/randx"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"github.com/markbates/goth"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

type FireStore struct {
	db *firestore.Client
	s  Service
	l  *log.Logger
}

func NewFireStore(l *log.Logger, client *firestore.Client, authService Service) FireStore {
	return FireStore{
		db: client,
		s:  authService,
		l:  l,
	}
}

func (f FireStore) Get(ctx context.Context, now time.Time, authToken string) (User, Session, error) {
	token, err := f.s.UnmarshalToken(authToken)
	if err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("failed to unmarshal token: %s", err)
		return User{}, Session{}, ErrNotAuthenticated
	}

	s, err := f.db.Collection("sessions").Doc(token.SessionID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("err fetching session: %s", err)
		return User{}, Session{}, err
	}

	var session Session
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(s.Data(), &session); err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("err decoding session: %s", err)
		return User{}, Session{}, ErrNotAuthenticated
	}

	if session.Invalidated {
		f.l.Println("session has been invalidated")
		return User{}, Session{}, ErrNotAuthenticated
	}

	expiresAt := time.Unix(session.ExpiresAt, 0)
	if now.After(expiresAt) {
		f.l.Println("session has expired")
		return User{}, Session{}, ErrNotAuthenticated
	}

	doc, err := f.db.Collection(collection.Users).Doc(session.UserID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return User{}, Session{}, err
	}

	var user User
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &user); err != nil {
		return User{}, Session{}, err
	}

	return user, session, nil
}

func (f FireStore) HttpGet(ctx context.Context, now time.Time, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (User, Session, error) {
	c, err := r.Cookie(Cookie)
	if err != nil {
		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return User{}, Session{}, web.Error
	}

	token, err := f.s.UnmarshalToken(c.Value)
	if err != nil {
		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return User{}, Session{}, web.Error
	}

	s, err := f.db.Collection("sessions").Doc(token.SessionID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("err fetching session: %s", err)
		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return User{}, Session{}, web.Error
	}

	var session Session

	if err := mapstructure.Decode(s.Data(), &session); err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("err decoding session: %s", err)

		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return User{}, Session{}, web.Error
	}

	if session.Invalidated {
		f.l.Println("session has been invalidated")

		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return User{}, Session{}, web.Error
	}

	expiresAt := time.Unix(session.ExpiresAt, 0)
	if now.After(expiresAt) {
		f.l.Println("session has expired")

		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return User{}, Session{}, web.Error
	}

	doc, err := f.db.Collection(collection.Users).Doc(session.UserID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return User{}, Session{}, err
	}

	var user User
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &user); err != nil {
		return User{}, Session{}, err
	}

	return user, session, nil
}

func (f FireStore) HttpCreate(
	ctx context.Context,
	now time.Time,
	u goth.User,
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
) error {
	id := randx.UID()

	iter := f.db.Collection(collection.Users).Where("Email", "==", u.Email).Documents(ctx)
	doc, err := iter.Next()
	if err != nil {
		if err == iterator.Done {
			f.l.Println("user not found")
			flash2.Create(w, flash2.Err, fmt.Sprintf("User %q not found.", u.Email), now)

			// causing import cycle, remove for now
			// uj.Redirect(w, r, "/signin")

			uj.Redirect(w, r, "/signin")

			return web.Error
		}

		return err
	}

	var user User
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &user); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	s := Session{
		ID:          id,
		UserID:      user.ID,
		CreatedAt:   now.Unix(),
		LastActive:  now.Unix(),
		ExpiresAt:   now.Add(SessionDuration).Unix(),
		Invalidated: false,
	}

	if _, err := f.db.Collection(collection.Sessions).Doc(id).Set(ctx, s); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	token := f.s.CreateToken(s)

	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
		Name:     Cookie,
		Value:    token,
		Expires:  now.Add(SessionDuration),
		Secure:   true,
		Path:     "/",
		HttpOnly: false, // for javascript access
		// SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode, // for oauth redirect
		SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode, // for oauth redirect
	})

	return nil
}

func (f FireStore) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	now time.Time,
	u goth.User,
) (*http.Cookie, error) {
	id := randx.UID()

	iter := f.db.Collection(collection.Users).Where("Email", "==", u.Email).Documents(ctx)
	doc, err := iter.Next()
	if err != nil {
		if err == iterator.Done {
			return nil, ErrNotAuthenticated
		}

		return nil, err
	}

	var user User
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &user); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	s := Session{
		ID:          id,
		UserID:      user.ID,
		CreatedAt:   now.Unix(),
		LastActive:  now.Unix(),
		ExpiresAt:   now.Add(SessionDuration).Unix(),
		Invalidated: false,
	}

	if _, err := f.db.Collection(collection.Sessions).Doc(id).Set(ctx, s); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	token := f.s.CreateToken(s)

	cookie := &http.Cookie{
		Name:     Cookie,
		Value:    token,
		Expires:  now.Add(SessionDuration),
		Secure:   true, // for iframe access...maybe. Might not need it.
		Path:     "/",
		HttpOnly: false,                 // for javascript access
		SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode, // for oauth redirect and iFrame access
	}

	return cookie, nil
}

func (f FireStore) HttpInvalidate(ctx context.Context, now time.Time, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	c, err := r.Cookie(Cookie)
	if err != nil {
		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return nil
	}

	token, err := f.s.UnmarshalToken(c.Value)
	if err != nil {
		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return web.Error
	}

	s, err := f.db.Collection("sessions").Doc(token.SessionID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("err fetching session: %s", err)
		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return web.Error
	}

	var session Session
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(s.Data(), &s); err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("err decoding session: %s", err)

		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return web.Error
	}

	if session.Invalidated {
		f.l.Println("session has been invalidated")

		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return web.Error
	}

	if now.After(time.Unix(session.ExpiresAt, 0)) {

		f.l.Println("session has expired")

		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return web.Error
	}

	if _, err := f.db.Doc(session.ID).Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
		{
			Path:  "Invalidated",
			Value: true,
		},
	}); err != nil {
		f.l.Printf("error invalidating session [deleting cookie]: %s", err)

		uj.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, "/signin", Cookie, now)
		return web.Error
	}

	return nil
}
```

```go
package auth

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
)

type key int8

const ctxKey key = 0

type AuthCtx struct {
	User    User
	Session Session
}

func Set(ctx context.Context, u User, s Session) context.Context {
	c := AuthCtx{u, s}
	return context.WithValue(ctx, ctxKey, c)
}

func FromCtx(ctx context.Context) AuthCtx {
	c, ok := ctx.Value(ctxKey).(AuthCtx)
	if !ok {
		panic("AuthCtx not on context")
	}

	return c
}

func (f FireStore) Mid(h web.Handler) web.Handler {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
		ctx := r.Context()
		now := time.Now()

		u, s, err := f.HttpGet(ctx, now, w, r)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		ctx = Set(ctx, u, s)
		r = r.WithContext(ctx)

		return h(w, r)
	}
}
```

```go
package auth

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"log"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/cryptox"
)

type Service struct {
	l   *log.Logger
	enc cryptox.Service
}

func NewService(
	l *log.Logger,
	secret string,
) Service {
	enc, err := cryptox.NewService(secret)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	return Service{
		enc: enc,

		l: l,
	}
}

var ErrNotAuthenticated = errors.New("unauthenticated")

func IsNotAuthenticated(err error) bool {
	return errors.Is(err, ErrNotAuthenticated)
}

type Token struct {
	SessionID string
}

func (s Service) CreateToken(session Session) string {
	token := Token{
		SessionID: session.ID,
	}

	out, err := json.Marshal(token)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	encrypted := s.enc.Encrypt(out)

	pretty := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString(encrypted)

	return pretty
}

func (s Service) UnmarshalToken(tokenStr string) (Token, error) {
	token := Token{}

	decoded, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(tokenStr)
	if err != nil {
		return Token{}, ErrNotAuthenticated
	}

	unencrypted, _, err := s.enc.Decrypt(decoded)
	if err != nil {
		return Token{}, err
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(unencrypted, &token); err != nil {
		return Token{}, ErrNotAuthenticated
	}

	return token, nil
}
```

```go
	UserID      string
	CreatedAt   int64
	ExpiresAt   int64
	LastActive  int64

}

type Store interface {

	HttpGet(ctx context.Context, now time.Time, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (User, Session, error)

	HttpInvalidate(ctx context.Context, now time.Time, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error
```

```go
	CountryCode string    `bigquery:"COUNTRY"`

}

type Service struct {
	client  *bigquery.Client
	l       *log.Logger
	dataset string
	table   string
}

func NewService(ctx context.Context, l *log.Logger, projectID, dataset, table string) (*Service, error) {
	client, err := bigquery.NewClient(ctx, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("bigquery.NewClient: %w", err)
	}

	return &Service{
		client:  client,
		l:       l,
		dataset: dataset,
		table:   table,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) GetUserTopReports(ctx context.Context, userEmail string) ([]TopReport, error) {

	q := s.client.Query(queryStr)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "email", Value: userEmail},
	}

	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute top reports query: %w", err)
	}

	var results []TopReport
	for {
		var row struct {
			ReportTitle string `bigquery:"REPORT"`
		}
		err := it.Next(&row)
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate top reports results: %w", err)
		}
		results = append(results, TopReport{ReportTitle: row.ReportTitle})
	}
	return results, nil
}

		s.l.Printf("ERROR inserting rating to BigQuery: %v", err)

	}

	return nil
}

func (s *Service) UpdateTargetOverride(ctx context.Context, country, cycle, branch, targetType string, targetOverride float64, comment string) error {
	queryStr := "UPDATE `df-fs-insights.INSIGHTS.TARGETS`\n" +
		"SET PREDICT_OVERRIDE = @targetOverride, OVERRIDE_REASON = @comment\n" +
		"WHERE COUNTRY = @country AND REPORT_CYCLE = @cycle AND BRANCH = @branch AND TYPE = @targetType AND APPROVED = false"

	q := s.client.Query(queryStr)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "targetOverride", Value: targetOverride},
		{Name: "comment", Value: comment},
		{Name: "country", Value: country},
		{Name: "cycle", Value: cycle},
		{Name: "branch", Value: branch},
		{Name: "targetType", Value: targetType},
	}

	job, err := q.Run(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to run update job: %w", err)
	}

	status, err := job.Wait(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to wait for update job completion: %w", err)
	}

	if err := status.Err(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("update job failed: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

func (s *Service) GetNextCampaignSequence(ctx context.Context, countryName, countryCode, successEventType, campaignType string) (int, error) {
	// ID format: {code}{YYYY-MM-DD}{seq} — seq starts at offset len(code)+10+1 (1-indexed)
	seqStart := len(countryCode) + 11
	queryStr := fmt.Sprintf(`
		SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(CAMPAIGN_ID, %d) AS INT64)), 0) AS MAX_SEQ
		FROM `+"`df-fs-insights.CAMPAIGN_TESTING.CAMPAIGNS`"+`
		WHERE COUNTRY = @country
		  AND CAMPAIGN_TYPE = @campaignType
		  AND SUCCESS_EVENT_TYPE = @successEventType
	`, seqStart)
	q := s.client.Query(queryStr)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "country", Value: countryName},
		{Name: "campaignType", Value: campaignType},
		{Name: "successEventType", Value: successEventType},
	}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get campaign sequence: %w", err)
	}
	var row struct {
		MAX_SEQ int64 `bigquery:"MAX_SEQ"`
	}
	if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
		if err == iterator.Done {
			return 1, nil
		}
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read campaign sequence: %w", err)
	}
	return int(row.MAX_SEQ) + 1, nil
}

	inserter := s.client.DatasetInProject(campaignProject, campaignDataset).Table("CAMPAIGNS_DETAIL").Inserter()
	items := make([]*BQCampaignDetail, len(details))
	for i := range details {
		items[i] = &details[i]
	}
	if err := inserter.Put(ctx, items); err != nil {
		s.l.Printf("ERROR inserting campaign details to BigQuery: %v", err)
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *Service) GetMessageDebtorCounts(ctx context.Context, campaignID string) (map[string]int, error) {
	queryStr := "SELECT MESSAGE_ID, COUNT(*) as CNT " +
		"FROM `df-fs-insights.CAMPAIGN_TESTING.CAMPAIGNS_DETAIL` " +
		"WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = @campaignID GROUP BY MESSAGE_ID"
	q := s.client.Query(queryStr)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "campaignID", Value: campaignID},
	}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute debtor counts query: %w", err)
	}
	counts := make(map[string]int)
	for {
		var row struct {
			MessageID string `bigquery:"MESSAGE_ID"`
			CNT       int64  `bigquery:"CNT"`
		}
		err := it.Next(&row)
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate debtor counts: %w", err)
		}
		counts[row.MessageID] = int(row.CNT)
	}
	return counts, nil
}

// GetNextTermSequence returns the next per-category sequence number, scanning
// both the live and history tables so an ID is never reused after a term is retired.
func (s *Service) GetNextTermSequence(ctx context.Context, prefix string) (int, error) {
	q := s.client.Query(`
		SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(ID, @start) AS INT64)), 0) AS MAX_SEQ
		FROM (
			SELECT ID FROM ` + "`df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS`" + ` WHERE STARTS_WITH(ID, @prefix)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT ID FROM ` + "`df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS_HISTORY`" + ` WHERE STARTS_WITH(ID, @prefix)
		)
	`)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "start", Value: len(prefix) + 1},
		{Name: "prefix", Value: prefix},
	}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to query term sequence: %w", err)
	}
	var row struct {
		MAX_SEQ int64 `bigquery:"MAX_SEQ"`
	}
	if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
		if err == iterator.Done {
			return 1, nil
		}
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read term sequence: %w", err)
	}
	return int(row.MAX_SEQ) + 1, nil
}

func (s *Service) GetTermHistory(ctx context.Context, id string) ([]BQCommonTerm, error) {
	q := s.client.Query(`
		SELECT ID, CATEGORY, TERM, DESCRIPTION, VERSION, CREATED, LAST_EDITED_BY AS EDITED_BY, COALESCE(HIDDEN, FALSE) AS HIDDEN
		FROM ` + "`df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS`" + ` WHERE ID = @id
		UNION ALL
		SELECT ID, CATEGORY, TERM, DESCRIPTION, VERSION, CREATED, EDITED_BY, COALESCE(HIDDEN, FALSE) AS HIDDEN
		FROM ` + "`df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS_HISTORY`" + ` WHERE ID = @id
		ORDER BY VERSION DESC
	`)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{{Name: "id", Value: id}}

		}
		results = append(results, row)
	}
	return results, nil
}

// CreateCommonTerm inserts a brand-new term at version 1. DML INSERT, not the
// streaming inserter: streamed rows stay in the buffer for ~90 min and would
// block a subsequent UpdateCommonTerm on the same ID.
func (s *Service) CreateCommonTerm(ctx context.Context, t BQCommonTerm) error {
	created := time.Now()
	if t.Created.Valid {
		created = t.Created.Timestamp
	}
	return s.runDML(ctx,
		"INSERT INTO `df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS` (ID, CATEGORY, TERM, DESCRIPTION, VERSION, CREATED, LAST_EDITED_BY, HIDDEN) VALUES (@id, @category, @term, @description, 1, @created, @editedBy, @hidden)",
		[]bigquery.QueryParameter{
			{Name: "id", Value: t.ID},
			{Name: "category", Value: t.Category},
			{Name: "term", Value: t.Term},
			{Name: "description", Value: t.Description},
			{Name: "created", Value: created},
			{Name: "editedBy", Value: t.EditedBy},
			{Name: "hidden", Value: t.Hidden},
		},
	)
}

// UpdateCommonTerm banks the current live version into history, then updates the
// live row in place — keeping the ID stable and bumping VERSION. Category is not
// touched: the ID encodes it.
func (s *Service) UpdateCommonTerm(ctx context.Context, id, term, description, editedBy string, hidden bool) error {
	if err := s.runDML(ctx,
		"INSERT INTO `df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS_HISTORY` (ID, CATEGORY, TERM, DESCRIPTION, VERSION, CREATED, EDITED_BY, HIDDEN) SELECT ID, CATEGORY, TERM, DESCRIPTION, VERSION, CREATED, LAST_EDITED_BY, COALESCE(HIDDEN, FALSE) FROM `df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS` WHERE ID = @id",
		[]bigquery.QueryParameter{{Name: "id", Value: id}},
	); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return s.runDML(ctx,
		"UPDATE `df-frontend.UJUZI.COMMON_TERMS` SET TERM = @term, DESCRIPTION = @description, VERSION = VERSION + 1, CREATED = @created, LAST_EDITED_BY = @editedBy, HIDDEN = @hidden WHERE ID = @id",
		[]bigquery.QueryParameter{
			{Name: "id", Value: id},
			{Name: "term", Value: term},
			{Name: "description", Value: description},
			{Name: "created", Value: time.Now()},
			{Name: "editedBy", Value: editedBy},
			{Name: "hidden", Value: hidden},
		},
	)
}

func (s *Service) DeactivateFeatureEntry(ctx context.Context, id string) error {

	job, err := q.Run(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to run deactivate feature entry job: %w", err)
	}
	s.l.Printf("BQ DeactivateFeature: job=%s waiting", job.ID())
	status, err := job.Wait(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to wait for deactivate feature entry job: %w", err)
	}
	if err := status.Err(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("deactivate feature entry job failed: %w", err)
	}
	stats := status.Statistics
	if stats != nil && stats.Details != nil {
		if dml, ok := stats.Details.(*bigquery.QueryStatistics); ok {
			s.l.Printf("BQ DeactivateFeature: job=%s complete, rows affected=%d, total bytes=%d", job.ID(), dml.NumDMLAffectedRows, stats.TotalBytesProcessed)
		}
	} else {
		s.l.Printf("BQ DeactivateFeature: job=%s complete (no stats)", job.ID())
	}
	return nil
}

		{Name: "owner", Value: e.Owner},
		{Name: "created", Value: e.Created},
		{Name: "active", Value: e.Active},
	})
}

func (s *Service) GetExistingDebtorsInCampaign(ctx context.Context, campaignID string, debtorIDs []string) ([]string, error) {
	if len(debtorIDs) == 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}
	queryStr := "SELECT DISTINCT DEBTOR_ID FROM `df-fs-insights.CAMPAIGN_TESTING.CAMPAIGNS_DETAIL` " +
		"WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = @campaignID AND DEBTOR_ID IN UNNEST(@debtorIDs)"
	q := s.client.Query(queryStr)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "campaignID", Value: campaignID},
		{Name: "debtorIDs", Value: debtorIDs},
	}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to query existing debtors: %w", err)
	}
	var found []string
	for {
		var row struct {
			DebtorID string `bigquery:"DEBTOR_ID"`
		}
		if err = it.Next(&row); err == iterator.Done {
			break
		} else if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate existing debtors: %w", err)
		}
		found = append(found, row.DebtorID)
	}
	return found, nil
}

func (s *Service) SearchCampaignDetail(ctx context.Context, messageID, debtorID string) (*BQCampaignDetail, error) {
	queryStr := "SELECT SEND_ID, DEBTOR_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID, MESSAGE_ID, " +
		"SEND_TIMESTAMP, DELIVERY_STATUS, SUCCESS_FLAG, SUCCESS_DATE " +
		"FROM `df-fs-insights.CAMPAIGN_TESTING.CAMPAIGNS_DETAIL` " +
		"WHERE MESSAGE_ID = @messageID AND DEBTOR_ID = @debtorID LIMIT 1"
	q := s.client.Query(queryStr)
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "messageID", Value: messageID},
		{Name: "debtorID", Value: debtorID},
	}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to search campaign detail: %w", err)
	}
	var row BQCampaignDetail
	if err = it.Next(&row); err == iterator.Done {
		return nil, nil
	} else if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read campaign detail: %w", err)
	}
	return &row, nil
}

// =============================================
// CREDIT POLICY HISTORY
//
// One row per submitted+approved change. Each row carries a complete
// point-in-time snapshot of every credit-policy YAML file for that country
// (NULL columns where the country doesn't ship the file). This lets a single
// row fully reconstruct the world at the moment the change was applied —
// dashboards never need to JOIN multiple rows or replay diffs.

// CreditPolicySnapshotRow is one BQ row per change_id.
type CreditPolicySnapshotRow struct {
	ChangeID         string              `bigquery:"CHANGE_ID"`
	Country          string              `bigquery:"COUNTRY"`
	Status           string              `bigquery:"STATUS"`
	SubmittedByEmail string              `bigquery:"SUBMITTED_BY_EMAIL"`
	SubmittedByName  string              `bigquery:"SUBMITTED_BY_NAME"`
	SubmittedAt      time.Time           `bigquery:"SUBMITTED_AT"`
	ApprovedAt       time.Time           `bigquery:"APPROVED_AT"`
	ApproversCSV     string              `bigquery:"APPROVERS_CSV"`
	CommitSHA        bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"COMMIT_SHA"`

	// File snapshots — NULL when the country doesn't ship that file.
	OldScoreCategoryMapYAML            bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"OLD_SCORE_CATEGORY_MAP_YAML"`
	PlatformYAML                       bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"PLATFORM_YAML"`
	PricingAndLimitsYAML               bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"PRICING_AND_LIMITS_YAML"`
	ProductNameMapYAML                 bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"PRODUCT_NAME_MAP_YAML"`
	ProvisionYAML                      bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"PROVISION_YAML"`
	ScoreCategoryRangesYAML            bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"SCORE_CATEGORY_RANGES_YAML"`
	ScoreCategoryBoosterAndThrottleYAML bigquery.NullString `bigquery:"SCORE_CATEGORY_BOOSTER_AND_THROTTLE_YAML"`
}

// CreditPolicyTable holds the project/dataset/table location.
type CreditPolicyTable struct {
	Project string
	Dataset string
	Table   string
}

// CreditPolicyChangeExists returns true when the table already has a row for
// the given change ID. Used to make the publish pipeline idempotent across
// retries.
func (s *Service) CreditPolicyChangeExists(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyTable, changeID string) (bool, error) {
	q := s.client.Query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `" + t.Project + "." + t.Dataset + "." + t.Table + "` WHERE CHANGE_ID = @id")
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{{Name: "id", Value: changeID}}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("change exists query: %w", err)
	}
	var row struct {
		N int64 `bigquery:"n"`
	}
	if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("change exists read: %w", err)
	}
	return row.N > 0, nil
}

// InsertCreditPolicySnapshot writes a single snapshot row.
func (s *Service) InsertCreditPolicySnapshot(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyTable, row CreditPolicySnapshotRow) error {
	inserter := s.client.DatasetInProject(t.Project, t.Dataset).Table(t.Table).Inserter()
	if err := inserter.Put(ctx, []*CreditPolicySnapshotRow{&row}); err != nil {
		s.l.Printf("ERROR inserting credit policy snapshot: %v", err)
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// UpdateCreditPolicyCommitSHA records the git commit hash for an
// already-inserted change once the push has succeeded. Used by the republish
// flow when the initial push failed.
func (s *Service) UpdateCreditPolicyCommitSHA(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyTable, changeID, commitSHA string) error {
	q := s.client.Query("UPDATE `" + t.Project + "." + t.Dataset + "." + t.Table + "` " +
		"SET COMMIT_SHA = @sha WHERE CHANGE_ID = @id")
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "sha", Value: commitSHA},
		{Name: "id", Value: changeID},
	}
	job, err := q.Run(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("update commit_sha: run: %w", err)
	}
	status, err := job.Wait(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("update commit_sha: wait: %w", err)
	}
	if err := status.Err(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("update commit_sha: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// =============================================
// CREDIT POLICY ACTIVE — current state, one row per country
//
// The active table answers "which policy is live right now for country X" in a
// single-row lookup, where CREDIT_POLICY_CHANGES keeps the append-only history.
// POLICY_JSON is a native BigQuery JSON column holding every policy file for the
// country keyed by filename. Written by MERGE DML (not streaming) so the upsert
// keyed on COUNTRY stays atomic and races-free.

type CreditPolicyActiveTable struct {
	Project string
	Dataset string
	Table   string
}

func (t CreditPolicyActiveTable) ref() string {
	return "`" + t.Project + "." + t.Dataset + "." + t.Table + "`"
}

type CreditPolicyActiveRow struct {
	Country        string
	PolicyJSON     string
	ActiveChangeID bigquery.NullString
	CommitSHA      bigquery.NullString
	UpdatedAt      time.Time
}

// UpsertActivePolicy replaces the single row for row.Country. The JSON arrives
// as a STRING param wrapped in PARSE_JSON — the Go client has no JSON
// query-parameter type, so this is the path to write a native JSON column.
func (s *Service) UpsertActivePolicy(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyActiveTable, row CreditPolicyActiveRow) error {
	sql := "MERGE " + t.ref() + " T " +
		"USING (SELECT @country AS COUNTRY) S ON T.COUNTRY = S.COUNTRY " +
		"WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET " +
		"POLICY_JSON = PARSE_JSON(@policy_json), " +
		"ACTIVE_CHANGE_ID = @change_id, " +
		"COMMIT_SHA = @commit_sha, " +
		"UPDATED_AT = @updated_at " +
		"WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COUNTRY, POLICY_JSON, ACTIVE_CHANGE_ID, COMMIT_SHA, UPDATED_AT) " +
		"VALUES (@country, PARSE_JSON(@policy_json), @change_id, @commit_sha, @updated_at)"
	params := []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "country", Value: row.Country},
		{Name: "policy_json", Value: row.PolicyJSON},
		{Name: "change_id", Value: row.ActiveChangeID},
		{Name: "commit_sha", Value: row.CommitSHA},
		{Name: "updated_at", Value: row.UpdatedAt},
	}
	return s.runDML(ctx, sql, params)
}

// CountActivePolicy returns the number of country rows in the active table.
func (s *Service) CountActivePolicy(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyActiveTable) (int, error) {
	q := s.client.Query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM " + t.ref())
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("count active policy: %w", err)
	}
	var row struct {
		N int64 `bigquery:"n"`
	}
	if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("count active policy read: %w", err)
	}
	return int(row.N), nil
}

// =============================================
// CREDIT POLICY PENDING — mutable workflow state
//
// The pending table holds in-flight credit-policy changes (submit → approve →
// applied / cancelled / failed). Unlike the snapshot table, rows here are
// mutated repeatedly as approvals come in and statuses flip. We use DML
// (INSERT INTO / UPDATE) rather than streaming so that an UPDATE issued
// minutes after INSERT doesn't race the streaming buffer.

// CreditPolicyPendingTable holds the project/dataset/table location for the
// pending workflow ledger.
type CreditPolicyPendingTable struct {
	Project string
	Dataset string
	Table   string
}

// CreditPolicyPendingRow is one BQ row per change. Status flips over the
// row's lifetime; APPROVALS_CSV / APPROVAL_COUNT grow as approvers click.
type CreditPolicyPendingRow struct {
	ChangeID           string                 `bigquery:"CHANGE_ID"`
	Country            string                 `bigquery:"COUNTRY"`
	Status             string                 `bigquery:"STATUS"`
	SubmittedAt        time.Time              `bigquery:"SUBMITTED_AT"`
	SubmittedByEmail   string                 `bigquery:"SUBMITTED_BY_EMAIL"`
	SubmittedByName    bigquery.NullString    `bigquery:"SUBMITTED_BY_NAME"`
	ToolsCSV           bigquery.NullString    `bigquery:"TOOLS_CSV"`
	ApprovalsCSV       bigquery.NullString    `bigquery:"APPROVALS_CSV"`
	ApprovalCount      int64                  `bigquery:"APPROVAL_COUNT"`
	DiffsJSON          string                 `bigquery:"DIFFS_JSON"`
	FieldChangesJSON   string                 `bigquery:"FIELD_CHANGES_JSON"`
	AppliedAt          bigquery.NullTimestamp `bigquery:"APPLIED_AT"`
	PublishedCommitSHA bigquery.NullString    `bigquery:"PUBLISHED_COMMIT_SHA"`
	FailedAt           bigquery.NullTimestamp `bigquery:"FAILED_AT"`
	ErrorMessage       bigquery.NullString    `bigquery:"ERROR_MESSAGE"`
	UpdatedAt          time.Time              `bigquery:"UPDATED_AT"`
}

func (t CreditPolicyPendingTable) ref() string {
	return "`" + t.Project + "." + t.Dataset + "." + t.Table + "`"
}

// runDML executes a DML statement and waits for completion. Centralised so
// every Insert/Update goes through the same error-handling path.
func (s *Service) runDML(ctx context.Context, sql string, params []bigquery.QueryParameter) error {
	q := s.client.Query(sql)
	q.Parameters = params
	job, err := q.Run(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("dml run: %w", err)
	}
	status, err := job.Wait(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("dml wait: %w", err)
	}
	if err := status.Err(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("dml: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// InsertPending writes a new pending change as a single DML INSERT.
func (s *Service) InsertPending(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyPendingTable, row CreditPolicyPendingRow) error {
	sql := "INSERT INTO " + t.ref() + " (" +
		"CHANGE_ID, COUNTRY, STATUS, SUBMITTED_AT, SUBMITTED_BY_EMAIL, SUBMITTED_BY_NAME, " +
		"TOOLS_CSV, APPROVALS_CSV, APPROVAL_COUNT, DIFFS_JSON, FIELD_CHANGES_JSON, " +
		"APPLIED_AT, PUBLISHED_COMMIT_SHA, FAILED_AT, ERROR_MESSAGE, UPDATED_AT" +
		") VALUES (" +
		"@change_id, @country, @status, @submitted_at, @submitted_by_email, @submitted_by_name, " +
		"@tools_csv, @approvals_csv, @approval_count, @diffs_json, @field_changes_json, " +
		"@applied_at, @published_commit_sha, @failed_at, @error_message, @updated_at" +
		")"
	return s.runDML(ctx, sql, pendingRowParams(row))
}

// UpdatePending overwrites every mutable column for a change. Callers load,
// mutate the in-memory struct, and write it back — the handlers don't need
// to know which columns changed.
func (s *Service) UpdatePending(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyPendingTable, row CreditPolicyPendingRow) error {
	sql := "UPDATE " + t.ref() + " SET " +
		"STATUS = @status, " +
		"SUBMITTED_BY_NAME = @submitted_by_name, " +
		"TOOLS_CSV = @tools_csv, " +
		"APPROVALS_CSV = @approvals_csv, " +
		"APPROVAL_COUNT = @approval_count, " +
		"DIFFS_JSON = @diffs_json, " +
		"FIELD_CHANGES_JSON = @field_changes_json, " +
		"APPLIED_AT = @applied_at, " +
		"PUBLISHED_COMMIT_SHA = @published_commit_sha, " +
		"FAILED_AT = @failed_at, " +
		"ERROR_MESSAGE = @error_message, " +
		"UPDATED_AT = @updated_at " +
		"WHERE CHANGE_ID = @change_id"
	return s.runDML(ctx, sql, pendingRowParams(row))
}

// pendingRowParams maps a CreditPolicyPendingRow to query parameters.
// Used by both InsertPending and UpdatePending so the column ↔ parameter
// mapping lives in one place.
func pendingRowParams(row CreditPolicyPendingRow) []bigquery.QueryParameter {
	return []bigquery.QueryParameter{
		{Name: "change_id", Value: row.ChangeID},
		{Name: "country", Value: row.Country},
		{Name: "status", Value: row.Status},
		{Name: "submitted_at", Value: row.SubmittedAt},
		{Name: "submitted_by_email", Value: row.SubmittedByEmail},
		{Name: "submitted_by_name", Value: row.SubmittedByName},
		{Name: "tools_csv", Value: row.ToolsCSV},
		{Name: "approvals_csv", Value: row.ApprovalsCSV},
		{Name: "approval_count", Value: row.ApprovalCount},
		{Name: "diffs_json", Value: row.DiffsJSON},
		{Name: "field_changes_json", Value: row.FieldChangesJSON},
		{Name: "applied_at", Value: row.AppliedAt},
		{Name: "published_commit_sha", Value: row.PublishedCommitSHA},
		{Name: "failed_at", Value: row.FailedAt},
		{Name: "error_message", Value: row.ErrorMessage},
		{Name: "updated_at", Value: row.UpdatedAt},
	}
}

const pendingSelectColumns = "CHANGE_ID, COUNTRY, STATUS, SUBMITTED_AT, " +
	"SUBMITTED_BY_EMAIL, SUBMITTED_BY_NAME, TOOLS_CSV, APPROVALS_CSV, " +
	"APPROVAL_COUNT, DIFFS_JSON, FIELD_CHANGES_JSON, APPLIED_AT, " +
	"PUBLISHED_COMMIT_SHA, FAILED_AT, ERROR_MESSAGE, UPDATED_AT"

// GetPending returns the row for a single change ID, or nil if not found.
func (s *Service) GetPending(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyPendingTable, changeID string) (*CreditPolicyPendingRow, error) {
	q := s.client.Query("SELECT " + pendingSelectColumns + " FROM " + t.ref() + " WHERE CHANGE_ID = @id LIMIT 1")
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{{Name: "id", Value: changeID}}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get pending: %w", err)
	}
	var row CreditPolicyPendingRow
	if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
		if err == iterator.Done {
			return nil, nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("get pending read: %w", err)
	}
	return &row, nil
}

// ListPending returns rows ordered by SUBMITTED_AT DESC. If status is
// non-empty, filters to that status; otherwise returns all rows.
func (s *Service) ListPending(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyPendingTable, status string) ([]CreditPolicyPendingRow, error) {
	sql := "SELECT " + pendingSelectColumns + " FROM " + t.ref()
	var params []bigquery.QueryParameter
	if status != "" {
		sql += " WHERE STATUS = @status"
		params = append(params, bigquery.QueryParameter{Name: "status", Value: status})
	}
	sql += " ORDER BY SUBMITTED_AT DESC"
	q := s.client.Query(sql)
	q.Parameters = params
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list pending: %w", err)
	}
	var rows []CreditPolicyPendingRow
	for {
		var row CreditPolicyPendingRow
		if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
			if err == iterator.Done {
				break
			}
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list pending read: %w", err)
		}
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	return rows, nil
}

// PendingForCountry returns the in-flight pending change for a country, or
// nil if none. Used as the per-country lock when a user opens edit mode.
func (s *Service) PendingForCountry(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyPendingTable, cc string) (*CreditPolicyPendingRow, error) {
	q := s.client.Query("SELECT " + pendingSelectColumns + " FROM " + t.ref() +
		" WHERE COUNTRY = @cc AND STATUS = 'pending' ORDER BY SUBMITTED_AT DESC LIMIT 1")
	q.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{{Name: "cc", Value: cc}}
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("pending for country: %w", err)
	}
	var row CreditPolicyPendingRow
	if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
		if err == iterator.Done {
			return nil, nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("pending for country read: %w", err)
	}
	return &row, nil
}

// CountPending returns the number of rows currently in 'pending' status.
// Used by the header badge on the credit-policy view page.
func (s *Service) CountPending(ctx context.Context, t CreditPolicyPendingTable) (int, error) {
	q := s.client.Query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM " + t.ref() + " WHERE STATUS = 'pending'")
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("count pending: %w", err)
	}
	var row struct {
		N int64 `bigquery:"n"`
	}
	if err := it.Next(&row); err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("count pending read: %w", err)
	}
	return int(row.N), nil
}
```

```go
package country

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/utils"
)

type key int8

const (
	ctxKey key = 0

	ZA = "za"
	UG = "ug"
	KE = "ke"
	ZM = "zm"
	TZ = "tz"
)

type Country struct {
	Name string
	Code string
}

var (
	List = []Country{
		{
			Name: "South Africa",
			Code: "za",
		},
		{
			Name: "Kenya",
			Code: "ke",
		},
		{
			Name: "Uganda",
			Code: "ug",
		},
		{
			Name: "Zambia",
			Code: "zm",
		},
		{
			Name: "Tanzania",
			Code: "tz",
		},
	}
)

func Set(ctx context.Context, c Country) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, ctxKey, c)
}

func FromCtx(ctx context.Context) Country {
	c, ok := ctx.Value(ctxKey).(Country)
	if !ok {
		panic("Country not on context")
	}

	return c
}

func CountryToCode(country string) string {
	if country == "" {
		return ""
	}

	for _, c := range List {
		if country == c.Name {
			return c.Code
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func CodeToCountry(code string) Country {
	for _, c := range List {
		if code == c.Code {
			return c
		}
	}

	panic(fmt.Sprintf("invalid country code %q", code))
}

func AuthorisedCountries(u auth.User) []Country {
	if u.IsSuper {
		return List
	}
	return utils.Map(u.Countries, CodeToCountry)
}
```

```go
package country

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/utils"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

type DBs struct {
	ujStore *firestore.Client
	m       map[string]*sql.DB
}

type DB struct {
	Host        string
	CountryCode string
}

func OpenDBs(ctx context.Context, ujStore *firestore.Client, uname, password string, dbs ...DB) (*DBs, error) {
	m := map[string]*sql.DB{}

	for _, db := range dbs {
		dbCfg := mysql.Config{
			User:                 uname,
			Passwd:               password,
			Net:                  "tcp",
			Addr:                 db.Host,
			DBName:               fmt.Sprintf("core_%s", db.CountryCode),
			AllowNativePasswords: true,
		}

		con, err := sql.Open("mysql", dbCfg.FormatDSN())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		if err := con.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		m[db.CountryCode] = con
	}

	return &DBs{
		ujStore: ujStore,
		m:       m,
	}, nil
}

func (d *DBs) GetDB(cc string) (*sql.DB, bool) {
	db, ok := d.m[cc]
	return db, ok
}

func (d DBs) Close() error {
	for cc, con := range d.m {
		fmt.Printf("closing %q db", cc)
		if err := con.Close(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func (dbs DBs) GetUserFunctionalAreas(ctx context.Context, user auth.User, c Country) ([]reporting.FunctionArea, error) {
	if user.IsSuper {
		return utils.Filter(reporting.FunctionAreas, func(functionalArea reporting.FunctionArea) bool {
			return !functionalArea.Hidden
		}), nil
	}

	userGroupIds, err := dbs.fetchUserGroupIds(ctx, user, c)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	functionalAreas, err := dbs.fetchFunctionalAreasForUserGroups(ctx, userGroupIds, c.Code)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return functionalAreas, nil
}

func (dbs DBs) fetchUserGroupIds(ctx context.Context, user auth.User, c Country) ([]string, error) {
	countryDb := dbs.m[c.Code]

	const userGroupQuery = `
		SELECT      sg.id id
		FROM        sec_tenant_users stu
		INNER JOIN  sec_accounts sa ON sa.id = stu.realm_account_id
		INNER JOIN  sec_group_members sgm ON stu.id = sgm.tenant_user_id 
		INNER JOIN  sec_groups sg ON sgm.user_group_id = sg.id 
		WHERE       stu.active = 1
		AND 		sa.disabled = 0
		AND			sa.email_address = ?
	`

	rows, err := countryDb.QueryContext(ctx, userGroupQuery, user.Email)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	userGroupIds := []string{}

	for rows.Next() {
		var userGroupId string

		if err := rows.Scan(&userGroupId); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		userGroupIds = append(userGroupIds, userGroupId)
	}

	return userGroupIds, nil
}

// GetUserGroups returns the Firestore UserGroup documents the user belongs
// to in the given country. Joins MySQL sec_groups (per-country, source of
// truth for group membership) with Firestore userGroups (admin-editable
// per-group settings). Returns an empty slice (no error) when the user is
// in no groups in that country.
func (dbs DBs) GetUserGroups(ctx context.Context, user auth.User, c Country) ([]UserGroup, error) {
	ids, err := dbs.fetchUserGroupIds(ctx, user, c)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}

	iter := dbs.ujStore.Collection(collection.UserGroups).
		Where("UnibosID", "in", ids).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).Documents(ctx)
	defer iter.Stop()

	var out []UserGroup
	for {
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		var ug UserGroup
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &ug); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out = append(out, ug)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (dbs DBs) fetchFunctionalAreasForUserGroups(ctx context.Context, userGroupIds []string, cc string) ([]reporting.FunctionArea, error) {
	if len(userGroupIds) == 0 {
		return []reporting.FunctionArea{}, nil
	}
	iter := dbs.ujStore.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Where("UnibosID", "in", userGroupIds).Where("CC", "==", cc).Documents(ctx)
	defer iter.Stop()

	uniqueFunctionalAreaIds := []string{}
	compareFAs := func(a, b string) bool {
		return a == b
	}

	for {
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		var ug UserGroup
		functionalAreaIds := []string{}
		mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &ug)

		for k, v := range ug.FunctionalAreas {
			if v {
				functionalAreaIds = append(functionalAreaIds, k)
			}
		}

		uniqueFunctionalAreaIds = utils.AddDistinct(uniqueFunctionalAreaIds, functionalAreaIds, compareFAs)
	}

	sort.Slice(uniqueFunctionalAreaIds, func(i, j int) bool {
		return uniqueFunctionalAreaIds[i] < uniqueFunctionalAreaIds[j]
	})

	functionalAreas := utils.Map(uniqueFunctionalAreaIds, func(id string) reporting.FunctionArea {
		return reporting.FunctionalAreasMap[id]
	})
	return functionalAreas, nil
}

func (dbs DBs) GetUserCountries(ctx context.Context, user auth.User) []Country {
	const userExists = `
		SELECT 1
		FROM sec_accounts sa
		WHERE sa.email_address = ?;
	`

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	results := make(chan Country, len(List))

	for _, c := range List {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			row := dbs.m[c.Code].QueryRowContext(ctx, userExists, user.Email)

			var i int
			err := row.Scan(&i)

			if err == nil {
				results <- c
			}
		}()
	}

	wg.Wait()
	close(results)

	countries := []Country{}
	for country := range results {
		countries = append(countries, country)
	}

	return countries
}

func (dbs DBs) GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx context.Context, user auth.User) []Country {
	if user.IsAnalyst || user.Admin || user.IsSuper {
		return List
	}
	if (time.Now().Unix()-user.CountriesSyncTime > int64(time.Minute.Seconds()*5)) || (len(user.Countries) == 0) {
		countries := dbs.GetUserCountries(ctx, user)
		docRef := dbs.ujStore.Collection(collection.Users).Doc(user.ID)
		docRef.Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
			{Path: "CountriesSyncTime", Value: time.Now().Unix()},
			{Path: "Countries", Value: utils.Map(countries, func(c Country) string {
				return c.Code
			})},
		})

		return countries
	}
	return utils.Map(user.Countries, CodeToCountry)
}

type UserGroup struct {
	ID              string
	Name            string
	FunctionalAreas map[string]bool
	CC              string
	UnibosID        string
}
```

## File: core\country\mid.go
```go
package country

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"slices"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
	"ujuzi/core/utils"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
)

func (dbs DBs) Mid(l *log.Logger) web.Middleware {
	return func(h web.Handler) web.Handler {
		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
			ctx := r.Context()
			u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

			defaultCC := u.CC
			countries := dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)
			ccs := utils.Map(countries, func(c Country) string {
				return c.Code
			})

			if u.IsSuper {
				if defaultCC == "" {
					defaultCC = "za"
				}
			} else {
				hasCountryAccess := len(countries) > 0

				if hasCountryAccess {
					if !slices.Contains(ccs, defaultCC) {
						defaultCC = countries[0].Code
					}
				} else if u.Admin || u.IsAnalyst || u.IsSuper {
					defaultCC = List[0].Code
				} else {
					layout.ErrorPage("", "You do not have access to any country.").Render(ctx, w)
					return nil
				}
			}

			cc := r.FormValue("cc")
			if cc == "" {
				l.Println("redirecting to default country code")
				http.Redirect(w, r, r.URL.Path+"?cc="+defaultCC, http.StatusSeeOther)
				return nil
			}

			var found bool
			var country Country

			for _, c := range List {
				if cc == c.Code {
					found = true
					country = c
					break
				}
			}

			if !found {
				l.Printf("redirecting to user's default country code: %q", defaultCC)
				http.Redirect(w, r, r.URL.Path+"?cc="+defaultCC, http.StatusSeeOther)
				return nil
			}

			if !u.IsAnalyst && !u.IsSuper && !u.Admin && !slices.Contains(ccs, cc) {
				ErrorPageWithCountry("", fmt.Sprintf("You do not have access to %s.", country.Name), cc, countries, uj.IsEmbedded(r)).Render(ctx, w)
				return nil
			}

			ctx = Set(ctx, country)
			newR := r.WithContext(ctx)

			return h(w, newR)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package flash2

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

type Type int

const (
	Info Type = iota + 1
	Warn
	Err

	flashKey  = "flash"
	separator = "$"

	flashExpTime = time.Minute
)

type Flash struct {
	Type Type
	Msg  string
}

func (f Flash) Marshal() string {
	flash, err := json.Marshal(f)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	}

	return base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString(flash)
}

func Unmarshal(flash string) (Flash, error) {
	f, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(flash)
	if err != nil {
		return Flash{}, err
	}

	out := Flash{}
	err = json.Unmarshal(f, &out)
	if err != nil {
		return Flash{}, err
	}

	return out, nil
}

func Create(w http.ResponseWriter, flashType Type, msg string, now time.Time) {
	flash := Flash{
		Type: flashType,
		Msg:  msg,
	}

	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
		Name:     flashKey,
		Value:    flash.Marshal(),
		Path:     "/",
		Expires:  now.Add(flashExpTime),
		HttpOnly: true,
		Secure:   true,                  // added
		SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode, // changed from Lax
	})
}

// Get attempts to find and unmarshal a flash message. If it is successful, the Flash is returned
// with true, else false is returned.
func Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, now time.Time) (Flash, bool) {
	// get cookie
	c, err := r.Cookie(flashKey)
	if err != nil {
		return Flash{}, false
	}

	flash, err := Unmarshal(c.Value)
	if err != nil {
		return Flash{}, false
	}

	// delete cookie
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
		Name:     flashKey,
		Value:    "",
		Path:     "/",
		Expires:  now.Add(-time.Hour * 24),
		HttpOnly: true,
		Secure:   true,                  // added
		SameSite: http.SameSiteNoneMode, // changed from Lax
	})

	return flash, true
}

func (t Type) String() string {
	switch t {
	case Info:
		return "Info"
	case Err:
		return "Error"
	case Warn:
		return "Warning"
	default:
		panic("unimplemented flash type")
	}
}
```
