```go
// Package gcs is a thin wrapper around cloud.google.com/go/storage that
// provides byte uploads with a single client lifecycle. The credit-policy
// publisher uses this to archive YAML snapshots after every approval.
package gcs

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"

	"cloud.google.com/go/storage"
)

type Service struct {
	client *storage.Client
	l      *log.Logger
}

func NewService(ctx context.Context, l *log.Logger) (*Service, error) {
	c, err := storage.NewClient(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gcs: storage.NewClient: %w", err)
	}
	return &Service{client: c, l: l}, nil
}

func (s *Service) Close() {
	if s.client != nil {
		s.client.Close()
	}
}

// Upload writes content to gs://bucket/key. Existing objects at the same key
// are overwritten — callers that need immutability should namespace by an
// idempotent ID (e.g. change ID) in the key.
func (s *Service) Upload(ctx context.Context, bucket, key string, content []byte, contentType string) error {
	w := s.client.Bucket(bucket).Object(key).NewWriter(ctx)
	if contentType != "" {
		w.ContentType = contentType
	}
	if _, err := io.Copy(w, bytes.NewReader(content)); err != nil {
		_ = w.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("gcs: write %s/%s: %w", bucket, key, err)
	}
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("gcs: close writer %s/%s: %w", bucket, key, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// URI returns the canonical gs:// URI for a key.
func URI(bucket, key string) string {
	return "gs://" + bucket + "/" + key
}
```

```go
package gdrive

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"

	"golang.org/x/oauth2/google"
	"google.golang.org/api/drive/v3"
	"google.golang.org/api/option"
)

const IMPERSONATED_USER = "ujuzi@unifi.credit"

type Service struct {
	srv *drive.Service
	l   *log.Logger
}

func NewService(ctx context.Context, l *log.Logger, serviceAccountJSON []byte) (*Service, error) {
	config, err := google.JWTConfigFromJSON(
		serviceAccountJSON,
		drive.DriveScope,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create JWT config: %w", err)
	}

	config.Subject = IMPERSONATED_USER

	srv, err := drive.NewService(ctx, option.WithTokenSource(config.TokenSource(ctx)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create drive service: %w", err)
	}

	return &Service{
		srv: srv,
		l:   l,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) UploadAndConvertToSheet(ctx context.Context, fileName string, fileContent []byte, shareWithEmail string) (string, error) {
	xlsxFileName := fileName + ".xlsx"
	xlsxFileMetadata := &drive.File{
		Name:     xlsxFileName,
		MimeType: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
	}

	tempFile, err := s.srv.Files.Create(xlsxFileMetadata).Media(bytes.NewReader(fileContent)).Do()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("could not upload temporary xlsx file: %w", err)
	}
	s.l.Printf("Temporary XLSX file '%s' uploaded with ID: %s", tempFile.Name, tempFile.Id)

	defer func() {
		err := s.srv.Files.Delete(tempFile.Id).Do()
		if err != nil {
			s.l.Printf("WARNING: Failed to delete temporary XLSX file %s: %v", tempFile.Id, err)
		} else {
			s.l.Printf("Successfully deleted temporary XLSX file %s", tempFile.Id)
		}
	}()

	sheetMetadata := &drive.File{
		Name:     fileName,
		MimeType: "application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet",
	}

	sheetFile, err := s.srv.Files.Copy(tempFile.Id, sheetMetadata).Fields("id", "name", "webViewLink").Do()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("could not convert file to Google Sheet: %w", err)
	}
	s.l.Printf("File converted to Google Sheet '%s' with ID: %s", sheetFile.Name, sheetFile.Id)

	permission := &drive.Permission{
		Type:         "user",
		Role:         "writer",
		EmailAddress: shareWithEmail,
	}

	_, err = s.srv.Permissions.Create(sheetFile.Id, permission).Do()
	if err != nil {
		s.l.Printf("WARNING: Could not share file %s with %s: %v. The file was still created.", sheetFile.Id, shareWithEmail, err)
	} else {
		s.l.Printf("File %s shared with %s", sheetFile.Id, shareWithEmail)
	}

	return sheetFile.WebViewLink, nil
}
```

```go
type UserInfo struct {
	Department string
	Office     string
	Country    string
}

func DecodeUserInfo(u *admin.User) (UserInfo, error) {
	type organizations []struct {
		Department string `mapstructure:"department"`
	}

	type addresses []struct {
		Formatted string `mapstructure:"formatted"`
	}

	orgs := organizations{}
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(u.Organizations, &orgs); err != nil {
		return UserInfo{}, err
	}

	addr := addresses{}
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(u.Addresses, &addr); err != nil {
		return UserInfo{}, err
	}

	out := UserInfo{}

	if len(orgs) > 0 {
		out.Department = orgs[0].Department
	}

	if len(addr) > 0 {
		addrString := addr[0]
		out.Office = addrString.Formatted

		_, c, ok := strings.Cut(addrString.Formatted, ",")
		if ok {
			c = strings.TrimSpace(c)
			out.Country = c
		}
	}

	return out, nil
}
```

```go
package ggroups

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/randx"
	"github.com/dustin/go-humanize"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	admin "google.golang.org/api/admin/directory/v1"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

const (
	StatusStarted = "STARTED"
	StatusSuccess = "SUCCESS"
	StatusFailed  = "FAILED"
)

var ErrSyncInProgress = errors.New("sync in progress")

type Sync struct {
	ID     string
	Time   int64
	Status string
	Reason string
}

func (s Sync) HumanTime() string {
	return humanize.Time(time.Unix(s.Time, 0))
}

func (s *Service) SyncInProgress() bool {
	return s.syncInProgress
}

func (s *Service) GetLastSync(ctx context.Context) (Sync, error) {
	iter := s.db.Collection(collection.Syncs).OrderBy("Time", firestore.Desc).Limit(1).Documents(ctx)
	d, err := iter.Next()
	if err != nil {
		return Sync{}, err
	}

	var ss Sync
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &ss); err != nil {
		return Sync{}, err
	}

	return ss, nil
}

// BackgrounSync runs a Google Groups user sync as a background job
func (s *Service) BackgrounSync(now time.Time) error {
	ctx := context.Background()

	if s.syncInProgress {
		return ErrSyncInProgress
	}

	go func() {
		if err := s.Sync(ctx, now); err != nil {
			s.l.Printf("GOOGLE GROUPS SYNC ERROR: %s", err)
		}
	}()

	return nil
}

// Sync runs a google groups sync
func (s *Service) Sync(ctx context.Context, now time.Time) error {
	syncID := randx.UID()

	s.syncInProgress = true
	defer func() {
		s.syncInProgress = false
	}()

	ss := Sync{
		ID:     syncID,
		Time:   now.Unix(),
		Status: StatusStarted,
	}
	if _, err := s.db.Collection(collection.Syncs).Doc(syncID).Set(ctx, ss); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	userCol := s.db.Collection(collection.Users)
	s.l.Println("syncing Google users")
	googleUserIds := map[string]struct{}{}
	var userCount int
	if err := s.GetAllUsers(ctx, func(u *admin.Users) error {
		count := len(u.Users)
		userCount += count

		s.l.Printf("syncing: %d users", count)

		for _, u := range u.Users {
			googleUserIds[u.Id] = struct{}{}

			uInfo, err := DecodeUserInfo(u)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}

			iter := userCol.Where("GoogleID", "==", u.Id).Limit(1).Documents(ctx)
			d, err := iter.Next()

			if err != nil && errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				if u.Archived || u.Suspended {
					continue
				}

				uid := randx.UID()

				if _, err := userCol.Doc(uid).Set(ctx, auth.User{
					ID:                uid,
					FirstName:         u.Name.GivenName,
					LastName:          u.Name.FamilyName,
					Email:             u.PrimaryEmail,
					Name:              u.Name.DisplayName,
					GoogleID:          u.Id,
					OrgUnit:           uInfo.Department,
					Country:           uInfo.Country,
					CC:                country.CountryToCode(uInfo.Country),
					Address:           uInfo.Office,
					Thumbnail:         u.ThumbnailPhotoUrl,
					LastSyncTime:      now.Unix(),
					Admin:             false,
					IsSuper:           false,
					IsAnalyst:         false,
					IsTarget:          false,
					Countries:         []string{},
					CountriesSyncTime: 0,
				}); err != nil {
					return err
				}

			} else if err != nil {
				return err
			} else {
				uid := d.Ref.ID

				var uu auth.User
				if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &uu); err != nil {
					return err
				}

				if u.Archived || u.Suspended {
					s.l.Printf("Removing user %q that is suspended or archived.", uu.Email)
					userCol.Doc(uid).Delete(ctx)
					continue
				}

				if _, err := userCol.Doc(uid).Set(ctx, auth.User{
					ID:                uid,
					FirstName:         u.Name.GivenName,
					LastName:          u.Name.FamilyName,
					Email:             u.PrimaryEmail,
					Name:              u.Name.DisplayName,
					Country:           uInfo.Country,
					CC:                country.CountryToCode(uInfo.Country),
					GoogleID:          u.Id,
					OrgUnit:           uInfo.Department,
					Address:           uInfo.Office,
					Thumbnail:         u.ThumbnailPhotoUrl,
					LastSyncTime:      now.Unix(),
					Admin:             uu.Admin,
					IsAnalyst:         uu.IsAnalyst,
					IsSuper:           uu.IsSuper,
					IsTarget:          uu.IsTarget,
					FunctionalAreas:   uu.FunctionalAreas,
					Countries:         uu.Countries,
					CountriesSyncTime: uu.CountriesSyncTime,
				}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}

		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		ss.Status = StatusFailed
		ss.Reason = fmt.Sprintf("%s", err)
		if _, err := s.db.Collection(collection.Syncs).Doc(syncID).Set(ctx, ss); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return err
	}

	// cleanup users in Ujuzi that is not present in Google
	ujuziUsers, err := userCol.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, ujuziUser := range ujuziUsers {
		var uu auth.User
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(ujuziUser.Data(), &uu); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		_, ok := googleUserIds[uu.GoogleID]
		if !ok {
			s.l.Printf("Removing user %q that is no longer in Google", uu.Email)
			userCol.Doc(ujuziUser.Ref.ID).Delete(ctx)
		}
	}

	ss.Status = StatusSuccess
	ss.Reason = fmt.Sprintf("synced %d users", userCount)

	if _, err := s.db.Collection(collection.Syncs).Doc(syncID).Set(ctx, ss); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return nil
}
```

```go
package jasper

import (
	"bytes"

	"errors"

	"strings"

	"github.com/carlmjohnson/requests"
)

// Notes on Jasper API:
// - does not support url encoding for auth params, so cannot user package requests .Param("")

const (
	CtrTypeDate                = "singleValueDate"
	CtrTypeMultiSelectCheckbox = "multiSelectCheckbox"
	CtrTypeMultiSelect         = "multiSelect"
	CtrTypeSingleValueText     = "singleValueText"
	CtrTypeSingleSelect        = "singleSelect"
)

type Client struct {
	Host     string
	Uname    string
	Password string
}

func NewClient(host, uname, password string) Client {
	return Client{
		Host:     host,
		Uname:    uname,
		Password: password,
	}
}

type Option struct {
	Value string `mapstructure:"value"`
	Label string `mapstructure:"label"`
}

type InputControl struct {
	ID          string `mapstructure:"id"`
	Description string `mapstructure:"description"`
	Type        string `mapstructure:"type"`
	Label       string `mapstructure:"label"`
	Mandatory   bool   `mapstructure:"mandatory"`
	State       struct {
		Options []Option `mapstructure:"options"`
	} `mapstructure:"state"`
}

var errEmptyResp = errors.New("empty response")

func (c Client) GetInputControls(ctx context.Context, reportURI string) ([]InputControl, error) {
	out := map[string][]InputControl{}

	err := requests.
		URL(fmt.Sprintf("%s/reports%s/inputControls?j_username=%s&j_password=%s", c.Host, reportURI, c.Uname, c.Password)).
		Accept("application/json").
		ToJSON(&out).
		AddValidator(func(r *http.Response) error {
			if r.StatusCode == 204 {
				return errEmptyResp
			}

			return requests.CheckStatus(
				http.StatusOK,
				http.StatusCreated,
				http.StatusAccepted,
				http.StatusNonAuthoritativeInfo,
			)(r)
		}).
		Fetch(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, errEmptyResp) {
			return []InputControl{}, nil
		}

		return []InputControl{}, err
	}

	m := out["inputControl"]

	return m, nil
}

func (c Client) ServeFile(
	ctx context.Context,
	w http.ResponseWriter,
	r *http.Request,
	l *log.Logger,
	userEmail string,
	cc string,
	reportURI string,
	fileName string,
	fileType string,
	params map[string][]string,
) error {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%s.%s", fileName, fileType))

	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/reports%s.%s?j_username=%s&j_password=%s&", c.Host, reportURI, fileType, c.Uname, c.Password)

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Minute*8)
	defer cancel()

	req := requests.
		URL(url).
		ToWriter(w).
		Params(params)

	if err := req.Fetch(ctx); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			web.JSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, struct {
				Msg string
			}{
				Msg: "timeout",
			})

			return web.Error
		}

		return err
	}
	utils.LogEvent(l, userEmail, cc, "download", fileName, "jasper")

	return nil
}

type Resource struct {
	Version        int    `json:"version"`
	PermissionMask int    `json:"permissionMask"`
	CreationDate   string `json:"creationDate"`
	UpdateDate     string `json:"updateDate"`
	Label          string `json:"label"`
	Description    string `json:"description"`
	URI            string `json:"uri"`
	ResourceType   string `json:"resourceType"`
}

var ErrDone = errors.New("empty")

func (c Client) GetResources(ctx context.Context, page int) ([]Resource, error) {

	// TODO: use GetResourcesJSON

	out := struct {
		ResourceLookup []Resource `json:"resourceLookup"`
	}{}

	// offset goes on to 1100 (page 11)
	// 1200 has no value

	offset := page * 100

	if err := requests.
		URL(fmt.Sprintf("%s/resources?j_username=%s&j_password=%s&offset=%d", c.Host, c.Uname, c.Password, offset)).
		Accept("application/json").
		ToJSON(&out).
		AddValidator(func(r *http.Response) error {
			if r.StatusCode == 204 {
				return ErrDone
			}

			if r.StatusCode >= 200 || r.StatusCode < 300 {
				return nil
			} else {
				return errors.New("invalid status")
			}
		}).Fetch(ctx); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrDone) {
			return nil, err
		}

		return nil, err
	}

	return out.ResourceLookup, nil
}

func (c Client) GetResourcesJSON(ctx context.Context, page int) (string, error) {

	// offset goes on to 1100 (page 11)
	// 1200 has no value

	offset := page * 100

	var out string

	if err := requests.
		URL(fmt.Sprintf("%s/resources?j_username=%s&j_password=%s&offset=%d", c.Host, c.Uname, c.Password, offset)).
		Accept("application/json").
		ToString(&out).
		AddValidator(func(r *http.Response) error {
			if r.StatusCode == 204 {
				return ErrDone
			}

			if r.StatusCode >= 200 || r.StatusCode < 300 {
				return nil
			} else {
				return errors.New("invalid status")
			}
		}).Fetch(ctx); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrDone) {
			return "", err
		}

		return "", err
	}

	return out, nil
}

// SCHEDULE FUNCTIONALITY

type ReportJob struct {
	Label                 string                `json:"label"`
	BaseOutputFilename    string                `json:"baseOutputFilename"`
	OutputFormats         OutputFormats         `json:"outputFormats"`
	Source                Source                `json:"source"`

}

type SimpleTrigger struct {

	RecurrenceInterval     interface{} `json:"recurrenceInterval"`
	RecurrenceIntervalUnit interface{} `json:"recurrenceIntervalUnit"`

}

type RepositoryDestination struct {

}

type OutputFTPInfo struct {

	UserName      interface{} `json:"userName"`
}

type MailNotification struct {
	ToAddresses    ToAddresses `json:"toAddresses"`
	Subject        string      `json:"subject"`
	MessageText    string      `json:"messageText"`
	ResultSendType string      `json:"resultSendType"`
}

type ToAddresses struct {
	Address []string `json:"address"`
}

func (c Client) ScheduleReport(ctx context.Context, reportURI, reportName, fileType, userEmail, subject string, params map[string][]string) error {
	jobLabel := fmt.Sprintf("Immediate Execution: %s for %s", reportName, userEmail)

	jobRequest := ReportJob{
		Label:              jobLabel,
		BaseOutputFilename: strings.ReplaceAll(reportName, " ", "_"),
		OutputFormats: OutputFormats{
			OutputFormat: []string{strings.ToUpper(fileType)},
		},
		Source: Source{
			ReportUnitURI: reportURI,
		},
		Trigger: Trigger{
			SimpleTrigger: SimpleTrigger{
				Timezone:        "Africa/Johannesburg",
				OccurrenceCount: 1,
				StartType:       1,
			},
		},
		OutputTimeZone: "Africa/Johannesburg",
		RepositoryDestination: RepositoryDestination{
			OverwriteFiles:      false,
			SequentialFilenames: false,
			FolderURI:           path.Dir(reportURI),
			SaveToRepository:    false,
			OutputFTPInfo: OutputFTPInfo{
				Type:          "ftp",
				Port:          21,
				PropertiesMap: map[string]string{},
			},
		},
		MailNotification: &MailNotification{
			ToAddresses: ToAddresses{
				Address: []string{userEmail},
			},
			Subject:        subject,
			MessageText:    "Your scheduled report from Ujuzi is attached.",
			ResultSendType: "SEND_ATTACHMENT",
		},
	}

	if len(params) > 0 {
		jobRequest.Source.Parameters = &Parameters{
			ParameterValues: params,
		}
	}

	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/jobs", c.Host)

	reqBuilder := requests.
		URL(url).
		Method(http.MethodPut).
		BasicAuth(c.Uname, c.Password).
		ContentType("application/json").
		BodyJSON(&jobRequest)

	jobJSON, jsonErr := json.MarshalIndent(jobRequest, "", "  ")
	if jsonErr != nil {
		log.Printf("Error marshalling schedule request body for logging: %v", jsonErr)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("--- Scheduling Jasper Report (PUT) ---")
		fmt.Println("URL:", url)
		fmt.Println("Body:", string(jobJSON))
		fmt.Println("--------------------------------------")
	}

	var responseBody strings.Builder
	err := reqBuilder.
		ToWriter(&responseBody).
		AddValidator(requests.CheckStatus(http.StatusOK, http.StatusCreated)).
		Fetch(ctx)

	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to schedule jasper report: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

// SCHEDULE TABLE FUNCTIONALITY

type JobSummary struct {
	ID               int    `json:"id"`
	Label            string `json:"label"`
	URI              string `json:"uri"`
	PreviousFireTime string `json:"previousFireTime"`
	NextFireTime     string `json:"nextFireTime"`
}

type CombinedJobDetails struct {
	ReportJob
	PreviousFireTime string `json:"previousFireTime"`
	NextFireTime     string `json:"nextFireTime"`
}

func (c Client) GetScheduledJobs(ctx context.Context) ([]CombinedJobDetails, error) {
	var jobSummaries struct {
		JobSummary []JobSummary `json:"jobSummary"`
	}

	err := requests.
		URL(fmt.Sprintf("%s/jobs?j_username=%s&j_password=%s&jobState=NORMAL", c.Host, c.Uname, c.Password)).
		Accept("application/json").
		ToJSON(&jobSummaries).
		Fetch(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get job list from jasper: %w", err)
	}

	var jobs []CombinedJobDetails
	for _, summary := range jobSummaries.JobSummary {
		var jobDetails ReportJob
		err := requests.
			URL(fmt.Sprintf("%s/jobs/%d?j_username=%s&j_password=%s", c.Host, summary.ID, c.Uname, c.Password)).
			Accept("application/json").
			ToJSON(&jobDetails).
			Fetch(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("failed to get details for jasper job %d: %v", summary.ID, err)
			continue
		}

		combined := CombinedJobDetails{
			ReportJob:        jobDetails,
			PreviousFireTime: summary.PreviousFireTime,
			NextFireTime:     summary.NextFireTime,
		}
		jobs = append(jobs, combined)
	}

	return jobs, nil
}

func (c Client) GetReport(ctx context.Context, reportURI string, fileType string, params map[string][]string) ([]byte, error) {
	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/reports%s.%s?j_username=%s&j_password=%s&", c.Host, reportURI, fileType, c.Uname, c.Password)

	var reportBuffer bytes.Buffer
	err := requests.
		URL(url).
		ToBytesBuffer(&reportBuffer).
		Params(params).
		Fetch(ctx)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return reportBuffer.Bytes(), nil
}
```

## File: core\jasper\sync.go
```go
package jasper

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/randx"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

var ErrSyncInProgress = errors.New("sync in progress")

type Service struct {
	c              Client
	syncInProgress bool
	l              *log.Logger
	db             *firestore.Client
}

func NewService(c Client, l *log.Logger, db *firestore.Client) *Service {
	return &Service{
		c:  c,
		l:  l,
		db: db,
	}
}

func (s *Service) IsSyncing() bool {
	return s.syncInProgress
}

func (s *Service) Sync() (<-chan error, error) {
	s.l.Println("syncing Jasper resources")

	if s.syncInProgress {
		return nil, ErrSyncInProgress
	}
	s.syncInProgress = true

	done := make(chan error, 1) // Use a buffered channel to prevent goroutine from blocking

	go func() {
		defer func() {
			s.syncInProgress = false
			close(done)
		}()

		ctx := context.Background()

		// 1. Fetch all 'reportUnit' resources from Jasper and build a set of their URIs.
		s.l.Println("Fetching all resources from Jasper server...")
		allJasperResources := []Resource{}
		jasperReportURIs := make(map[string]struct{})
		var page int
		for {
			resources, err := s.c.GetResources(ctx, page)
			if err != nil {
				if errors.Is(err, ErrDone) {
					break // No more pages.
				}
				err = fmt.Errorf("error fetching Jasper resources page %d: %w", page, err)
				s.l.Printf("ERROR: %s", err)
				done <- err
				return
			}

			for _, r := range resources {
				if r.ResourceType == "reportUnit" {
					allJasperResources = append(allJasperResources, r)
					jasperReportURIs[r.URI] = struct{}{}
				}
			}
			page++
		}
		s.l.Printf("Fetched %d 'reportUnit' resources from Jasper.", len(allJasperResources))

		// 2. Fetch all existing Jasper reports from Firestore.
		s.l.Println("Fetching all Jasper reports from Firestore...")
		firestoreReportMap := make(map[string]string) // Map URI to Firestore document ID.
		iter := s.db.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Type", "==", reporting.TypeJasper).Documents(ctx)
		for {
			doc, err := iter.Next()
			if err == iterator.Done {
				break
			}
			if err != nil {
				err = fmt.Errorf("error fetching Firestore Jasper reports: %w", err)
				s.l.Printf("ERROR: %s", err)
				done <- err
				return
			}
			link, _ := doc.Data()["Link"].(string)
			if link != "" {
				firestoreReportMap[link] = doc.Ref.ID
			}
		}
		s.l.Printf("Found %d Jasper reports in Firestore.", len(firestoreReportMap))

		// 3. Identify and delete reports from Firestore that are not in Jasper.
		deleteBatch := s.db.Batch()
		deletedCount := 0
		for uri, docID := range firestoreReportMap {
			if _, exists := jasperReportURIs[uri]; !exists {
				docRef := s.db.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(docID)
				deleteBatch.Delete(docRef)
				deletedCount++
				s.l.Printf("Staging for deletion: Jasper report '%s' (not found on server)", uri)
			}
		}

		if deletedCount > 0 {
			if _, err := deleteBatch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
				err = fmt.Errorf("error committing deletions to Firestore: %w", err)
				s.l.Printf("ERROR: %s", err)
				done <- err
				return
			}
			s.l.Printf("Successfully deleted %d reports from Firestore.", deletedCount)
		} else {
			s.l.Println("No reports to delete from Firestore.")
		}

		// 4. Sync (add/update) reports from Jasper to Firestore.
		s.l.Println("Starting sync/update of Jasper reports to Firestore...")
		if resourcesCount, err := s.syncBatch(ctx, allJasperResources); err != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("error syncing Jasper batch: %w", err)
			s.l.Printf("ERROR: %s", err)
			done <- err
			return
		} else {
			s.l.Printf("Successfully synced/updated %d Jasper resources.", resourcesCount)
		}

		s.l.Println("Done syncing Jasper resources.")
		done <- nil
	}()

	return done, nil
}

func (s *Service) syncBatch(ctx context.Context, resources []Resource) (int, error) {

	col := s.db.Collection(collection.Reports)

	var syncCount int
	for _, r := range resources {

		// reportUnit
		// inputControl
		// file
		// jdbcDataSource
		// folder
		if r.ResourceType != "reportUnit" {
			continue
		}

		iter := col.
			Where("Type", "==", reporting.TypeJasper).
			Where("Link", "==", r.URI).
			Limit(1).
			Documents(ctx)

		d, err := iter.Next()

		cc, ok := GetUriCC(r.URI)

		// skip reports that don't have a country code
		if !ok {
			fmt.Printf("no country code: skipping report %s, %s,\n", r.Label, r.URI)
			continue
		}

		syncCount++

		if err != nil && errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
			uid := randx.UID()

			if _, err := col.Doc(uid).Set(ctx, reporting.Report{
				ID:             uid,
				Type:           reporting.TypeJasper,
				Link:           r.URI,
				Title:          r.Label,
				Description:    r.Description,
				DateAdded:      parseTime(r.CreationDate).Unix(),
				CC:             cc,
				FunctionalArea: "",
				BusinessOwners: make(map[string]string),
			}); err != nil {
				return 0, err
			}

		} else if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		} else {
			uid := d.Ref.ID

			var rr reporting.Report
			if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &rr); err != nil {
				return 0, err
			}

			if _, err := col.Doc(uid).Set(ctx, reporting.Report{
				ID:             uid,
				Type:           reporting.TypeJasper,
				Link:           rr.Link,
				Title:          r.Label,
				Description:    r.Description,
				DateAdded:      rr.DateAdded,
				CC:             rr.CC,
				FunctionalArea: rr.FunctionalArea,
				Architect:      rr.Architect,
				Builders:       rr.Builders,
				BusinessOwners: rr.BusinessOwners,
				Guide:          rr.Guide,
			}); err != nil {
				return 0, err
			}
		}
	}

	s.l.Printf("resource batch: %d\n", syncCount)

	return syncCount, nil
}

func parseTime(t string) time.Time {
	tt, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02T15:04:05", t)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	return tt
}

// /Reports/KE/Expected_Collections
func GetUriCC(uri string) (string, bool) {
	out := strings.Split(uri, "/")
	if len(out) != 4 {
		return "", false
	}

	if out[1] != "Reports" {
		return "", false
	}

	cc := strings.ToLower(out[2])

	for _, c := range country.List {
		if c.Code == cc {
			return cc, true
		}
	}

	return "", false
}

func (s Service) ClearReports(ctx context.Context) error {
	iter := s.db.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Type", "==", "JASPER").Documents(ctx)

	var count int
	for {
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				break
			} else {
				return err
			}
		}

		count++

		if _, err := doc.Ref.Delete(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	fmt.Printf("cleared %d reports", count)
	return nil
}

// SCHEDULE TABLE

func (s *Service) GetScheduledJobs(ctx context.Context) ([]CombinedJobDetails, error) {
	jobs, err := s.c.GetScheduledJobs(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		s.l.Printf("ERROR fetching scheduled jobs from Jasper: %v", err)
		return nil, err
	}
	return jobs, nil
}
```

```go
	DateAdded      int64
	CC             string
	FunctionalArea string
	URLCountryCode string
	BranchCode     string // Looker param name for the per-session branch filter (e.g. "Branch_ID"); value comes from the UJUZI_BRANCH cookie set at signin
	ConsultantCode string
	Architect      string
	Builders       string
	BusinessOwners map[string]string
	Guide          string

	DateCode       string
	PeriodCode     string
	PrevPeriodCode string
	PrevCycleCode  string
	PageTarget1    string
	PageTarget2    string
	PageTarget3    string
}

func (r Report) HumanDate() string {
	return humanize.Time(time.Unix(r.DateAdded, 0))
}

type Type string

const (
	TypeJasper Type = "JASPER"
	TypeLooker Type = "LOOKER"
	TypeTool   Type = "TOOL"
)

func (t Type) Print() string {
	switch t {
	case TypeJasper:
		return "Jasper"
	case TypeLooker:
		return "Looker"
	case TypeTool:
		return "Tool"
	default:
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("invalid reporting type %q", t))
	}
}
```

```templ
templ SelectInput(name string, label string, f form.Field, required bool, options []SelectOption) {
	<div>
		<label class="block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-gray-900">
			{ label }
		</label>
		<select
			name={ name }
			class="mt-2 block w-full border-0 py-1.5 pl-3 pr-10 text-gray-900 ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gray-600 sm:text-sm sm:leading-6"
		>
			if !required {
				<option
					value=""
					if f.Val == "" {
						selected
					}
				>-</option>
			}
			for _, o := range options {
				<option
					value={ o.Value }
					if o.Value == f.Val {
						selected
					}
				>{ o.Label }</option>
			}
		</select>
		<p class="text-red-700">
			if f.Err != "" {
				{ f.Err }
			} else {
				&nbsp;
			}
		</p>
	</div>
}

templ CheckboxDropdown(name string, label string, options []SelectOption) {

		<p class="text-red-700">
			&nbsp;
		</p>
	</div>
}
```

## File: core\uj\uj.go
```go
// package uj deals with application level controls
package uj

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"time"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

func IsEmbedded(r *http.Request) bool {
	v := r.FormValue("embedded")
	return v == "true"
}

// Redirect does an http.Redirect with certain Ujuzi specific params included
func Redirect(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, link string) error {
	u, err := url.Parse(link)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	q := u.Query()

	embedded := r.FormValue("embedded")
	cc := r.FormValue("cc")

	if embedded != "" {
		q.Set("embedded", embedded)
	}

	if cc != "" {
		q.Set("cc", cc)
	}

	u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
	link = u.String()

	http.Redirect(w, r, link, http.StatusSeeOther)
	return nil
}

func DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, link string, cookie string, now time.Time) error {
	u, err := url.Parse(link)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	q := u.Query()

	embedded := r.FormValue("embedded")
	cc := r.FormValue("cc")

	if embedded != "" {
		q.Set("embedded", embedded)
	}

	if cc != "" {
		q.Set("cc", cc)
	}

	u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
	link = u.String()

	web.DeleteCookieAndRedirect(w, r, link, cookie, http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, now)

	return nil
}

func Href(r *http.Request, link string) string {
	u, err := url.Parse(link)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	q := u.Query()

	embedded := r.FormValue("embedded")
	cc := r.FormValue("cc")

	if embedded != "" {
		q.Set("embedded", embedded)
	}

	if cc != "" {
		q.Set("cc", cc)
	}

	u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
	link = u.String()

	return link
}

func SafeHref(r *http.Request, href string) templ.SafeURL {
	return templ.SafeURL(Href(r, href))
}
```

## File: core\utils\utils.go
```go
package utils

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"time"
)

func Map[T, U any](ts []T, f func(T) U) []U {
	us := make([]U, len(ts))
	for i := range ts {
		us[i] = f(ts[i])
	}
	return us
}

func AddDistinct[T any](list []T, newItems []T, compare func(T, T) bool) []T {
	uniqueList := make([]T, len(list))
	copy(uniqueList, list)

	for _, newItem := range newItems {
		exists := false
		for _, existingItem := range uniqueList {
			if compare(existingItem, newItem) {
				exists = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !exists {
			uniqueList = append(uniqueList, newItem)
		}
	}
	return uniqueList
}

func Filter[T any](slice []T, predicate func(T) bool) []T {
	var result []T
	for _, item := range slice {
		if predicate(item) {
			result = append(result, item)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func InList(item string, list []string) bool {
	for _, v := range list {
		if v == item {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

type EventLog struct {
	Severity   string    `json:"severity"`
	EventType  string    `json:"event_type"`
	TargetType string    `json:"target_type"`
	UserID     string    `json:"user_id"`
	Target     string    `json:"target"`
	Country    string    `json:"country"`
	Timestamp  time.Time `json:"timestamp"`
}

func LogEvent(l *log.Logger, userEmail string, cc string, eventType string, target string, targetType string) {
	logEntry := EventLog{
		Severity:   "INFO",
		EventType:  eventType,
		UserID:     userEmail,
		TargetType: targetType,
		Target:     target,
		Country:    cc,
		Timestamp:  time.Now(),
	}
	entryJSON, _ := json.Marshal(logEntry)
	l.Println(string(entryJSON))
}
```

## File: core\webx\cachectl.go
```go
package webx

import (
	"crypto/md5"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/logx"
)

// ====================================================================
// ETAG CACHING

type memCache struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	// map[assetpath]md5hash
	c map[string]string
}

func newMemCache() memCache {
	return memCache{
		c: map[string]string{},
	}
}

func (c *memCache) get(route string) (string, bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	fileHash, ok := c.c[route]
	if ok {
		return fileHash, true
	}

	return "", false
}

func (c *memCache) set(route string, r io.Reader) (string, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	fileHash, err := md5Util(r)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	c.c[route] = fileHash
	return fileHash, nil
}

func md5Util(r io.Reader) (string, error) {
	h := md5.New()

	if _, err := io.Copy(h, r); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", h.Sum(nil)), nil
}

func StaticHandler(fs fs.FS, l *log.Logger, discardLogs bool) http.HandlerFunc {
	c := newMemCache()
	fileServer := http.FileServer(http.FS(fs))

	// overwrite the logger with one that discards logs
	if discardLogs {
		l = logx.NewDiscard()
	}

	// create an http handler
	h := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		// strip the leading / from the URL path to turn it into
		// a valid file path
		path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/")

		// Try to get the asset etag
		etag, ok := c.get(path)

		// if we haven't cached the asset yet, we should do that first
		if !ok {
			l.Printf("etag not set, hashing file: %s", path)

			// try to open the file for the given path
			file, err := fs.Open(path)

			if err != nil {
				// if the file does not exist, we respond with 404
				if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
					l.Print("404 -> file not found")
					w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
					w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
					w.Write([]byte("asset not found"))
					return

					// otherwise something went wrong
				} else {
					l.Printf("internal error: %s", err)
					w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
					w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
					w.Write([]byte("something went wrong!"))
					return
				}
			}

			// if the file was opened successfully, we set it in our in-mem cache
			etag, err = c.set(path, file)

			// if that fails, we return an internal server error
			if err != nil {
				l.Printf("internal error: %s", err)
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
				w.Write([]byte("internal server error (500)"))
				return
			}
		}

		// try to get the if-none-match header from the request,
		// if it is available and valid, we respond with a
		// status-304 NotModified. This informs the browser that
		// it may use the asset that is still cached - sending almost
		// zero bytes over the network
		if etag == r.Header.Get("if-none-match") {
			l.Printf("client has cached file: %s", path)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotModified)
			return

			// if the client’s browser does not have the 'if-none-match'
			// header present in the request, we set the 'cache-control' and
			// 'etag' headers
		} else {

			// The no-cache response directive indicates that the response can be stored in caches,
			// but the response must be validated with the origin server before each reuse
			//
			// https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Cache-Control
			w.Header().Set("cache-control", "no-cache")
			w.Header().Set("etag", etag)

			fileServer.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		}
	}

	return h
}
```

```go
// webx(tension)
package webx

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
)

func MidCatchConnDrop(l *log.Logger) web.Middleware {
	return func(h web.Handler) web.Handler {
		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
			err := h(w, r)
			if err == nil {
				return nil
			}

			if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				l.Println("ERROR: connection dropped")
				w.WriteHeader(499)
				return nil
			}

			// Propagate; swallowing here produced silent blank 200 responses.
			return err
		}
	}
}
```

## File: core\yamledit\yamledit.go
```go
// Package yamledit applies value-only changes to YAML files while preserving
// comments and key order. Used by the credit-policy publisher.
package yamledit

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

// FieldChange describes a single scalar-leaf update.
//
// Path is the key sequence from the document root to the scalar. For
// sequence nodes, the path entry is a stringified zero-based index ("0",
// "1", …). For mapping nodes, it is the literal key.
type FieldChange struct {
	File     string
	Path     []string
	OldValue string
	NewValue string
}

// ApplyChanges parses input, applies every change in order, and re-serialises.
// Comments and key order survive because we walk yaml.Node directly.
//
// The new scalar value is rendered to match the formatting of the original
// (same decimal-place count when both are numeric, integer-shape when the
// original had no dot). Non-numeric strings are written verbatim.
func ApplyChanges(input []byte, changes []FieldChange) ([]byte, error) {
	if len(changes) == 0 {
		return input, nil
	}

	var root yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(input, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("yamledit: parse: %w", err)
	}

	for i, ch := range changes {
		if err := applyOne(&root, ch.Path, ch.NewValue); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("yamledit: change %d %v: %w", i, ch.Path, err)
		}
	}

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	enc := yaml.NewEncoder(&buf)
	enc.SetIndent(2)
	if err := enc.Encode(&root); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("yamledit: encode: %w", err)
	}
	if err := enc.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("yamledit: close encoder: %w", err)
	}
	return buf.Bytes(), nil
}

func applyOne(root *yaml.Node, path []string, newRaw string) error {
	if len(path) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("empty path")
	}
	node := root
	if node.Kind == yaml.DocumentNode {
		if len(node.Content) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("empty document")
		}
		node = node.Content[0]
	}
	for i, seg := range path {
		isLast := i == len(path)-1
		// Promote a null scalar to an empty mapping so we can descend.
		// Some YAML files have keys like `withdrawal_charges:` with the
		// body commented out — the resulting node has Kind=Scalar/Value="".
		// Without this, any edit nested under such a key would fail.
		if node.Kind == yaml.ScalarNode && node.Value == "" {
			node.Kind = yaml.MappingNode
			node.Tag = ""
			node.Content = nil
		}
		switch node.Kind {
		case yaml.MappingNode:
			next := mappingValue(node, seg)
			if next == nil {
				// Auto-create the missing key. Intermediate segments
				// become empty mappings so the next iteration can
				// descend; the leaf becomes a fresh scalar that the
				// formatter below will fill.
				keyNode := &yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Value: seg}
				var valNode *yaml.Node
				if isLast {
					valNode = &yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode}
				} else {
					valNode = &yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.MappingNode}
				}
				node.Content = append(node.Content, keyNode, valNode)
				node = valNode
			} else {
				node = next
			}
		case yaml.SequenceNode:
			idx, err := strconv.Atoi(seg)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("path[%d] %q: expected sequence index, got non-integer", i, seg)
			}
			if idx < 0 || idx >= len(node.Content) {
				return fmt.Errorf("path[%d] index %d out of range (len=%d)", i, idx, len(node.Content))
			}
			node = node.Content[idx]
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("path[%d] %q: cannot descend into kind %d", i, seg, node.Kind)
		}
	}
	if node.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode {
		return fmt.Errorf("leaf is not scalar (kind=%d)", node.Kind)
	}
	node.Value = formatLikeOriginal(node.Value, newRaw)
	return nil
}

func mappingValue(m *yaml.Node, key string) *yaml.Node {
	for i := 0; i+1 < len(m.Content); i += 2 {
		if m.Content[i].Value == key {
			return m.Content[i+1]
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// formatLikeOriginal renders newRaw with the same decimal-place count as orig.
// If newRaw is not numeric, it is returned verbatim.
func formatLikeOriginal(orig, newRaw string) string {
	newF, err := strconv.ParseFloat(newRaw, 64)
	if err != nil {
		return newRaw
	}
	dot := strings.Index(orig, ".")
	if dot < 0 {
		if newF == float64(int64(newF)) {
			return strconv.FormatInt(int64(newF), 10)
		}
		return strconv.FormatFloat(newF, 'f', -1, 64)
	}
	decimals := len(orig) - dot - 1
	return strconv.FormatFloat(newF, 'f', decimals, 64)
}
```

```go
package yamledit

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

func TestApplyChanges_PreservesCommentsAndOrder(t *testing.T) {
	src := []byte(`za:
  # Top-of-file comment
  scorecard_type:
    acquisition:
      client_score:
        aa1:
          product:
            - product_name: usecured
              normal_interest_rate: 0.2775 # current ZA rate
              arrears_interest_rate: 0.2775
              max_term: 9
              core:
                rule_based_max_disbursement_limit: 10000.00
                gross_salary_multiple_max_disbursement_limit: 0.55
              test:
                rule_based_max_disbursement_limit: 12000.00
                gross_salary_multiple_max_disbursement_limit: 0.55
`)
	changes := []FieldChange{
		{
			Path:     []string{"za", "scorecard_type", "acquisition", "client_score", "aa1", "product", "0", "normal_interest_rate"},
			OldValue: "27.8%",
			NewValue: "0.30",
		},
		{
			Path:     []string{"za", "scorecard_type", "acquisition", "client_score", "aa1", "product", "0", "core", "rule_based_max_disbursement_limit"},
			OldValue: "10,000.00",
			NewValue: "11000",
		},
		{
			Path:     []string{"za", "scorecard_type", "acquisition", "client_score", "aa1", "product", "0", "max_term"},
			OldValue: "9 months",
			NewValue: "12",
		},
	}

	out, err := ApplyChanges(src, changes)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApplyChanges: %v", err)
	}
	got := string(out)

	wants := []string{
		"# Top-of-file comment",
		"# current ZA rate",
		"normal_interest_rate: 0.3000",     // matches 4 decimal places of original 0.2775
		"rule_based_max_disbursement_limit: 11000.00", // matches 2 decimal places
		"max_term: 12",
	}
	for _, want := range wants {
		if !strings.Contains(got, want) {
			t.Errorf("output missing %q\n--- got ---\n%s", want, got)
		}
	}

	if !strings.Contains(got, "product_name: usecured") {
		t.Errorf("output lost product_name line:\n%s", got)
	}

	idxNormal := strings.Index(got, "normal_interest_rate")
	idxArrears := strings.Index(got, "arrears_interest_rate")
	idxMax := strings.Index(got, "max_term")
	if !(idxNormal < idxArrears && idxArrears < idxMax) {
		t.Errorf("key order corrupted: normal=%d arrears=%d max=%d\n%s", idxNormal, idxArrears, idxMax, got)
	}

	var parsed map[string]any
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(out, &parsed); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("output is not valid YAML: %v\n%s", err, got)
	}
}

func TestApplyChanges_PlatformTier(t *testing.T) {
	src := []byte(`za:
  withdrawal_charges:
    mobile_money: 10.00
    cash:
      - tier: 1
        value_from_inclusive: 0.00
        value_to_inclusive: 1999.99
        cash_withdraw_fee: 80.00
      - tier: 2
        value_from_inclusive: 2000.00
        value_to_inclusive: 3999.99
        cash_withdraw_fee: 100.00
`)
	changes := []FieldChange{
		{
			Path:     []string{"za", "withdrawal_charges", "mobile_money"},
			OldValue: "10.00",
			NewValue: "12.50",
		},
		{
			Path:     []string{"za", "withdrawal_charges", "cash", "1", "cash_withdraw_fee"},
			OldValue: "100.00",
			NewValue: "110",
		},
	}
	out, err := ApplyChanges(src, changes)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApplyChanges: %v", err)
	}
	got := string(out)

	if !strings.Contains(got, "mobile_money: 12.50") {
		t.Errorf("mobile_money not updated:\n%s", got)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(got, "cash_withdraw_fee: 110.00") {
		t.Errorf("tier-1 cash_withdraw_fee not updated to 110.00:\n%s", got)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(got, "cash_withdraw_fee: 80.00") {
		t.Errorf("tier-0 cash_withdraw_fee should be unchanged at 80.00:\n%s", got)
	}
}

func TestApplyChanges_MissingKeyAutoCreated(t *testing.T) {
	src := []byte("za:\n  foo: 1\n")
	out, err := ApplyChanges(src, []FieldChange{
		{Path: []string{"za", "bar"}, NewValue: "2"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	got := string(out)
	if !strings.Contains(got, "bar: 2") {
		t.Errorf("expected new key bar to be created:\n%s", got)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(got, "foo: 1") {
		t.Errorf("existing key foo lost:\n%s", got)
	}
}

func TestApplyChanges_NullScalarPromoted(t *testing.T) {
	// Mirrors ZA's platform.yml: withdrawal_charges: with all children
	// commented out. yamledit should promote the null scalar to a mapping
	// and add the missing leaf key on the fly.
	src := []byte("za:\n  withdrawal_charges:\n")
	out, err := ApplyChanges(src, []FieldChange{
		{Path: []string{"za", "withdrawal_charges", "mobile_money"}, NewValue: "5"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	got := string(out)
	if !strings.Contains(got, "mobile_money: 5") {
		t.Errorf("expected mobile_money to be created:\n%s", got)
	}
}

func TestFormatLikeOriginal(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		orig, raw, want string
	}{
		{"10000.00", "11000", "11000.00"},
		{"10000.00", "11000.5", "11000.50"},
		{"0.2775", "0.3", "0.3000"},
		{"9", "12", "12"},
		{"160", "165", "165"},
		{"text", "x", "x"},
		{"10.5", "10.567", "10.6"},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		got := formatLikeOriginal(c.orig, c.raw)
		if got != c.want {
			t.Errorf("formatLikeOriginal(%q, %q) = %q, want %q", c.orig, c.raw, got, c.want)
		}
	}
}
```

## File: iframe_server\main.go
```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/logx"
)

func main() {
	l := logx.New("")
	if err := run(l); err != nil {
		l.Printf("ERROR: %s", err)
	}
}

func run(l *log.Logger) error {

	app := web.NewApp()

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
		ctx := r.Context()
		return IFrame().Render(ctx, w)
	})

	l.Println("listening at :8889")

	server := http.Server{
		Addr:    ":8889",
		Handler: app,
	}

	fmt.Println(server.ListenAndServe())

	return nil
}
```

```go
	}

	if err != nil {

	}

	}

func printList[T any](list []T) {
	for _, item := range list {
		fmt.Println(item)
	}
}

// SyncWaysOfWork populates report metadata from the WAYS_OF_WORK BigQuery table.
func (Admin) SyncWaysOfWork() error {
	ctx := context.Background()
	l := logx.New("mage")
	l.Println("Starting Ways of Work sync from BigQuery...")

	// 1. Connect to Firestore
	cfg, err := loadConf()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load config: %w", err)
	}
	db, err := connect(cfg)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to connect to Firestore: %w", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	// 2. Connect to BigQuery
	projectID := "df-frontend"
	bqClient, err := bigquery.NewClient(ctx, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("bigquery.NewClient: %w", err)
	}
	defer bqClient.Close()

	// 3. Define the struct for the BQ row
	type WaysOfWorkData struct {
		ReportName         string `bigquery:"REPORT_NAME"`
		FunctionalArea     string `bigquery:"FUNCTIONAL_AREA"`
		ReportType         string `bigquery:"REPORT_TYPE"`
		Builder            string `bigquery:"BUILDER"`
		CoBuilder          string `bigquery:"CO_BUILDER"`
		Architect          string `bigquery:"ARCHITECT"`
		BusinessOwnerKE    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_KE"`
		BusinessOwnerUG    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_UG"`
		BusinessOwnerZM    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_ZM"`
		BusinessOwnerZA    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_ZA"`
		BusinessOwnerMANZI string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_MANZI"`
		BusinessOwnerTZ    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_TZ"`
	}

	// 4. Query BigQuery
	l.Println("Querying BigQuery table: df-frontend.UJUZI.WAYS_OF_WORK")
	q := bqClient.Query("SELECT * FROM `df-frontend.UJUZI.WAYS_OF_WORK`")
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read from BigQuery: %w", err)
	}

	// 5. Iterate and update Firestore
	var updatedCount int
	for {
		var wowData WaysOfWorkData
		err := it.Next(&wowData)
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("error iterating BigQuery results: %w", err)
		}

		reportName := wowData.ReportName
		if reportName == "" {
			l.Println("Skipping row with empty REPORT_NAME")
			continue
		}

		// Find reports in Firestore with the same title
		reportIter := db.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", reportName).Documents(ctx)
		docs, err := reportIter.GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			l.Printf("Error querying Firestore for report '%s': %v", reportName, err)
			continue // continue to next BQ row
		}

		if len(docs) == 0 {
			l.Printf("No matching report found in Ujuzi for '%s'. Skipping.", reportName)
			continue
		}

		// Prepare data for update
		var builders []string
		if wowData.Builder != "" {
			builders = append(builders, wowData.Builder)
		}
		if wowData.CoBuilder != "" {
			builders = append(builders, wowData.CoBuilder)
		}

		businessOwners := map[string]string{
			"ke":    wowData.BusinessOwnerKE,
			"ug":    wowData.BusinessOwnerUG,
			"zm":    wowData.BusinessOwnerZM,
			"za":    wowData.BusinessOwnerZA,
			"manzi": wowData.BusinessOwnerMANZI,
			"tz":    wowData.BusinessOwnerTZ,
		}

		// Update all matching reports in Firestore
		batch := db.Batch()
		for _, doc := range docs {
			updates := []firestore.Update{
				{Path: "Architect", Value: wowData.Architect},
				{Path: "Builders", Value: strings.Join(builders, ", ")},
				{Path: "BusinessOwners", Value: businessOwners},
			}
			batch.Update(doc.Ref, updates)
			l.Printf("Staging update for report '%s' (ID: %s)", reportName, doc.Ref.ID)
		}

		// Commit the batch
		if _, err = batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			l.Printf("Error committing updates for report '%s': %v", reportName, err)
		} else {
			updatedCount += len(docs)
		}
	}

	l.Printf("Sync complete. Updated %d report documents.", updatedCount)
	return nil
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/logx"
	"github.com/magefile/mage/mg"

	"ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/modules/tools/creditpolicy"
)

type CreditPolicy mg.Namespace

// Mirrors app/main.go — credit-policy config is identical across environments.
const (
	cpBQProject     = "df-fs-insights"
	cpBQDataset     = "INSIGHTS"
	cpBQActiveTable = "CREDIT_POLICY"
	cpRepoURL       = "https://bitbucket.org/unibos/credit-policy-config.git"
	cpRepoBranch    = "master"
)

// BackfillActive seeds the active CREDIT_POLICY table from current Bitbucket
// master, one row per country. Idempotent — safe to re-run.
func (CreditPolicy) BackfillActive() error {
	ctx := context.Background()
	l := logx.New("mage")

	cfg, err := loadConf()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("load config: %w", err)
	}

	svc, err := bq.NewService(ctx, l, cpBQProject, cpBQDataset, cpBQActiveTable)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("bq service: %w", err)
	}

	bb := creditpolicy.NewBitbucketClient(cpRepoURL, cpRepoBranch, cfg.CreditPolicyBitbucketAuth)
	active := bq.CreditPolicyActiveTable{Project: cpBQProject, Dataset: cpBQDataset, Table: cpBQActiveTable}

	codes, err := creditpolicy.BackfillActivePolicy(ctx, bb, svc, active)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, cc := range codes {
		l.Printf("seeded active policy: %s", cc)
	}

	n, err := svc.CountActivePolicy(ctx, active)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("count active policy: %w", err)
	}
	l.Printf("done — %d countries written, %d rows in %s", len(codes), n, cpBQActiveTable)
	return nil
}
```

```go
func initAdmin(ctx context.Context) *admin.Service {
	cfg, err := loadConf()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	scBytes, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(cfg.ServiceAcc)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	config, err := google.JWTConfigFromJSON(
		scBytes,
		admin.AdminDirectoryGroupReadonlyScope,
		admin.AdminDirectoryUserReadonlyScope,
		admin.AdminDirectoryGroupMemberReadonlyScope,
	)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	config.Subject = ASSUME_IDENTITY
	srv, err := admin.NewService(ctx, option.WithTokenSource(config.TokenSource(ctx)))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	return srv
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// Hello starts an http server that returns 'hello world'
func Hello(host string) error {

	server := http.Server{
		Addr: host,
		Handler: http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "Hello World")
		}),
	}

	fmt.Printf("running at %q\n", host)

	if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return nil
}
```

```go
	if err != nil {

	cfg, err := loadConf()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	c := jasper.NewClient(cfg.JasperHost, cfg.JasperUname, cfg.JasperPassword)
	l := logx.New("")

	db, err := connect(cfg)
	if err != nil {

	done, err := s.Sync()
	if err != nil {

	}

	if err := <-done; err != nil {

	}

	return nil
```

```go
	country := "South Africa"
	urlCountryCode := "df288"

	// Construct the query parameter dynamically
	// ?params=%7B"df288":"include%25EE%2580%25800%25EE%2580%2580IN%25EE%2580%2580Kenya"%7D
	query := fmt.Sprintf(`{"%s":"include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s"}`, urlCountryCode, country)
	encodedQuery := url.QueryEscape(query)

	// Append the query parameter to the base URL
	finalURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s?params=%s", baseURL, encodedQuery)

	fmt.Println(finalURL)

	return nil
}
```

```go
package main

func (Admin) ExportReports() error {
	cfg, err := loadConf()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	db, err := connect(cfg)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	ctx := context.Background()

	reports := []reporting.Report{}
	for _, c := range country.List {
		fmt.Printf("exporting %q\n", c.Code)

		iter := db.
			Collection(collection.Reports).
			Where("CC", "==", c.Code).
			OrderBy("FunctionalArea", firestore.Asc).
			Documents(ctx)

		for {
			d, err := iter.Next()
			if err != nil {
				if err == iterator.Done {
					break
				}
				return err
			}

			var r reporting.Report
			if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &r); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			// if r.Type == "JASPER" {
			// 	continue
			// }

			reports = append(reports, r)
		}

		if f, err := os.Create("./exports/reports.csv"); err != nil {
			return err
		} else {
			csvw := csv.NewWriter(f)

			csvw.Write([]string{
				"Title",
				"Country Code",
				"Functional Area",
				"Link",
				"Type",
			})

			for _, r := range reports {
				if err := csvw.Write([]string{
					r.Title,
					r.CC,
					r.FunctionalArea,
					r.Link,
					string(r.Type),
				}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}

			csvw.Flush()
			if err := csvw.Error(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func getOffice(a string) string {
	locationAndCountry := strings.Split(a, ", ")
	if len(locationAndCountry) != 2 {
		return ""
	}

	return locationAndCountry[0]
}

func getOfficeCountry(a string) string {
	locationAndCountry := strings.Split(a, ", ")
	if len(locationAndCountry) != 2 {
		return ""
	}

	return locationAndCountry[1]
}

func (Admin) ExportUsersByRole() error {
	cfg, err := loadConf()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	db, err := connect(cfg)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	ctx := context.Background()

	iter := db.
		Collection(collection.Users).
		OrderBy("OrgUnit", firestore.Desc).
		Documents(ctx)

	admin_users := []auth.User{}
	analyst_users := []auth.User{}
	standard_users := []auth.User{}

	for {
		d, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if err == iterator.Done {
				break
			}
			return err
		}

		var u auth.User
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &u); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if u.Admin {
			admin_users = append(admin_users, u)
		}

		if u.IsAnalyst {
			analyst_users = append(analyst_users, u)
		}

		if !u.Admin || !u.IsAnalyst {
			standard_users = append(standard_users, u)
		}
	}

	lists := [][]auth.User{admin_users, analyst_users, standard_users}
	headers := []string{"ADMINS", "ANALYSTS", "OTHERS"}

	if f, err := os.Create("./users.csv"); err != nil {
		return err
	} else {
		csvw := csv.NewWriter(f)
		for i, users := range lists {
			csvw.Write([]string{
				"====================",
				headers[i],
				"====================",
			})
			csvw.Write([]string{
				"First Name",
				"Last Name",
				"Email",
				"Org Unit",
				"Office",
				"Office Country",
				"Country Code",
				"Activations",
				"Collections",
				"FinancialOperations",
				"FinancialReporting",
				"InternalAudit",
				"KYC",
				"Productivity",
				"Recoveries",
				"Sales",
				"Operations",
				"CreditAndPolicy",
			})

			for _, u := range users {
				if err := csvw.Write([]string{
					u.FirstName,
					u.LastName,
					u.Email,
					u.OrgUnit,
					getOffice(u.Address),
					getOfficeCountry(u.Address),
					u.CC,
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.Activations),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.Collections),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.FinancialOperations),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.FinancialReporting),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.InternalAudit),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.KYC),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.Productivity),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.Recoveries),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.Sales),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.Operations),
					fmt.Sprint(u.FunctionalAreas.CreditAndPolicy),
				}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}

			csvw.Write([]string{
				"====================",
			})
			csvw.Write([]string{
				"====================",
			})
			csvw.Write([]string{})

			csvw.Flush()
			if err := csvw.Error(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"ujuzi/core/country"

	"github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
)

func QueryPerm() error {
	cfg, err := loadConf()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	dbCfg := mysql.Config{
		User:                 cfg.UnifiDbUser,
		Passwd:               cfg.UnifiDbPassword,
		Net:                  "tcp",
		Addr:                 cfg.UnifiDbZaHost,
		DBName:               "core_za",
		AllowNativePasswords: true,
	}

	db, err := sql.Open("mysql", dbCfg.FormatDSN())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer db.Close()

	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := db.PingContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	const q = `
		SELECT      sa.email_address email, sg.group_name group_name
		FROM        sec_tenant_users stu
					INNER JOIN sec_accounts sa ON sa.id = stu.realm_account_id
					INNER JOIN sec_group_members sgm ON stu.id = sgm.tenant_user_id 
					INNER JOIN sec_groups sg ON sgm.user_group_id = sg.id 
		WHERE       stu.active = 1
		AND sa.disabled = 0
		ORDER BY     sa.email_address, sg.group_name
		;
	`

	rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, q)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	type user struct {
		Email string
		Group string
	}

	users := []user{}

	for rows.Next() {
		u := user{}

		if err := rows.Scan(&u.Email, &u.Group); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		users = append(users, u)
	}

	for _, u := range users {
		fmt.Printf("%s\t\t%s\n", u.Email, u.Group)
	}

	return nil
}

func FetchCountries(email string) error {
	ctx := context.Background()

	const userExists = `
		SELECT 1
		FROM sec_accounts sa
		WHERE sa.email_address = ?;
	`
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	results := make(chan country.Country, len(country.List))

	for _, c := range country.List {
		dbCfg := mysql.Config{
			User:                 "root",
			Passwd:               "",
			Net:                  "tcp",
			Addr:                 "127.0.0.1",
			DBName:               fmt.Sprintf("core_%s", c.Code),
			AllowNativePasswords: true,
		}

		db, err := sql.Open("mysql", dbCfg.FormatDSN())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer db.Close()

		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			row := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, userExists, email)

			var i int
			err := row.Scan(&i)

			if err == nil {
				results <- c
			}
		}()
	}

	wg.Wait()
	close(results)

	countries := []country.Country{}
	for country := range results {
		countries = append(countries, country)
	}

	fmt.Println(countries)
	return nil
}
```

## File: magefiles\util.go
```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"os"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	firebase "firebase.google.com/go"
	"github.com/ardanlabs/conf/v3"
	"google.golang.org/api/option"
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v2"
)

type Conf struct {
	Port            int `conf:"default:8080"`
	GoogleKey       string
	GoogleSecret    string
	GoogleProjectID string
	Dev             bool
	Host            string
	SessionSecret   string
	ServiceAcc      string `conf:",mask"`
	JasperHost      string
	JasperUname     string
	JasperPassword  string
	UnifiDbUser     string
	UnifiDbPassword string
	UnifiDbZaHost   string
	UnifiDbZmHost   string
	UnifiDbUgHost   string
	UnifiDbKeHost   string
	UnifiDbTzHost   string

	CreditPolicyBitbucketAuth string `conf:",mask"`
}

func loadConf() (Conf, error) {
	var cfg Conf
	f, err := os.Open("env.dev.yaml")
	if err != nil {
		return Conf{}, err
	}

	env := map[string]string{}
	if err := yaml.NewDecoder(f).Decode(env); err != nil {
		return Conf{}, err
	}

	for k, v := range env {
		os.Setenv(k, v)
	}

	if _, err = conf.Parse("", &cfg); err != nil {
		return Conf{}, err
	}

	return cfg, nil
}

func connect(cfg Conf) (*firestore.Client, error) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conf := &firebase.Config{
		ProjectID: cfg.GoogleProjectID,
	}

	saBytes, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(cfg.ServiceAcc)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	fbaseApp, err := firebase.NewApp(ctx, conf, option.WithCredentialsJSON(saBytes))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	db, err := fbaseApp.Firestore(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return db, nil
}

func connectDefault(projectID string) (*firestore.Client, error) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conf := &firebase.Config{
		ProjectID: projectID,
	}

	fbaseApp, err := firebase.NewApp(ctx, conf)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	db, err := fbaseApp.Firestore(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return db, nil
}
```

```templ
package admin

import (
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/form"

func (m module) addReportLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	f := addReportForm{
		State: make(map[string]form.Field),
	}

	return addReportPage(r, c.Code, userCountries, f).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m module) addReportAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}

	// Read the form values once
	reportType := reporting.Type(r.FormValue("Type"))
	link := r.FormValue("Link")
	name := r.FormValue("Name")
	description := r.FormValue("Description")
	fa := r.FormValue("FunctionalArea")
	urlCountryCode := r.FormValue("URLCountryCode")
	cycleCode := r.FormValue("CycleCode")
	dateCode := r.FormValue("DateCode")
	prevCycleCode := r.FormValue("PrevCycleCode")
	periodCode := r.FormValue("PeriodCode")
	prevPeriodCode := r.FormValue("PrevPeriodCode")
	pageTarget1 := r.FormValue("PageTarget1")
	pageTarget2 := r.FormValue("PageTarget2")
	pageTarget3 := r.FormValue("PageTarget3")
	branchCode := r.FormValue("BranchCode")
	consultantCode := r.FormValue("ConsultantCode")
	releaseToAll := r.FormValue("ReleaseToAll") == "on"

	// If ReleaseToAll is checked, create a report for each country
	if releaseToAll {
		for _, c := range country.List {
			id := randx.UID()
			report := reporting.Report{
				ID:             id,
				Type:           reportType,
				Link:           link,
				Title:          name,
				CC:             c.Code, // Use the country code from the loop
				Description:    description,
				DateAdded:      now.Unix(),
				FunctionalArea: fa,
				URLCountryCode: urlCountryCode,
				CycleCode:      cycleCode,
				DateCode:       dateCode,
				PrevCycleCode:  prevCycleCode,
				PeriodCode: 	periodCode,
				PrevPeriodCode: prevPeriodCode,
				PageTarget1:    pageTarget1,
				PageTarget2:    pageTarget2,
				PageTarget3:    pageTarget3,
				BranchCode:     branchCode,
				ConsultantCode: consultantCode,
				BusinessOwners: make(map[string]string),
			}
			if _, err := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(id).Set(ctx, report); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	} else {
		id := randx.UID()
		report := reporting.Report{
			ID:             id,
			Type:           reportType,
			Link:           link,
			Title:          name,
			CC:             country.FromCtx(ctx).Code, // Use the current country code
			Description:    description,
			DateAdded:      now.Unix(),
			FunctionalArea: fa,
			URLCountryCode: urlCountryCode,
			CycleCode:      cycleCode,
			DateCode:       dateCode,
			PrevCycleCode:  prevCycleCode,
			PeriodCode: 	periodCode,
			PrevPeriodCode: prevPeriodCode,
			PageTarget1:    pageTarget1,
			PageTarget2:    pageTarget2,
			PageTarget3:    pageTarget3,
			BusinessOwners: make(map[string]string),
		}
		if _, err := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(id).Set(ctx, report); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/reports")
	return nil
}

type addReportForm struct {
	State          map[string]form.Field
	Title          form.Field
	Type           form.Field
	Description    form.Field
	Link           form.Field
	FunctionalArea form.Field
	URLCountryCode form.Field
	ReleaseToAll   form.Field
}

func faOptions() []cmp.SelectOption {
	out := make([]cmp.SelectOption, len(reporting.FunctionAreas))
	for i, fa := range reporting.FunctionAreas {
		out[i] = cmp.SelectOption{
			Label: fa.Name,
			Value: fa.ID,
		}
	}

	return out
}
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/ggroups"
	"ujuzi/core/jasper"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
	"ujuzi/core/webx"
	"ujuzi/modules/base"

	"cloud.google.com/go/bigquery"
	"cloud.google.com/go/datastore"
	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/mid"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
)

type module struct {
	l              *log.Logger
	sessionStore   auth.Store
	fsDb           *firestore.Client
	dbs            *country.DBs
	js             *jasper.Service
	gg             *ggroups.Service
	reloadCache    *base.ReloadCache
	schedulesCache *SchedulesCache
	dbFsInsights   *datastore.Client
	dataformCache  *DataformCache
	bqDfFrontend   *bigquery.Client
	serviceAcc     []byte
}

func stdMid(l *log.Logger, additionalMid ...web.Middleware) []web.Middleware {
	mid := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	}

	mid = append(mid, additionalMid...)

	return mid
}

func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	fsDb *firestore.Client,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	js *jasper.Service,
	gg *ggroups.Service,
	reloadCache *base.ReloadCache,
	schedulesCache *SchedulesCache,
	dbFsInsights *datastore.Client,
	dataformCache *DataformCache,
	bqDfFrontend *bigquery.Client,
	serviceAcc []byte,
) {

	m := module{
		l:              l,
		sessionStore:   sessionStore,
		fsDb:           fsDb,
		dbs:            dbs,
		js:             js,
		gg:             gg,
		reloadCache:    reloadCache,
		schedulesCache: schedulesCache,
		dbFsInsights:   dbFsInsights,
		dataformCache:  dataformCache,
		bqDfFrontend:   bqDfFrontend,
		serviceAcc:     serviceAcc,
	}

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/reports")
		return nil
	}, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/users", m.usersLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/users", m.usersAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/usergroups", m.userGroupsLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/usergroups", m.userGroupsAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/reports", m.reportsLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/reports", m.reportsAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/reports/add", m.addReportLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/reports/add", m.addReportAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/reload", m.reloadLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/reports/{id}", m.editReportLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/reports/{id}", m.editReportAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/schedules", m.schedulesLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/jobconfig", m.jobConfigLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/jobconfig", m.createJobConfig, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/jobconfig/{id}", m.updateJobConfig, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/waysofwork", m.waysOfWorkLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/waysofwork", m.waysOfWorkAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/waysofwork/edit", m.editWaysOfWorkLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/waysofwork/edit", m.editWaysOfWorkAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/changelog", m.changelogLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/changelog", m.changelogAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/updatefa/{id}", m.updateReportFunctionalArea, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/updateusergroupfa", m.updateUserGroupFA, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/waysofwork/update", m.updateWaysOfWork, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/toggle_report_deployment", m.toggleReportDeployment, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/dataform", m.dataformLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/dataform", m.dataformAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/admin/dataform/cancel", m.dataformCancel, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/admin/dataform/{batchID}", m.dataformDetailLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	l.Println("dataform: routes registered — GET/POST /admin/dataform, POST /admin/dataform/cancel, GET /admin/dataform/{batchID}")

}

func adminTabs(r *http.Request) []Tab {
	tabs := []Tab{

				"/admin/usergroups",
			},
		},
		{
			Title:  "Reload Jobs",
			Href:   "/admin/reload",
			Active: false,
			ActiveLinks: []string{
				"/admin/reload",
			},
		},
		{
			Title:  "Ways of Work",

			},

		{
			Title:  "Schedules",
			Href:   "/admin/schedules",

			},

			Active:      false,
			ActiveLinks: []string{"/admin/jobconfig"},
		},
		{
			Title:  "Dataform",
			Href:   "/admin/dataform",
			Active: false,
			ActiveLinks: []string{
				"/admin/dataform",
			},
		},
	}

	for i, t := range tabs {
		for _, a := range t.ActiveLinks {
			if r.URL.Path == a {
				tabs[i].Active = true
				break
			}
		}

	return tabs
```

```templ
package admin

import (
	"net/http"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
)

func (m module) adminLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	return adminPage(r, c.Code, userCountries).Render(ctx, w)
}

templ adminPage(r *http.Request, cc string, userCountries []country.Country) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin") {
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto">
			@Tabs(r, adminTabs(r), cc, userCountries) {
				<h1>Overview</h1>
			}
		</div>
	}
}
```
