```go
package admin

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/randx"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

func (m module) updateReportFunctionalArea(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	type body struct {
		FunctionalAreaID string
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()
	reportID := r.PathValue("id")

	token, ok := auth.TokenFromHeader(r)
	if !ok {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "'auth' Header missing.")
	}

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.Get(ctx, now, token)
	if err != nil {
		if auth.IsNotAuthenticated(err) {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "AuthToken invalid or expired, request a new token.")
		}
		return err
	}

	if !u.Admin {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "User does not have permissions to view this resource.")
	}

	var reqBody body
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&reqBody); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body.")
	}

	// Get the document reference for the specific report.
	docRef := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(reportID)

	// Update the single document.
	_, err = docRef.Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
		{Path: "FunctionalArea", Value: reqBody.FunctionalAreaID},
	})
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("Failed to update report with ID %s: %v", reportID, err)
		return err
	}

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}

func (m module) updateUserGroupFA(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	type body struct {
		FunctionalArea string
		On             bool
		UserGroupID    string
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	token, ok := auth.TokenFromHeader(r)
	if !ok {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "'auth' Header missing.")
	}

	var reqBody body
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&reqBody); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body.")
	}

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.Get(ctx, now, token)
	if err != nil {
		if auth.IsNotAuthenticated(err) {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "AuthToken invalid or expired, request a new token.")
		}
		return err
	}

	if !u.Admin {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "User does not have permissions to view this resource.")
	}

	d, err := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Doc(reqBody.UserGroupID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("User group %q not found.", reqBody.UserGroupID))
	}

	var userGroup country.UserGroup
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &userGroup); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	fmt.Println(reqBody)

	if _, err := d.Ref.Set(ctx, map[string]any{
		"FunctionalAreas": map[string]bool{
			reqBody.FunctionalArea: reqBody.On,
		},
	}, firestore.MergeAll); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}

func (m module) updateWaysOfWork(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	// Auth check
	token, ok := auth.TokenFromHeader(r)
	if !ok {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "'auth' Header missing.")
	}
	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.Get(ctx, now, token)
	if err != nil || !u.Admin {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Forbidden")
	}

	// Decode body
	var payload struct {
		Title string `json:"Title"`
		Field string `json:"Field"`
		Value string `json:"Value"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	// Find reports by title
	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", payload.Title).Documents(ctx)
	docs, err := iter.GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(docs) == 0 {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Report not found")
	}

	batch := m.fsDb.Batch()

	for _, docSnap := range docs {
		var update firestore.Update

		switch {
		case payload.Field == "Architect":
			update = firestore.Update{Path: "Architect", Value: payload.Value}
		case payload.Field == "Builders":
			update = firestore.Update{Path: "Builders", Value: payload.Value}
		case payload.Field == "Guide":
			update = firestore.Update{Path: "Guide", Value: payload.Value}
		case strings.HasPrefix(payload.Field, "bo_"):
			cc := strings.TrimPrefix(payload.Field, "bo_")
			update = firestore.Update{Path: "BusinessOwners." + cc, Value: payload.Value}
		default:
			// No valid field, do nothing for this doc
			continue
		}

		batch.Update(docSnap.Ref, []firestore.Update{update})
	}

	if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("Failed to commit ways of work update batch: %v", err)
		return err
	}

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}

func (m module) toggleReportDeployment(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	// Auth check
	token, ok := auth.TokenFromHeader(r)
	if !ok {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "'Auth' Header missing.")
	}
	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.Get(ctx, now, token)
	if err != nil || !u.Admin {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Forbidden")
	}

	// Decode body
	var payload struct {
		Title       string `json:"Title"`
		CountryCode string `json:"CountryCode"`
		Deploy      bool   `json:"Deploy"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	if payload.Deploy {
		// --- DEPLOY (CREATE) ---
		// First check if it already exists to prevent duplicates
		checkIter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).
			Where("Title", "==", payload.Title).
			Where("CC", "==", payload.CountryCode).
			Limit(1).
			Documents(ctx)
		_, err := checkIter.Next()
		if err != iterator.Done { // If it's not Done, it means a doc was found or another error occurred
			if err == nil {
				m.l.Printf("Report '%s' already exists for country '%s', skipping creation.", payload.Title, payload.CountryCode)
				return web.Text(w, http.StatusConflict, "Report already exists for this country.")
			}
			return err
		}

		// Find a template report to copy from
		templateIter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", payload.Title).Limit(1).Documents(ctx)
		templateDoc, err := templateIter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if err == iterator.Done {
				return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Could not find a template report to copy.")
			}
			return err
		}

		var templateReport reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(templateDoc.Data(), &templateReport); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// Create the new report
		newReportID := randx.UID()
		newReport := templateReport // Copy all fields
		newReport.ID = newReportID
		newReport.CC = payload.CountryCode
		newReport.DateAdded = now.Unix() // Set a new creation date

		_, err = m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(newReportID).Set(ctx, newReport)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

	} else {
		// --- UNDEPLOY (DELETE) ---
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).
			Where("Title", "==", payload.Title).
			Where("CC", "==", payload.CountryCode).
			Limit(1).
			Documents(ctx)

		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if err == iterator.Done {
				m.l.Printf("Could not find report '%s' for country '%s' to delete. It might have been already deleted.", payload.Title, payload.CountryCode)
				return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Report to delete not found.")
			}
			return err
		}

		if _, err := doc.Ref.Delete(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}
```

```templ
package admin

type changelogPageData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	Content       string
}

func (m module) changelogLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	doc, err := m.fsDb.Collection("app_content").Doc("changelog").Get(ctx)
	var content string
	if err != nil {
		if status.Code(err) == codes.NotFound {
			content = "" // Document doesn't exist, treat content as empty
		} else {
			return err
		}
	} else {
		content, _ = doc.Data()["Content"].(string)
	}

	data := changelogPageData{
		r:             r,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		Content:       content,
	}

	return changelogPage(data).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m module) changelogAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid form")
	}

	content := r.FormValue("content")

	// We use MergeAll to create the document if it doesn't exist.
	_, err := m.fsDb.Collection("app_content").Doc("changelog").Set(ctx, map[string]interface{}{
		"Content": content,
	}, firestore.MergeAll)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changelog: %w", err)
	}

	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/changelog")
}
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"

	"cloud.google.com/go/bigquery"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"golang.org/x/oauth2/google"
	dataformapi "google.golang.org/api/dataform/v1beta1"
	"google.golang.org/api/option"
)

// ─── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const (
	dataformProjectID  = "df-fs-insights"
	dataformLocation   = "europe-west9"
	dataformRepository = "DATAFORM"
	dataformPollSecs   = 10

	bqBatchesTable    = "DATAFORM_BATCHES"
	bqExecutionsTable = "DATAFORM_EXECUTIONS"
)

var dataformBasePath = fmt.Sprintf(
	"projects/%s/locations/%s/repositories/%s",
	dataformProjectID, dataformLocation, dataformRepository,
)

// ─── In-memory state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type DataformCache struct {
	mu         sync.RWMutex
	batch      *LiveBatch
	cancelFunc context.CancelFunc
	l          *log.Logger
}

func NewDataformCache(l *log.Logger) *DataformCache {
	return &DataformCache{l: l}
}

func (c *DataformCache) Get() (*LiveBatch, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	if c.batch == nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	// return a shallow copy to avoid race on the caller side
	b := *c.batch
	countries := make([]LiveCountry, len(c.batch.Countries))
	for i, cc := range c.batch.Countries {
		cycles := make([]LiveCycle, len(cc.Cycles))
		copy(cycles, cc.Cycles)
		countries[i] = cc
		countries[i].Cycles = cycles
	}
	b.Countries = countries
	return &b, true
}

func (c *DataformCache) IsRunning() bool {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return c.batch != nil && c.batch.Status == "RUNNING"
}

func (c *DataformCache) start(batch *LiveBatch, cancel context.CancelFunc) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.batch = batch
	c.cancelFunc = cancel
}

func (c *DataformCache) cancel() {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.cancelFunc != nil {
		c.cancelFunc()
	}
}

func (c *DataformCache) updateCountryStatus(countryIdx int, status string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.batch != nil && countryIdx < len(c.batch.Countries) {
		c.batch.Countries[countryIdx].Status = status
	}
}

func (c *DataformCache) updateCycle(countryIdx, cycleIdx int, executionID, consoleLink, status string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.batch == nil {
		return
	}
	if countryIdx < len(c.batch.Countries) {
		cc := &c.batch.Countries[countryIdx]
		if cycleIdx < len(cc.Cycles) {
			cc.Cycles[cycleIdx].ExecutionID = executionID
			cc.Cycles[cycleIdx].ConsoleLink = consoleLink
			cc.Cycles[cycleIdx].Status = status
		}
	}
}

func (c *DataformCache) finish(status string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.batch != nil {
		c.batch.Status = status
		c.batch.FinishedAt = time.Now()
	}
	c.cancelFunc = nil
}

func (c *DataformCache) clear() {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.batch = nil
}

// ─── Live state types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type LiveBatch struct {
	ID          string
	Workspace   string
	TargetTag   string
	RequestedBy string
	StartedAt   time.Time
	FinishedAt  time.Time
	Status      string // RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED | CANCELLED
	Countries   []LiveCountry
}

type LiveCountry struct {
	Code      string
	SortOrder int
	Status    string // AWAITING | RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED | SKIPPED
	Cycles    []LiveCycle
}

type LiveCycle struct {
	Cycle       string
	ExecutionID string
	ConsoleLink string
	Status      string // AWAITING | RUNNING | SUCCEEDED | FAILED
}

// ─── Form input ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type dataformCountryInput struct {
	Code       string `json:"code"`
	SortOrder  int    `json:"sortOrder"`
	StartCycle string `json:"startCycle"`
	EndCycle   string `json:"endCycle"`
	Enabled    bool   `json:"enabled"`
}

// ─── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (m module) dataformLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	liveBatch, _ := m.dataformCache.Get()
	isRunning := m.dataformCache.IsRunning()
	m.l.Printf("dataform: loader — isRunning=%v batchStatus=%v bqClientNil=%v",
		isRunning, func() string {
			if liveBatch != nil {
				return liveBatch.Status
			}
			return "none"
		}(), m.bqDfFrontend == nil)

	history, err := m.queryBatchHistory(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("WARN: failed to query dataform batch history: %v", err)
		history = nil
	}

	nextMonth := time.Now().AddDate(0, 1, 0)
	maxCycle := fmt.Sprintf("%04d%02d", nextMonth.Year(), int(nextMonth.Month()))

	return dataformPage(dataformPageData{
		R:             r,
		CC:            c.Code,
		UserCountries: userCountries,
		LiveBatch:     liveBatch,
		IsRunning:     isRunning,
		History:       history,
		MaxCycle:      maxCycle,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m module) dataformAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	m.l.Println("dataform: received batch submission from", u.Email)

	if m.dataformCache.IsRunning() {
		m.l.Println("dataform: rejected — batch already running")
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusConflict, "A batch is already running.")
	}

	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid form data.")
	}

	workspace := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("workspace"))
	targetTag := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("target_tag"))
	countriesJSON := r.FormValue("countries_json")

	m.l.Printf("dataform: workspace=%q tag=%q countries_json_len=%d", workspace, targetTag, len(countriesJSON))

	if workspace == "" || targetTag == "" || countriesJSON == "" {
		m.l.Println("dataform: validation failed — missing required fields")
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "workspace, target_tag and countries_json are required.")
	}

	var countryInputs []dataformCountryInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(countriesJSON), &countryInputs); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid countries_json.")
	}

	// Build live countries
	liveCountries := make([]LiveCountry, 0, len(countryInputs))
	for _, ci := range countryInputs {
		if !ci.Enabled {
			liveCountries = append(liveCountries, LiveCountry{
				Code:      ci.Code,
				SortOrder: ci.SortOrder,
				Status:    "SKIPPED",
			})
			continue
		}

		cycles, err := generateCycles(ci.StartCycle, ci.EndCycle)
		if err != nil {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("country %s: %v", ci.Code, err))
		}

		liveCycles := make([]LiveCycle, len(cycles))
		for j, c := range cycles {
			liveCycles[j] = LiveCycle{Cycle: c, Status: "AWAITING"}
		}

		liveCountries = append(liveCountries, LiveCountry{
			Code:      ci.Code,
			SortOrder: ci.SortOrder,
			Status:    "AWAITING",
			Cycles:    liveCycles,
		})
	}

	batch := &LiveBatch{
		ID:          uuid.New().String(),
		Workspace:   workspace,
		TargetTag:   targetTag,
		RequestedBy: u.Email,
		StartedAt:   time.Now(),
		Status:      "RUNNING",
		Countries:   liveCountries,
	}

	batchCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	m.dataformCache.start(batch, cancel)

	m.l.Printf("dataform: starting batch %s with %d countries", batch.ID, len(liveCountries))
	go m.runBatch(batchCtx, batch.ID, m.serviceAcc)

	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/dataform")
}

func (m module) dataformCancel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}
	m.dataformCache.cancel()
	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/dataform")
}

func (m module) dataformDetailLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	batchID := r.PathValue("batchID")

	batch, executions, err := m.queryBatchDetail(ctx, batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to query batch detail: %w", err)
	}

	return dataformDetailPage(dataformDetailPageData{
		R:             r,
		CC:            c.Code,
		UserCountries: userCountries,
		Batch:         batch,
		Executions:    executions,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

// ─── Goroutine logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (m module) runBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string, serviceAcc []byte) {
	cache := m.dataformCache

	batch, ok := cache.Get()
	if !ok {
		return
	}

	// Build Dataform API client
	jwtConfig, err := google.JWTConfigFromJSON(serviceAcc, "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform")
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("dataform: failed to create JWT config: %v", err)
		cache.finish("FAILED")
		return
	}

	dfSvc, err := dataformapi.NewService(ctx, option.WithTokenSource(jwtConfig.TokenSource(ctx)))
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("dataform: failed to create service: %v", err)
		cache.finish("FAILED")
		return
	}

	workspacePath := fmt.Sprintf(
		"projects/%s/locations/%s/repositories/%s/workspaces/%s",
		dataformProjectID, dataformLocation, dataformRepository, batch.Workspace,
	)

	anyFailed := false

	for i, country := range batch.Countries {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			cache.finish("CANCELLED")
			m.writeBatchToBQ(batchID)
			return
		default:
		}

		if country.Status == "SKIPPED" {
			continue
		}

		cache.updateCountryStatus(i, "RUNNING")

		countryFailed := false
		for j, lc := range country.Cycles {
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				cache.finish("CANCELLED")
				m.writeBatchToBQ(batchID)
				return
			default:
			}

			cache.updateCycle(i, j, "", "", "RUNNING")

			// Step 1: Compile
			compilationName, err := m.compileWorkspace(ctx, dfSvc, workspacePath, country.Code, lc.Cycle)
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("dataform: compile failed for %s/%s: %v", country.Code, lc.Cycle, err)
				cache.updateCycle(i, j, "", "", "FAILED")
				countryFailed = true
				break
			}

			// Step 2: Invoke
			executionName, executionID, err := m.invokeWorkflow(ctx, dfSvc, compilationName, batch.TargetTag)
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("dataform: invoke failed for %s/%s: %v", country.Code, lc.Cycle, err)
				cache.updateCycle(i, j, "", "", "FAILED")
				countryFailed = true
				break
			}

			consoleLink := fmt.Sprintf(
				"https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery/dataform/locations/%s/repositories/%s/workflows/%s?project=%s",
				dataformLocation, dataformRepository, executionID, dataformProjectID,
			)
			cache.updateCycle(i, j, executionID, consoleLink, "RUNNING")

			// Step 3: Poll
			finalState, err := m.pollExecution(ctx, dfSvc, executionName)
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("dataform: poll failed for %s/%s: %v", country.Code, lc.Cycle, err)
				cache.updateCycle(i, j, executionID, consoleLink, "FAILED")
				countryFailed = true
				break
			}

			if finalState != "SUCCEEDED" {
				m.l.Printf("dataform: %s/%s ended with state %s", country.Code, lc.Cycle, finalState)
				cache.updateCycle(i, j, executionID, consoleLink, "FAILED")
				countryFailed = true
				break
			}

			cache.updateCycle(i, j, executionID, consoleLink, "SUCCEEDED")
		}

		if countryFailed {
			cache.updateCountryStatus(i, "FAILED")
			anyFailed = true
		} else {
			cache.updateCountryStatus(i, "COMPLETED")
		}
	}

	finalStatus := "COMPLETED"
	if anyFailed {
		finalStatus = "FAILED"
	}
	cache.finish(finalStatus)
	m.writeBatchToBQ(batchID)
}

func (m module) compileWorkspace(ctx context.Context, svc *dataformapi.Service, workspacePath, countryCode, cycle string) (string, error) {
	result, err := svc.Projects.Locations.Repositories.CompilationResults.
		Create(dataformBasePath, &dataformapi.CompilationResult{
			Workspace: workspacePath,
			CodeCompilationConfig: &dataformapi.CodeCompilationConfig{
				Vars: map[string]string{
					"countryCode": countryCode,
					"cycle":       cycle,
				},
			},
		}).
		Context(ctx).
		Do()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return result.Name, nil
}

func (m module) invokeWorkflow(ctx context.Context, svc *dataformapi.Service, compilationName, targetTag string) (executionName, executionID string, err error) {
	result, err := svc.Projects.Locations.Repositories.WorkflowInvocations.
		Create(dataformBasePath, &dataformapi.WorkflowInvocation{
			CompilationResult: compilationName,
			InvocationConfig: &dataformapi.InvocationConfig{
				IncludedTags:                   []string{targetTag},
				TransitiveDependenciesIncluded: true,
			},
		}).
		Context(ctx).
		Do()
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	parts := strings.Split(result.Name, "/")
	id := parts[len(parts)-1]
	return result.Name, id, nil
}

func (m module) pollExecution(ctx context.Context, svc *dataformapi.Service, executionName string) (string, error) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(dataformPollSecs * time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return "CANCELLED", ctx.Err()
		case <-ticker.C:
			inv, err := svc.Projects.Locations.Repositories.WorkflowInvocations.
				Get(executionName).
				Context(ctx).
				Do()
			if err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			switch inv.State {
			case "RUNNING", "CANCELING", "QUEUED":
				// keep polling
			default:
				return inv.State, nil
			}
		}
	}
}

// ─── BQ writes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type bqBatchRow struct {
	ID          string    `bigquery:"ID"`
	Workspace   string    `bigquery:"WORKSPACE"`
	TargetTag   string    `bigquery:"TARGET_TAG"`
	RequestedBy string    `bigquery:"REQUESTED_BY"`
	StartedAt   time.Time `bigquery:"STARTED_AT"`
	FinishedAt  time.Time `bigquery:"FINISHED_AT"`
	Status      string    `bigquery:"STATUS"`
}

type bqExecutionRow struct {
	BatchID     string `bigquery:"BATCH_ID"`
	CountryCode string `bigquery:"COUNTRY_CODE"`
	Cycle       string `bigquery:"CYCLE"`
	ExecutionID string `bigquery:"EXECUTION_ID"`
	ConsoleLink string `bigquery:"CONSOLE_LINK"`
	Status      string `bigquery:"STATUS"`
}

func (m module) writeBatchToBQ(batchID string) {
	if m.bqDfFrontend == nil {
		m.l.Println("dataform: BQ client is nil — skipping history write")
		return
	}

	batch, ok := m.dataformCache.Get()
	if !ok {
		m.l.Println("dataform: no batch in cache — skipping history write")
		return
	}
	m.l.Printf("dataform: writing batch %s (status=%s) to BQ", batch.ID, batch.Status)

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	// Write batch summary
	batchInserter := m.bqDfFrontend.Dataset("UJUZI").Table(bqBatchesTable).Inserter()
	batchRow := &bqBatchRow{
		ID:          batch.ID,
		Workspace:   batch.Workspace,
		TargetTag:   batch.TargetTag,
		RequestedBy: batch.RequestedBy,
		StartedAt:   batch.StartedAt,
		FinishedAt:  batch.FinishedAt,
		Status:      batch.Status,
	}
	if err := batchInserter.Put(ctx, batchRow); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("dataform: failed to write batch to BQ: %v", err)
	}

	// Write all execution rows
	execInserter := m.bqDfFrontend.Dataset("UJUZI").Table(bqExecutionsTable).Inserter()
	var execRows []*bqExecutionRow
	for _, country := range batch.Countries {
		for _, cycle := range country.Cycles {
			if cycle.ExecutionID == "" {
				continue
			}
			execRows = append(execRows, &bqExecutionRow{
				BatchID:     batch.ID,
				CountryCode: country.Code,
				Cycle:       cycle.Cycle,
				ExecutionID: cycle.ExecutionID,
				ConsoleLink: cycle.ConsoleLink,
				Status:      cycle.Status,
			})
		}
	}
	if len(execRows) > 0 {
		if err := execInserter.Put(ctx, execRows); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("dataform: failed to write executions to BQ: %v", err)
		}
	}

	// Clear in-memory state — completed batch is now in BQ history
	m.dataformCache.clear()
	m.l.Printf("dataform: batch %s cleared from cache", batchID)
}

// ─── BQ reads ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type BatchHistoryRow struct {
	ID          string    `bigquery:"ID"`
	Workspace   string    `bigquery:"WORKSPACE"`
	TargetTag   string    `bigquery:"TARGET_TAG"`
	RequestedBy string    `bigquery:"REQUESTED_BY"`
	StartedAt   time.Time `bigquery:"STARTED_AT"`
	FinishedAt  time.Time `bigquery:"FINISHED_AT"`
	Status      string    `bigquery:"STATUS"`
}

type ExecutionHistoryRow struct {
	BatchID     string `bigquery:"BATCH_ID"`
	CountryCode string `bigquery:"COUNTRY_CODE"`
	Cycle       string `bigquery:"CYCLE"`
	ExecutionID string `bigquery:"EXECUTION_ID"`
	ConsoleLink string `bigquery:"CONSOLE_LINK"`
	Status      string `bigquery:"STATUS"`
}

func (m module) queryBatchHistory(ctx context.Context) ([]BatchHistoryRow, error) {
	if m.bqDfFrontend == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}

	q := m.bqDfFrontend.Query(
		"SELECT ID, WORKSPACE, TARGET_TAG, REQUESTED_BY, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, STATUS " +
			"FROM `df-frontend.UJUZI.DATAFORM_BATCHES` " +
			"ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC LIMIT 50",
	)
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var rows []BatchHistoryRow
	for {
		var row BatchHistoryRow
		err := it.Next(&row)
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	return rows, nil
}

func (m module) queryBatchDetail(ctx context.Context, batchID string) (*BatchHistoryRow, []ExecutionHistoryRow, error) {
	if m.bqDfFrontend == nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("BQ client not configured")
	}

	bq := m.bqDfFrontend

	// Batch summary
	qBatch := bq.Query(
		"SELECT ID, WORKSPACE, TARGET_TAG, REQUESTED_BY, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, STATUS " +
			"FROM `df-frontend.UJUZI.DATAFORM_BATCHES` WHERE ID = @batchID LIMIT 1",
	)
	qBatch.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{{Name: "batchID", Value: batchID}}
	itBatch, err := qBatch.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("batch query: %w", err)
	}
	var batch BatchHistoryRow
	if err := itBatch.Next(&batch); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("batch not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Executions
	qExec := bq.Query(
		"SELECT BATCH_ID, COUNTRY_CODE, CYCLE, EXECUTION_ID, CONSOLE_LINK, STATUS " +
			"FROM `df-frontend.UJUZI.DATAFORM_EXECUTIONS` WHERE BATCH_ID = @batchID " +
			"ORDER BY COUNTRY_CODE, CYCLE",
	)
	qExec.Parameters = []bigquery.QueryParameter{{Name: "batchID", Value: batchID}}
	itExec, err := qExec.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("executions query: %w", err)
	}
	var execRows []ExecutionHistoryRow
	for {
		var row ExecutionHistoryRow
		if err := itExec.Next(&row); err != nil {
			break
		}
		execRows = append(execRows, row)
	}

	return &batch, execRows, nil
}

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func generateCycles(start, end string) ([]string, error) {
	if len(start) != 6 || len(end) != 6 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cycles must be 6-digit YYYYMM strings, got %q and %q", start, end)
	}

	var startY, startM, endY, endM int
	if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(start, "%4d%2d", &startY, &startM); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid start cycle %q", start)
	}
	if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(end, "%4d%2d", &endY, &endM); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid end cycle %q", end)
	}
	if startY > endY || (startY == endY && startM > endM) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("start cycle %s is after end cycle %s", start, end)
	}

	var cycles []string
	y, mo := startY, startM
	for y < endY || (y == endY && mo <= endM) {
		cycles = append(cycles, fmt.Sprintf("%04d%02d", y, mo))
		mo++
		if mo > 12 {
			mo = 1
			y++
		}
	}
	return cycles, nil
}

// groupExecutionsByCountry groups execution rows by country code, preserving order.
func groupExecutionsByCountry(rows []ExecutionHistoryRow) []countryExecutions {
	seen := map[string]*countryExecutions{}
	var order []string
	for _, r := range rows {
		if _, ok := seen[r.CountryCode]; !ok {
			seen[r.CountryCode] = &countryExecutions{Code: r.CountryCode}
			order = append(order, r.CountryCode)
		}
		seen[r.CountryCode].Rows = append(seen[r.CountryCode].Rows, r)
	}
	result := make([]countryExecutions, 0, len(order))
	for _, code := range order {
		result = append(result, *seen[code])
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Code < result[j].Code })
	return result
}

type countryExecutions struct {
	Code string
	Rows []ExecutionHistoryRow
}
```

```templ
// ─── Status helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func statusBadgeClass(status string) string {
	switch status {
	case "COMPLETED", "SUCCEEDED":
		return "inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-green-800"
	case "FAILED":
		return "inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-red-800"
	case "RUNNING":
		return "inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-blue-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-blue-800"
	case "CANCELLED":
		return "inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-yellow-800"
	default:
		return "inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-800"
	}
}

func cyclesFraction(c LiveCountry) string {
	total := len(c.Cycles)
	done := 0
	for _, cy := range c.Cycles {
		if cy.Status == "SUCCEEDED" || cy.Status == "FAILED" {
			done++
		}
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", done, total)
}

		<script>
			(function () {
				// ── Cycle helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────
				var BASE_YEAR = 2022, BASE_MONTH = 1; // Jan 2022 = absolute index 0
				var MIN_CYCLE  = '202401';             // visible minimum
				function toIdx(yyyymm) {
					var y = parseInt(yyyymm.slice(0, 4), 10);
					var m = parseInt(yyyymm.slice(4, 6), 10);
					return (y - BASE_YEAR) * 12 + (m - BASE_MONTH);
				}
				function fromIdx(idx) {
					var total = BASE_YEAR * 12 + (BASE_MONTH - 1) + idx;
					var y = Math.floor(total / 12);
					var m = (total % 12) + 1;
					return String(y) + String(m).padStart(2, '0');
				}
				function validCycle(v) {
					return /^\d{6}$/.test(v);
				}

				// ── Slider setup ───────────────────────────────────────────
				function initSlider(card, minIdx, maxIdx) {
					var sRange = card.querySelector('.range-start');
					var eRange = card.querySelector('.range-end');
					var fill   = card.querySelector('.range-fill');
					var sLabel = card.querySelector('.label-start');
					var eLabel = card.querySelector('.label-end');
					var sInput = card.querySelector('.start-cycle');
					var eInput = card.querySelector('.end-cycle');
					var oStart = card.querySelector('.override-start');
					var oEnd   = card.querySelector('.override-end');

					sRange.min = eRange.min = minIdx;
					sRange.max = eRange.max = maxIdx;
					// Default: start = 6 months before max, clamped to minIdx
					sRange.value = Math.max(minIdx, maxIdx - 6);
					eRange.value = maxIdx;

					function redraw() {
						var useOverride = validCycle(oStart.value) && validCycle(oEnd.value);
						var sText, eText, pctS, pctE;
						var span = maxIdx - minIdx || 1;

						if (useOverride) {
							sText = oStart.value;
							eText = oEnd.value;
							var sIdx = Math.max(minIdx, Math.min(maxIdx, toIdx(sText)));
							var eIdx = Math.max(minIdx, Math.min(maxIdx, toIdx(eText)));
							pctS = (sIdx - minIdx) / span * 100;
							pctE = (eIdx - minIdx) / span * 100;
							// Sync sliders to override values for visual alignment
							sRange.value = sIdx;
							eRange.value = eIdx;
						} else {
							var s = parseInt(sRange.value, 10);
							var e = parseInt(eRange.value, 10);
							if (s > e) { sRange.value = e; s = e; }
							pctS = (s - minIdx) / span * 100;
							pctE = (e - minIdx) / span * 100;
							sText = fromIdx(s);
							eText = fromIdx(e);
							sRange.style.zIndex = s >= maxIdx - 1 ? 5 : 3;
						}

						fill.style.left  = pctS + '%';
						fill.style.width = (pctE - pctS) + '%';
						sLabel.textContent = sText;
						eLabel.textContent = eText;
						sLabel.style.left = pctS + '%';
						eLabel.style.left = pctE + '%';
						sInput.value = sText;
						eInput.value = eText;
					}

					sRange.addEventListener('input', redraw);
					eRange.addEventListener('input', redraw);
					oStart.addEventListener('input', redraw);
					oEnd.addEventListener('input', redraw);
					redraw();
				}

				function initDataform() {
					var list = document.getElementById('country-cards');
					var maxCycle = list.dataset.maxCycle;
					var minIdx = toIdx(MIN_CYCLE);
					var maxIdx = toIdx(maxCycle);
					var btn = document.getElementById('df-submit-btn');

					Sortable.create(list, { handle: '.drag-handle', animation: 150 });

					list.querySelectorAll('li[data-country]').forEach(function (card) {
						initSlider(card, minIdx, maxIdx);

						// Pencil button toggles override row
						card.querySelector('.df-override-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
							var row = card.querySelector('.df-override-row');
							row.classList.toggle('hidden');
						});
					});

					// ── Submit validity check ───────────────────────────────
					function checkValidity() {
						var ws  = document.getElementById('workspace').value.trim();
						var tag = document.getElementById('target_tag').value.trim();
						var anyChecked = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')).some(function (cb) { return cb.checked; });
						var ok = ws !== '' && tag !== '' && anyChecked;
						btn.disabled = !ok;
						btn.classList.toggle('opacity-40', !ok);
						btn.classList.toggle('cursor-not-allowed', !ok);
					}
					document.getElementById('workspace').addEventListener('input', checkValidity);
					document.getElementById('target_tag').addEventListener('input', checkValidity);
					list.addEventListener('change', checkValidity);
					checkValidity();

					// ── Form submit: pack countries JSON ────────────────────
					document.getElementById('dataform-form').addEventListener('submit', function () {
						var cards = list.querySelectorAll('li[data-country]');
						var countries = [];
						cards.forEach(function (card, idx) {
							countries.push({
								code:       card.dataset.country,
								sortOrder:  idx + 1,
								startCycle: card.querySelector('.start-cycle').value,
								endCycle:   card.querySelector('.end-cycle').value,
								enabled:    card.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]').checked,
							});
						});
						document.getElementById('countries-json-input').value = JSON.stringify(countries);
					});
				}

				var s = document.createElement('script');
				s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.2/Sortable.min.js';
				s.onload = initDataform;
				document.head.appendChild(s);
			})();
		</script>
	</div>
}

		<!-- Hidden inputs for form submission -->
		<input type="hidden" class="start-cycle"/>
		<input type="hidden" class="end-cycle"/>
		<!-- Dual range slider -->
		<div class="px-1 pb-4">
			<div class="relative h-4">
				<!-- Track -->
				<div class="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 left-0 right-0 h-1 bg-gray-200 rounded-full pointer-events-none"></div>
				<!-- Filled range -->
				<div class="range-fill absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-1 bg-gray-900 rounded-full pointer-events-none" style="left:0%;width:100%"></div>
				<!-- Start handle -->
				<input type="range" class="df-range range-start" style="z-index:3"/>
				<!-- End handle -->
				<input type="range" class="df-range range-end" style="z-index:4"/>
			</div>
			<!-- Labels float under their respective thumbs -->
			<div class="relative h-4 mt-0.5">
				<span class="label-start absolute text-xs font-mono text-gray-500" style="transform:translateX(-50%)"></span>
				<span class="label-end absolute text-xs font-mono text-gray-500" style="transform:translateX(-50%)"></span>
			</div>
		</div>
	</li>
}

// ─── Progress view ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

templ dataformProgress(b *LiveBatch) {
	<div class="mb-10">
		<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
			<div>
				<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
					Batch Running
					<span class={ statusBadgeClass(b.Status) }>{ b.Status }</span>
				</h2>
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
					Workspace: <strong>{ b.Workspace }</strong> · Tag: <strong>{ b.TargetTag }</strong> · Started by: { b.RequestedBy }
				</p>
			</div>
			if b.Status == "RUNNING" {
				<form method="POST" action="/admin/dataform/cancel">
					<button
						type="submit"
						class="rounded-md bg-red-600 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-red-500"
					>
						Cancel
					</button>
				</form>
			}
		</div>
		<!-- Country accordions -->
		<div class="space-y-2">
			for _, c := range b.Countries {
				<details class="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm" open?={ c.Status == "RUNNING" }>
					<summary class="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 select-none">
						<div class="flex items-center gap-x-3">
							<span class="text-sm font-semibold uppercase text-gray-900">{ c.Code }</span>
							<span class={ statusBadgeClass(c.Status) }>{ c.Status }</span>
						</div>
						if c.Status != "SKIPPED" && c.Status != "AWAITING" {
							<span class="text-xs text-gray-500">{ cyclesFraction(c) } cycles</span>
						}
					</summary>
					if len(c.Cycles) > 0 {
						<div class="overflow-x-auto border-t border-gray-100">
							<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200 text-sm">
								<thead class="bg-gray-50">
									<tr>
										<th class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Cycle</th>
										<th class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Status</th>
										<th class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Link</th>
									</tr>
								</thead>
								<tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100 bg-white">
									for _, cy := range c.Cycles {
										<tr class="even:bg-gray-50">
											<td class="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-gray-900">{ cy.Cycle }</td>
											<td class="px-4 py-2">
												<span class={ statusBadgeClass(cy.Status) }>{ cy.Status }</span>
											</td>
											<td class="px-4 py-2">
												if cy.ConsoleLink != "" {
													<a href={ templ.URL(cy.ConsoleLink) } target="_blank" class="text-blue-600 underline hover:text-blue-800 text-xs">View in GCP</a>
												} else {
													<span class="text-gray-400 text-xs">—</span>
												}
											</td>
										</tr>
									}
								</tbody>
							</table>
						</div>
					}
				</details>
			}
		</div>
		if b.Status == "RUNNING" {
			<script>
				setTimeout(() => { window.location.reload(); }, 5000);
			</script>
		}
	</div>
}

// ─── History table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

templ dataformHistory(rows []BatchHistoryRow, r *http.Request) {
	<div class="mt-8 border-t border-gray-200 pt-8">
		<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">History</h2>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<p class="text-sm text-gray-500">No completed batches yet.</p>
		} else {
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-300 text-sm">
					<thead>
						<tr>
							<th class="py-3 pl-4 pr-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Started</th>
							<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Workspace</th>
							<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Tag</th>
							<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Requested By</th>
							<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Finished</th>
							<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Status</th>
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-200 bg-white">
						for _, row := range rows {
							<tr class="even:bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer" onclick={ templ.ComponentScript{Call: fmt.Sprintf("window.location.href='/admin/dataform/%s'", row.ID)} }>
								<td class="whitespace-nowrap py-3 pl-4 pr-3 text-gray-900">{ row.StartedAt.Format("2006-01-02 15:04") }</td>
								<td class="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3 text-gray-700">{ row.Workspace }</td>
								<td class="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3 text-gray-700">{ row.TargetTag }</td>
								<td class="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3 text-gray-500">{ row.RequestedBy }</td>
								<td class="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3 text-gray-500">{ row.FinishedAt.Format("2006-01-02 15:04") }</td>
								<td class="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3">
									<span class={ statusBadgeClass(row.Status) }>{ row.Status }</span>
								</td>
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

// ─── Detail page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

templ dataformDetailPage(d dataformDetailPageData) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin - Dataform Batch") {
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto">

								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">GCP Link</th>

						</thead>

							for _, row := range ce.Rows {
								<tr class="even:bg-gray-50">
									<td class="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-gray-900">{ row.Cycle }</td>
									<td class="px-4 py-2">
										<span class={ statusBadgeClass(row.Status) }>{ row.Status }</span>
									</td>
									<td class="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-xs text-gray-600">{ row.ExecutionID }</td>

										} else {

									</td>
								</tr>
							}
						</tbody>
					</table>
				</div>
			</details>
		}
	</div>
	<div class="mt-6">
		<a href="/admin/dataform" class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 underline">← Back to Dataform</a>
	</div>
}
```

## File: modules\admin\editReports.templ
```templ
package admin

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/form"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/cmp"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
)

func (m module) editReportLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	reportID := r.PathValue("id")

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}

	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("ID", "==", reportID).Documents(ctx)

	d, err := iter.Next()
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("Report %q not found.", reportID))
		} else {
			return err
		}
	}

	var report reporting.Report
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &report); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	f := editReportForm{
		State:          make(map[string]form.Field),
		Title:          form.Val(report.Title),
		Description:    form.Val(report.Description),
		Type:           form.Val(string(report.Type)),
		Link:           form.Val(report.Link),
		FunctionalArea: form.Val(report.FunctionalArea),
		URLCountryCode: form.Val(report.URLCountryCode),
	}

	f.State["CycleCode"] = form.Val(report.CycleCode)
	f.State["DateCode"] = form.Val(report.DateCode)
	f.State["PrevCycleCode"] = form.Val(report.PrevCycleCode)
	f.State["PeriodCode"] = form.Val(report.PeriodCode)
	f.State["PrevPeriodCode"] = form.Val(report.PrevPeriodCode)
	f.State["PageTarget1"] = form.Val(report.PageTarget1)
	f.State["PageTarget2"] = form.Val(report.PageTarget2)
	f.State["PageTarget3"] = form.Val(report.PageTarget3)
	f.State["BranchCode"] = form.Val(report.BranchCode)
	f.State["ConsultantCode"] = form.Val(report.ConsultantCode)

	return editReportPage(editReportPageData{
		R:             r,
		CC:            c.Code,
		UserCountries: userCountries,
		Report:        report,
		EditDisabled:  report.Type == reporting.TypeJasper,
	}, f).Render(ctx, w)
}

type editReportPageData struct {
	R             *http.Request
	CC            string
	UserCountries []country.Country
	Report        reporting.Report
	EditDisabled  bool
}

type editReportForm struct {
	State          map[string]form.Field
	Title          form.Field
	Description    form.Field
	Type           form.Field
	Link           form.Field
	FunctionalArea form.Field
	URLCountryCode form.Field
}

func (m module) editReportAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	reportID := r.PathValue("id")

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid form data")
	}

	action := r.FormValue("_action")

	// Get the original report title, needed for "update_all" and "delete"
	doc, err := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(reportID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Report not found")
		}
		return err
	}
	originalTitle, _ := doc.Data()["Title"].(string)

	switch action {
	case "delete":
		// For Looker reports, deleting one deletes all reports with the same title across all countries.
		// Jasper reports have this button disabled, so no special handling is needed here.
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", originalTitle).Documents(ctx)
		batch := m.fsDb.Batch()
		for {
			doc, err := iter.Next()
			if err == iterator.Done {
				break
			}
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			batch.Delete(doc.Ref)
		}
		if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to commit delete batch: %w", err)
		}

	case "edit", "update_all":
		updates := []firestore.Update{
			{Path: "Title", Value: r.FormValue("Name")},
			{Path: "Description", Value: r.FormValue("Description")},
			{Path: "Type", Value: reporting.Type(r.FormValue("Type"))},
			{Path: "Link", Value: r.FormValue("Link")},
			{Path: "FunctionalArea", Value: r.FormValue("FunctionalArea")},
			{Path: "URLCountryCode", Value: r.FormValue("URLCountryCode")},
			{Path: "CycleCode", Value: r.FormValue("CycleCode")},
			{Path: "DateCode", Value: r.FormValue("DateCode")},
			{Path: "PrevCycleCode", Value: r.FormValue("PrevCycleCode")},
			{Path: "PeriodCode", Value: r.FormValue("PeriodCode")},
			{Path: "PrevPeriodCode", Value: r.FormValue("PrevPeriodCode")},
			{Path: "PageTarget1", Value: r.FormValue("PageTarget1")},
			{Path: "PageTarget2", Value: r.FormValue("PageTarget2")},
			{Path: "PageTarget3", Value: r.FormValue("PageTarget3")},
			{Path: "BranchCode", Value: r.FormValue("BranchCode")},
			{Path: "ConsultantCode", Value: r.FormValue("ConsultantCode")},
		}

		if action == "edit" {
			// Update a single report document.
			if _, err := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(reportID).Update(ctx, updates); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		} else { // This handles the "update_all" case.
			// Update all report documents that share the same original title.
			iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", originalTitle).Documents(ctx)
			batch := m.fsDb.Batch()
			for {
				doc, err := iter.Next()
				if err == iterator.Done {
					break
				}
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				batch.Update(doc.Ref, updates)
			}
			if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("failed to commit update_all batch: %w", err)
			}
		}

	default:
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid action specified")
	}

	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/reports")
}

templ editReportPage(d editReportPageData, f editReportForm) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin") {
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto">
			@Tabs(d.R, adminTabs(d.R), d.CC, d.UserCountries) {
				<h1 class="text-2xl">Edit Report</h1>
				<form method="POST" class="mt-10">

													/>
												</td>
											</tr>
											<tr>
												<td class="w-1/3 py-4 pl-4 pr-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 sm:pl-6">

													/>
```

## File: modules\admin\editWaysOfWork.templ
```templ
package admin

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/icon"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

type editWaysOfWorkPageData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	Title         string
	Guide         string
}

func (m module) editWaysOfWorkLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)
	title := r.FormValue("title")

    cc := r.FormValue("cc")
	if cc == "" {
		cc = u.CC
		if cc == "" && len(userCountries) > 0 {
			cc = userCountries[0].Code
		} else if cc == "" {
			cc = "za" // Ultimate fallback
		}
	}

	// Fetch the first report with this title to get the current guide content.
	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", title).Limit(1).Documents(ctx)
	doc, err := iter.Next()
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
			return layout.ErrorPage("Not Found", "Report not found.").Render(ctx, w)
		}
		return err
	}

	var report reporting.Report
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &report); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	data := editWaysOfWorkPageData{
		r:             r,
		cc:            cc,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		Title:         title,
		Guide:         report.Guide,
	}

	return editWaysOfWorkPage(data).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m module) editWaysOfWorkAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	title := r.FormValue("title")
	guideContent := r.FormValue("guide")

	// Find all reports with the given title
	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", title).Documents(ctx)
	docs, err := iter.GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get reports by title: %w", err)
	}

	if len(docs) == 0 {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("no reports found with title: %s", title))
	}

	// Use a batch to update all documents atomically
	batch := m.fsDb.Batch()
	for _, docSnap := range docs {
		update := firestore.Update{Path: "Guide", Value: guideContent}
		batch.Update(docSnap.Ref, []firestore.Update{update})
	}

	if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to commit batch update for guide: %w", err)
	}

	// Redirect back to the ways of work page
	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/waysofwork")
}

templ editWaysOfWorkPage(d editWaysOfWorkPageData) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin - Edit Ways of Work") {
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto">
			@Tabs(d.r, adminTabs(d.r), d.cc, d.userCountries) {
				<h1 class="text-2xl">Edit Guide for: { d.Title }</h1>
				<p class="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600">You can use HTML to format content, embed images, and videos.</p>

				<form method="POST" class="mt-10 space-y-6">
					<input type="hidden" name="title" value={ d.Title }/>
					<div>
						<label for="guide-content" class="block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-gray-900">Guide Content (HTML allowed)</label>
						<div class="mt-2 rounded-md shadow-sm ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-inset focus-within:ring-gray-600">
							@htmlToolbar("guide-content")
							<textarea id="guide-content" name="guide" rows="20" class="block w-full rounded-b-md border-0 bg-transparent py-1.5 text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:ring-0 sm:text-sm sm:leading-6 font-mono">{ d.Guide }</textarea>
						</div>
					</div>

					<div class="flex items-center gap-x-4">
						<button type="submit" class="rounded-md bg-green-x-light px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-green-x-dark">Save</button>
						<button type="button" id="preview-btn" data-target="guide-content" class="rounded-md bg-gray-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-300">Preview</button>
					</div>
				</form>
			}
		</div>

		<!-- Preview Modal -->
		<div id="preview-modal" class="relative z-10 hidden" aria-labelledby="modal-title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
			<div class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity"></div>
			<div class="fixed inset-0 z-10 w-screen overflow-y-auto">
				<div class="flex min-h-full items-end justify-center p-4 text-center sm:items-center sm:p-0">
					<div class="relative transform overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-white text-left shadow-xl transition-all sm:my-8 sm:w-full sm:max-w-3xl">
						<div class="bg-white px-4 pb-4 pt-5 sm:p-6 sm:pb-4">
							<div class="flex justify-between items-start">
								<h3 class="text-base font-semibold leading-6 text-gray-900" id="modal-title">Content Preview</h3>
								<button type="button" id="close-preview-btn" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
									@icon.X()
								</button>
							</div>
							<div class="mt-4">
								<div id="preview-content" class="prose lg:prose-lg max-w-none">
									<!-- Rendered content will go here -->
								</div>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/html_toolbar.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
		<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/edit_ways_of_work.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
	}
}
```

## File: modules\admin\jobconfig.go
```go
package admin

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"

	"cloud.google.com/go/datastore"
)

type JobConfig struct {
	EncodedKey string                 `json:"EncodedKey"`
	Properties map[string]interface{} `json:"Properties"`
}

type jobConfigPageData struct {
	R             *http.Request
	CC            string
	UserCountries []country.Country
	JobConfigs    []JobConfig
}

func (m module) jobConfigLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	m.l.Println("Querying datastore for AUTOMATION_V2 job configs...")
	query := datastore.NewQuery("AUTOMATION_V2")
	var entities []datastore.PropertyList
	keys, err := m.dbFsInsights.GetAll(ctx, query, &entities)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("Failed to query datastore for AUTOMATION_V2: %v", err)
		return err
	}
	m.l.Printf("Successfully loaded %d AUTOMATION_V2 job configs from datastore.", len(keys))

	jobConfigs := make([]JobConfig, len(entities))
	for i, entity := range entities {
		props := make(map[string]interface{})
		for _, prop := range entity {
			if prop.Name == "cron_override" {
				if nestedEntity, ok := prop.Value.(*datastore.Entity); ok {
					simpleMap := make(map[string]string)
					if nestedEntity != nil {
						for _, nestedProp := range nestedEntity.Properties {
							if val, ok := nestedProp.Value.(string); ok {
								simpleMap[nestedProp.Name] = val
							}
						}
					}
					props[prop.Name] = simpleMap
					continue
				}
			}

			if prop.Name == "update_source_tables_config" {
				if ustcEntity, ok := prop.Value.(*datastore.Entity); ok {
					ustcMap := make(map[string]interface{})
					if ustcEntity != nil {
						for _, ustcProp := range ustcEntity.Properties {
							if ustcProp.Name == "override" {
								simpleMap := make(map[string]string)
								if iList, ok := ustcProp.Value.([]interface{}); ok {
									for _, i := range iList {
										if nestedEntity, ok := i.(*datastore.Entity); ok && nestedEntity != nil {
											for _, nestedProp := range nestedEntity.Properties {
												if val, ok := nestedProp.Value.(string); ok {
													simpleMap[nestedProp.Name] = val
												}
											}
										}
									}
								} else if nestedEntity, ok := ustcProp.Value.(*datastore.Entity); ok && nestedEntity != nil {
									for _, nestedProp := range nestedEntity.Properties {
										if val, ok := nestedProp.Value.(string); ok {
											simpleMap[nestedProp.Name] = val
										}
									}
								}
								ustcMap[ustcProp.Name] = simpleMap
							} else if ustcProp.Name == "exclusions" {
								var values []string
								if exclusionsList, ok := ustcProp.Value.([]interface{}); ok {
									for _, item := range exclusionsList {
										if str, ok := item.(string); ok {
											values = append(values, str)
										}
									}
								} else if nestedEntity, ok := ustcProp.Value.(*datastore.Entity); ok && nestedEntity != nil {
									for _, nestedProp := range nestedEntity.Properties {
										if val, ok := nestedProp.Value.(string); ok {
											values = append(values, val)
										}
									}
								}
								ustcMap[ustcProp.Name] = values
							} else {
								ustcMap[ustcProp.Name] = ustcProp.Value
							}
						}
					}
					props[prop.Name] = ustcMap
					continue
				}
			}

			if prop.Name == "mailing_list" {
				if mlEntity, ok := prop.Value.(*datastore.Entity); ok {
					mlMap := make(map[string]interface{})
					if mlEntity != nil {
						for _, mlProp := range mlEntity.Properties {
							if mlProp.Name == "receipt_emails" {
								if reEntity, ok := mlProp.Value.(*datastore.Entity); ok {
									reMap := make(map[string][]string)
									if reEntity != nil {
										for _, reProp := range reEntity.Properties {
											if emails, ok := reProp.Value.([]interface{}); ok {
												emailStrs := make([]string, len(emails))
												for i, e := range emails {
													if emailStr, ok := e.(string); ok {
														emailStrs[i] = emailStr
													}
												}
												reMap[reProp.Name] = emailStrs
											}
										}
									}
									mlMap[mlProp.Name] = reMap
								}
							} else {
								mlMap[mlProp.Name] = mlProp.Value
							}
						}
					}
					props[prop.Name] = mlMap
					continue
				}
			}

			props[prop.Name] = prop.Value
		}
		jobConfigs[i] = JobConfig{
			EncodedKey: keys[i].Encode(),
			Properties: props,
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(jobConfigs, func(i, j int) bool {
		nameI, _ := jobConfigs[i].Properties["name"].(string)
		nameJ, _ := jobConfigs[j].Properties["name"].(string)
		return nameI < nameJ
	})

	m.l.Printf(jobConfigs[0].Properties["name"].(string))

	data := jobConfigPageData{
		R:             r,
		CC:            c.Code,
		UserCountries: userCountries,
		JobConfigs:    jobConfigs,
	}

	return jobConfigPage(data).Render(ctx, w)
}

func pageJobConfigDataJSON(jobs []JobConfig) string {
	data := struct {
		JobConfigs []JobConfig       `json:"JobConfigs"`
		Countries  []country.Country `json:"Countries"`
	}{
		JobConfigs: jobs,
		Countries:  country.List,
	}

	bytes, err := json.Marshal(data)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	jsonString := string(bytes)
	safeJSONString := strings.ReplaceAll(jsonString, "</script>", "<\\/script>")
	return safeJSONString
}
```

```templ
package admin

templ jobConfigPage(d jobConfigPageData) {
    @layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin - Job Config") {
```

```go
package admin

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"

	"cloud.google.com/go/datastore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
)

func (m module) updateJobConfig(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()
	encodedKey := r.PathValue("id")

	token, ok := auth.TokenFromHeader(r)
	if !ok {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "'Auth' Header missing.")
	}
	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.Get(ctx, now, token)
	if err != nil || !u.Admin {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Forbidden")
	}

	key, err := datastore.DecodeKey(encodedKey)
	if err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid entity ID.")
	}

	var properties map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&properties); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid JSON body.")
	}

	if val, ok := properties["schedule_tags"]; ok {
		if valStr, ok := val.(string); ok && valStr == "cyclical" {
			properties["schedule_tags"] = []interface{}{"cyclical"}
		}
	}

	delete(properties, "EncodedKey")

	var props datastore.PropertyList
	for name, value := range properties {
		if name == "cron_override" {
			if overrideMap, ok := value.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				var nestedProps datastore.PropertyList
				for k, v := range overrideMap {
					if vStr, ok := v.(string); ok {
						nestedProps = append(nestedProps, datastore.Property{
							Name:  k,
							Value: vStr,
						})
					}
				}
				nestedEntity := &datastore.Entity{
					Properties: nestedProps,
				}
				props = append(props, datastore.Property{
					Name:    name,
					Value:   nestedEntity,
					NoIndex: true,
				})
				continue
			}
		}

		if name == "update_source_tables_config" {
			if ustcMap, ok := value.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				var ustcProps datastore.PropertyList

				if isEnabled, ok := ustcMap["is_enabled"].(bool); ok {
					ustcProps = append(ustcProps, datastore.Property{Name: "is_enabled", Value: isEnabled, NoIndex: false})
				}

				var maxStalenessValue int64 = 30
				if maxStaleness, ok := ustcMap["max_staleness"]; ok && maxStaleness != nil {
					switch v := maxStaleness.(type) {
					case float64:
						maxStalenessValue = int64(v)
					case string:
						if intVal, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil {
							maxStalenessValue = intVal
						}
					}
				}
				ustcProps = append(ustcProps, datastore.Property{Name: "max_staleness", Value: maxStalenessValue, NoIndex: false})

				var overrideEntities []interface{}
				if overrideList, ok := ustcMap["override"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, item := range overrideList {
						if itemMap, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							var nestedProps datastore.PropertyList
							for k, v := range itemMap {
								if vStr, ok := v.(string); ok {
									nestedProps = append(nestedProps, datastore.Property{Name: k, Value: vStr, NoIndex: false})
								}
							}
							if len(nestedProps) > 0 {
								overrideEntities = append(overrideEntities, &datastore.Entity{Properties: nestedProps})
							}
						}
					}
				}
				ustcProps = append(ustcProps, datastore.Property{
					Name:    "override",
					Value:   overrideEntities,
					NoIndex: true,
				})

				var exclusionValues []interface{}
				if exclusionsList, ok := ustcMap["exclusions"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, v := range exclusionsList {
						if vStr, ok := v.(string); ok && vStr != "" {
							exclusionValues = append(exclusionValues, vStr)
						}
					}
				}
				ustcProps = append(ustcProps, datastore.Property{
					Name:    "exclusions",
					Value:   exclusionValues,
					NoIndex: false,
				})

				props = append(props, datastore.Property{
					Name:    name,
					Value:   &datastore.Entity{Properties: ustcProps},
					NoIndex: true,
				})
				continue
			}
		}

		if name == "mailing_list" {
			if mlMap, ok := value.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				var mlProps datastore.PropertyList
				if sendEmail, ok := mlMap["send_email"].(bool); ok {
					mlProps = append(mlProps, datastore.Property{Name: "send_email", Value: sendEmail, NoIndex: false})
				}
				if receiptEmails, ok := mlMap["receipt_emails"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					var emailProps datastore.PropertyList
					for country, emails := range receiptEmails {
						if emailList, ok := emails.([]interface{}); ok {
							emailProps = append(emailProps, datastore.Property{
								Name:    country,
								Value:   emailList,
								NoIndex: false,
							})
						}
					}
					if len(emailProps) > 0 {
						mlProps = append(mlProps, datastore.Property{
							Name:    "receipt_emails",
							Value:   &datastore.Entity{Properties: emailProps},
							NoIndex: true,
						})
					}
				}
				props = append(props, datastore.Property{
					Name:    name,
					Value:   &datastore.Entity{Properties: mlProps},
					NoIndex: true,
				})
				continue
			}
		}

		if v, ok := value.(float64); ok && v == float64(int64(v)) {
			value = int64(v)
		}
		props = append(props, datastore.Property{
			Name:  name,
			Value: value,
		})
	}

	_, err = m.dbFsInsights.RunInTransaction(ctx, func(tx *datastore.Transaction) error {
		var placeholder datastore.PropertyList
		if err := tx.Get(key, &placeholder); err != nil {
			if err == datastore.ErrNoSuchEntity {
				return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Entity not found.")
			}
			return err
		}

		_, err := tx.Put(key, &props)
		return err
	})

	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("Failed to update entity in Datastore: %v", err)
		if err == datastore.ErrNoSuchEntity {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Entity not found.")
		}
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to save changes.")
	}

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}
```

## File: modules\admin\reload.go
```go
package admin

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/modules/base"
)

type reloadPageData struct {
	R                 *http.Request
	CC                string
	UserCountries     []country.Country
	DefaultCollection string
	Collections       []string
	CoreReloads       []base.CoreReload
}

func (m module) reloadLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.IsAnalyst && !u.Admin {
		http.Redirect(w, r, "/", http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}

	cc := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	cachedData, found := m.reloadCache.Get(cc.Code)
	if !found || len(cachedData.Entities) == 0 {
		return reloadLoadingPage(reloadPageData{
			R:             r,
			CC:            cc.Code,
			UserCountries: userCountries,
		}).Render(ctx, w)
	}

	allEntities := cachedData.Entities
	collections := cachedData.Collections

	var defaultCollection string
	for _, c := range collections {
		if strings.Contains(c, "core_"+cc.Code) {
			defaultCollection = c
			break
		}
	}

	if defaultCollection == "" {
		return errors.New("default collection not set")
	}

	return reloadPage(reloadPageData{
		R:                 r,
		CC:                cc.Code,
		UserCountries:     userCountries,
		DefaultCollection: defaultCollection,
		Collections:       collections,
		CoreReloads:       allEntities,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func ReloadsJSON(data reloadPageData) string {
	out := struct {
		Entities          []base.CoreReload
		Collections       []string
		DefaultCollection string
		Countries         []country.Country
	}{
		Entities:          data.CoreReloads,
		Collections:       data.Collections,
		DefaultCollection: data.DefaultCollection,
		Countries:         data.UserCountries,
	}

	d, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	return string(d)
}
```

```templ
package admin

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"encoding/json"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
)

type ReportWithCountries struct {
	reporting.Report
	DeployedCountries map[string]bool
}

func (m module) reportsLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	// 1. Fetch all reports to build the deployment map.
	allReportsIter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Documents(ctx)
	reportsByTitle := make(map[string]map[string]bool)
	for {
		doc, err := allReportsIter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				break
			}
			return err
		}
		var report reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &report); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, ok := reportsByTitle[report.Title]; !ok {
			reportsByTitle[report.Title] = make(map[string]bool)
		}
		reportsByTitle[report.Title][report.CC] = true
	}

	// 2. Fetch and augment reports for the current country.
	var reportsWithCountries []ReportWithCountries
	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).OrderBy("FunctionalArea", firestore.Asc).Documents(ctx)
	for {
		d, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				break
			} else {
				return err
			}
		}

		var report reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &report); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		reportsWithCountries = append(reportsWithCountries, ReportWithCountries{
			Report:            report,
			DeployedCountries: reportsByTitle[report.Title],
		})
	}

	// Sort reports by Functional Area, then by Title
	sort.Slice(reportsWithCountries, func(i, j int) bool {
		if reportsWithCountries[i].FunctionalArea == reportsWithCountries[j].FunctionalArea {
			return reportsWithCountries[i].Title < reportsWithCountries[j].Title
		}
		return reportsWithCountries[i].FunctionalArea < reportsWithCountries[j].FunctionalArea
	})

	return reportsPage(reportsPageData{
		R:             r,
		CC:            c.Code,
		UserCountries: userCountries,
		Reports:       reportsWithCountries,
		ReportCount:   len(reportsWithCountries),
		SyncingJasper: m.js.IsSyncing(),
		FunctionalAreas: reporting.FunctionAreas,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m module) reportsAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}

	action := r.FormValue("_action")

	if action == "sync_jasper" {
		_, err := m.js.Sync()
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("failed to sync jasper resources: %s", err)
		}
	} else {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("invalid form action %q", action))
	}

	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/reports")
}

func pageReportsDataJSON(reports []ReportWithCountries, fas []reporting.FunctionArea) string {
	data := struct {
		Reports         []ReportWithCountries
		FunctionalAreas []reporting.FunctionArea
		Countries       []country.Country // Add this line
	}{
		Reports:         reports,
		FunctionalAreas: fas,
		Countries:       country.List, // And this line
	}

	bytes, err := json.Marshal(data)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(bytes)
}

type reportsPageData struct {
	R             *http.Request
	CC            string
	UserCountries []country.Country
	Reports       []ReportWithCountries
	FunctionalAreas []reporting.FunctionArea
	SyncingJasper bool
	ReportCount   int
}

templ reportsPage(d reportsPageData) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin") {
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto">
			@Tabs(d.R, adminTabs(d.R), d.CC, d.UserCountries) {
				<div class="bg-green-x-dark p-4 rounded-lg mb-6">
					<div class="flex gap-x-4">
						<a
							href={ uj.SafeHref(d.R, "/admin/reports/add") }
							class="block px-4 py-2 bg-white text-gray-900 rounded-md shadow-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-100"
						>
							Add Report
						</a>
						<form method="POST">
							<input type="hidden" name="_action" value="sync_jasper"/>
							<button
								class="block px-4 py-2 bg-white text-gray-900 rounded-md shadow-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-100 disabled:bg-gray-200 disabled:text-gray-500"
								disabled?={ d.SyncingJasper }
							>
								Sync Jasper
							</button>
						</form>
					</div>
				</div>
			}
			<div
					id="container"
					class="mt-10"
					data-page={ pageReportsDataJSON(d.Reports, d.FunctionalAreas) }
				></div>
		</div>
		<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/report_table.js?v=1.0.1"></script>
	}
}
```

```templ
package admin

	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"

func (m module) schedulesLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	cachedData, found := m.schedulesCache.Get()
	if !found {
		return layout.ErrorPage("Schedules Not Yet Loaded", "Jasper schedules are being loaded in the background. Please try again in a few moments.").Render(ctx, w)
	}

	jobs := cachedData.Jobs

	// Sort jobs alphabetically by Resource URI (as requested)
	sort.Slice(jobs, func(i, j int) bool {
		return jobs[i].Source.ReportUnitURI < jobs[j].Source.ReportUnitURI
	})

	return schedulesPage(schedulesPageData{
		r:             r,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		jobs:          jobs,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

type schedulesPageData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	jobs          []jasper.CombinedJobDetails
}

// formatRecipientsList renders recipients in a vertical list.
templ formatRecipientsList(notification *jasper.MailNotification) {
	if notification == nil || len(notification.ToAddresses.Address) == 0 {
		<span>None</span>
	} else {
		for _, addr := range notification.ToAddresses.Address {
			<div>{ addr }</div>
		}
	}
}

templ schedulesPage(d schedulesPageData) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin - Schedules") {
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto">
			@Tabs(d.r, adminTabs(d.r), d.cc, d.userCountries) {
				<div class="mt-8 flow-root">
					<div class="overflow-x-auto">
						<div class="inline-block min-w-full py-2 align-middle">
							<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-300">
								<thead>
									<tr>
										<th scope="col" class="py-3.5 pl-4 pr-3 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 sm:pl-0">Resource</th>
										<th scope="col" class="px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Job Name</th>
										<th scope="col" class="px-3 py-3.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Recipients</th>
									</tr>
								</thead>
								<tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-200 bg-white">
									if len(d.jobs) == 0 {
										<tr>
											<td colspan="3" class="px-3 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500 text-center">No enabled schedules found on JasperServer.</td>

										</tr>
									}
								</tbody>
							</table>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	}
```

## File: modules\admin\schedules_cache.go
```go
package admin

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/jasper"
)

type SchedulesCacheData struct {
	Jobs        []jasper.CombinedJobDetails
	LastUpdated time.Time
}

type SchedulesCache struct {
	mu    sync.RWMutex
	cache SchedulesCacheData
	js    *jasper.Service
	l     *log.Logger
}

func NewSchedulesCache(l *log.Logger, js *jasper.Service) *SchedulesCache {
	return &SchedulesCache{
		cache: SchedulesCacheData{},
		js:    js,
		l:     l,
	}
}

func (c *SchedulesCache) Get() (SchedulesCacheData, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	if c.cache.Jobs == nil {
		return SchedulesCacheData{}, false
	}
	return c.cache, true
}

func (c *SchedulesCache) Refresh(ctx context.Context) error {
	c.l.Println("Starting background refresh for Jasper schedules...")
	jobs, err := c.js.GetScheduledJobs(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		c.l.Printf("ERROR refreshing Jasper schedules: %v", err)
		return err
	}

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.cache = SchedulesCacheData{
		Jobs:        jobs,
		LastUpdated: time.Now(),
	}
	c.l.Printf("Finished background refresh for Jasper schedules. Fetched %d jobs.", len(jobs))
	return nil
}

func (c *SchedulesCache) StartBackgroundRefresh(interval time.Duration) {
	c.l.Println("Starting background cache refresh for Jasper schedules...")
	go func() {
		if err := c.Refresh(context.Background()); err != nil {
			c.l.Printf("Initial cache refresh for schedules failed: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	go func() {
		for range ticker.C {
			if err := c.Refresh(context.Background()); err != nil {
				c.l.Printf("Periodic cache refresh for schedules failed: %v", err)
			}
		}
	}()
}
```
