## File: modules\admin\sync.go
```go
package admin

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"

	"cloud.google.com/go/bigquery"
	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

func (m module) syncWaysOfWork(ctx context.Context) error {
	m.l.Println("Starting Ways of Work sync from BigQuery...")

	projectID := "df-frontend"
	bqClient, err := bigquery.NewClient(ctx, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("bigquery.NewClient: %w", err)
	}
	defer bqClient.Close()

	type WaysOfWorkData struct {
		ReportName         string `bigquery:"REPORT_NAME"`
		FunctionalArea     string `bigquery:"FUNCTIONAL_AREA"`
		ReportType         string `bigquery:"REPORT_TYPE"`
		Builder            string `bigquery:"BUILDER"`
		CoBuilder          string `bigquery:"CO_BUILDER"`
		Architect          string `bigquery:"ARCHITECT"`
		BusinessOwnerKE    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_KE"`
		BusinessOwnerUG    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_UG"`
		BusinessOwnerZM    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_ZM"`
		BusinessOwnerZA    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_ZA"`
		BusinessOwnerTZ    string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_TZ"`
		BusinessOwnerMANZI string `bigquery:"BUSINESS_OWNER_MANZI"`
	}

	// 2. FIX: Removed the ptrToString helper function as it's no longer needed.

	m.l.Println("Querying BigQuery table: df-frontend.UJUZI.WAYS_OF_WORK_TABLE")
	q := bqClient.Query("SELECT * FROM `df-frontend.UJUZI.WAYS_OF_WORK_TABLE`")
	it, err := q.Read(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read from BigQuery: %w", err)
	}

	var updatedCount int
	for {
		var wowData WaysOfWorkData
		err := it.Next(&wowData)
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("error iterating BigQuery results: %w", err)
		}

		reportName := wowData.ReportName
		if reportName == "" {
			m.l.Println("Skipping row with empty REPORT_NAME")
			continue
		}

		reportIter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Title", "==", reportName).Documents(ctx)
		docs, err := reportIter.GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("Error querying Firestore for report '%s': %v", reportName, err)
			continue
		}

		if len(docs) == 0 {
			m.l.Printf("No matching report found in Ujuzi for '%s'. Skipping.", reportName)
			continue
		}

		var builders []string
		if wowData.Builder != "" {
			builders = append(builders, wowData.Builder)
		}
		if wowData.CoBuilder != "" {
			builders = append(builders, wowData.CoBuilder)
		}

		businessOwners := map[string]string{
			"ke":    wowData.BusinessOwnerKE,
			"ug":    wowData.BusinessOwnerUG,
			"zm":    wowData.BusinessOwnerZM,
			"za":    wowData.BusinessOwnerZA,
			"tz":    wowData.BusinessOwnerTZ,
			"manzi": wowData.BusinessOwnerMANZI,
		}

		batch := m.fsDb.Batch()
		for _, doc := range docs {
			updates := []firestore.Update{
				{Path: "Architect", Value: wowData.Architect},
				{Path: "Builders", Value: strings.Join(builders, ", ")},
				{Path: "BusinessOwners", Value: businessOwners},
			}
			batch.Update(doc.Ref, updates)
			m.l.Printf("Staging update for report '%s' (ID: %s)", reportName, doc.Ref.ID)
		}

		if _, err = batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("Error committing updates for report '%s': %v", reportName, err)
		} else {
			updatedCount += len(docs)
		}
	}

	m.l.Printf("Sync complete. Updated %d report documents.", updatedCount)
	return nil
}

package admin

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/randx"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

func (m module) userGroupsLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	var userGroups []country.UserGroup
	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).Documents(ctx)
	for {
		d, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				break
			}
			return err
		}

		var u country.UserGroup
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &u); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		userGroups = append(userGroups, u)
	}

	sort.Slice(userGroups, func(i, j int) bool {
		return userGroups[i].Name < userGroups[j].Name
	})

	functionalAreas := []string{
		"FinancialReporting",
		"FinancialOperations",
		"Productivity",
		"Sales",
		"Collections",
		"Recoveries",
		"Activations",
		"InternalAudit",
		"KYC",
		"CreditAndPolicy",
		"Operations",
		"HumanResources",
		"DataMetrics",
	}

	return userGroupsPage(userGroupsPageData{
		r:               r,
		cc:              c.Code,
		userCountries:   userCountries,
		userGroups:      userGroups,
		functionalAreas: functionalAreas,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m module) userGroupsAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	action := r.FormValue("_action")
	if action == "sync_usergroups" {
		c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
		if err := m.syncUserGroups(ctx, c); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR: failed to sync user groups for %s: %v", c.Code, err)
			// You could add a flash message here to inform the user of an error.
		}
	}

	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/usergroups?cc="+country.FromCtx(ctx).Code)
}

func (m module) syncUserGroups(ctx context.Context, c country.Country) error {
	m.l.Printf("Starting user group sync for country: %s", c.Code)

	// 1. Get DB connection for the country
	countryDb, ok := m.dbs.GetDB(c.Code)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("database connection for country %s not found", c.Code)
	}

	// 2. Query sec_groups from MySQL
	const getGroupsQuery = `SELECT id, group_name FROM sec_groups;`
	rows, err := countryDb.QueryContext(ctx, getGroupsQuery)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("querying sec_groups for %s failed: %w", c.Code, err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	type secGroup struct {
		ID   string
		Name string
	}

	groupsFromDB := make(map[string]string) // map[id]name
	for rows.Next() {
		var g secGroup
		if err := rows.Scan(&g.ID, &g.Name); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("scanning sec_group row failed: %w", err)
		}
		groupsFromDB[g.ID] = g.Name
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("error during rows iteration for sec_groups: %w", err)
	}
	m.l.Printf("Found %d groups in sec_groups for %s", len(groupsFromDB), c.Code)

	// 3. Get existing usergroups from Firestore for the current country
	existingGroupsFirestore := make(map[string]string) // map[UnibosID]doc.Ref.ID
	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).Documents(ctx)
	for {
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to retrieve existing usergroups from Firestore: %w", err)
		}
		unibosID, _ := doc.Data()["UnibosID"].(string)
		if unibosID != "" {
			existingGroupsFirestore[unibosID] = doc.Ref.ID
		}
	}
	m.l.Printf("Found %d existing usergroups in Firestore for %s", len(existingGroupsFirestore), c.Code)

	// 4. Compare and create/delete records in Firestore
	batch := m.fsDb.Batch()
	newGroupCount := 0
	deletedGroupCount := 0

	// Initialize functional areas map for new groups
	defaultFunctionalAreas := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, fa := range reporting.FunctionAreas {
		if !fa.Hidden {
			defaultFunctionalAreas[fa.ID] = false
		}
	}

	// Add new groups from MySQL that are not in Firestore
	for unibosID, name := range groupsFromDB {
		if _, exists := existingGroupsFirestore[unibosID]; !exists {
			newID := randx.UID()
			docRef := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Doc(newID)

			newUserGroup := country.UserGroup{
				ID:              newID,
				Name:            name,
				UnibosID:        unibosID,
				CC:              c.Code,
				FunctionalAreas: defaultFunctionalAreas,
			}

			batch.Set(docRef, newUserGroup)
			newGroupCount++
			m.l.Printf("Staging new usergroup for creation: %s (UnibosID: %s)", name, unibosID)
		}
	}

	// Delete groups from Firestore that are not in MySQL
	for unibosID, docID := range existingGroupsFirestore {
		if _, exists := groupsFromDB[unibosID]; !exists {
			docRef := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.UserGroups).Doc(docID)
			batch.Delete(docRef)
			deletedGroupCount++
			m.l.Printf("Staging usergroup for deletion: %s (UnibosID: %s)", docID, unibosID)
		}
	}

	if newGroupCount > 0 || deletedGroupCount > 0 {
		if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to commit usergroup changes to Firestore: %w", err)
		}
		m.l.Printf("Successfully created %d and deleted %d usergroups for %s", newGroupCount, deletedGroupCount, c.Code)
	} else {
		m.l.Printf("No usergroups to create or delete for %s.", c.Code)
	}

	return nil
}

func pageUserGroupDataJSON(userGroups []country.UserGroup, functionalAreas []string) string {
	data := struct {
		UserGroups      []country.UserGroup
		FunctionalAreas []string
	}{
		UserGroups:      userGroups,
		FunctionalAreas: functionalAreas,
	}

	bytes, err := json.Marshal(data)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(bytes)
}

type userGroupsPageData struct {
	r               *http.Request
	cc              string
	userCountries   []country.Country
	userGroups      []country.UserGroup
	functionalAreas []string
}

	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	var users []auth.User
	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Users).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).Documents(ctx)
	for {
		d, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				break
			}
			return err
		}

		var u auth.User
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &u); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		users = append(users, u)
	}

	return usersPage(usersPageData{
		r:             r,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		users:         users,
		syncingUsers:  m.gg.SyncInProgress(),
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func pageUserDataJSON(users []auth.User) string {
	departmentsMap := map[string]struct{}{}

	for _, u := range users {
		departmentsMap[strings.TrimSpace(u.OrgUnit)] = struct{}{}
	}

	departments := make([]string, 0)

	for k := range departmentsMap {
		if k != "" {
			departments = append(departments, k)
		}
	}

	data := struct {
		Users       []auth.User
		Departments []string
	}{
		Users:       users,
		Departments: departments,
	}

	bytes, err := json.Marshal(data)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(bytes)
}

type usersPageData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	users         []auth.User
	syncingUsers  bool
}

templ usersPage(d usersPageData) {

func (m module) usersAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	action := r.FormValue("_action")

	if action == "sync_users" {
		if err := m.gg.BackgrounSync(now); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/users")
	} else {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("invalid form action %q", action))
	}
}

package admin

type WaysOfWorkReport struct {
	Title          string
	Type           reporting.Type
	FunctionalArea string
	Architect      string
	Builders       string
	BusinessOwners map[string]string
	Guide          string
	ReportIDs      map[string]string
}

type waysOfWorkPageData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	reports       []WaysOfWorkReport
}

func (m module) waysOfWorkAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	action := r.FormValue("_action")
	if action == "sync_ways_of_work" {
		if err := m.syncWaysOfWork(ctx); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR: failed to sync ways of work: %v", err)
			// You could add a flash message here to inform the user of an error.
		}
	} else {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("invalid form action %q", action))
	}

	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/admin/waysofwork")
}

func (m module) waysOfWorkLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.Admin {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	// ... (cc determination logic remains the same)
	cc := r.FormValue("cc")
	if cc == "" {
		cc = u.CC
		if cc == "" && len(userCountries) > 0 {
			cc = userCountries[0].Code
		} else if cc == "" {
			cc = "za" // Ultimate fallback
		}
	}


	iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Documents(ctx)

	groupedReports := make(map[string]*WaysOfWorkReport)
	allCountries := country.List

	for {
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err == iterator.Done {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		var report reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &report); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		if _, ok := groupedReports[report.Title]; !ok {
			newGr := &WaysOfWorkReport{
				Title:          report.Title,
				Type:           report.Type,
				Architect:      report.Architect,
				Builders:       report.Builders,
				Guide:          report.Guide,
				BusinessOwners: make(map[string]string),
				ReportIDs:      make(map[string]string),
				FunctionalArea: report.FunctionalArea,
			}
			for _, c := range allCountries {
				newGr.BusinessOwners[c.Code] = ""
			}
			newGr.BusinessOwners["manzi"] = ""
			groupedReports[report.Title] = newGr
		}

		gr := groupedReports[report.Title]
		gr.ReportIDs[report.CC] = doc.Ref.ID

		// If the grouped report's FunctionalArea is empty, try to populate it
		// from another country's version of the same report.
		if gr.FunctionalArea == "" && report.FunctionalArea != "" {
			gr.FunctionalArea = report.FunctionalArea
		}

		if report.BusinessOwners != nil {
			for cc, owner := range report.BusinessOwners {
				gr.BusinessOwners[cc] = owner
			}
		}
	}

	var reportsList []WaysOfWorkReport
	for _, report := range groupedReports {
		// Only add reports that have a functional area and are not decommissioned.
		if report.FunctionalArea != "" && report.FunctionalArea != "Decommissioned" {
			reportsList = append(reportsList, *report)
		}
	}

	sort.Slice(reportsList, func(i, j int) bool {
		return reportsList[i].Title < reportsList[j].Title
	})

	return waysOfWorkPage(waysOfWorkPageData{
		r:             r,
		cc:            cc,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		reports:       reportsList,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func pageWaysOfWorkDataJSON(reports []WaysOfWorkReport) string {
	data := struct {
		Reports   []WaysOfWorkReport
		Countries []country.Country
	}{
		Reports:   reports,
		Countries: country.List,
	}

	bytes, err := json.Marshal(data)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(bytes)
}

templ waysOfWorkPage(d waysOfWorkPageData) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi Admin - Ways of Work") {
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto">
			@Tabs(d.r, adminTabs(d.r), d.cc, d.userCountries) {
				<div class="bg-green-x-dark p-4 rounded-lg mb-6">
					<div class="flex gap-x-4">
					<form method="POST">
						<input type="hidden" name="_action" value="sync_ways_of_work"/>
						<button
							type="submit"
							class="block px-4 py-2 bg-white text-gray-900 rounded-md shadow-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors"
						>
							Sync Ways of Work
						</button>
					</form>
				</div>
				</div>
				<div
					id="container"
					data-page={ pageWaysOfWorkDataJSON(d.reports) }
				></div>
			}
		</div>
		// Update script tag
		<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/ways_of_work_table.js?v=1.0.1"></script>
	}
}

## File: modules\base\apiEndpoints.go
```go
package base

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/utils"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
)

func (m module) reportingActionHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()
	reportID := r.PathValue("id")

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.HttpGet(ctx, now, w, r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	d, err := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(reportID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("report %q not found", reportID))
	}

	var report reporting.Report
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &report); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if report.Type != reporting.TypeJasper {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "only Jasper reports can take this action")
	}

	fa, err := m.dbs.GetUserFunctionalAreas(ctx, u, country.CodeToCountry(report.CC))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !utils.InList(report.FunctionalArea, utils.Map(fa, func(area reporting.FunctionArea) string { return area.ID })) {
		web.JSON(w, http.StatusForbidden, struct{ Msg string }{Msg: "forbidden"})
		return web.Error
	}

	var body map[string][]string
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	var fileType string
	if val, ok := body["file_type"]; ok && len(val) > 0 {
		fileType = val[0]
	}

	params := make(map[string][]string)
	isSchedule := false
	if val, ok := body["email_report"]; ok && len(val) > 0 && val[0] == "on" {
		isSchedule = true
	}

	isOpenInSheets := false
	if val, ok := body["google_sheets"]; ok && len(val) > 0 && val[0] == "on" {
		isOpenInSheets = true
	}

	for k, v := range body {
		if k == "file_type" || k == "email_report" || k == "google_sheets" || k == "cc" || k == "embedded" {
			continue
		}

		if len(v) == 1 && v[0] == "" {
			continue
		}

		params[k] = v
	}

	if isOpenInSheets {
		reportContent, err := m.jsC.GetReport(ctx, report.Link, "xlsx", params)
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR: failed to get jasper report content: %s", err)
			return web.JSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{"error": "Failed to fetch report from Jasper"})
		}

		fileName := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s", report.Title, now.Format("2006-01-02_15-04"))

		sheetURL, err := m.gdriveSvc.UploadAndConvertToSheet(ctx, fileName, reportContent, u.Email)
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR: failed to upload/convert to Google Sheets: %s", err)
			return web.JSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{"error": "Failed to process report with Google Sheets"})
		}

		utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, report.CC, "open_in_sheets", report.Title, "jasper")

		return web.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"sheetURL": sheetURL})
	}

	if isSchedule {
		subject := fmt.Sprintf("Ujuzi - Scheduled: %s : %s", report.Title, now.Format("2006/01/02 15:04"))
		err = m.jsC.ScheduleReport(ctx, report.Link, report.Title, fileType, u.Email, subject, params)
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR: failed to schedule jasper report: %s", err)
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to schedule report on Jasper server")
		}
		utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, report.CC, "schedule", report.Title, "jasper")
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusAccepted, "Accepted")
	}

	return m.jsC.ServeFile(
		ctx, w, r, m.l,
		u.Email,
		report.CC,
		report.Link,
		report.Title,
		strings.ToLower(fileType),
		params,
	)
}

func (m module) updateTargetOverride(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.IsTarget {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Forbidden")
	}

	var payload struct {
		Country        string  `json:"country"`
		Cycle          string  `json:"cycle"`
		Branch         string  `json:"branch"`
		Type           string  `json:"type"`
		TargetOverride float64 `json:"targetOverride"`
		Comment        string  `json:"comment"`
	}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	err := m.bq.UpdateTargetOverride(ctx, payload.Country, payload.Cycle, payload.Branch, payload.Type, payload.TargetOverride, payload.Comment)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR updating target override: %v", err)
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to update target override")
	}

	logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Target override updated for %s/%s/%s/%s", payload.Country, payload.Cycle, payload.Branch, payload.Type)
	utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, u.CC, "update", logMsg, "target_override")

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}

func (m module) approveTarget(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.IsAnalyst {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Forbidden")
	}

	var payload struct {
		Country string `json:"country"`
		Cycle   string `json:"cycle"`
		Type    string `json:"type"`
	}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	err := m.bq.ApproveTargets(ctx, payload.Country, payload.Cycle, payload.Type)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR approving targets: %v", err)
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to approve targets")
	}

	logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Targets approved for %s/%s/%s", payload.Country, payload.Cycle, payload.Type)
	cc := country.CountryToCode(payload.Country)
	utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, cc, "approve", logMsg, "target_approval")

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}

func (m module) disapproveTarget(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !u.IsAnalyst {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Forbidden")
	}

	var payload struct {
		Country string `json:"country"`
		Cycle   string `json:"cycle"`
		Type    string `json:"type"`
	}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	err := m.bq.DisapproveTargets(ctx, payload.Country, payload.Cycle, payload.Type)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR disapproving targets: %v", err)
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to disapprove targets")
	}

	logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Targets disapproved for %s/%s/%s", payload.Country, payload.Cycle, payload.Type)
	cc := country.CountryToCode(payload.Country)
	utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, cc, "disapprove", logMsg, "target_approval")

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}

	"ujuzi/core/uj"
)

func (m module) signinLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	_, ok := auth.TokenFromCookie(r)
	if ok {
		// Preserve the incoming query string when bouncing an already-authed
		// visitor to the dashboard. Lets URL params like ?cc=…&branch=…
		// reach the dashboard loader on Electron-app launches that hit
		// /signin first and would otherwise drop them.
		target := "/"
		if raw := r.URL.RawQuery; raw != "" {
			target = "/?" + raw
		}
		uj.Redirect(w, r, target)
		return nil
	}

	f, ok := flash2.Get(w, r, now)

	return signinPage(f, ok).Render(ctx, w)
}

package base

	"github.com/markbates/goth/gothic"

)

type module struct {
	l                    *log.Logger
	sessionStore         auth.Store
	fsDb                 *firestore.Client
	dbs                  *country.DBs
	js                   *jasper.Service
	jsC                  jasper.Client
	dbZA                 *datastore.Client
	dbUG                 *datastore.Client
	dbKE                 *datastore.Client
	dbZM                 *datastore.Client
	dbTZ                 *datastore.Client
	bq                   *bq.Service
	gdriveSvc            *gdrive.Service
	dashboardConfigCache *DashboardConfigCache
}

func stdMid(l *log.Logger, additionalMid ...web.Middleware) []web.Middleware {
	mid := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	}

	mid = append(mid, additionalMid...)

	return mid
}

func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	fsDb *firestore.Client,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	js *jasper.Service,
	jsC jasper.Client,
	dbZA *datastore.Client,
	dbUG *datastore.Client,
	dbKE *datastore.Client,
	dbZM *datastore.Client,
	dbTZ *datastore.Client,
	bqService *bq.Service,
	gDriveService *gdrive.Service,
	dashboardConfigCache *DashboardConfigCache,
) {
	apimid := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
	}

	m := module{
		l:                    l,
		sessionStore:         sessionStore,
		fsDb:                 fsDb,
		dbs:                  dbs,
		js:                   js,
		jsC:                  jsC,
		dbZA:                 dbZA,
		dbUG:                 dbUG,
		dbKE:                 dbKE,
		dbZM:                 dbZM,
		dbTZ:                 dbTZ,
		bq:                   bqService,
		gdriveSvc:            gDriveService,
		dashboardConfigCache: dashboardConfigCache,
	}

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/", m.dashboardLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/signin", m.signinLoader, stdMid(l)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/reporting/{id}", m.reportingLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/reporting/{id}", m.reportingActionHandler, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/runloadjob", m.runloadjob, apimid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/loadJobStatus", m.loadJobStatus, apimid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/updatecron", m.updatecron, apimid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/updateloadjobenabled", m.updateLoadJobEnabled, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/runloadjoballcountries", m.runloadjoballcountries, apimid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/rate-report", m.rateReportHandler, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/targets/approve", m.approveTarget, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/targets/disapprove", m.disapproveTarget, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/api/targets/override", m.updateTargetOverride, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/targets", m.targetsLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/changelog", m.changelogLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools", m.toolsIndexLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/change-view", m.changeViewLoader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/change-view", m.changeViewAction, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/auth/{provider}/callback", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
		ctx := r.Context()
		now := time.Now()

		user, err := gothic.CompleteUserAuth(w, r)
		if err != nil {
			l.Printf("ERROR: %s", err)

			return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Somthing went wrong")
		}

		m.l.Printf("creating user session for %q", user.Email)

		if err := m.sessionStore.HttpCreate(ctx, now, user, w, r); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return Callback().Render(ctx, w)
	}, stdMid(l)...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/auth/{provider}", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
		now := time.Now()

		provider := r.PathValue("provider")
		if provider != "google" {
			uj.Redirect(w, r, "/signin")
			return nil
		}

		ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), gothic.ProviderParamKey, provider)
		r = r.WithContext(ctx)

		// try to get the user without re-authenticating
		if u, err := gothic.CompleteUserAuth(w, r); err == nil {
			if err := m.sessionStore.HttpCreate(ctx, now, u, w, r); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
			return nil
		} else {
			gothic.BeginAuthHandler(w, r)
		}

		return nil
	}, stdMid(l)...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/logout/{provider}", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
		gothic.Logout(w, r)
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/signin")
		return nil
	}, stdMid(l)...)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/logout", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
		now := time.Now()
		ctx := r.Context()

		if err := m.sessionStore.HttpInvalidate(ctx, now, w, r); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return nil
	}, stdMid(l)...)

}

func (m module) getCountryDB(c country.Country) *datastore.Client {
	switch c.Code {
	case country.ZA:
		return m.dbZA
	case country.UG:
		return m.dbUG
	case country.KE:
		return m.dbKE
	case country.ZM:
		return m.dbZM
	case country.TZ:
		return m.dbTZ
	default:
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("invalid cc %q", c.Code))
	}
}

func (m module) runloadjoballcountries(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	body := struct {
		Table    string
		Database string
	}{}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.HttpGet(ctx, now, w, r)
	if err != nil {
		return err // HttpGet handles redirects
	}

	if !u.IsAnalyst {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "User does not have permission")
	}

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	var currentCC string
	var dbPrefix, dbSuffix string

	for _, c := range country.List {
		ccWithUnderscores := fmt.Sprintf("_%s_", c.Code)
		if strings.Contains(body.Database, ccWithUnderscores) {
			currentCC = c.Code
			parts := strings.Split(body.Database, ccWithUnderscores)
			if len(parts) == 2 {
				dbPrefix = parts[0]
				dbSuffix = parts[1]
			}
			break
		}

		ccAsSuffix := fmt.Sprintf("_%s", c.Code)
		if strings.HasSuffix(body.Database, ccAsSuffix) {
			currentCC = c.Code
			dbPrefix = strings.TrimSuffix(body.Database, ccAsSuffix)
			dbSuffix = ""
			break
		}
	}

	if currentCC == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Could not determine country from database name")
	}

	m.l.Printf("Bulk refresh for table '%s' triggered by %s", body.Table, u.Email)

	for _, c := range userCountries {
		go func(c country.Country) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
			defer cancel()

			client, err := executions.NewClient(ctx, option.WithEndpoint("workflowexecutions.googleapis.com:443"))
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("ERROR: creating executions client for %s: %v", c.Code, err)
				return
			}
			defer client.Close()

			countryForProject := getCountry(c.Code)
			workflowName := fmt.Sprintf("projects/df-ps-%s/locations/europe-west9/workflows/manual-refresh-single-table", countryForProject)

			var databaseForCountry string
			if dbSuffix != "" {
				databaseForCountry = fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s", dbPrefix, c.Code, dbSuffix)
			} else {
				databaseForCountry = fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s", dbPrefix, c.Code)
			}

			m.l.Printf("Refreshing table '%s' in collection '%s' for country %s", body.Table, databaseForCountry, c.Name)

			createReq := &executionspb.CreateExecutionRequest{
				Parent: workflowName,
				Execution: &executionspb.Execution{
					Argument: fmt.Sprintf(`{
    						"table": %q,
    						"database": %q
    						}`, body.Table, databaseForCountry),
				},
			}

			execution, err := client.CreateExecution(ctx, createReq)
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("ERROR: creating execution for %s, table %s, db %s: %v", c.Code, body.Table, databaseForCountry, err)
				return
			}
			m.l.Printf("created execution for %s: %q", c.Code, execution.Name)
		}(c)
	}

	return web.JSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, nil)
}

// =-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

func (m module) getEntitiesForCountry(ctx context.Context, cc string) ([]CoreReload, error) {
	c := country.CodeToCountry(cc)
	ccDB := m.getCountryDB(c)

	query := datastore.NewQuery("__kind__").KeysOnly()
	keys, err := ccDB.GetAll(ctx, query, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// --- MODIFICATION START ---
	allEntitiesMap := make(map[string]CoreReload)

	for _, k := range keys {
		if strings.HasPrefix(k.Name, "__") && strings.HasSuffix(k.Name, "__") {
			continue
		}
		var entities []CoreReload
		q := datastore.NewQuery(k.Name)
		if _, err := ccDB.GetAll(ctx, q, &entities); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("Warning: failed to get entities for collection %s in %s: %v", k.Name, cc, err)
			continue
		}

		for _, entity := range entities {
			jobKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", entity.Database, entity.Name)
			if existing, ok := allEntitiesMap[jobKey]; ok {
				if entity.PreviousTableRefreshSAST > existing.PreviousTableRefreshSAST {
					allEntitiesMap[jobKey] = entity
				}
			} else {
				allEntitiesMap[jobKey] = entity
			}
		}
	}

	var uniqueEntities []CoreReload
	for _, entity := range allEntitiesMap {
		uniqueEntities = append(uniqueEntities, entity)
	}

	return uniqueEntities, nil
	// --- MODIFICATION END ---
}

func (m module) loadJobStatus(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	body := struct {
		CC string
	}{}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.HttpGet(ctx, now, w, r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !u.IsAnalyst {
		return err
	}

	var allEntities []CoreReload

	if body.CC == "" || body.CC == "ALL" {
		// If no country code is specified, fetch for all countries.
		for _, c := range country.List {
			entities, err := m.getEntitiesForCountry(ctx, c.Code)
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("Warning: failed to get entities for country %s: %v", c.Code, err)
				continue // Don't fail the whole request if one country fails
			}
			allEntities = append(allEntities, entities...)
		}
	} else {
		// Otherwise, fetch for the specified country.
		var err error
		allEntities, err = m.getEntitiesForCountry(ctx, body.CC)
		if err != nil {
			return err // Fail if the requested country fails
		}
	}

	return web.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, struct {
		CoreReloads []CoreReload
	}{
		CoreReloads: allEntities,
	})
}

func (m module) runloadjob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	body := struct {
		Table    string
		Database string
		CC       string
	}{}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.HttpGet(ctx, now, w, r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !u.IsAnalyst {
		return err
	}

	client, err := executions.NewClient(ctx, option.WithEndpoint("workflowexecutions.googleapis.com:443"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer client.Close()

	workflowName := fmt.Sprintf("projects/%s/locations/%s/workflows/%s", fmt.Sprintf("df-ps-%s", getCountry(body.CC)), "europe-west9", "manual-refresh-single-table")

	createReq := &executionspb.CreateExecutionRequest{
		Parent: workflowName,
		Execution: &executionspb.Execution{
			Argument: fmt.Sprintf(`{
				"table": %q,
				"database": %q
				}`, body.Table, body.Database),
		},
	}

	execution, err := client.CreateExecution(ctx, createReq)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	m.l.Printf("created req %q", execution.Name)
	return nil

}

		return err
	}

	c := country.CodeToCountry(body.CC)
	ccDB := m.getCountryDB(c)

	query := datastore.NewQuery("__kind__").KeysOnly()
	keys, err := ccDB.GetAll(ctx, query, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	collections := []string{}
	for _, k := range keys {

			continue
		}
		collections = append(collections, k.Name)
	}

	allEntities := []CoreReload{}
	for _, c := range collections {
		entities := []CoreReload{}

		q := datastore.NewQuery(c)
		if _, err := ccDB.GetAll(ctx, q, &entities); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		allEntities = slices.Concat(allEntities, entities)
	}

	return web.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, struct {
		CoreReloads []CoreReload

		CoreReloads: allEntities,

}
*/

func getCountry(code string) string {
	c := country.CodeToCountry(code)

	cName := strings.ToLower(c.Name)
	return strings.Replace(cName, " ", "-", -1)
}

func (m module) updatecron(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	body := struct {
		CC          string
		Collection  string
		LoadjobName string
		Cron        string
	}{}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.HttpGet(ctx, now, w, r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !u.IsAnalyst {
		return err
	}

	if !gronx.New().IsValid(body.Cron) {
		return web.JSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]any{
			"error": "invalid cron",
		})
	}

	c := country.CodeToCountry(body.CC)
	ccDB := m.getCountryDB(c)

	q := datastore.NewQuery(body.Collection).FilterField("name", "=", body.LoadjobName)

	var entities []CoreReload

	keys, err := ccDB.GetAll(ctx, q, &entities)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("Failed to query entities:", err)
		return web.JSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, nil)
	}

	if len(keys) == 0 {
		fmt.Println("No entities found")
		return web.JSON(w, http.StatusNotFound, nil)
	}

	if len(keys) != 1 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("found more than one entry with name %q", body.LoadjobName))
	}

	entities[0].CronSchedule = body.Cron

	if _, err = ccDB.Put(ctx, keys[0], &entities[0]); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("Failed to save updated entity:", err)
		return web.JSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, nil)
	}

	return web.JSON(w, http.StatusNoContent, nil)
}

func (m module) updateLoadJobEnabled(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	now := time.Now()

	var body struct {
		Database string
		Table    string
		CC       string
		Enabled  bool
	}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	u, _, err := m.sessionStore.HttpGet(ctx, now, w, r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if !u.Admin && !u.IsAnalyst {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Forbidden")
	}

	c := country.CodeToCountry(body.CC)
	ccDB := m.getCountryDB(c)

	q := datastore.NewQuery(body.Database).FilterField("name", "=", body.Table)

	var entities []CoreReload
	keys, err := ccDB.GetAll(ctx, q, &entities)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR querying datastore for job: %v", err)
		return err
	}
	if len(keys) == 0 {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Job not found")
	}
	if len(keys) > 1 {
		m.l.Printf("WARN: found multiple jobs for %s in %s", body.Table, body.Database)
	}

	key := keys[0]
	entity := entities[0]
	entity.HasGcsData = body.Enabled

	if _, err := ccDB.Put(ctx, key, &entity); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR updating datastore for job: %v", err)
		return err
	}

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}

	doc, err := m.fsDb.Collection("app_content").Doc("changelog").Get(ctx)

	if err != nil {

package base

import (
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"

	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"

)

// levelOption pairs a numeric Level with the human-readable label from the
// design doc's level matrix. Edit this list if labels need refining; the cookie
// value is just the integer.
type levelOption struct {
	Level int
	Label string
	Desc  string
}

var levelOptions = []levelOption{
	{Level: 1, Label: "L1 — Frontline", Desc: "Favorites only."},
	{Level: 2, Label: "L2 — Frontline +1", Desc: "Favorites + Dashboards & Lists (flat)."},
	{Level: 3, Label: "L3 — Technical / Specialist", Desc: "Adds search and grouped sub-headings."},
	{Level: 4, Label: "L4 — Country Mgmt / Exec", Desc: "Same as L3 today."},
	{Level: 5, Label: "L5 — Data", Desc: "Full view including the burger menu."},
}

type changeViewData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	u             auth.User
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	currentLevel  int // effective (override or true) — pre-selects the radio
	trueLevel     int // computed from groups — used to tag the user's "real" level
}

func (m module) changeViewLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if r.URL.Path != "/change-view" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Not Found")
	}
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)
	groups, err := m.dbs.GetUserGroups(ctx, u, c)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	trueLevel := calculateUserLevel(groups, u.Admin)
	current := trueLevel
	if override := getOverrideLevel(r); override > 0 {
		current = override
	}
	return changeView(changeViewData{
		r:             r,
		u:             u,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		currentLevel:  current,
		trueLevel:     trueLevel,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

// changeViewAction sets the UJUZI_LEVEL cookie from the posted form and
// redirects back to the home dashboard. Invalid/out-of-range values are
// rejected with a 400.
func (m module) changeViewAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid form")
	}
	var n int
	if g := r.FormValue("group"); g != "" {
		lvl, ok := levelForGroupName(g)
		if !ok {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "unknown user group")
		}
		n = lvl
	} else {
		var err error
		n, err = strconv.Atoi(r.FormValue("level"))
		if err != nil || n < 1 || n > 5 {
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "level must be 1..5")
		}
	}
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
		Name:     levelCookie,
		Value:    strconv.Itoa(n),
		Path:     "/",
		HttpOnly: false,
		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
		MaxAge:   60 * 60 * 24 * 365,
	})
	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
}

templ changeView(d changeViewData) {
	@layout.Html("Change View") {
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
			<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
					<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
				</a>
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150" title="Back to Home">
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg">Change View</span>
			</div>
			@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
		</div>
		<div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 mt-10 mb-20">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				<h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-1">Change Your View Level</h2>
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-6">
					Pick a level to preview how the home dashboard renders for that role.
					Your choice is stored in a cookie and persists across visits.
				</p>
				<form method="POST" action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/change-view") } class="space-y-3">
					for _, opt := range levelOptions {
						@levelRadio(opt, d.currentLevel, d.trueLevel)
					}
					<div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4">
						<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
							Cancel
						</a>
						<button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">
							Save
						</button>
					</div>
				</form>
				<form method="POST" action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/change-view") } class="mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-200">
					<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-1">Simulate a user group</h3>
					<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-3">Loads the level that group maps to.</p>
					<div class="flex gap-3">
						<input
							name="group"
							list="group-names"
							placeholder="e.g. Contact Centre"
							class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-green-x-dark focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						/>
						<button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors shrink-0">
							Load group's view
						</button>
					</div>
					<datalist id="group-names">
						for _, g := range sortedGroupNames() {
							<option value={ g }></option>
						}
					</datalist>
				</form>
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

templ levelRadio(opt levelOption, current int, trueLevel int) {
	<label class="flex items-start gap-3 p-4 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50 has-[:checked]:border-green-x-dark has-[:checked]:bg-green-x-light/10">
		<input
			type="radio"
			name="level"
			value={ strconv.Itoa(opt.Level) }
			class="mt-1 h-4 w-4 text-green-x-dark focus:ring-green-x-dark"
			checked?={ opt.Level == current }
		/>
		<div class="flex-1">
			<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ opt.Label }</p>
			<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{ opt.Desc }</p>
		</div>
		<div class="flex flex-col items-end gap-1 shrink-0">
			if opt.Level == current {
				<span class="text-xs font-medium text-green-x-dark uppercase tracking-wider">Current</span>
			}
			if opt.Level == trueLevel {
				<span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Your level</span>
			}
		</div>
	</label>
}

## File: modules\base\dashboard.templ
```templ
package base

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/icon"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
	"ujuzi/core/utils"
)

// =============================================================================
// REIMAGINED DASHBOARD
//
// Layout summary:
//   - Tall red header (logo, "Ujuzi", search icon, country dropdown, burger).
//   - Five hardcoded green favorite buttons (identical for every user) plus a
//     6th View More button at L3+. Buttons straddle the header/body boundary.
//   - Full-width report iframe below the buttons, defaulting to the first
//     favorite (Shake The Tree). Favorite clicks and View More items rewrite
//     the iframe's src in place — the URL stays at /.
//   - Per-element visibility is gated by a Level (1..5) currently hardcoded
//     to 5 in getUserLevel — see TODO there.
//
// Maintenance hooks (see comments at definitions):
//   - favoriteButtons          — top-of-file: edit labels / IDs / descriptions
//   - groupLevels              — userGroup.Name → presentational level (1..5)
//   - minLevelForReport        — placeholder per-report MinLevel hook
//   - getUserLevel             — placeholder user-level lookup
// =============================================================================

// branchOverrides maps a lowercased ?branch= value to its exact dataset
// casing for names that per-word title-casing can't reproduce — internal
// caps ("fortportal") and acronyms/punctuation ("the hilton - cbd"). Add a
// row here whenever a branch fails to match its Looker value.
var branchOverrides = map[string]string{
	"fortportal":       "FortPortal",
	"the hilton - cbd": "The Hilton - CBD",
}

// branchFromRequest reads ?branch= from the incoming request URL, trims
// whitespace, and returns a canonical Title-cased form. Empty when no value
// is present. Looker "IN" filters are case-sensitive — ?branch=posta has to
// land in the iframe URL as "Posta" to match the dataset value. URL-driven
// rather than cookie-backed so the filter dies the moment a navigation strips
// it (e.g. clicking a different country submits a form without ?branch=).
func branchFromRequest(r *http.Request) string {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(r.URL.Query().Get("branch")))
	if s == "" {
		return s
	}
	if override, ok := branchOverrides[s]; ok {
		return override
	}
	return titleCaseWords(s)
}

// titleCaseWords uppercases the first rune of each whitespace-separated word,
// leaving the rest lower. Input is assumed already lowercased.
func titleCaseWords(s string) string {
	words := strings.Fields(s)
	for i, w := range words {
		runes := []rune(w)
		runes[0] = unicode.ToUpper(runes[0])
		words[i] = string(runes)
	}
	return strings.Join(words, " ")
}

// favoriteHref builds the /reporting/{id} URL the favorite circle buttons link
// to, preserving cc, embedded, and (when present) the per-request branch
// param so the filter propagates from the dashboard render into each iframe
// load. Branch is dropped from the URL the moment the dashboard render
// doesn't carry it (country switch, manual nav, etc.).
func favoriteHref(cc string, isEmbedded bool, reportID, branch string) string {
	u := fmt.Sprintf("/reporting/%s?cc=%s", reportID, cc)
	if isEmbedded {
		u += "&embedded=true"
	}
	if branch != "" {
		u += "&branch=" + url.QueryEscape(branch)
	}
	return u
}

// defaultIframeSrc returns the URL the home page's report iframe loads on
// first paint. When the dashboard was reached via /reporting/{id} (i.e.
// d.initialReportID is set) we point the iframe at that report so the
// shared link lands the user on the correct view. Otherwise it falls back
// to the first resolved favorite (Shake The Tree when present); if no
// favorites resolved (e.g. Firestore lookup found nothing for this country)
// we render an empty iframe rather than a guaranteed-404 src.
func defaultIframeSrc(d dashboardData) string {
	if d.initialReportID != "" {
		return favoriteHref(d.cc, true, d.initialReportID, d.branch)
	}
	if len(d.favorites) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return favoriteHref(d.cc, true, d.favorites[0].ID, d.branch)
}

func userDataJson(fa []reporting.FunctionArea, reports []reporting.Report) string {
	m := map[string]any{
		"FunctionalAreas": fa,
		"Reports":         reports,
	}

	if out, err := json.Marshal(m); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	} else {
		return string(out)
	}
}

// favoriteButton struct + favoriteButtons slice live in dashboard_config.go.

// View More overlay sub-headings are now the FunctionalArea names themselves
// (one heading per FA the user has access to), iterated in the order defined
// by reporting.FunctionAreas. The earlier 3-bucket consolidation
// (Operations / Productivity / Credit and Credit Policy) was dropped so
// users can see exactly which FA each report belongs to.

// minLevelForReport is the placeholder MinLevel resolver. Every report defaults
// to MinLevel 1 today, so every level sees every report they otherwise have
// access to via FunctionalAreas (the user-group → FA mapping is already the
// authoritative gate). Levels only differentiate page chrome and the
// favorites layout, not which reports a user can reach via View More.
//
// TODO: replace with real per-report MinLevel — either by adding MinLevel to
// reporting.Report (firestore migration) or a separate registry keyed by
// report ID.
func minLevelForReport(_ reporting.Report) int { return 1 }

// levelCookie is the name of the cookie holding the user's currently-selected
// view level override. Set by POST /change-view; read by getOverrideLevel.
const levelCookie = "UJUZI_LEVEL"

// groupLevels maps a userGroup.Name (the Firestore userGroups doc's Name
// field, mirrored from MySQL sec_groups.group_name via the admin sync) to
// its presentational level. If a user belongs to multiple mapped groups,
// the maximum level wins. Users in no mapped groups fall through to
// defaultLevel below.
//
// Edit here to retune. No schema change required.
var groupLevels = map[string]int{
	"Contact Centre":             1,
	"Recoveries":                 1,
	"Client Service":             1,
	"Loan Consultants":           1,
	"Branch Manager":             2,
	"Contact Centre Team Leader": 2,
	"Recoveries Team Leader":     2,
	"Call Centre Team Lead":      2,
  	"Team Leaders":               2,
	"Telemarketer":               2,
	"HeadofDepartment":           3,
	"Management":                 3,
	"Accounts":                   3,
	"Audit":                      3,
	"Finance":                    3,
	"Financial Temp Access":      3,
	"Human Resources":            3,
	"IT_Ops":                     3,
	"LocalIT":                    3,
	"Marketing":                  3,
	"Product Team":               3,
	"Quality Control":            3,
	"Quality control: User":      3,
	"QualityControlApp":          3,
	"System Administrators":      3,
	"Executive":                  4,
	"Data_Reporting":             5,
}

// levelForGroupName resolves a typed group name to its presentational level
// via groupLevels, case-insensitively so a hand-typed "contact centre"
// matches "Contact Centre". Used only by the /change-view group form.
func levelForGroupName(name string) (int, bool) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	for g, l := range groupLevels {
		if strings.EqualFold(g, name) {
			return l, true
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}

func sortedGroupNames() []string {
	names := make([]string, 0, len(groupLevels))
	for g := range groupLevels {
		names = append(names, g)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	return names
}

// defaultLevel applies when the user is in no groupLevels-mapped groups
// (per spec: "EVERYONE else gets Level 4").
const defaultLevel = 4

// calculateUserLevel picks the user's true level from their group memberships
// in the current country. Multiple mapped groups → max wins. No mapped groups
// → defaultLevel. Admins are pinned to L5 regardless of group memberships,
// so they don't lose the burger menu and other L5 chrome when switching to a
// country where their MySQL groups don't map to Data_Reporting.
//
// Note: level is purely presentational; data access is still gated by
// FunctionalAreas. Override via /change-view still wins over the value
// returned here.
func calculateUserLevel(groups []country.UserGroup, isAdmin bool) int {
	max := 0
	for _, g := range groups {
		if l, ok := groupLevels[g.Name]; ok && l > max {
			max = l
		}
	}
	if isAdmin && max < 5 {
		max = 5
	}
	if max == 0 {
		return defaultLevel
	}
	return max
}

// userTagline renders the small subtitle under the "Ujuzi" header word.
// Appends "from <Branch>" when a branch is in scope this request (i.e. the
// dashboard was loaded with ?branch=…), otherwise just "Welcome <Name>".
// The branch value is already Title-cased by branchFromRequest.
func userTagline(u auth.User, branch string) string {
	if branch != "" {
		return "Welcome " + u.FirstName + " from " + branch
	}
	return "Welcome " + u.FirstName
}

// getOverrideLevel returns the level the user explicitly chose on /change-view
// via the UJUZI_LEVEL cookie, or 0 if no valid override is set. The dashboard
// loader falls back to the calculated true level (calculateUserLevel) when
// this returns 0.
func getOverrideLevel(r *http.Request) int {
	c, err := r.Cookie(levelCookie)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(c.Value)
	if err != nil || n < 1 || n > 5 {
		return 0
	}
	return n
}

// resolveFavorites looks up each cached favorite entry by ReportTitle
// against Reports.Title in the user's current country. Preserves cache
// order (which is the Order field set in the admin tool). Entries with no
// per-country Report match are silently dropped. The favorites row is
// level-driven by dashboardFavoritesForLevel, so MinLevel is not applied
// to favorites. Returns the rendered buttons and the underlying reports
// (parallel slices) so callers can build the L2 search payload without
// re-querying Firestore.
func (m module) resolveFavorites(ctx context.Context, cc string) ([]favoriteButton, []reporting.Report) {
	entries := m.dashboardConfigCache.Favorites()
	buttons := make([]favoriteButton, 0, len(entries))
	reports := make([]reporting.Report, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).
			Where("Title", "==", e.ReportTitle).
			Where("CC", "==", cc).
			Limit(1).
			Documents(ctx)
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("favorite %q not found in %s: %v", e.ReportTitle, cc, err)
			continue
		}
		var r reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &r); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("favorite %q decode error: %v", e.ReportTitle, err)
			continue
		}
		buttons = append(buttons, favoriteButton{
			Label:       e.Label,
			ID:          r.ID,
			Description: r.Description,
		})
		reports = append(reports, r)
	}
	return buttons, reports
}

// resolveLevel2Dashboards looks up each cached dashboard entry by
// ReportTitle against Reports.Title for the user's current country. For
// each match we use the matched doc's Firestore ID for routing and its
// Description for the tooltip. Entries with MinLevel > level or no
// per-country match are omitted. Returns parallel button + report slices.
func (m module) resolveLevel2Dashboards(ctx context.Context, cc string, level int) ([]favoriteButton, []reporting.Report) {
	entries := m.dashboardConfigCache.Dashboards()
	buttons := make([]favoriteButton, 0, len(entries))
	reports := make([]reporting.Report, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.MinLevel > level {
			continue
		}
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).
			Where("Title", "==", e.ReportTitle).
			Where("CC", "==", cc).
			Limit(1).
			Documents(ctx)
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			// Done (no match) or any other error → skip per spec.
			continue
		}
		var r reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &r); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("level2 dashboard %q decode error: %v", e.ReportTitle, err)
			continue
		}
		buttons = append(buttons, favoriteButton{
			Label:       e.Label,
			ID:          r.ID,
			Description: r.Description,
		})
		reports = append(reports, r)
	}
	return buttons, reports
}

// resolveTopReports queries the per-user usage table df-frontend.UJUZI.TOP_5
// (via core/bq.Service) and resolves each returned ReportTitle to a
// Firestore Reports doc in the user's current country. Cross-country misses
// (a title that BQ returns for the user but that has no matching Report
// in this CC) are silently dropped with a log warning — same pattern as
// resolveLevel2Dashboards. A BQ-level error returns nil + the error so
// callers can degrade gracefully (the favorites row falls back to just the
// pinned admin-curated STT entry rather than reverting to noisy Looker-
// report padding).
func (m module) resolveTopReports(ctx context.Context, userEmail, cc string) ([]favoriteButton, error) {
	top, err := m.bq.GetUserTopReports(ctx, userEmail)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("GetUserTopReports: %w", err)
	}
	buttons := make([]favoriteButton, 0, len(top))
	for _, t := range top {
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).
			Where("Title", "==", t.ReportTitle).
			Where("CC", "==", cc).
			Limit(1).
			Documents(ctx)
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("top report %q not found in %s: %v", t.ReportTitle, cc, err)
			continue
		}
		var r reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &r); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("top report %q decode error: %v", t.ReportTitle, err)
			continue
		}
		buttons = append(buttons, favoriteButton{
			Label:       r.Title,
			ID:          r.ID,
			Description: r.Description,
		})
	}
	return buttons, nil
}

// resolveLevel2Lists looks up each cached list entry for the given country
// by querying Firestore for a Report whose Link == /Reports/{CC}/{Extension}
// (CC upper-cased). When a match is found we use the matched doc's actual
// Firestore ID for routing and its Description for the tooltip. Entries
// with MinLevel > level or no match in the current country are omitted.
// Returns parallel button + report slices.
func (m module) resolveLevel2Lists(ctx context.Context, cc string, level int) ([]favoriteButton, []reporting.Report) {
	entries := m.dashboardConfigCache.Lists()
	buttons := make([]favoriteButton, 0, len(entries))
	reports := make([]reporting.Report, 0, len(entries))
	ccUpper := strings.ToUpper(cc)
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.MinLevel > level {
			continue
		}
		wantLink := fmt.Sprintf("/Reports/%s/%s", ccUpper, e.Extension)
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("Link", "==", wantLink).Limit(1).Documents(ctx)
		doc, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			// Done (no match) or any other error → skip per spec.
			continue
		}
		var r reporting.Report
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &r); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("level2 list %q decode error: %v", e.Label, err)
			continue
		}
		buttons = append(buttons, favoriteButton{
			Label:       e.Label,
			ID:          r.ID,
			Description: r.Description,
		})
		reports = append(reports, r)
	}
	return buttons, reports
}

func (m module) dashboardLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if r.URL.Path != "/" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Not Found")
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	d, err := m.buildDashboardData(r, "")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, c.Code, "view", "home", "ujuzi")

	return dashboard(d).Render(ctx, w)
}

// buildDashboardData assembles the full dashboardData payload for the home
// page render. Shared between the canonical / dashboard route and the
// non-embedded /reporting/{id} route, where it's invoked with
// initialReportID set so the iframe boots with the requested report rather
// than the first favorite.
func (m module) buildDashboardData(r *http.Request, initialReportID string) (dashboardData, error) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)
	fa, err := m.dbs.GetUserFunctionalAreas(ctx, u, c)
	if err != nil {
		return dashboardData{}, err
	}

	reports := []reporting.Report{}

	for _, f := range fa {
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).Where("FunctionalArea", "==", f.ID).Documents(ctx)
		for {
			doc, err := iter.Next()
			if err != nil {
				if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
					break
				}
				return dashboardData{}, err
			}

			var rep reporting.Report
			if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &rep); err != nil {
				return dashboardData{}, err
			}

			reports = append(reports, rep)
		}
	}

	groups, err := m.dbs.GetUserGroups(ctx, u, c)
	if err != nil {
		return dashboardData{}, err
	}
	trueLevel := calculateUserLevel(groups, u.Admin)
	level := trueLevel
	if override := getOverrideLevel(r); override > 0 {
		level = override
	}

	// L1 has no View More button so column data doesn't matter. L2 renders a
	// curated flat list resolved from Firestore (per-country availability +
	// description lookup). L3+ falls through to the FA-grouped Firestore
	// data.
	dashboardCol := map[string][]reporting.Report{}
	listsCol := map[string][]reporting.Report{}
	var l2Dashboards, l2Lists []favoriteButton
	var l2DashboardReports, l2ListReports []reporting.Report
	if level == 2 {
		l2Dashboards, l2DashboardReports = m.resolveLevel2Dashboards(ctx, c.Code, level)
		l2Lists, l2ListReports = m.resolveLevel2Lists(ctx, c.Code, level)
	} else if level >= 3 {
		dashboardCol = reportsForColumn(reports, reporting.TypeLooker, level)
		listsCol = reportsForColumn(reports, reporting.TypeJasper, level)
	}

	resolvedFavorites, favoriteReports := m.resolveFavorites(ctx, c.Code)

	// L3+ favorites pull slots 2-5 from the per-user BQ TOP_5
	// (df-frontend.UJUZI.TOP_5). Levels below 3 use the admin-curated set
	// only, so we skip the BQ call entirely. A BQ error is logged and
	// degrades gracefully — dashboardFavoritesForLevel will still render
	// the pinned admin-curated STT alone rather than failing the page.
	var topReports []favoriteButton
	if level >= 3 {
		var terr error
		topReports, terr = m.resolveTopReports(ctx, u.Email, c.Code)
		if terr != nil {
			m.l.Printf("resolveTopReports for %s: %v", u.Email, terr)
		}
	}

	// Search payload: at L2 we restrict the search index to the curated
	// config (favorites + level2Dashboards + level2Lists) so users can't
	// search their way into reports outside what the home view exposes.
	// L1 has no search input. L3+ keeps the full FA-derived report set.
	searchableReports := reports
	if level == 2 {
		searchableReports = make([]reporting.Report, 0, len(favoriteReports)+len(l2DashboardReports)+len(l2ListReports))
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, list := range [][]reporting.Report{favoriteReports, l2DashboardReports, l2ListReports} {
			for _, rep := range list {
				if seen[rep.ID] {
					continue
				}
				seen[rep.ID] = true
				searchableReports = append(searchableReports, rep)
			}
		}
	}

	return dashboardData{
		r:                 r,
		u:                 u,
		cc:                c.Code,
		userCountries:     userCountries,
		embedded:          uj.IsEmbedded(r),
		fa:                fa,
		reports:           reports,
		searchableReports: searchableReports,
		level:             level,
		trueLevel:         trueLevel,
		favorites:         dashboardFavoritesForLevel(resolvedFavorites, topReports, level),
		dashboardCol:      dashboardCol,
		listsCol:          listsCol,
		l2Dashboards:      l2Dashboards,
		l2Lists:           l2Lists,
		branch:            branchFromRequest(r),
		tools:             accessibleTools(u, m.dashboardConfigCache.Tools()),
		initialReportID:   initialReportID,
	}, nil
}

type dashboardData struct {
	r                 *http.Request
	u                 auth.User
	cc                string
	userCountries     []country.Country
	embedded          bool
	fa                []reporting.FunctionArea
	reports           []reporting.Report
	searchableReports []reporting.Report // payload for the header search (Fuse index)
	level             int                // effective level used for rendering (override or true)
	trueLevel         int                // computed from user groups; used to gate Exit Temp View button
	favorites         []favoriteButton
	dashboardCol      map[string][]reporting.Report
	listsCol          map[string][]reporting.Report
	l2Dashboards      []favoriteButton // resolved at L2 only (Firestore-derived Description)
	l2Lists           []favoriteButton // resolved at L2 only (Firestore-derived ID + Description)
	branch            string           // per-request branch filter from ?branch=; empty when none
	tools             []DashboardConfigEntry // tools the current user is allow-listed for; empty hides the Tools column
	initialReportID   string           // when set, defaultIframeSrc boots the iframe with this report instead of the first favorite (used for /reporting/{id} dashboard render)
}

// reportsForColumn returns reports filtered by type and minimum level, keyed
// by their FunctionalArea ID. Each group is sorted alphabetically by Title
// (case-insensitive) so the View More overlay renders items inside every
// heading in alphabetical order. The overlay itself iterates FAs alphabetically
// by Name — see sortedFunctionalAreas.
func reportsForColumn(reports []reporting.Report, t reporting.Type, level int) map[string][]reporting.Report {
	out := map[string][]reporting.Report{}
	for _, r := range reports {
		if r.Type != t {
			continue
		}
		if minLevelForReport(r) > level {
			continue
		}
		out[r.FunctionalArea] = append(out[r.FunctionalArea], r)
	}
	for k := range out {
		items := out[k]
		sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
			return strings.ToLower(items[i].Title) < strings.ToLower(items[j].Title)
		})
	}
	return out
}

// sortedFunctionalAreas returns a copy of fa sorted alphabetically by Name
// (case-insensitive). Used by the View More overlay so the L3+ headings render
// in alphabetical order regardless of the order GetUserFunctionalAreas returns.
func sortedFunctionalAreas(fa []reporting.FunctionArea) []reporting.FunctionArea {
	out := make([]reporting.FunctionArea, len(fa))
	copy(out, fa)
	sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
		return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
	})
	return out
}

// L2 entries (level2Dashboards / level2Lists) live in dashboard_config.go.
// They render as a flat list (no FA sub-headings) — see level2Column below.

// groupedHasAny reports whether any FA group in the grouped map has at least
// one report. Used by viewMoreColumn to decide between rendering the FA list
// and the "no items" fallback.
func groupedHasAny(grouped map[string][]reporting.Report) bool {
	for _, items := range grouped {
		if len(items) > 0 {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// overlayGridClass picks the View More overlay's column count: 3 columns
// when the user has at least one accessible tool (Dashboards | Lists |
// Tools), 2 otherwise (Dashboards | Lists). Tool visibility is allowlist-
// driven via toolEntry.AllowedEmails — see accessibleTools in
// dashboard_config.go.
func overlayGridClass(hasTools bool) string {
	if hasTools {
		return "grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-10"
	}
	return "grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-10"
}

// dashboardFavoritesForLevel picks the favorite circles shown on the home
// page. `config` is the curated favorites list from the dashboard-config
// tool, resolved to per-country Report docs in admin order; `topReports`
// is the per-user BQ TOP_5 list (df-frontend.UJUZI.TOP_5), populated only
// at L3+.
//
// L1/L2 show the curated list verbatim, capped at 5. L3+ pins config[0]
// (Shake The Tree) as circle #1, fills slots 2-5 from topReports in order,
// then backfills any slots topReports didn't cover from the rest of the
// curated list — so a user with no BQ usage still sees the full curated
// row rather than a lone STT. The count is whatever the curated list
// provides (up to 5). When config is empty (misconfigured environment)
// L3+ renders topReports alone, capped at 5.
func dashboardFavoritesForLevel(config, topReports []favoriteButton, level int) []favoriteButton {
	if level < 3 {
		if len(config) > 5 {
			return config[:5]
		}
		return config
	}
	if len(config) == 0 {
		if len(topReports) > 5 {
			return topReports[:5]
		}
		return topReports
	}
	out := []favoriteButton{config[0]}
	seen := map[string]bool{config[0].ID: true}
	add := func(b favoriteButton) {
		if len(out) >= 5 || seen[b.ID] {
			return
		}
		out = append(out, b)
		seen[b.ID] = true
	}
	for _, t := range topReports {
		add(t)
	}
	for _, c := range config[1:] {
		add(c)
	}
	return out
}

templ dashboard(d dashboardData) {
	@layout.Html("Ujuzi") {
		@slideover()
		<div id="report-search-container"></div>
		if d.level < 2 {
			<input id="report-search-trigger" type="text" class="sr-only" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"/>
		}
		<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/report_search.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
		<div class="hidden" id="userdata" data-userdata={ userDataJson(d.fa, d.searchableReports) }></div>
		<style>body{overflow:hidden}</style>
		<style>
			.favorites-wrapper {
				margin-top: 0;
				padding-bottom: 0.75rem; /* move buttons slightly higher than the header bar on mobile */
				padding-top: 0.75rem;
			}
			.fav-btn {
				width: clamp(4.5rem, 18vw, 6rem);
				height: clamp(4.5rem, 18vw, 6rem);
			}
			@media (min-width: 768px) {
				.favorites-wrapper {
					margin-top: calc(-1 * clamp(1.5rem, min(7dvh, 4dvw), 3.5rem));
					padding-bottom: 0;
					padding-top: 0;
				}
				.fav-btn {
					width: clamp(3rem, min(14dvh, 8dvw), 7rem);
					height: clamp(3rem, min(14dvh, 8dvw), 7rem);
				}
			}
		</style>
		<div class="flex flex-col h-[100dvh] w-full">
			<div class="order-3 md:order-1 w-full shrink-0 z-50 md:z-40">
				@dashboardHeader(d)
			</div>

			<div class="relative max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 z-10 md:z-50 pointer-events-none favorites-wrapper order-2 w-full shrink-0">
				@favoritesRow(d)
			</div>

			<link rel="preconnect" href="https://lookerstudio.google.com" crossorigin/>
			<link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://lookerstudio.google.com"/>

			<div id="iframe-container" class="w-full relative flex-grow flex flex-col order-1 md:order-3 md:mt-4">
				<style>
					@keyframes tree-grow {
						0%   { clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0); transform: scale(0.45); opacity: 0.4; }
						60%  { clip-path: inset(12% 0 0 0); transform: scale(1.04); opacity: 1; }
						100% { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
					}
					#iframe-loading .tree-loader {
						transform-origin: 50% 100%;
						animation: tree-grow 2.4s cubic-bezier(.22, .9, .3, 1) infinite alternate;
						will-change: clip-path, transform;
					}
				</style>
				<div
					id="iframe-loading"
					class="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white/95 border-2 border-red-x-light pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-300"
					style="z-index: 5;"
					aria-live="polite"
				>
					<svg
						class="tree-loader w-28 h-28 mb-4 text-red-x-dark"
						xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
						viewBox="0 0 361.43 362.69"
						fill="currentColor"
						aria-hidden="true"
					>
						<path
