72,17.7-17.93,27.08-5.72-8.09-11.55-16.35-17.39-24.6-.35.13-.71.26-1.06.38,4.65,13.54,9.3,27.07,13.95,40.61-1.33.77-2.66,1.54-3.98,2.31-14.41-16.49-28.83-32.98-43.24-49.47-.42.25-.84.5-1.26.75,3.25,5.02,6.67,9.93,9.71,15.07,7.03,11.9,14.33,23.7,20.53,36.03,1.86,3.69.46,9.01.56,13.59-3.79-1.18-8.68-1.26-11.15-3.75-7.59-7.63-14.25-16.17-21.27-24.37-1.49-1.74-2.94-3.52-5.8-4.47,3.19,5.61,6.39,11.22,9.58,16.84-.52.69-1.04,1.38-1.57,2.06-10.69-8.24-21.38-16.47-31.11-23.97,2.66,10.73,15.21,21.39,41.84,44.73-14.5,1.93-27.54,3.67-40.59,5.4.05.35.09.71.14,1.07,12.42.87,24.83,1.74,36.02,2.52-9.95,34.47-19.63,68.02-29.29,101.49C56.69,309.43,15.27,241.29,19.03,175.93,24.81,75.76,100.31,23.86,170.27,19.86c90.62-5.19,158.15,57.37,170.67,135.9,12.88,80.79-35.12,152.56-101.95,176.27M361.35,182.36C364.18,83.66,281.51-.32,181.08,0,80.42.33,6.33,79.07.44,168.14c-7.62,115.38,85.13,191.2,173,194.42,106.76,3.92,190.81-84.88,187.91-180.21"/>
```templ
					</svg>
					<p class="text-red-x-dark font-semibold text-lg">Loading…</p>
					<p class="text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1">This can take a few seconds.</p>
				</div>
				<iframe
					id="report-iframe"
					class="w-full flex-grow border-2 border-red-x-light block bg-white"
					src={ defaultIframeSrc(d) }
					title="Report"
				></iframe>
			</div>
		</div> @iframeLoadingScript()
		@favoriteLabelFitScript()
		@homeZoomScript()
		@viewMoreOverlay(d)
		if d.level != d.trueLevel {
			<button
				type="button"
				onclick="document.cookie='UJUZI_LEVEL=; Path=/; Max-Age=0'; location.href='/';"
				class="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-30 bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg transition-colors"
			>
				Exit Temp View
			</button>
		}
	}
}

// Header chrome scales with dvh via clamp() so it matches the rest of the
// dashboard (iframe + favorites) when Windows display scaling shrinks the
// logical viewport. dvh factors are tuned so the caps engage at ~800dvh
// (typical desktop viewport after browser chrome) — most users see the
// original sizes, and only Windows-zoomed viewports below that threshold
// shrink. Floors keep things legible without forcing wraps.
templ dashboardHeader(d dashboardData) {
	<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between z-50" style="height: clamp(4rem, 10dvh, 5rem); padding-left: clamp(0.75rem, 2dvw, 1.5rem); padding-right: clamp(0.75rem, 2dvw, 1.5rem);">
		<div class="flex items-center" style="gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1dvw, 1rem);">
			<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi" style="width: clamp(2rem, 6dvh, 3rem); height: clamp(2rem, 6dvh, 3rem);">
				<img src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi" style="width: clamp(1.5rem, 5dvh, 2.5rem);"/>
			</a>
			<div class="flex flex-col leading-tight">
				<span class="text-white font-bold tracking-wide" style="font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 3.75dvh, 1.875rem);">Ujuzi</span>
				<span class="text-white/80 font-normal" style="font-size: clamp(0.625rem, 1.5dvh, 0.75rem);">{ userTagline(d.u, d.branch) }</span>
			</div>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center ml-auto" style="gap: clamp(0.375rem, 1dvw, 0.75rem);">
			if d.level >= 2 {
				@searchInput()
			}
			@zoomControls()
			@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, d.embedded)
			if d.level >= 5 {
				@burgerMenu(d.r, d.u, d.level)
			}
		</div>
	</div>
}

// searchInput is the visible search box that filters Firestore reports
// inline as the user types. Results render in #report-search-dropdown
// directly below the input (max 5, styled like the burger menu).
// report_search.js wires the input event + click handlers.
templ searchInput() {
	<div class="relative">
		<input
			id="report-search-trigger"
			type="text"
			placeholder="Search..."
			autocomplete="off"
			class="px-2 rounded-full border border-white bg-transparent placeholder:text-white text-white text-center appearance-none outline-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-white focus-visible:outline-none focus:bg-white/10"
			style="width: clamp(5rem, 14dvh, 7rem); height: clamp(1.75rem, 4.5dvh, 2.25rem); font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.75dvh, 0.875rem);"
			aria-label="Search reports"
		/>
		<div
			id="report-search-dropdown"
			class="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 md:bottom-auto md:mt-2 w-64 origin-bottom-right md:origin-top-right rounded-md bg-white shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5 hidden z-50 overflow-hidden"
		></div>
	</div>
}

// zoomControls is the magnifying-glass icon button + flyout dropdown that
// manipulates the home #iframe-container's horizontal padding (vw) to zoom
// the embedded report in/out. Mirrors the reporting page's zoom UI and
// shares its localStorage key so settings carry across.
templ zoomControls() {
	<div class="relative" id="zoom-menu-container">
		<button
			id="zoom-toggle-btn"
			type="button"
			aria-label="Zoom"
			class="flex items-center justify-center text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150"
			style="width: clamp(2rem, 6dvh, 3rem); height: clamp(2rem, 6dvh, 3rem);"
		>
			<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.8" stroke="currentColor" style="width: clamp(1.125rem, 3.5dvh, 1.75rem); height: clamp(1.125rem, 3.5dvh, 1.75rem);">
				<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M21 21l-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 1 0 5.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 10.607 10.607ZM10.5 7.5v6m3-3h-6"/>
			</svg>
		</button>
		<div
			id="zoom-dropdown"
			class="absolute top-1/2 right-full -translate-y-1/2 mr-2 flex items-center bg-white rounded-full shadow-xl border border-gray-200 px-1 py-1 gap-0.5 transition-all duration-200 ease-out opacity-0 translate-x-2 pointer-events-none"
			style="z-index:200"
		>
			<span id="zoom-pct" class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 px-3 min-w-[4.5rem] text-center tabular-nums">100%</span>
			<button
				id="zoom-out-btn"
				type="button"
				aria-label="Zoom out"
				class="flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 rounded-full text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150"
			>
				<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4">
					<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M21 21l-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 1 0 5.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 10.607 10.607ZM13.5 10.5h-6"/>
				</svg>
			</button>
			<button
				id="zoom-in-btn"
				type="button"
				aria-label="Zoom in"
				class="flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 rounded-full text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150"
			>
				<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4">
					<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M21 21l-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 1 0 5.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 10.607 10.607ZM10.5 7.5v6m3-3h-6"/>
				</svg>
			</button>
		</div>
	</div>
}

// iframeLoadingScript shows a "Loading report…" overlay every time the
// embedded report iframe's src changes (initial load + every favorite,
// View More, and search-result click).
//
// Cross-origin Looker iframes don't expose a "render complete" signal, so
// `iframe.onload` only tells us the document loaded — Looker still paints
// for ~1-2s after that. We compromise: hide the overlay POST_LOAD_BUFFER_MS
// after the load event so the user doesn't watch a blank white box mid-paint.
// MAX_WAIT_MS guards against load never firing (e.g. blocked content) so the
// overlay can't get stuck forever.
templ iframeLoadingScript() {
	<script>
		(() => {
			const iframe = document.getElementById('report-iframe');
			const overlay = document.getElementById('iframe-loading');
			if (!iframe || !overlay) return;

			const POST_LOAD_BUFFER_MS = 2500;
			const MAX_WAIT_MS = 15000;

			let hideTimer = null;
			let maxTimer = null;

			const show = () => {
				overlay.style.opacity = '1';
				overlay.style.display = 'flex';
				clearTimeout(hideTimer);
				clearTimeout(maxTimer);
				maxTimer = setTimeout(hide, MAX_WAIT_MS);
			};

			const hide = () => {
				clearTimeout(hideTimer);
				clearTimeout(maxTimer);
				overlay.style.opacity = '0';
				// After the fade, take it out of the layer entirely so it
				// doesn't block iframe-internal pointer events at edges.
				setTimeout(() => { overlay.style.display = 'none'; }, 300);
			};

			// Initial load — only show if the iframe actually has a src.
			if (iframe.getAttribute('src')) {
				show();
			} else {
				hide();
			}

			iframe.addEventListener('load', () => {
				if (!iframe.getAttribute('src')) {
					hide();
					return;
				}
				clearTimeout(hideTimer);
				hideTimer = setTimeout(hide, POST_LOAD_BUFFER_MS);
			});

			// Anything that swaps iframe.src (favorites, View More, search)
			// triggers this — one place owns the overlay state.
			const obs = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
				for (const m of mutations) {
					if (m.attributeName !== 'src') continue;
					if (iframe.getAttribute('src')) show();
					else hide();
				}
			});
			obs.observe(iframe, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['src'] });
		})();
	</script>
}

// favoriteLabelFitScript shrinks each `.favorite-label` font-size by 1px at a
// time until the label fits in ≤ 2 lines (or hits the 9px floor). Per-label
// rather than per-viewport, since labels of wildly different lengths share
// the same row and CSS clamp() alone can't size them individually.
//
// Runs after `<button>`s are in the DOM. Re-runs on viewport resize because
// the circle width is a dvh/dvw clamp (see favoriteCircle), so resizing or
// changing Windows display scale changes how many chars fit per line.
templ favoriteLabelFitScript() {
	<script>
		(() => {
			const MAX_LINES = 2;
			// Bounds derive from the circle's rendered width so the label
			// shrinks with the circle when Windows display scaling kicks in.
			// At the original 112px circle these resolve to ~14px / ~8px,
			// matching the previous fixed bounds.
			const HARD_FLOOR_PX = 5;
			const HARD_CEIL_PX = 14;

			const fit = (el) => {
				const btn = el.closest('button');
				const w = btn ? btn.getBoundingClientRect().width : 0;
				const maxPx = Math.min(HARD_CEIL_PX, Math.max(HARD_FLOOR_PX, Math.round(w / 8)));
				const minPx = Math.min(maxPx, Math.max(HARD_FLOOR_PX, Math.round(w / 14)));
				for (let px = maxPx; px >= minPx; px--) {
					el.style.fontSize = px + 'px';
					const lh = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).lineHeight) || px * 1.2;
					// +1 tolerance — sub-pixel rounding sometimes inflates
					// scrollHeight by ~1 even when content visually fits.
					if (el.scrollHeight <= lh * MAX_LINES + 1) return;
				}
			};

			const fitAll = () => document.querySelectorAll('.favorite-label').forEach(fit);

			fitAll();
			let resizeTimer = null;
			window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
				clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
				resizeTimer = setTimeout(fitAll, 100);
			});
		})();
	</script>
}

// homeZoomScript wires the header's zoom controls to the home iframe-container.
// Same localStorage key as the reporting page so the user's preference travels.
templ homeZoomScript() {
	<script>
		(() => {
			const STORAGE_KEY = 'ujuzi_zoom_global';
			const STEP = 2;          // vw per step
			const MAX_LEVEL = 10;
			const BASE_PADDING = 2;  // vw always present

			const container = document.getElementById('iframe-container');
			const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('zoom-toggle-btn');
			const dropdown  = document.getElementById('zoom-dropdown');
			const pctEl     = document.getElementById('zoom-pct');
			const outBtn    = document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn');
			const inBtn     = document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn');
			const menu      = document.getElementById('zoom-menu-container');

			let level = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '0', 10);
			if (isNaN(level) || level < 0 || level > MAX_LEVEL) level = 0;

			const applyPadding = () => {
				const pad = (BASE_PADDING + level * STEP) + 'vw';
				container.style.paddingLeft  = pad;
				container.style.paddingRight = pad;
				const effective = 100 - 2 * (BASE_PADDING + level * STEP);
				const base = 100 - 2 * BASE_PADDING;
				pctEl.textContent = Math.round(effective / base * 100) + '%';
			};
			applyPadding();

			let open = false;
			const openZoom  = () => { open = true;  dropdown.classList.remove('opacity-0','translate-x-2','pointer-events-none'); dropdown.classList.add('opacity-100','translate-x-0','pointer-events-auto'); };
			const closeZoom = () => { open = false; dropdown.classList.add('opacity-0','translate-x-2','pointer-events-none');    dropdown.classList.remove('opacity-100','translate-x-0','pointer-events-auto'); };

			toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); open ? closeZoom() : openZoom(); });
			document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!menu.contains(e.target)) closeZoom(); });

			outBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
				e.stopPropagation();
				if (level < MAX_LEVEL) { level++; applyPadding(); localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, level); }
			});
			inBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
				e.stopPropagation();
				if (level > 0) { level--; applyPadding(); localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, level); }
			});
		})();
	</script>
}

// burgerMenu is rendered at every level so Change View remains reachable —
// otherwise a user who picks a low level on /change-view would be locked out
// of the page that lets them change it back. Admin only appears at L5 + admin;
// Change View is always visible. (Tools moved to the View More overlay.)
templ burgerMenu(r *http.Request, u auth.User, level int) {
	<div id="burger-menu" class="group relative" data-open="false">
		<button
			type="button"
			onclick="event.stopPropagation();(function(){const m=document.getElementById('burger-menu');m.dataset.open=m.dataset.open==='true'?'false':'true';})()"
			class="flex items-center justify-center text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-colors"
			title="Menu"
			aria-label="Open menu"
			style="width: clamp(2rem, 6dvh, 3rem); height: clamp(2rem, 6dvh, 3rem);"
		>
			<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" style="width: clamp(1.125rem, 3.5dvh, 1.75rem); height: clamp(1.125rem, 3.5dvh, 1.75rem);">
				<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3.75 6.75h16.5M3.75 12h16.5m-16.5 5.25h16.5"/>
			</svg>
		</button>
		<div class="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 md:bottom-auto md:mt-2 w-48 origin-bottom-right md:origin-top-right rounded-md bg-white shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5 hidden group-data-[open=true]:block z-50">
			<div class="py-1">
				if level >= 5 && u.Admin {
					<a
						href={ uj.SafeHref(r, "/admin") }
						class="block px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
					>
						Admin
					</a>
				}
				<a
					href={ uj.SafeHref(r, "/change-view") }
					class="block px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
				>
					Change View
				</a>
				<button
					id="copy-report-link-btn"
					type="button"
					class="block w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
					data-default-label="Copy Report Link"
				>
					Copy Report Link
				</button>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
	<script>
		(() => {
			const menu = document.getElementById('burger-menu');
			if (!menu) return;
			document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
				if (!menu.contains(e.target) && menu.dataset.open === 'true') {
					menu.dataset.open = 'false';
				}
			});

			// Copy Report Link — reads the current iframe src, strips the
			// embedded=true marker (so the shared URL lands on the dashboard
			// with the iframe pointed at the report, not the bare iframe
			// content), and writes an absolute URL to the clipboard.
			//
			// The iframe is rendered AFTER this header script in the DOM, so
			// we look it up at click time rather than at init time.
			const copyBtn = document.getElementById('copy-report-link-btn');
			if (!copyBtn) return;

			let flashTimer = null;
			const flash = (msg) => {
				clearTimeout(flashTimer);
				copyBtn.textContent = msg;
				flashTimer = setTimeout(() => {
					copyBtn.textContent = copyBtn.dataset.defaultLabel;
				}, 1500);
			};

			copyBtn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
				e.stopPropagation();
				const iframe = document.getElementById('report-iframe');
				const src = iframe && iframe.getAttribute('src');
				if (!src) {
					flash('No report loaded');
					return;
				}
				const url = new URL(src, window.location.origin);
				url.searchParams.delete('embedded');
				const shareable = url.toString();
				try {
					await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareable);
					flash('Copied!');
				} catch (err) {
					// navigator.clipboard requires a secure context (https
					// or localhost). Fall back to a hidden textarea +
					// execCommand for the non-secure-context case so the
					// button still works in local/dev over plain http.
					try {
						const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
						ta.value = shareable;
						ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
						ta.style.position = 'fixed';
						ta.style.opacity = '0';
						document.body.appendChild(ta);
						ta.select();
						const ok = document.execCommand('copy');
						document.body.removeChild(ta);
						flash(ok ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy failed');
					} catch (e2) {
						flash('Copy failed');
					}
				}
			});
		})();
	</script>
}

templ favoritesRow(d dashboardData) {
	<div class="flex flex-wrap justify-center items-center gap-2 md:gap-4">
		for _, b := range d.favorites {
			@favoriteCircle(d, b)
		}
		if d.level >= 2 {
			@viewMoreCircle()
		}
	</div>
}

// favoriteCircle is a green circular button that swaps the report iframe's src
// when clicked. Always passes embedded=true so the nested reporting page hides
// its own iframe-nav (see modules/base/reporting.templ).
//
// Diameter scales with the *smaller* of dvh and dvw via clamp() so the
// circles shrink alongside any axis the viewport tightens on. Width matters
// just as much as height: at Windows 150% display scaling the logical
// viewport (e.g. 1280×720) keeps the circles within their height-based cap,
// but the centered row still overruns the right-side header chrome (search,
// flag, burger). 8dvw caps each circle at ~1/12 of the viewport width so 6
// circles + 5 gaps stay inside the middle band even at 1280px. 13dvh keeps
// them from getting unreasonably tall on a short, very wide viewport. The
// 7rem ceiling preserves the original look on normal desktop. The 3rem
// floor keeps labels legible — favoriteLabelFitScript (above) re-fits the
// font on resize.
templ favoriteCircle(d dashboardData, b favoriteButton) {
	<button
		type="button"
		data-report-href={ favoriteHref(d.cc, true, b.ID, d.branch) }
		onclick="document.getElementById('report-iframe').src = this.dataset.reportHref"
		class="fav-btn group relative pointer-events-auto bg-gradient-to-tr from-green-x-dark to-green-x-light rounded-full shadow-2xl shadow-black/90 flex items-center justify-center text-center p-2 cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-black/60 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-x-light"
	>
		<span class="favorite-label text-white pointer-events-none px-1 leading-tight">{ b.Label }</span>
		<span class="pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white text-green-x-dark font-bold px-1 py-0 rounded-full shadow whitespace-nowrap" style="bottom: clamp(0.25rem, min(1.5dvh, 0.9dvw), 0.75rem); font-size: clamp(0.4rem, min(1dvh, 0.6dvw), 0.5rem);">CLICK HERE</span>
		<span class="pointer-events-none absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2 w-48 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity bg-black/80 text-white text-xs rounded-md px-2 py-1 z-20">
			{ b.Description }
		</span>
	</button>
}

// viewMoreCircle is the 6th button (L2+). Clicking it opens the View More
// overlay listing every dashboard/list the user has access to (gated by their
// FunctionalAreas — every level >= 2 can browse what their user group allows;
// L1 doesn't see this button at all).
templ viewMoreCircle() {
	<button
		type="button"
		onclick="document.getElementById('view-more-overlay').dataset.open = 'true'"
		class="fav-btn group relative pointer-events-auto bg-gradient-to-tr from-green-x-dark to-green-x-light rounded-full shadow-2xl shadow-black/90 flex items-center justify-center text-center p-2 cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-black/60 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-x-light"
	>
		<span class="favorite-label text-white pointer-events-none px-1 leading-tight">Show<br/>More</span>
		<span class="pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white text-green-x-dark font-bold px-1 py-0 rounded-full shadow whitespace-nowrap" style="bottom: clamp(0.25rem, min(1.5dvh, 0.9dvw), 0.75rem); font-size: clamp(0.4rem, min(1dvh, 0.6dvw), 0.5rem);">CLICK HERE</span>
		<span class="pointer-events-none absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2 w-48 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity bg-black/80 text-white text-xs rounded-md px-2 py-1 z-20">
			See every dashboard and list
		</span>
	</button>
}

// viewMoreOverlay is a full-screen modal listing every dashboard/list the
// user has access to. Rendered at every level — what's listed inside is
// already filtered by the user's FunctionalAreas. Toggling follows the
// codebase's data-open pattern (cf. slideover/burgerMenu); the backdrop is
// click-to-dismiss.
templ viewMoreOverlay(d dashboardData) {
	<div
		id="view-more-overlay"
		data-open="false"
		class="fixed inset-0 z-[60] hidden data-[open=true]:flex bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm items-start justify-center pt-16"
		onclick="if(event.target===this){this.dataset.open='false'}"
	>
		<div class="relative bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto p-8 mx-4">
			<button
				type="button"
				onclick="document.getElementById('view-more-overlay').dataset.open='false'"
				aria-label="Close"
				class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-9 h-9 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-600"
			>
				@icon.X()
			</button>
			<div class={ overlayGridClass(len(d.tools) > 0) }>
				if d.level == 2 {
					@level2Column(d, "Dashboards", d.l2Dashboards)
					@level2Column(d, "Lists", d.l2Lists)
				} else {
					@viewMoreColumn(d, "Dashboards", d.dashboardCol)
					@viewMoreColumn(d, "Lists", d.listsCol)
				}
				if len(d.tools) > 0 {
					@viewMoreToolsColumn(d)
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
}

templ viewMoreColumn(d dashboardData, title string, grouped map[string][]reporting.Report) {
	<div>
		<h3 class="bg-gradient-to-tr from-green-x-dark to-green-x-light text-white text-lg font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-2 text-center mb-4">{ title }</h3>
		if !groupedHasAny(grouped) {
			<p class="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">No items available.</p>
		}
		for _, fa := range sortedFunctionalAreas(d.fa) {
			if items, ok := grouped[fa.ID]; ok && len(items) > 0 {
				<h4 class="text-red-x-light text-lg font-bold mt-4 mb-2">{ fa.Name }</h4>
				for _, r := range items {
					@viewMoreRow(d, r)
				}
			}
		}
	</div>
}

templ viewMoreRow(d dashboardData, r reporting.Report) {

		onclick="document.getElementById('report-iframe').src = this.dataset.reportHref; document.getElementById('view-more-overlay').dataset.open='false'"
		class="group relative w-full text-left flex justify-between items-center gap-4 py-1.5 border-b border-gray-50 last:border-b-0 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"

}

// level2Column renders a flat (no FA sub-heading) list of curated entries
// for L2 users. The entries come from level2Dashboards / level2Lists in
// dashboard_config.go and use Dev/Prod Firestore IDs resolved at render.
templ level2Column(d dashboardData, title string, items []favoriteButton) {

		}

}

templ level2Row(d dashboardData, b favoriteButton) {
	<button
		type="button"

}

// viewMoreToolsColumn lists tools the current user is allow-listed for
// (see accessibleTools + toolEntry.AllowedEmails in dashboard_config.go).

templ viewMoreToolsColumn(d dashboardData) {

				<span class="text-xs text-green-x-dark group-hover:text-green-x-light font-medium whitespace-nowrap">Click to view</span>
			</a>

	</div>
}
```

## File: modules\base\dashboard_config.go
```go
package base

import (
	"strings"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
)

// =============================================================================
// DASHBOARD CONFIG
//
// The four configurable lists the home dashboard renders — favorite circles,
// L2 dashboards, L2 lists, and tools — live in Firestore (collection
// "dashboardConfig") and are exposed through DashboardConfigCache (see
// dashboard_config_cache.go). The /tools/dashboard-config admin tool edits
// them; render-time reads go through the cache.
//
// This file holds only the small helpers used by the dashboard renderer:
// userCanAccessTool and accessibleTools (both work over DashboardConfigEntry
// values supplied by the caller).
// =============================================================================

// favoriteButton is the render-time DTO for a favorite circle or a row in
// the L2 Dashboards/Lists overlay. Built by the dashboard handler from a
// DashboardConfigEntry by looking up the matching Firestore Reports doc
// (favorites + dashboards: by Title; lists: by Link). Label comes from
// the config entry; ID + Description come from the resolved Report doc.
type favoriteButton struct {
	Label       string
	ID          string
	Description string
}

// userCanAccessTool reports whether u may see/use t, by case-insensitive
// match of u.Email against t.AllowedEmails. No admin bypass — u.Admin == true
// does NOT grant access on its own. An empty AllowedEmails always returns
// false (effectively disabling the tool until someone is added).
func userCanAccessTool(u auth.User, t DashboardConfigEntry) bool {
	for _, e := range t.AllowedEmails {
		if strings.EqualFold(u.Email, e) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// accessibleTools returns the subset of the supplied tool entries that u
// can see. Order is preserved. Returned slice is a fresh allocation so
// callers can mutate without affecting the underlying cache snapshot.
func accessibleTools(u auth.User, tools []DashboardConfigEntry) []DashboardConfigEntry {
	out := make([]DashboardConfigEntry, 0, len(tools))
	for _, t := range tools {
		if userCanAccessTool(u, t) {
			out = append(out, t)
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

## File: modules\base\dashboard_config_cache.go
```go
package base

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log"
	"sort"
	"sync"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/randx"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"

	"ujuzi/core/collection"
)

// =============================================================================
// DASHBOARD CONFIG CACHE
//
// The home dashboard renders four lists — favorite circles, L2 dashboards,
// L2 lists, and tools — that used to be hardcoded slices in
// dashboard_config.go. They now live in Firestore (collection
// "dashboardConfig") so the /tools/dashboard-config admin tool can edit
// them without a deploy.
//
// The cache holds a fully-resolved copy of all four lists in memory. The
// dashboard handler reads from it on every page render; the admin tool
// calls Reload() after each save so changes are visible immediately.
//
// On first boot of a fresh environment the collection is empty — the cache
// seeds it from seedEntries() (today's hardcoded values) so behaviour is
// preserved verbatim. Once seeded, the seed function is never used again.
// =============================================================================

// DashboardConfigKind discriminates the four kinds of entries in
// collection.DashboardConfig.
type DashboardConfigKind string

const (
	KindFavorite  DashboardConfigKind = "favorite"
	KindDashboard DashboardConfigKind = "dashboard"
	KindList      DashboardConfigKind = "list"
	KindTool      DashboardConfigKind = "tool"
)

// DashboardConfigEntry is a single row in the dashboardConfig collection.
// Field meaning varies by Kind; see the per-kind notes below.
//
//	Favorite  — Label + ReportTitle (looked up against Firestore Reports
//	            by Title in the user's country); MinLevel gates visibility.
//	Dashboard — Same as Favorite but rendered inside the View More overlay
//	            instead of the favorites row. MinLevel gates visibility.
//	List      — Label + Extension (last segment of the Jasper path; the
//	            renderer constructs /Reports/{CC}/{Extension} and matches
//	            it against Report.Link). MinLevel gates visibility.
//	Tool      — Label + URL + Description + AllowedEmails. MinLevel is
//	            ignored — tools are gated purely by AllowedEmails.
type DashboardConfigEntry struct {
	ID            string
	Kind          DashboardConfigKind
	Order         int
	MinLevel      int
	Label         string
	ReportTitle   string
	Extension     string
	URL           string
	Description   string
	AllowedEmails []string
}

// DashboardConfigCache holds the resolved entries grouped by Kind. Reads
// are sorted by Order (callers don't need to re-sort). Writes happen via
// Reload, which re-queries Firestore in full.
type DashboardConfigCache struct {
	mu         sync.RWMutex
	l          *log.Logger
	fsDb       *firestore.Client
	favorites  []DashboardConfigEntry
	dashboards []DashboardConfigEntry
	lists      []DashboardConfigEntry
	tools      []DashboardConfigEntry
}

// NewDashboardConfigCache constructs the cache and performs the first
// Reload. If the Firestore collection is empty it seeds it from
// seedEntries() so dev/prod boot with the same hardcoded set we used to
// ship. Any Reload error is logged but does not abort startup — the
// dashboard renders an empty config instead of crashing.
func NewDashboardConfigCache(ctx context.Context, l *log.Logger, fsDb *firestore.Client) *DashboardConfigCache {
	c := &DashboardConfigCache{l: l, fsDb: fsDb}
	if err := c.Reload(ctx); err != nil {
		l.Printf("dashboardConfigCache: initial load failed: %v", err)
	}
	return c
}

// Reload re-reads the entire dashboardConfig collection into memory. If
// the collection is empty it first seeds Firestore from seedEntries() and
// re-reads. Safe to call concurrently from the admin save handler.
func (c *DashboardConfigCache) Reload(ctx context.Context) error {
	entries, err := c.readAll(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		c.l.Printf("dashboardConfigCache: collection empty, seeding from defaults")
		if err := c.seed(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		entries, err = c.readAll(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	var favs, dashs, lists, tools []DashboardConfigEntry
	for _, e := range entries {
		switch e.Kind {
		case KindFavorite:
			favs = append(favs, e)
		case KindDashboard:
			dashs = append(dashs, e)
		case KindList:
			lists = append(lists, e)
		case KindTool:
			tools = append(tools, e)
		default:
			c.l.Printf("dashboardConfigCache: skipping entry with unknown kind %q (id=%s)", e.Kind, e.ID)
		}
	}
	sortByOrder(favs)
	sortByOrder(dashs)
	sortByOrder(lists)
	sortByOrder(tools)

	c.mu.Lock()
	c.favorites = favs
	c.dashboards = dashs
	c.lists = lists
	c.tools = tools
	c.mu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

// Favorites returns a copy of the cached favorite entries (sorted by Order).
func (c *DashboardConfigCache) Favorites() []DashboardConfigEntry { return c.snapshot(c.favorites) }

// Dashboards returns a copy of the cached dashboard entries (sorted by Order).
func (c *DashboardConfigCache) Dashboards() []DashboardConfigEntry { return c.snapshot(c.dashboards) }

// Lists returns a copy of the cached list entries (sorted by Order).
func (c *DashboardConfigCache) Lists() []DashboardConfigEntry { return c.snapshot(c.lists) }

// Tools returns a copy of the cached tool entries (sorted by Order).
func (c *DashboardConfigCache) Tools() []DashboardConfigEntry { return c.snapshot(c.tools) }

// ReplaceKind atomically replaces every Firestore doc of the given Kind
// with the supplied entries (Order is taken from slice position). Used by
// the admin save handler — the UI posts the full per-Kind list and we
// rewrite that Kind wholesale. Tool/non-Tool kinds use the same path; the
// caller is responsible for not mixing Kinds.
//
// The implementation reuses existing IDs when an entry already has one
// (typical case: the user edited/reordered an existing row) and only
// Delete-s the IDs that no longer appear in the new set. This matters
// because Firestore's WriteBatch rejects multiple operations on the same
// document — a naive "delete-all-then-set-all" approach blows up the
// whole batch the moment any row is reused.
func (c *DashboardConfigCache) ReplaceKind(ctx context.Context, kind DashboardConfigKind, entries []DashboardConfigEntry) error {
	existingIDs, err := c.idsForKind(ctx, kind)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	keep := make(map[string]bool, len(entries))
	batch := c.fsDb.Batch()
	for i, e := range entries {
		e.Kind = kind
		e.Order = i
		if e.ID == "" || keep[e.ID] {
			e.ID = randx.UID()
		}
		keep[e.ID] = true
		batch.Set(c.fsDb.Collection(collection.DashboardConfig).Doc(e.ID), e)
	}
	for _, id := range existingIDs {
		if keep[id] {
			continue
		}
		batch.Delete(c.fsDb.Collection(collection.DashboardConfig).Doc(id))
	}
	if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return c.Reload(ctx)
}

func (c *DashboardConfigCache) snapshot(src []DashboardConfigEntry) []DashboardConfigEntry {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	out := make([]DashboardConfigEntry, len(src))
	copy(out, src)
	return out
}

func (c *DashboardConfigCache) readAll(ctx context.Context) ([]DashboardConfigEntry, error) {
	iter := c.fsDb.Collection(collection.DashboardConfig).Documents(ctx)
	var out []DashboardConfigEntry
	for {
		d, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				break
			}
			return nil, err
		}
		var e DashboardConfigEntry
		if err := mapstructure.Decode(d.Data(), &e); err != nil {
			c.l.Printf("dashboardConfigCache: decode error on %s: %v", d.Ref.ID, err)
			continue
		}
		if e.ID == "" {
			e.ID = d.Ref.ID
		}
		out = append(out, e)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (c *DashboardConfigCache) idsForKind(ctx context.Context, kind DashboardConfigKind) ([]string, error) {
	iter := c.fsDb.Collection(collection.DashboardConfig).Where("Kind", "==", string(kind)).Documents(ctx)
	var ids []string
	for {
		d, err := iter.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
				break
			}
			return nil, err
		}
		ids = append(ids, d.Ref.ID)
	}
	return ids, nil
}

func (c *DashboardConfigCache) seed(ctx context.Context) error {
	batch := c.fsDb.Batch()
	for _, e := range seedEntries() {
		if e.ID == "" {
			e.ID = randx.UID()
		}
		batch.Set(c.fsDb.Collection(collection.DashboardConfig).Doc(e.ID), e)
	}
	_, err := batch.Commit(ctx)
	return err
}

func sortByOrder(s []DashboardConfigEntry) {
	sort.SliceStable(s, func(i, j int) bool { return s[i].Order < s[j].Order })
}

// seedEntries returns the bootstrap config — verbatim copies of the
// hardcoded slices that used to live in dashboard_config.go, with
// MinLevel chosen to preserve today's visibility:
//
//	Favorites idx 0–3 → MinLevel 1 (visible to everyone).
//	Favorites idx 4 (Client Funnel) → MinLevel 2.
//	Dashboards + Lists → MinLevel 2 (today's L2-only behaviour).
//	Tools → MinLevel 0 (level-agnostic); AllowedEmails carries the gate.
//
// This runs exactly once per environment: the cache only calls seed()
// when collection.DashboardConfig is empty.
func seedEntries() []DashboardConfigEntry {
	favs := []DashboardConfigEntry{
		{Label: "Shake The Tree", ReportTitle: "Shake The Tree", MinLevel: 1},
		{Label: "Productivity Dashboard", ReportTitle: "Productivity Dashboard", MinLevel: 1},
		{Label: "CSAT", ReportTitle: "CSAT", MinLevel: 1},
		{Label: "Push the Boundaries", ReportTitle: "Push the Boundaries", MinLevel: 1},
		{Label: "Client Funnel", ReportTitle: "Client Funnel", MinLevel: 2},
	}
	dashs := []DashboardConfigEntry{
		{Label: "Branch Performance", ReportTitle: "Branch Performance", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Branch Year In Review", ReportTitle: "Branch Year In Review", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Country Dashboard", ReportTitle: "Country Dashboard", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Employer Risk Report", ReportTitle: "Employer Risk Report", MinLevel: 2},
	}
	lists := []DashboardConfigEntry{
		{Label: "Activations and Re-activations", Extension: "Activations_and_Re_activations", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Branch Enquiries", Extension: "Branch_Enquiries", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Consultant Cycle Stats", Extension: "Consultant_Cycle_Stats", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Employee List", Extension: "Employee_List", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Incomplete Applications", Extension: "Incomplete_Applications", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Sales List", Extension: "Sales_List", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Ussd Journey", Extension: "Ussd_Journey", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Walk-Away List", Extension: "Walk_away_client", MinLevel: 2},
		{Label: "Web Quotes", Extension: "Prequal_Quotes", MinLevel: 2},
	}
	tools := []DashboardConfigEntry{
		{
			Label:         "Campaigns",
			URL:           "/tools/campaigns",
			Description:   "Set up and run debt-recovery campaigns with controlled message variants.",
			AllowedEmails: []string{"liam@unifi.credit", "veroshan@unifi.credit", "jonathan@unifi.credit", "wynand@unifi.credit"},
		},
		{
			Label:         "Unifi Words",
			URL:           "/tools/unifi-words",
			Description:   "Manage the shared business glossary used across reports and tools.",
			AllowedEmails: []string{"liam@unifi.credit", "jonathan@unifi.credit", "elena@unifi.credit", "stephne@unifi.credit", "michael.perry@unifi.credit", "kaylie@unifi.credit"},
		},
		{
			Label:         "Credit Policy",
			URL:           "/tools/credit-policy",
			Description:   "Submit, preview, and approve country-level credit-policy changes.",
			AllowedEmails: []string{"liam@unifi.credit", "wynand@unifi.credit", "jonathan@unifi.credit", "elena@unifi.credit"},
		},
		{
			Label:         "Targets",
			URL:           "/targets",
			Description:   "Review, approve, and override branch performance targets per cycle.",
			AllowedEmails: []string{"liam@unifi.credit", "neil@unifi.credit", "elena@unifi.credit", "jonathan@unifi.credit"},
		},
		{
			Label:         "Dataform",
			URL:           "/admin/dataform",
			Description:   "Manage and monitor Dataform pipeline runs across countries.",
			AllowedEmails: []string{"liam@unifi.credit", "neil@unifi.credit"},
		},
		{
			Label:         "Dashboard Config",
			URL:           "/tools/dashboard-config",
			Description:   "Edit the home dashboard's favorites, dashboards, lists, and tools.",
			AllowedEmails: []string{"liam@unifi.credit"},
		},
	}

	var out []DashboardConfigEntry
	out = append(out, applyKindAndOrder(favs, KindFavorite)...)
	out = append(out, applyKindAndOrder(dashs, KindDashboard)...)
	out = append(out, applyKindAndOrder(lists, KindList)...)
	out = append(out, applyKindAndOrder(tools, KindTool)...)
	return out
}

func applyKindAndOrder(in []DashboardConfigEntry, kind DashboardConfigKind) []DashboardConfigEntry {
	out := make([]DashboardConfigEntry, len(in))
	for i, e := range in {
		e.Kind = kind
		e.Order = i
		out[i] = e
	}
	return out
}
```

## File: modules\base\rating_api.go
```go
package base

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/core/utils"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
)

func (m module) rateReportHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	var payload struct {
		ReportID    string `json:"reportId"`
		ReportTitle string `json:"reportTitle"`
		CountryCode string `json:"cc"`
		Rating      string `json:"rating"`
		Feedback    string `json:"feedback"`
	}

	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
	}

	event := bq.RatingEvent{
		UserID:      u.Email,
		ReportID:    payload.ReportID,
		ReportTitle: payload.ReportTitle,
		CountryCode: payload.CountryCode,
		Rating:      payload.Rating,
		Feedback:    payload.Feedback,
		Timestamp:   time.Now(),
	}

	if err := m.bq.InsertRating(ctx, event); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR: failed to insert rating into BigQuery: %v", err)
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Could not save rating")
	}

	utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, payload.CountryCode, "rating", payload.ReportTitle, "report")

	return web.Text(w, http.StatusNoContent, "")
}
```

## File: modules\base\reload_cache.go
```go
package base

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"ujuzi/core/country"

	"cloud.google.com/go/datastore"
)

type ReloadCacheData struct {
	Collections []string
	Entities    []CoreReload
	LastUpdated time.Time
}

type ReloadCache struct {
	mu               sync.RWMutex
	cache            map[string]ReloadCacheData   // key is country code
	datastoreClients map[string]*datastore.Client // key is country code
	l                *log.Logger
}

func NewReloadCache(l *log.Logger, dbZA, dbUG, dbKE, dbZM, dbTZ *datastore.Client) *ReloadCache {
	clients := map[string]*datastore.Client{
		country.ZA: dbZA,
		country.UG: dbUG,
		country.KE: dbKE,
		country.ZM: dbZM,
		country.TZ: dbTZ,
	}

	return &ReloadCache{
		cache:            make(map[string]ReloadCacheData),
		datastoreClients: clients,
		l:                l,
	}
}

// Get retrieves cached data for a country.
func (c *ReloadCache) Get(countryCode string) (ReloadCacheData, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	data, found := c.cache[countryCode]
	return data, found
}

// Refresh performs the data loading and updates the cache for a specific country.
func (c *ReloadCache) Refresh(ctx context.Context, countryCode string) error {
	c.l.Printf("Starting background refresh for /reload page data for country: %s", countryCode)

	client, ok := c.datastoreClients[countryCode]
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("no datastore client for country code: %s", countryCode)
	}

	query := datastore.NewQuery("__kind__").KeysOnly()
	keys, err := client.GetAll(ctx, query, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get kinds for %s: %w", countryCode, err)
	}

	var collections []string
	for _, k := range keys {
		if strings.HasPrefix(k.Name, "__") && strings.HasSuffix(k.Name, "__") {
			continue
		}
		collections = append(collections, k.Name)
	}

	// --- MODIFICATION START ---
	allEntitiesMap := make(map[string]CoreReload)

	for _, collectionName := range collections {
		var entities []CoreReload
		q := datastore.NewQuery(collectionName)
		if _, err := client.GetAll(ctx, q, &entities); err != nil {
			c.l.Printf("failed to get entities for collection %s in %s: %v", collectionName, countryCode, err)
			continue // Continue to fetch other collections even if one fails
		}

		for _, entity := range entities {
			jobKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", entity.Database, entity.Name)

			if existing, ok := allEntitiesMap[jobKey]; ok {
				// A simple string comparison works here because the timestamp format is sortable.
				if entity.PreviousTableRefreshSAST > existing.PreviousTableRefreshSAST {
					allEntitiesMap[jobKey] = entity
				}
			} else {
				allEntitiesMap[jobKey] = entity
			}
		}
	}

	var uniqueEntities []CoreReload
	for _, entity := range allEntitiesMap {
		uniqueEntities = append(uniqueEntities, entity)
	}

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.cache[countryCode] = ReloadCacheData{
		Collections: collections,
		Entities:    uniqueEntities,
		LastUpdated: time.Now(),
	}
	// --- MODIFICATION END ---

	c.l.Printf("Finished background refresh for /reload page for country: %s. Fetched %d entities across %d collections.", countryCode, len(uniqueEntities), len(collections))
	return nil
}

// StartBackgroundRefresh starts a ticker to periodically refresh the cache.
func (c *ReloadCache) StartBackgroundRefresh(interval time.Duration) {
	c.l.Println("Starting background cache refresh for /reload page...")

	// Initial refresh for all countries
	go func() {
		for cc := range c.datastoreClients {
			if err := c.Refresh(context.Background(), cc); err != nil {
				c.l.Printf("Initial cache refresh failed for %s: %v", cc, err)
			}
		}
	}()

	// Periodic refresh
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	go func() {
		for range ticker.C {
			c.l.Println("Starting periodic cache refresh for /reload page...")
			for cc := range c.datastoreClients {
				if err := c.Refresh(context.Background(), cc); err != nil {
					c.l.Printf("Periodic cache refresh failed for %s: %v", cc, err)
				}
			}
		}
	}()
}
```

```templ
package base

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/collection"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/jasper"
	"ujuzi/core/reporting"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/cmp"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/icon"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
	"ujuzi/core/utils"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/form"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2"
	"google.golang.org/api/iterator"
)

func (m module) reportingLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	reportID := r.PathValue("id")

	// Direct hits on /reporting/{id} render the home dashboard with the
	// iframe pre-pointed at this report — the shared-link UX. Only the
	// dashboard iframe itself reloads /reporting/{id}?embedded=true, which
	// falls through to the page-rendering path below.
	if !uj.IsEmbedded(r) {
		d, err := m.buildDashboardData(r, reportID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return dashboard(d).Render(ctx, w)
	}

	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)


	doc, err := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Doc(reportID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {

		// handle report not found case
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("report %q not found", reportID))
	}

	var report reporting.Report
	if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &report); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	fa, err := m.dbs.GetUserFunctionalAreas(ctx, u, c)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	reports := []reporting.Report{}

	for _, f := range fa {
		iter := m.fsDb.Collection(collection.Reports).Where("CC", "==", c.Code).Where("FunctionalArea", "==", f.ID).Documents(ctx)
		for {
			doc, err := iter.Next()
			if err != nil {
				if errors.Is(err, iterator.Done) {
					break
				}
				return err
			}

			var r reporting.Report
			if err := mapstructure.Decode(doc.Data(), &r); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			reports = append(reports, r)
		}
	}

	d := reportingPageData{
		Report:        report,
		CC:            c.Code,
		Embedded:      uj.IsEmbedded(r),
		UserCountries: userCountries,
		Reports:       reports,
		FA:            fa,
		Country:       c.Name,
		U:             u,
	}

	if report.Type == reporting.TypeJasper {
		inputControls, err := m.jsC.GetInputControls(ctx, report.Link)
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR: failed to reach Jasper server: %s", err)
			return web.Text(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to reach Jasper server")
		}

		inputControlsForm := map[string]form.Field{}

		for _, ctr := range inputControls {
        // Check if the control is a date type
        if ctr.Type == jasper.CtrTypeDate {
            // Set the value to today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format
            inputControlsForm[ctr.ID] = form.Val(time.Now().Format("2006-01-02"))
        } else {
            // Otherwise, keep it empty
            inputControlsForm[ctr.ID] = form.Val("")
        }
    }

		d.InputControls = inputControls
		d.InputControlsForm = inputControlsForm
	}

	if report.Type == reporting.TypeLooker {
		utils.LogEvent(m.l, u.Email, c.Code, "view", report.Title, "looker")
	}

	return reportingPage(r, d).Render(ctx, w)
}

type reportingPageData struct {
	Report            reporting.Report
	InputControls     []jasper.InputControl
	InputControlsForm map[string]form.Field
	CC                string
	Embedded          bool
	UserCountries     []country.Country
	Country           string
	FA                []reporting.FunctionArea
	Reports           []reporting.Report
	U                 auth.User
}

func toOpts(in []jasper.Option) []cmp.SelectOption {
	out := make([]cmp.SelectOption, len(in))
	for i := 0; i < len(in); i++ {
		out[i] = cmp.SelectOption{
			Label: in[i].Label,
			Value: in[i].Value,
		}
	}

	return out
}

func processGuide(report reporting.Report, cc string) string {
	guide := report.Guide
	guide = strings.ReplaceAll(guide, "{{ARCHITECT}}", report.Architect)
	guide = strings.ReplaceAll(guide, "{{BUILDERS}}", report.Builders)
	businessOwner := "N/A"
	if owner, ok := report.BusinessOwners[cc]; ok && owner != "" {
		businessOwner = owner
	}
	guide = strings.ReplaceAll(guide, "{{BUSINESS_OWNER}}", businessOwner)

	for key, owner := range report.BusinessOwners {
		placeholder := fmt.Sprintf("{{BUSINESS_OWNER_%s}}", key)
		if owner == "" {
			owner = "N/A"
		}
		guide = strings.ReplaceAll(guide, placeholder, owner)
	}

	return guide
}

func addParamsToReportLink(report reporting.Report, countryName string, cc string, r *http.Request, user auth.User) string {
	link := report.Link
    
    if pt1 := r.FormValue("pt_1"); pt1 != "" && report.PageTarget1 != "" {
        link = fmt.Sprintf("%s/page/%s", strings.TrimSuffix(link, "/"), report.PageTarget1)
    } else if pt2 := r.FormValue("pt_2"); pt2 != "" && report.PageTarget2 != "" {
        link = fmt.Sprintf("%s/page/%s", strings.TrimSuffix(link, "/"), report.PageTarget2)
    } else if pt3 := r.FormValue("pt_3"); pt3 != "" && report.PageTarget3 != "" {
        link = fmt.Sprintf("%s/page/%s", strings.TrimSuffix(link, "/"), report.PageTarget3)
    }
	u, err := url.Parse(link)
	if err != nil {
		return report.Link // Return original link on parse error
	}

	reportParams := make(map[string]string)

	if report.ConsultantCode != "" {
		fullName := strings.TrimSpace(user.FirstName + " " + user.LastName)
		reportParams[report.ConsultantCode] = fmt.Sprintf("include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s", fullName)
	}
	

	if report.PeriodCode != "" {
		now := time.Now()
        period := now.Format("200601") // Formats current time as YYYYMM
        reportParams[report.PeriodCode] = fmt.Sprintf("include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s", period)
    }


	if report.URLCountryCode != "" {
		// Looker Studio's specific format for "IN" filter
		reportParams[report.URLCountryCode] = fmt.Sprintf("include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s", countryName)
	}

	// Per-request branch filter: report.BranchCode is the Looker param name
	// (configured per-report in /admin/reports); the value comes from the
	// ?branch= query string on the incoming iframe request. URL-driven, no
	// persistence — context changes (e.g. switching country on the home
	// page) automatically drop the filter on the next render because the
	// regenerated favorite/View More hrefs no longer carry it.
	if report.BranchCode != "" {
		if b := branchFromRequest(r); b != "" {
			reportParams[report.BranchCode] = fmt.Sprintf("include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s", b)
		}
	}

	now := time.Now()
	if report.DateCode != "" {
		reportParams[report.DateCode] = fmt.Sprintf("include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s", now.Format("2006-01-02"))
	}

if report.CycleCode != "" || report.PrevCycleCode != "" {
		_, _, day := now.Date()
		cutoff := 10 // Default for other countries
		if cc == "za" {
			cutoff = 4
		}

		currentCycleTime := now
		if day <= cutoff {
			// If before cutoff, use previous month as current cycle
			currentCycleTime = now.AddDate(0, -1, 0)
		}

		if report.CycleCode != "" {
			cycle := currentCycleTime.Format("200601")
			reportParams[report.CycleCode] = fmt.Sprintf("include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s", cycle)
		}
		
		if report.PrevCycleCode != "" {
			prevCycleTime := currentCycleTime.AddDate(0, -1, 0) // one month before the "current" cycle time
			prevCycle := prevCycleTime.Format("200601")
			reportParams[report.PrevCycleCode] = fmt.Sprintf("include%%EE%%80%%800%%EE%%80%%80IN%%EE%%80%%80%s", prevCycle)
		}
	}

	if len(reportParams) == 0 {
		params := map[string]string{
			"CC1": countryName, "CC2": countryName, "CC3": countryName, "CC4": countryName,
			"CC5": countryName, "CC6": countryName, "CC7": countryName, "CC8": countryName,
			"CC9": countryName, "CC10": countryName, "CC11": countryName, "CC12": countryName,
			"CC13": countryName, "CC14": countryName, "CC15": countryName, "CC16": countryName,
			"CC17": countryName, "CC18": countryName, "CC19": countryName, "CC20": countryName,
		}
		paramsAsString, err := json.Marshal(params)
		if err != nil {
			return report.Link
		}

		q := u.Query()
		q.Set("params", string(paramsAsString))
		u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
		return u.String()
	}

	paramsAsString, err := json.Marshal(reportParams)
	if err != nil {
		return report.Link
	}

	q := u.Query()
	q.Set("params", string(paramsAsString))
	u.RawQuery = q.Encode()
	return u.String()
}

func getFieldName(ctr jasper.InputControl) string {
	if ctr.Description == "" {
		return ctr.Label
	}
	return ctr.Description
}

// iframeContainerClass picks the right height class for the report iframe
// container based on whether the page is embedded (no top nav, take the full
// viewport, no extra padding) or standalone (subtract the 3.5rem nav height
// and keep the breathing-room padding).
func iframeContainerClass(embedded bool) string {
	if embedded {
		return "w-full flex justify-center h-screen"
	}
	return "w-full py-4 flex justify-center h-[calc(100vh-3.5rem)]"
}

			<div class="pt-10 pb-10 lg:px-16 xl:px-32 2xl:px-48">
				<div class="mx-auto max-w-screen-2xl">
					<div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
						if d.Report.Guide != "" {
							<details class="group mb-6 border rounded-md shadow-sm bg-gray-50">
								<summary class="list-none flex justify-between items-center px-4 py-3 cursor-pointer font-medium text-gray-900 select-none">

						<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
					</a>

					<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg after:content-['|'] after:pl-3 after:font-extralight">{ d.Report.Title }</span>

				<div class="flex items-center gap-2">

						<button id="zoom-toggle-btn" aria-label="Zoom"
							class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150">
							<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.8" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
								<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M21 21l-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 1 0 5.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 10.607 10.607ZM10.5 7.5v6m3-3h-6"/>
							</svg>

						<!-- Zoom dropdown -->

							class="absolute top-1/2 right-full -translate-y-1/2 mr-2 flex items-center bg-white rounded-full shadow-xl border border-gray-200 px-1 py-1 gap-0.5 transition-all duration-200 ease-out opacity-0 translate-x-2 pointer-events-none"
							style="z-index:200">
							<span id="zoom-pct" class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 px-3 min-w-[4.5rem] text-center tabular-nums">100%</span>
							<button id="zoom-out-btn" aria-label="Zoom out"
								class="flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-full text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150">
								<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4">
									<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M21 21l-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 1 0 5.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 10.607 10.607ZM13.5 10.5h-6"/>
								</svg>
							</button>
							<button id="zoom-in-btn" aria-label="Zoom in"
								class="flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-full text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150">
								<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4">
									<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M21 21l-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 1 0 5.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 10.607 10.607ZM10.5 7.5v6m3-3h-6"/>
								</svg>
							</button>
						</div>
					</div>
					<div class="relative">
						<input type="checkbox" id="burger-menu-toggle" class="hidden peer" />
					<label for="burger-menu-toggle" class="cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-colors">
						<span class="sr-only">Toggle Menu</span>
						<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-6 h-6">
							<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3.75 6.75h16.5M3.75 12h16.5m-16.5 5.25h16.5"/>
						</svg>
					</label>
					<div class="absolute top-12 right-0 bg-white shadow-lg rounded-md w-64 hidden peer-checked:block" style="z-index:100">
						<div class="p-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
							<h2 class="text-lg font-bold">{ d.Report.Title }</h2>
							<button
								id="report-search-trigger"
								class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-4 py-2 bg-green-x-light text-white rounded-full hover:bg-green-x-dark transition-colors font-medium"
							>
								<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
									<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="m21 21-5.197-5.197m0 0A7.5 7.5 0 1 0 5.196 5.196a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 10.607 10.607Z"/>
								</svg>
								Search Reports
							</button>
							<button
								data-option={ "dashboards" }
								data-fa={ reporting.FunctionalAreasMap[d.Report.FunctionalArea].Name }
								data-faid={ reporting.FunctionalAreasMap[d.Report.FunctionalArea].ID }
								data-slideover
								class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-4 py-2 bg-green-x-light text-white rounded-full hover:bg-green-x-dark transition-colors font-medium"
							>
								<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
									<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3.75 12h16.5m-16.5 3.75h16.5M3.75 19.5h16.5M5.625 4.5h12.75a1.875 1.875 0 0 1 0 3.75H5.625a1.875 1.875 0 0 1 0-3.75Z"/>
								</svg>
								More Reports
							</button>
						</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
				<script>
                    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
                        const toggle = document.getElementById('burger-menu-toggle');
                        const menuContainer = toggle.closest('.relative');
                        const nav = document.getElementById('iframe-nav');
                        const CLOSE_DISTANCE = 300;

                        // Transparent overlay to capture mousemove events over the iframe
                        const overlay = document.createElement('div');
                        overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:3.5rem;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;display:none;pointer-events:none;';
                        document.body.appendChild(overlay);

                        const closeMenu = () => {
                            toggle.checked = false;
                            overlay.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                            overlay.style.display = 'none';
                        };

                        toggle.addEventListener('change', () => {
                            if (toggle.checked) {
                                overlay.style.display = 'block';
                                overlay.style.pointerEvents = 'all';
                            } else {
                                overlay.style.display = 'none';
                                overlay.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                            }
                        });

                        document.getElementById('report-search-trigger').addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
                        document.querySelector('[data-slideover]').addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

                        // Hide/show header when slideover opens/closes
                        const slideover = document.getElementById('slideover');
                        if (slideover) {
                            new MutationObserver(() => {
                                nav.style.visibility = slideover.dataset.open === 'true' ? 'hidden' : '';
                            }).observe(slideover, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-open'] });
                        }

                        const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
                            if (!toggle.checked) return;
                            const rect = menuContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const closestX = Math.max(rect.left, Math.min(e.clientX, rect.right));
                            const closestY = Math.max(rect.top, Math.min(e.clientY, rect.bottom));
                            const dx = e.clientX - closestX;
                            const dy = e.clientY - closestY;
                            const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                            if (distance > CLOSE_DISTANCE) {
                                closeMenu();
                            }
                        };

                        document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
                        overlay.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);

                        // Zoom controls
                        const iframeContainer = document.getElementById('iframe-container');
                        let paddingLevel = 0;
                        const STEP = 2; // vw units per step
                        const MAX_LEVEL = 10;
                        const BASE_PADDING = 2; // vw always present
                        const STORAGE_KEY = 'ujuzi_zoom_global';
                        const pctDisplay = document.getElementById('zoom-pct');

                        const updatePct = () => {
                            const effective = 100 - 2 * (BASE_PADDING + paddingLevel * STEP);
                            const base = 100 - 2 * BASE_PADDING;
                            pctDisplay.textContent = Math.round(effective / base * 100) + '%';
                        };

                        const applyPadding = () => {
                            iframeContainer.style.paddingLeft  = `${BASE_PADDING + paddingLevel * STEP}vw`;
                            iframeContainer.style.paddingRight = `${BASE_PADDING + paddingLevel * STEP}vw`;
                            updatePct();
                        };

                        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
                        if (saved !== null) paddingLevel = parseInt(saved, 10);
                        applyPadding();

                        // Zoom dropdown toggle
                        const zoomToggleBtn = document.getElementById('zoom-toggle-btn');
                        const zoomDropdown = document.getElementById('zoom-dropdown');
                        let zoomOpen = false;
                        const openZoom = () => {
                            zoomOpen = true;
                            zoomDropdown.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-x-2', 'pointer-events-none');
                            zoomDropdown.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-x-0', 'pointer-events-auto');
                        };
                        const closeZoom = () => {
                            zoomOpen = false;
                            zoomDropdown.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-x-0', 'pointer-events-auto');
                            zoomDropdown.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-x-2', 'pointer-events-none');
                        };
                        zoomToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            zoomOpen ? closeZoom() : openZoom();
                        });
                        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                            if (!document.getElementById('zoom-menu-container').contains(e.target)) {
                                closeZoom();
                            }
                        });

                        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            if (paddingLevel < MAX_LEVEL) { paddingLevel++; applyPadding(); localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, paddingLevel); }
                        });
                        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            if (paddingLevel > 0) { paddingLevel--; applyPadding(); localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, paddingLevel); }
                        });
                    });
                </script>
				<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/dashboard_slideover.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
			</div>
			}
			<div id="iframe-container" class={ iframeContainerClass(d.Embedded) }>
				switch d.Report.Type {
					case reporting.TypeLooker:
						<iframe
							id="report-iframe"
							class="w-full h-full"
							src={ addParamsToReportLink(d.Report, d.Country, d.CC, r, d.U) }
							frameborder="0"
						></iframe>
					case "HEX":
						<iframe
							id="report-iframe"
							class="w-full lg:w-[75%] h-full"
							src={ d.Report.Link }
							frameborder="0"
						></iframe>
					default:
						<div>Nothing to show</div>
				}
			</div>
		}
		<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/checkbox_dropdown.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
		<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/archive_to_sheets.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
	}
}
```

## File: modules\base\targets.go
```go
package base

import (
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
)

type targetsPageData struct {
	r                 *http.Request
	u                 auth.User
	cc                string
	userCountries     []country.Country
	embedded          bool
	Cycles            []string
	Types             []string
	Branches          []string
	Countries         []country.Country
	SelectedCycle     string
	SelectedType      string
	SelectedBranch    string
	Overrides         []bq.TargetOverride
	ApprovalGroups    []bq.TargetApprovalItem
	ApprovedOverrides []bq.TargetOverride
	AllApproved       bool
}

func (m module) targetsLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !u.IsTarget {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	filterValues, err := m.bq.GetTargetFilterValues(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR fetching target filter values: %v", err)
		return err
	}

	countryMap := make(map[string]country.Country)
	cycleSet := make(map[string]struct{})
	typeSet := make(map[string]struct{})
	branchSet := make(map[string]struct{})

	for _, v := range filterValues {
		for _, knownCountry := range country.List {
			if strings.EqualFold(knownCountry.Name, v.Country) {
				countryMap[knownCountry.Code] = knownCountry
				break
			}
		}
		if v.Cycle != "" {
			cycleSet[v.Cycle] = struct{}{}
		}
		if v.Type != "" {
			typeSet[v.Type] = struct{}{}
		}
		if v.Branch != "" {
			branchSet[v.Branch] = struct{}{}
		}
	}

	countriesDropdownData := make([]country.Country, 0, len(countryMap))
	for _, country := range countryMap {
		countriesDropdownData = append(countriesDropdownData, country)
	}
	sort.Slice(countriesDropdownData, func(i, j int) bool {
		return countriesDropdownData[i].Name < countriesDropdownData[j].Name
	})

	cyclesForFilter := make([]string, 0, len(cycleSet))
	for cycle := range cycleSet {
		cyclesForFilter = append(cyclesForFilter, cycle)
	}
	sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.StringSlice(cyclesForFilter)))

	typesForFilter := make([]string, 0, len(typeSet))
	for t := range typeSet {
		typesForFilter = append(typesForFilter, t)
	}
	sort.Strings(typesForFilter)

	branchesForFilter := make([]string, 0, len(branchSet))
	for branch := range branchSet {
		branchesForFilter = append(branchesForFilter, branch)
	}
	sort.Strings(branchesForFilter)

	overrides, err := m.bq.GetTargetOverrides(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR fetching target overrides: %v", err)
		overrides = []bq.TargetOverride{}
	}

	approvedOverrides, err := m.bq.GetApprovedOverrides(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR fetching approved overrides: %v", err)
		approvedOverrides = []bq.TargetOverride{}
	}

	approvalGroups, err := m.bq.GetApprovalGroups(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR fetching approval groups: %v", err)
		approvalGroups = []bq.TargetApprovalItem{}
	}

	selectedCycle := r.FormValue("cycle")
	if selectedCycle == "" && len(cyclesForFilter) > 0 {
		selectedCycle = cyclesForFilter[0]
	}
	selectedType := r.FormValue("type")
	selectedBranch := r.FormValue("branch")
	selectedCountry := r.FormValue("cc")
	if selectedCountry == "" {
		selectedCountry = c.Code
	}

	var filteredOverrides []bq.TargetOverride
	for _, override := range overrides {
		var overrideCountryCode string
		for _, knownCountry := range country.List {
			if strings.EqualFold(knownCountry.Name, override.Country) {
				overrideCountryCode = knownCountry.Code
				break
			}
		}

		countryMatch := (selectedCountry == "" || strings.EqualFold(overrideCountryCode, selectedCountry))
		cycleMatch := (selectedCycle == "" || override.Cycle == selectedCycle)
		typeMatch := (selectedType == "" || override.Type == selectedType)
		branchMatch := (selectedBranch == "" || override.Branch == selectedBranch)

		if countryMatch && cycleMatch && typeMatch && branchMatch {
			filteredOverrides = append(filteredOverrides, override)
		}
	}

	var filteredApprovedOverrides []bq.TargetOverride
	for _, override := range approvedOverrides {
		var overrideCountryCode string
		for _, knownCountry := range country.List {
			if strings.EqualFold(knownCountry.Name, override.Country) {
				overrideCountryCode = knownCountry.Code
				break
			}
		}

		countryMatch := (selectedCountry == "" || strings.EqualFold(overrideCountryCode, selectedCountry))
		cycleMatch := (selectedCycle == "" || override.Cycle == selectedCycle)
		typeMatch := (selectedType == "" || override.Type == selectedType)
		branchMatch := (selectedBranch == "" || override.Branch == selectedBranch)

		if countryMatch && cycleMatch && typeMatch && branchMatch {
			filteredApprovedOverrides = append(filteredApprovedOverrides, override)
		}
	}

	var filteredApprovals []bq.TargetApprovalItem
	for _, approval := range approvalGroups {
		var approvalCountryCode string
		var found bool
		for _, knownCountry := range country.List {
			if strings.EqualFold(knownCountry.Code, approval.Country) || strings.EqualFold(knownCountry.Name, approval.Country) {
				approvalCountryCode = knownCountry.Code
				found = true
				break
			}
		}

		if !found {
			continue
		}

		countryMatch := (selectedCountry == "" || strings.EqualFold(approvalCountryCode, selectedCountry))
		cycleMatch := (selectedCycle == "" || approval.Cycle == selectedCycle)
		typeMatch := (selectedType == "" || approval.Type == selectedType)

		if countryMatch && cycleMatch && typeMatch {
			filteredApprovals = append(filteredApprovals, approval)
		}
	}

	allApproved := true
	if len(filteredApprovals) > 0 {
		for _, approval := range filteredApprovals {
			if !approval.Approved {
				allApproved = false
				break
			}
		}
	}

	data := targetsPageData{
		r:                 r,
		u:                 u,
		cc:                c.Code,
		userCountries:     userCountries,
		embedded:          uj.IsEmbedded(r),
		Countries:         countriesDropdownData,
		Cycles:            cyclesForFilter,
		Types:             typesForFilter,
		Branches:          branchesForFilter,
		SelectedCycle:     selectedCycle,
		SelectedType:      selectedType,
		SelectedBranch:    selectedBranch,
		Overrides:         filteredOverrides,
		ApprovalGroups:    filteredApprovals,
		ApprovedOverrides: filteredApprovedOverrides,
		AllApproved:       allApproved,
	}

	return targetsPage(data).Render(ctx, w)
}
```

```templ
func countryOptions(countries []country.Country) []cmp.SelectOption {
	opts := make([]cmp.SelectOption, len(countries))
	for i, c := range countries {
		opts[i] = cmp.SelectOption{Label: c.Name, Value: c.Code}
	}
	return opts
}

func stringToOptions(items []string) []cmp.SelectOption {
	opts := make([]cmp.SelectOption, len(items))
	for i, item := range items {
		opts[i] = cmp.SelectOption{Label: item, Value: item}
	}
	return opts
}
```

```templ
package base

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
)

// Tool entries live in the dashboardConfig Firestore collection and are
// exposed through DashboardConfigCache.Tools(). Both this standalone /tools
// page and the View More overlay render from the same data.

type toolsIndexData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	u             auth.User
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	tools         []DashboardConfigEntry
}

func (m module) toolsIndexLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if r.URL.Path != "/tools" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Not Found")
	}
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	// Allowlist-driven: if u isn't in any tool's AllowedEmails, bounce them
	// home rather than rendering an empty grid. See accessibleTools in
	// dashboard_config.go for the matching rule (case-insensitive email).
	tools := accessibleTools(u, m.dashboardConfigCache.Tools())
	if len(tools) == 0 {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
		return nil
	}

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)
	return toolsIndex(toolsIndexData{
		r:             r,
		u:             u,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		tools:         tools,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

templ toolsIndex(d toolsIndexData) {
	@layout.Html("Tools") {
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
			<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
					<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
				</a>
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150" title="Back to Home">
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg">Tools</span>
			</div>
			@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
		</div>
		<!-- The loader redirects users with zero accessible tools to /, so
		     d.tools is guaranteed non-empty here. -->
		<div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 mt-12 mb-20">
			<div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-10 md:gap-16 justify-items-center">
				for _, t := range d.tools {
					@toolCircle(d, t)
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

templ toolCircle(d toolsIndexData, t DashboardConfigEntry) {
	<a
		href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, t.URL) }
		class="group relative w-32 h-32 md:w-40 md:h-40 bg-gradient-to-tr from-green-x-dark to-green-x-light rounded-full shadow-2xl shadow-black/90 flex items-center justify-center text-center p-3 cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-black/60 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-x-light"
		title={ t.Description }
	>
		<span class="text-sm md:text-base font-semibold text-white pointer-events-none">{ t.Label }</span>
		<span class="pointer-events-none absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2 w-56 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity bg-black/80 text-white text-xs rounded-md px-2 py-1 z-20">
			{ t.Description }
		</span>
	</a>
}
```

## File: modules\tools\tools.go
```go
// Package tools is a thin orchestrator. The work for each tool lives in a
// subpackage:
//
//   - modules/tools/campaigns
//   - modules/tools/commonterms
//   - modules/tools/creditpolicy
//   - modules/tools/dashboardconfig
//
// This file owns nothing apart from the wiring that fans `InitModule` out to
// each subpackage and a type re-export that keeps the `app/main.go` call site
// readable.
package tools

import (
	"log"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/core/country"

	"ujuzi/modules/base"
	"ujuzi/modules/tools/campaigns"
	"ujuzi/modules/tools/commonterms"
	"ujuzi/modules/tools/creditpolicy"
	"ujuzi/modules/tools/dashboardconfig"
	"ujuzi/modules/tools/datadictionary"
)

// PublishConfig is re-exported from creditpolicy so app/main.go can construct
// it without importing the subpackage directly.
type PublishConfig = creditpolicy.PublishConfig

// InitModule wires every tool the app exposes. It is the single call site
// from app/main.go; this function fans out into each subpackage's own
// InitModule with only the deps that subpackage cares about.
func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	fsDb *firestore.Client,
	dashboardConfigCache *base.DashboardConfigCache,
	approversCSV string,
	autoApproversCSV string,
	quorum int,
	bqService *bq.Service,
	bqPending bq.CreditPolicyPendingTable,
	publishCfg PublishConfig,
) {
	campaigns.InitModule(l, app, sessionStore, dbs, bqService)
	commonterms.InitModule(l, app, sessionStore, dbs, bqService)
	creditpolicy.InitModule(l, app, sessionStore, dbs, approversCSV, autoApproversCSV, quorum, bqService, bqPending, publishCfg)
	dashboardconfig.InitModule(l, app, sessionStore, dbs, fsDb, dashboardConfigCache)
	datadictionary.InitModule(l, app, sessionStore, dbs, bqService)
}
```

```go
package campaigns

import (

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/mid"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/x/randx"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
```
