```go
)

// =============================================
// MODULE

// module holds the per-process state for the campaigns tool. Created by
// InitModule; handlers receive *module via method receivers.
type module struct {
	l   *log.Logger
	dbs *country.DBs
	bq  *bqpkg.Service
}

// InitModule registers all campaign routes with the supplied app.
func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	bqService *bqpkg.Service,
) {
	m := &module{l: l, dbs: dbs, bq: bqService}

	std := stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/campaigns", m.campaignListLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/campaigns/new", m.campaignNewLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/campaigns/check-name", m.campaignCheckNameHandler, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/campaigns", m.campaignCreateAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/campaigns/{id}", m.campaignDetailLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/campaigns/{id}/messages/new", m.messageNewLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/campaigns/{id}/messages", m.messageCreateAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/campaigns/{id}/messages/{msgid}", m.messageDetailLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/campaigns/{id}/messages/{msgid}/debtors", m.debtorUploadAction, std...)
}

// stdMid is the standard middleware stack used by every campaigns route.
// Duplicated per subpackage rather than imported from a parent — that
// would create a circular import.
func stdMid(l *log.Logger, additionalMid ...web.Middleware) []web.Middleware {
	m := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	}
	return append(m, additionalMid...)
}

// =============================================
// DATA TYPES (display layer)

type Campaign struct {
	ID                 string
	Country            string
	Name               string
	SuccessEventType   string
	CampaignType       string
	TargetSegment      string
	Channel            string
	StartDate          string
	EndDate            string
	CampaignDays       int
	HasControlGroup    bool
	Control            float64
	ControlGroupMethod string
	ApprovedBy         string
	AuditNotes         string
	CreatedBy          string
	CreatedAt          string
}

type Message struct {
	ID             string
	CampaignID     string
	VariantLabel   string
	Detail         string
	MessageContent string
	SequenceOrder  int
	DebtorCount    int
}

type DebtorRow struct {
	DebtorID       string
	DeliveryStatus string
}

// =============================================
// HELPERS

func campaignFromBQ(c bqpkg.BQCampaign) Campaign {
	out := Campaign{
		ID:           c.CampaignID,
		Country:      c.Country.StringVal,
		Name:         c.CampaignName,
		CampaignDays: 35,
	}
	if c.SuccessEventType.Valid {
		out.SuccessEventType = c.SuccessEventType.StringVal
	}
	if c.CampaignType.Valid {
		out.CampaignType = c.CampaignType.StringVal
	}
	if c.TargetSegment.Valid {
		out.TargetSegment = c.TargetSegment.StringVal
	}
	if c.CampaignChannel.Valid {
		out.Channel = c.CampaignChannel.StringVal
	}
	if c.StartDate.Valid {
		out.StartDate = c.StartDate.Date.String()
	}
	if c.EndDate.Valid {
		out.EndDate = c.EndDate.Date.String()
	}
	if c.CampaignDays.Valid {
		out.CampaignDays = int(c.CampaignDays.Int64)
	}
	if c.Control.Valid && c.Control.Float64 > 0 {
		out.HasControlGroup = true
		out.Control = c.Control.Float64
	}
	if c.ControlGroupMethod.Valid {
		out.ControlGroupMethod = c.ControlGroupMethod.StringVal
	}
	if c.ApprovedBy.Valid {
		out.ApprovedBy = c.ApprovedBy.StringVal
	}
	if c.AuditNotes.Valid {
		out.AuditNotes = c.AuditNotes.StringVal
	}
	if c.CreatedBy.Valid {
		out.CreatedBy = c.CreatedBy.StringVal
	}
	if c.CreatedAt.Valid {
		out.CreatedAt = c.CreatedAt.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02")
	}
	return out
}

func messageFromBQ(m bqpkg.BQCampaignMessage, debtorCount int) Message {
	out := Message{
		ID:            m.MessageID,
		CampaignID:    m.CampaignID,
		VariantLabel:  m.VariantLabel,
		SequenceOrder: 1,
		DebtorCount:   debtorCount,
	}
	if m.Detail.Valid {
		out.Detail = m.Detail.StringVal
	}
	if m.MessageContent.Valid {
		out.MessageContent = m.MessageContent.StringVal
	}
	if m.SequenceOrder.Valid {
		out.SequenceOrder = int(m.SequenceOrder.Int64)
	}
	return out
}

func parseDate(s string) (civil.Date, bool) {
	t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s)
	if err != nil {
		return civil.Date{}, false
	}
	return civil.DateOf(t), true
}

func ccURL(r *http.Request, path string) string {
	cc := r.URL.Query().Get("cc")
	if cc == "" {
		return path
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s?cc=%s", path, cc)
}

func (m *module) campaignListLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	bqCampaigns, err := m.bq.GetCampaigns(ctx, c.Name)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading campaigns: %v", err)
		bqCampaigns = nil
	}

	campaigns := make([]Campaign, 0, len(bqCampaigns))
	for _, bc := range bqCampaigns {
		campaigns = append(campaigns, campaignFromBQ(bc))
	}

	return campaignListPage(campaignListData{
		r:             r,
		u:             u,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		Campaigns:     campaigns,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) campaignCheckNameHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	name := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("name"))
	if name == "" {
		return web.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"available": true})
	}
	exists, err := m.bq.CampaignNameExists(ctx, name)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR checking campaign name: %v", err)
		return web.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"available": true})
	}
	return web.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"available": !exists})
}

func (m *module) campaignCreateAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	now := time.Now()

	campaignName := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("campaign_name"))
	if campaignName == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Campaign name is required")
	}

	exists, err := m.bq.CampaignNameExists(ctx, campaignName)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR checking campaign name uniqueness: %v", err)
	} else if exists {
		userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)
		return campaignNewPage(campaignNewData{
			r:             r,
			u:             u,
			cc:            c.Code,
			userCountries: userCountries,
			CountryName:   c.Name,
			Today:         time.Now().Format("2006-01-02"),
			Error:         fmt.Sprintf("A campaign named %q already exists.", campaignName),
		}).Render(ctx, w)
	}

	successEventType := r.FormValue("success_event_type")
	if successEventType == "custom" {
		successEventType = strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("success_event_type_custom"))
	}

	campaignType := r.FormValue("campaign_type")
	if campaignType == "custom" {
		campaignType = strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("campaign_type_custom"))
	}

	targetSegment := r.FormValue("target_segment")
	if targetSegment == "custom" {
		targetSegment = strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("target_segment_custom"))
	}

	campaignChannel := r.FormValue("campaign_channel")
	startDateStr := r.FormValue("start_date")
	auditNotes := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("audit_notes"))

	startDate, startOK := parseDate(startDateStr)
	var endDate civil.Date
	if startOK {
		st := time.Date(startDate.Year, startDate.Month, startDate.Day, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
		endDate = civil.DateOf(st.AddDate(0, 0, 35))
	}

	seq, seqErr := m.bq.GetNextCampaignSequence(ctx, c.Name, strings.ToUpper(c.Code), successEventType, campaignType)
	if seqErr != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR getting campaign sequence: %v", seqErr)
		seq = 1
	}
	campaignID := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s%03d", strings.ToUpper(c.Code), time.Now().Format("2006-01-02"), seq)

	bqC := bqpkg.BQCampaign{
		CampaignID:         campaignID,
		CampaignName:       campaignName,
		Country:            bigquery.NullString{StringVal: c.Name, Valid: true},
		SuccessEventType:   bigquery.NullString{StringVal: successEventType, Valid: successEventType != ""},
		CampaignType:       bigquery.NullString{StringVal: campaignType, Valid: campaignType != ""},
		TargetSegment:      bigquery.NullString{StringVal: targetSegment, Valid: targetSegment != ""},
		CampaignChannel:    bigquery.NullString{StringVal: campaignChannel, Valid: campaignChannel != ""},
		CampaignDays:       bigquery.NullInt64{Int64: 35, Valid: true},
		Control:            bigquery.NullFloat64{Float64: 0.15, Valid: true},
		ControlGroupMethod: bigquery.NullString{StringVal: "RANDOM", Valid: true},
		ApprovedBy:         bigquery.NullString{StringVal: u.Email, Valid: true},
		ApprovedAt:         bigquery.NullTimestamp{Timestamp: now, Valid: true},
		AuditNotes:         bigquery.NullString{StringVal: auditNotes, Valid: auditNotes != ""},
		CreatedBy:          bigquery.NullString{StringVal: u.Email, Valid: true},
		CreatedAt:          bigquery.NullTimestamp{Timestamp: now, Valid: true},
	}
	if startOK {
		bqC.StartDate = bigquery.NullDate{Date: startDate, Valid: true}
		bqC.EndDate = bigquery.NullDate{Date: endDate, Valid: true}
	}

	if err := m.bq.InsertCampaign(ctx, bqC); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create campaign: %w", err)
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, ccURL(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s", campaignID)))
	return nil
}

func (m *module) campaignDetailLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	id := r.PathValue("id")
	bqC, err := m.bq.GetCampaign(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load campaign: %w", err)
	}
	if bqC == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Campaign not found")
	}

	bqMsgs, err := m.bq.GetCampaignMessages(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading campaign messages: %v", err)
		bqMsgs = nil
	}

	counts, err := m.bq.GetMessageDebtorCounts(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading debtor counts: %v", err)
		counts = map[string]int{}
	}

	messages := make([]Message, 0, len(bqMsgs))
	for _, bm := range bqMsgs {
		messages = append(messages, messageFromBQ(bm, counts[bm.MessageID]))
	}

	campaign := campaignFromBQ(*bqC)
	return campaignDetailPage(campaignDetailData{
		r:             r,
		u:             u,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		Campaign:      campaign,
		Messages:      messages,
		CanAddMessage: true,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) messageCreateAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	campaignID := r.PathValue("id")

	bqC, err := m.bq.GetCampaign(ctx, campaignID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load campaign: %w", err)
	}
	if bqC == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Campaign not found")
	}
	variantLabel := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("variant_label"))
	if variantLabel == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Variant label is required")
	}

	detail := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("detail"))
	messageContent := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("message_content"))

	messageID := randx.UID()

	msg := bqpkg.BQCampaignMessage{
		MessageID:      messageID,
		CampaignID:     campaignID,
		VariantLabel:   variantLabel,
		Detail:         bigquery.NullString{StringVal: detail, Valid: detail != ""},
		MessageContent: bigquery.NullString{StringVal: messageContent, Valid: messageContent != ""},
		SequenceOrder:  bigquery.NullInt64{Int64: 1, Valid: true},
	}

	if err := m.bq.InsertCampaignMessage(ctx, msg); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create message: %w", err)
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, ccURL(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages/%s", campaignID, messageID)))
	return nil
}

func (m *module) messageDetailLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	campaignID := r.PathValue("id")
	msgID := r.PathValue("msgid")
	return m.renderMessageDetail(w, r, campaignID, msgID, "", nil)
}

// renderMessageDetail loads all message detail data and renders the page.
// uploadError and failedDebtors are non-empty only when an upload has failed.
func (m *module) renderMessageDetail(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, campaignID, msgID, uploadError string, failedDebtors []string) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	bqC, err := m.bq.GetCampaign(ctx, campaignID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load campaign: %w", err)
	}
	if bqC == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Campaign not found")
	}

	bqMsg, err := m.bq.GetCampaignMessage(ctx, msgID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load message: %w", err)
	}
	if bqMsg == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Message not found")
	}

	total, err := m.bq.CountCampaignDetails(ctx, msgID)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR counting campaign details: %v", err)
	}

	debtorQuery := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("debtor"))
	var debtorResult *DebtorRow
	var debtorSearched bool
	if debtorQuery != "" {
		debtorSearched = true
		found, serr := m.bq.SearchCampaignDetail(ctx, msgID, debtorQuery)
		if serr != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR searching campaign detail: %v", serr)
		} else if found != nil {
			row := &DebtorRow{DebtorID: found.DebtorID}
			if found.DeliveryStatus.Valid {
				row.DeliveryStatus = found.DeliveryStatus.StringVal
			}
			debtorResult = row
		}
	}

	return messageDetailPage(messageDetailData{
		r:              r,
		u:              u,
		cc:             c.Code,
		userCountries:  userCountries,
		Campaign:       campaignFromBQ(*bqC),
		Message:        messageFromBQ(*bqMsg, total),
		DebtorQuery:    debtorQuery,
		DebtorResult:   debtorResult,
		DebtorSearched: debtorSearched,
		UploadError:    uploadError,
		FailedDebtors:  failedDebtors,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — DEBTOR UPLOAD

func (m *module) debtorUploadAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	campaignID := r.PathValue("id")
	msgID := r.PathValue("msgid")

	bqC, err := m.bq.GetCampaign(ctx, campaignID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load campaign: %w", err)
	}
	if bqC == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Campaign not found")
	}

	var sendTime time.Time
	if bqC.StartDate.Valid {
		d := bqC.StartDate.Date
		sendTime = time.Date(d.Year, d.Month, d.Day, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	} else {
		sendTime = time.Now()
	}

	var debtorIDs []string

	if err := r.ParseMultipartForm(32 << 20); err == nil {
		if file, _, ferr := r.FormFile("debtor_file"); ferr == nil {
			defer file.Close()
			ids, csvErr := parseDebtorCSV(file)
			if csvErr != nil {
				return m.renderMessageDetail(w, r, campaignID, msgID, csvErr.Error(), nil)
			}
			debtorIDs = ids
		}
	}

	if len(debtorIDs) == 0 {
		uj.Redirect(w, r, ccURL(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages/%s", campaignID, msgID)))
		return nil
	}

	// Check for debtors already in this campaign (any message)
	existing, err := m.bq.GetExistingDebtorsInCampaign(ctx, campaignID, debtorIDs)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR checking existing debtors: %v", err)
	} else if len(existing) > 0 {
		errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("%d debtor(s) already exist in this campaign and were not uploaded. Fix the list and try again.", len(existing))
		return m.renderMessageDetail(w, r, campaignID, msgID, errMsg, existing)
	}

	details := make([]bqpkg.BQCampaignDetail, 0, len(debtorIDs))
	for _, did := range debtorIDs {
		details = append(details, bqpkg.BQCampaignDetail{
			SendID:         randx.UID(),
			DebtorID:       did,
			CampaignID:     campaignID,
			MessageID:      msgID,
			SendTimestamp:  bigquery.NullTimestamp{Timestamp: sendTime, Valid: true},
			DeliveryStatus: bigquery.NullString{StringVal: "sent", Valid: true},
			SuccessFlag:    0,
		})
	}

	if err := m.bq.InsertCampaignDetails(ctx, details); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert debtors: %w", err)
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, ccURL(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages/%s", campaignID, msgID)))
	return nil
}

// parseDebtorCSV reads debtor IDs from a CSV file.
// The first row must have "debtor_id" as the first column header (case-insensitive).
// Returns an error if the header is missing or wrong.
func parseDebtorCSV(r io.Reader) ([]string, error) {
	reader := csv.NewReader(r)
	var ids []string
	first := true
	for {
		record, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
		if first {
			first = false
			if len(record) == 0 || !strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(record[0]), "debtor_id") {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid CSV: first column header must be \"debtor_id\", got %q", record[0])
			}
			continue
		}
		if len(record) > 0 && record[0] != "" {
			ids = append(ids, strings.TrimSpace(record[0]))
		}
	}
	return ids, nil
}
```

```templ
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden">

					<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">All Campaigns</h2>
					<a
						href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/campaigns/new") }
						class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"

						+ Create Campaign

					</div>
				} else {
					<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
						<thead class="bg-gray-50">
							<tr>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Campaign Name</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Type</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Channel</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Start Date</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">End Date</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4"></th>
							</tr>
						</thead>
						<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
							for _, c := range d.Campaigns {
								<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors group">
									<td class="px-6 py-4">
										<p class="font-semibold text-gray-900">{ c.Name }</p>
										<p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">{ c.SuccessEventType }</p>
									</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600">{ c.CampaignType }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600">{ c.Channel }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 whitespace-nowrap">{ c.StartDate }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 whitespace-nowrap">{ c.EndDate }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4 text-right">
										<a
											href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s", c.ID)) }
											class="text-sm font-medium text-green-x-dark hover:text-green-x-light transition-colors"
										>
											View →
										</a>
									</td>
								</tr>
							}
						</tbody>
					</table>
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

// =============================================
// CAMPAIGN NEW PAGE

templ campaignNewPage(d campaignNewData) {
	@layout.Html("New Campaign") {
		<!-- Page header -->
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
			<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
					<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
				</a>
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/campaigns") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150" title="Back to Campaigns">
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg">Create Campaign</span>
			</div>
			@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
		</div>
		<!-- Form -->
		<div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 mt-6 mb-20">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				<form method="POST" action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/campaigns") } class="space-y-6">
					if d.Error != "" {
						<div class="rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{ d.Error }</div>
					}
					<!-- Country (read-only) -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Country</label>
						<input
							type="text"
							value={ d.CountryName }
							readonly
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"
						/>
					</div>
					<!-- Campaign Name -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Campaign Name <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
						<input
							type="text"
							name="campaign_name"
							id="campaign_name"
							required
							placeholder="e.g. Q1 Debt Recovery"
							onblur="checkCampaignName(this.value)"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						/>
						<p id="campaign_name_error" class="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600 hidden"></p>
					</div>
					<!-- Success Metric -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Success Metric</label>
						<select
							name="success_event_type"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						>
							<option value="">Select</option>
							<option value="REFERAL">REFERAL</option>
							<option value="CREDIT_UTILIZED">CREDIT_UTILIZED</option>
						</select>
					</div>
					<!-- Campaign Type -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Campaign Type</label>
						<select
							name="campaign_type"
							id="campaign_type_select"
							onchange="toggleCustom('campaign_type')"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						>
							<option value="">Select</option>
							<option value="UPSELL">UPSELL</option>
							<option value="ACQUISITION">ACQUISITION</option>
							<option value="custom">Custom…</option>
						</select>
						<div id="campaign_type_custom_wrap" style="display:none" class="mt-2">
							<input type="text" name="campaign_type_custom" placeholder="Enter campaign type"
								class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
					</div>
					<!-- Target Segment -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Target Segment</label>
						<select
							name="target_segment"
							id="target_segment_select"
							onchange="toggleCustom('target_segment')"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						>
							<option value="">Select</option>
							<option value="ALL_ACTIVE">ALL_ACTIVE</option>
							<option value="custom">Custom…</option>
						</select>
						<div id="target_segment_custom_wrap" style="display:none" class="mt-2">
							<input type="text" name="target_segment_custom" placeholder="Enter segment name"
								class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
					</div>
					<!-- Campaign Channel -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Campaign Channel</label>
						<select
							name="campaign_channel"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						>
							<option value="">Select</option>
							<option value="SMS">SMS</option>
							<option value="EMAIL">EMAIL</option>
						</select>
					</div>
					<!-- Dates -->
					<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Start Date</label>
							<input
								type="date"
								name="start_date"
								id="start_date"
								oninput="updateEndDate()"
								class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
							/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">End Date</label>
							<input
								type="date"
								name="end_date"
								id="end_date"
								readonly
								class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"
							/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Campaign Days</label>
							<input type="text" value="35" readonly class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"/>
						</div>
					</div>
					<!-- Notes -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Notes</label>
						<textarea
							name="audit_notes"
							rows="3"
							placeholder="What is the aim of this campaign…"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark resize-none"
						></textarea>
					</div>
					<!-- Created By (read-only) -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Created By</label>
						<input type="text" value={ d.u.Email } readonly class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"/>
					</div>
					<!-- Submit -->
					<div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
						<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/campaigns") } class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">Cancel</a>
						<button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">Create Campaign</button>
					</div>
				</form>
			</div>
		</div>
		<script>
			function toggleCustom(field) {
				const val = document.getElementById(field + '_select').value;
				document.getElementById(field + '_custom_wrap').style.display = val === 'custom' ? 'block' : 'none';
			}
			function updateEndDate() {
				const start = document.getElementById('start_date').value;
				if (!start) return;
				const d = new Date(start + 'T00:00:00');
				d.setDate(d.getDate() + 35);
				document.getElementById('end_date').value = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
			}
			async function checkCampaignName(name) {
				const errEl = document.getElementById('campaign_name_error');
				if (!name.trim()) { errEl.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
				try {
					const params = new URLSearchParams({ name });
					const res = await fetch('/tools/campaigns/check-name?' + params);
					const data = await res.json();
					if (!data.available) {
						errEl.textContent = 'A campaign with this name already exists.';
						errEl.classList.remove('hidden');
					} else {
						errEl.classList.add('hidden');
					}
				} catch (_) {}
			}
		</script>
	}
}

// =============================================
// CAMPAIGN DETAIL PAGE

templ campaignDetailPage(d campaignDetailData) {
	@layout.Html(d.Campaign.Name) {
		<!-- Page header -->
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
			<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
					<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
				</a>
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/campaigns") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150" title="Back to Campaigns">
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg after:content-['|'] after:pl-3 after:font-extralight">{ d.Campaign.Name }</span>
				<span class="text-white text-lg">{ d.Campaign.CampaignType } · { d.Campaign.Channel }</span>
			</div>
			@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
		</div>
		<!-- Content -->
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 mt-6 mb-20 space-y-6">
			<!-- Campaign info card -->
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Campaign Details</h2>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
					<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
						<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Start Date</p>
						<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ d.Campaign.StartDate }</p>
					</div>
					<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
						<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">End Date</p>
						<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ d.Campaign.EndDate }</p>
					</div>
					<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
						<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Success Metric</p>
						<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ d.Campaign.SuccessEventType }</p>
					</div>
					<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
						<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Target Segment</p>
						<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ d.Campaign.TargetSegment }</p>
					</div>
					if d.Campaign.HasControlGroup {
						<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
							<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Control Size</p>
							<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ fmt.Sprintf("%.0f%%", d.Campaign.Control*100) }</p>
						</div>
						<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
							<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Control Method</p>
							<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ d.Campaign.ControlGroupMethod }</p>
						</div>
					}
					if d.Campaign.AuditNotes != "" {
						<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4 col-span-2 md:col-span-4">
							<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Notes</p>
							<p class="text-sm text-gray-700">{ d.Campaign.AuditNotes }</p>
						</div>
					}
				</div>
				<p class="mt-4 text-xs text-gray-400">Created by { d.Campaign.CreatedBy } on { d.Campaign.CreatedAt }</p>
			</div>
			<!-- Messages table -->
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden">
				<div class="px-6 py-5 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
					<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Messages</h2>
					if d.CanAddMessage {
						<a
							href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages/new", d.Campaign.ID)) }
							class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
						>
							+ Add Message
						</a>
					} else {
						<span class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-200 text-gray-400 text-sm font-medium cursor-not-allowed" title="Campaign has already started">
							+ Add Message
						</span>
					}
				</div>
				if len(d.Messages) == 0 {
					<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-16">
						<p class="text-gray-400">No messages yet. Add the first one!</p>
					</div>
				} else {
					<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
						<thead class="bg-gray-50">
							<tr>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Variant</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Detail</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Debtors</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-4"></th>
							</tr>
						</thead>
						<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
							for _, msg := range d.Messages {
								<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
									<td class="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-gray-900 whitespace-nowrap">{ msg.VariantLabel }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 max-w-xs">
										<p class="line-clamp-2">{ msg.Detail }</p>
									</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4">
										<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
											{ fmt.Sprintf("%s debtors", formatCount(msg.DebtorCount)) }
										</span>
									</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-4 text-right">
										<a
											href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages/%s", d.Campaign.ID, msg.ID)) }
											class="text-sm font-medium text-green-x-dark hover:text-green-x-light transition-colors"
										>
											View →
										</a>
									</td>
								</tr>
							}
						</tbody>
					</table>
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

// MESSAGE NEW PAGE

templ messageNewPage(d messageNewData) {
	@layout.Html("New Message") {
		<!-- Page header -->
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
			<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
					<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
				</a>
				<a
					href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s", d.Campaign.ID)) }
					class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150"
					title={ "Back to " + d.Campaign.Name }
				>
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg after:content-['|'] after:pl-3 after:font-extralight">Add Message</span>
				<span class="text-white text-lg">{ d.Campaign.Name }</span>
			</div>
			@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
		</div>
		<!-- Form -->
		<div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 mt-6 mb-20">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				<form
					method="POST"
					action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages", d.Campaign.ID)) }
					class="space-y-6"
				>
					<!-- Variant -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Test Group <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
						<select
							name="variant_label"
							required
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						>
							<option value="">Select</option>
							<option value="CONTROL">CONTROL</option>
							<option value="ACTIVE">ACTIVE</option>
						</select>
					</div>
					<!-- List Name -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">List Name</label>
						<input
							type="text"
							name="detail"
							placeholder="Name for the debtor list used in this variant"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						/>
					</div>
					<!-- Message Content -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Message Content</label>
						<textarea
							name="message_content"
							rows="5"
							placeholder="Full message text to be sent to debtors…"
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark resize-none"
						></textarea>
					</div>
					<!-- Submit -->
					<div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
						<a
							href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s", d.Campaign.ID)) }
							class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
						>
							Cancel
						</a>
						<button
							type="submit"
							class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
						>
							Add Message
						</button>
					</div>
				</form>
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

templ messageDetailPage(d messageDetailData) {
	@layout.Html(d.Message.VariantLabel) {
		<!-- Page header -->
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
			<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
					<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
				</a>
				<a
					href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s", d.Campaign.ID)) }
					class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150"
					title={ "Back to " + d.Campaign.Name }
				>
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg after:content-['|'] after:pl-3 after:font-extralight">{ d.Message.VariantLabel }</span>
				<span class="text-white text-lg">{ d.Campaign.Name }</span>
			</div>
			@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
		</div>
		<!-- Content -->
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 mt-6 mb-20 space-y-6">
			<!-- Message details card -->
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Message Details</h2>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
					<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
						<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Detail</p>
						<p class="text-sm text-gray-800">{ d.Message.Detail }</p>
					</div>
					<div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light rounded-xl p-4 text-white">
						<p class="text-xs font-medium text-white/70 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Debtors Loaded</p>
						<p class="text-3xl font-extrabold">{ formatCount(d.Message.DebtorCount) }</p>
					</div>
				</div>
				if d.Message.MessageContent != "" {
					<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
						<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Message Content</p>
						<p class="text-sm text-gray-800 whitespace-pre-wrap">{ d.Message.MessageContent }</p>
					</div>
				}
			</div>
			<!-- Upload error card -->
			if d.UploadError != "" {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8 border-l-4 border-red-500">
					<h2 class="text-base font-semibold text-red-700 mb-1">Upload Failed</h2>
					<p class="text-sm text-red-600 mb-3">{ d.UploadError }</p>
					if len(d.FailedDebtors) > 0 {
						<div class="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg bg-red-50 border border-red-200 p-3 space-y-0.5">
							for _, id := range d.FailedDebtors {
								<p class="text-xs font-mono text-red-800">{ id }</p>
							}
						</div>
					}
				</div>
			}
			<!-- Debtor Upload card — hidden once debtors have been loaded -->
			if d.Message.DebtorCount == 0 {
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-1">Upload Debtor List</h2>
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4">
					Upload a CSV file. The file must have <code class="bg-gray-100 px-1 rounded">debtor_id</code> as the header in the first column.
				</p>
				<form
					method="POST"
					action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages/%s/debtors", d.Campaign.ID, d.Message.ID)) }
					enctype="multipart/form-data"
					class="space-y-4"
				>
					<input
						type="file"
						name="debtor_file"
						accept=".csv"
						required
						class="block w-full text-sm text-gray-500 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-medium file:bg-green-x-dark file:text-white hover:file:bg-green-x-light"
					/>
					<div class="flex justify-end">
						<button
							type="submit"
							class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
						>
							Upload
						</button>
					</div>
				</form>
			</div>
			} // end upload card
			<!-- Debtor Search -->
			if d.Message.DebtorCount > 0 {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
					<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Search Debtor</h2>
					<form method="GET" action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/campaigns/%s/messages/%s", d.Campaign.ID, d.Message.ID)) } class="flex gap-3">
						<input
							type="text"
							name="debtor"
							value={ d.DebtorQuery }
							placeholder="Enter debtor ID…"
							class="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						/>
						if d.cc != "" {
							<input type="hidden" name="cc" value={ d.cc }/>
						}
						<button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">Search</button>
					</form>
					if d.DebtorSearched {
						if d.DebtorResult != nil {
							<div class="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-4">
								<p class="text-xs font-medium text-green-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Found</p>
								<div class="flex gap-6 text-sm">
									<div><span class="text-gray-500">Debtor ID: </span><span class="font-mono font-medium text-gray-900">{ d.DebtorResult.DebtorID }</span></div>
									<div><span class="text-gray-500">Status: </span><span class="font-medium text-gray-900">{ d.DebtorResult.DeliveryStatus }</span></div>
								</div>
							</div>
						} else {
							<div class="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4">
								<p class="text-sm text-red-700">Debtor <span class="font-mono font-medium">{ d.DebtorQuery }</span> not found in this message.</p>
							</div>
						}
					}
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	}
}

// =============================================
// HELPERS

func formatCount(n int) string {
	if n >= 1000 {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%d,%03d", n/1000, n%1000)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", n)
}
```

## File: modules\tools\commonterms\commonterms.go
```go
package commonterms

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"html"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/mid"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"
	"github.com/yuin/goldmark"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	bqpkg "ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
	"ujuzi/core/webx"
)

// =============================================
// MODULE

// module holds the per-process state for the common-terms tool. Created
// by InitModule; handlers receive *module via method receivers.
type module struct {
	l   *log.Logger
	dbs *country.DBs
	bq  *bqpkg.Service
}

// InitModule registers common-terms routes with the supplied app.
func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	bqService *bqpkg.Service,
) {
	m := &module{l: l, dbs: dbs, bq: bqService}

	std := stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))

	// NOTE: static paths (new, history, embedded) must be registered before /tools/unifi-words/{id}/edit (dynamic)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/unifi-words", m.commonTermsLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/unifi-words", m.termCreateAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/unifi-words/preview", m.termPreviewAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/unifi-words/new", m.termNewLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/unifi-words/embedded", m.commonTermsEmbeddedLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/unifi-words/history", m.termHistoryLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/unifi-words/{id}/edit", m.termEditLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/unifi-words/{id}", m.termEditAction, std...)
}

// stdMid is the standard middleware stack used by every common-terms route.
// Duplicated per subpackage rather than imported from a parent — that
// would create a circular import.
func stdMid(l *log.Logger, additionalMid ...web.Middleware) []web.Middleware {
	m := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	}
	return append(m, additionalMid...)
}

// =============================================
// CATEGORIES

// categories is the canonical, ordered set of term categories. Each maps to an
// ID prefix that, with a per-category sequence number, forms a stable term ID
// (e.g. "HRI1"). The owners table and the add-term dropdown use these names verbatim.
var categories = []struct {
	Name   string
	Prefix string
}{
	{"Risk & Portfolio", "RP"},
	{"Scoring & Limits", "SL"},
	{"Client Lifecycle", "CL"},
	{"HR & Internal", "HRI"},
	{"Core Systems", "CS"},
	{"Billing & Dates", "BD"},
	{"Loan Origination", "LO"},
	{"Marketing", "M"},
	{"Accounts & Payments", "AP"},
	{"Data & Reporting", "DR"},
}

func prefixFor(category string) string {
	for _, c := range categories {
		if c.Name == category {
			return c.Prefix
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// =============================================
// DATA TYPES

type CommonTerm struct {
	ID          string
	Category    string
	Term        string
	Description string
	Version     int64
	Created     string
	EditedBy    string
	Hidden      bool
}

// =============================================
// PAGE DATA TYPES

type commonTermsData struct {
	r               *http.Request
	u               auth.User
	cc              string
	userCountries   []country.Country
	Categories      []string
	TermsByCategory map[string][]CommonTerm
	CategoryOwners  map[string]string
	OwnedCategories []string // categories the logged-in user owns (for the add form)
	ActiveCat       string   // anchor of the active tab
	EditMode        bool
	EditToggleURL   string
	TermsJSON       string // JSON array for search popup
	CanEdit         bool   // whether the logged-in user may enter edit mode
}

type termNewData struct {
	r               *http.Request
	u               auth.User
	cc              string
	userCountries   []country.Country
	OwnedCategories []string
	BackURL         string
}

type termSearchItem struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Term    string `json:"term"`
	Desc    string `json:"desc"`
	Section string `json:"section"`
}

type termEditData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	u             auth.User
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	Term          CommonTerm
	BackURL       string
}

type termHistoryData struct {
	r             *http.Request
	u             auth.User
	cc            string
	userCountries []country.Country
	TermName      string
	History       []CommonTerm
}

// =============================================
// ACCESS CONTROL

// canEditCategory returns true when the user's email matches the category's owner in BQ.
func canEditCategory(email, categoryOwner string) bool {
	return categoryOwner == email
}

// canEdit returns true when the user owns at least one category in BQ.
func canEdit(email string, categoryOwners map[string]string) bool {
	for _, owner := range categoryOwners {
		if owner == email {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// =============================================
// HELPERS

// renderMarkdown converts markdown to HTML. Falls back to escaped plain text on error.
func renderMarkdown(s string) string {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := goldmark.Convert([]byte(s), &buf); err != nil {
		return html.EscapeString(s)
	}
	return buf.String()
}

// categoryAnchor converts a category name to a URL-safe anchor ID.
func categoryAnchor(cat string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(cat) {
		if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
			b.WriteRune(r)
		} else {
			b.WriteRune('-')
		}
	}
	return b.String()
}

func tabBtnClass(active bool) string {
	base := "px-5 py-2 text-sm max-w-36 truncate shrink-0 rounded-t-lg transition-colors"
	if active {
		return base + " font-semibold bg-gray-200 text-gray-900"
	}
	return base + " bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200 hover:text-gray-800"
}

func tabPanelClass(active bool) string {
	if active {
		return ""
	}
	return "hidden"
}

func commonTermFromBQ(t bqpkg.BQCommonTerm) CommonTerm {
	out := CommonTerm{
		ID:          t.ID,
		Category:    t.Category,
		Term:        t.Term,
		Description: t.Description,
		Version:     t.Version,
		EditedBy:    t.EditedBy,
		Hidden:      t.Hidden,
	}
	if t.Created.Valid {
		out.Created = t.Created.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02")
	}
	return out
}

// ownedCategories returns the canonical categories owned by email, in canonical order.
func ownedCategories(email string, owners map[string]string) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, c := range categories {
		if owners[c.Name] == email {
			out = append(out, c.Name)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — LIST

func (m *module) commonTermsLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	bqTerms, err := m.bq.GetCommonTerms(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading common terms: %v", err)
		bqTerms = nil
	}

	categoryOwners, err := m.bq.GetCategoryOwners(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading category owners: %v", err)
		categoryOwners = map[string]string{}
	}

	allByCategory := make(map[string][]CommonTerm)
	for _, t := range bqTerms {
		allByCategory[t.Category] = append(allByCategory[t.Category], commonTermFromBQ(t))
	}

	allCategories := make([]string, 0, len(allByCategory))
	for cat := range allByCategory {
		allCategories = append(allCategories, cat)
	}
	sort.Strings(allCategories)

	userCanEdit := canEdit(u.Email, categoryOwners)
	editMode := r.URL.Query().Get("edit") == "1" && userCanEdit

	// In edit mode only show categories the user can edit.
	displayCategories := allCategories
	displayByCategory := allByCategory
	if editMode {
		displayCategories = make([]string, 0, len(allCategories))
		displayByCategory = make(map[string][]CommonTerm)
		for _, cat := range allCategories {
			if canEditCategory(u.Email, categoryOwners[cat]) {
				displayCategories = append(displayCategories, cat)
				displayByCategory[cat] = allByCategory[cat]
			}
		}
	}

	// Resolve active category from ?cat= param against the displayed set.
	activeCat := r.URL.Query().Get("cat")
	validCat := false
	for _, cat := range displayCategories {
		if categoryAnchor(cat) == activeCat {
			validCat = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !validCat && len(displayCategories) > 0 {
		activeCat = categoryAnchor(displayCategories[0])
	}

	var editToggleURL string
	if editMode {
		editToggleURL = "/tools/unifi-words?cat=" + activeCat
	} else {
		editToggleURL = "/tools/unifi-words?cat=" + activeCat + "&edit=1"
	}

	// Build flat JSON for the search popup (all categories in view mode, editable only in edit mode).
	searchSource := displayCategories
	searchMap := displayByCategory
	var searchItems []termSearchItem
	for _, cat := range searchSource {
		for _, t := range searchMap[cat] {
			searchItems = append(searchItems, termSearchItem{
				ID:      "row-" + t.ID,
				Term:    t.Term,
				Desc:    t.Description,
				Section: categoryAnchor(cat),
			})
		}
	}
	termsJSONBytes, _ := json.Marshal(searchItems)

	return commonTermsPage(commonTermsData{
		r:               r,
		u:               u,
		cc:              c.Code,
		userCountries:   userCountries,
		Categories:      displayCategories,
		TermsByCategory: displayByCategory,
		CategoryOwners:  categoryOwners,
		OwnedCategories: ownedCategories(u.Email, categoryOwners),
		ActiveCat:       activeCat,
		EditMode:        editMode,
		EditToggleURL:   editToggleURL,
		TermsJSON:       string(termsJSONBytes),
		CanEdit:         userCanEdit,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) commonTermsEmbeddedLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	bqTerms, err := m.bq.GetCommonTerms(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading common terms: %v", err)
		bqTerms = nil
	}

	categoryOwners, err := m.bq.GetCategoryOwners(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading category owners: %v", err)
		categoryOwners = map[string]string{}
	}

	allByCategory := make(map[string][]CommonTerm)
	for _, t := range bqTerms {
		if t.Hidden {
			continue
		}
		allByCategory[t.Category] = append(allByCategory[t.Category], commonTermFromBQ(t))
	}

	cats := make([]string, 0, len(allByCategory))
	for cat := range allByCategory {
		cats = append(cats, cat)
	}
	sort.Strings(cats)

	activeCat := r.URL.Query().Get("cat")
	validCat := false
	for _, cat := range cats {
		if categoryAnchor(cat) == activeCat {
			validCat = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !validCat && len(cats) > 0 {
		activeCat = categoryAnchor(cats[0])
	}

	var searchItems []termSearchItem
	for _, cat := range cats {
		for _, t := range allByCategory[cat] {
			searchItems = append(searchItems, termSearchItem{
				ID:      "row-" + t.ID,
				Term:    t.Term,
				Desc:    t.Description,
				Section: categoryAnchor(cat),
			})
		}
	}
	termsJSONBytes, _ := json.Marshal(searchItems)

	return commonTermsEmbeddedPage(commonTermsData{
		r:               r,
		u:               u,
		cc:              c.Code,
		userCountries:   userCountries,
		Categories:      cats,
		TermsByCategory: allByCategory,
		CategoryOwners:  categoryOwners,
		ActiveCat:       activeCat,
		TermsJSON:       string(termsJSONBytes),
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — NEW TERM

func (m *module) termNewLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	owners, err := m.bq.GetCategoryOwners(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load category owners: %w", err)
	}
	owned := ownedCategories(u.Email, owners)
	if len(owned) == 0 {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "You do not own any categories")
	}

	return termNewPage(termNewData{
		r:               r,
		u:               u,
		cc:              c.Code,
		userCountries:   userCountries,
		OwnedCategories: owned,
		BackURL:         "/tools/unifi-words?edit=1",
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) termCreateAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	owners, err := m.bq.GetCategoryOwners(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load category owners: %w", err)
	}

	category := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("category"))
	term := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("term"))
	description := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("description"))
	hidden := r.FormValue("hidden") == "on"

	if !canEditCategory(u.Email, owners[category]) {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Not authorized to add to this category")
	}
	if term == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Term name is required")
	}
	prefix := prefixFor(category)
	if prefix == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Unknown category")
	}

	seq, err := m.bq.GetNextTermSequence(ctx, prefix)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to allocate term ID: %w", err)
	}

	if err := m.bq.CreateCommonTerm(ctx, bqpkg.BQCommonTerm{
		ID:          fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", prefix, seq),
		Category:    category,
		Term:        term,
		Description: description,
		EditedBy:    u.Email,
		Hidden:      hidden,
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create term: %w", err)
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, "/tools/unifi-words?cat="+categoryAnchor(category))
	return nil
}

// termPreviewAction renders a description to HTML with the same goldmark pipeline
// used on the display pages, so the editor preview matches the final output exactly.
func (m *module) termPreviewAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	_, err := w.Write([]byte(renderMarkdown(r.FormValue("description"))))
	return err
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — EDIT FORM

func (m *module) termEditLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	id := r.PathValue("id")
	bqT, err := m.bq.GetCommonTerm(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load common term: %w", err)
	}
	if bqT == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Term not found")
	}
	owners, err := m.bq.GetCategoryOwners(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load category owners: %w", err)
	}
	if !canEditCategory(u.Email, owners[bqT.Category]) {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Not authorized to edit this category")
	}

	return termEditPage(termEditData{
		r:             r,
		u:             u,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		Term:          commonTermFromBQ(*bqT),
		BackURL:       "/tools/unifi-words?edit=1",
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — EDIT ACTION

func (m *module) termEditAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	id := r.PathValue("id")

	// Authorize against the term's category before mutating.
	bqT, err := m.bq.GetCommonTerm(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load term for auth check: %w", err)
	}
	if bqT == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Term not found")
	}
	owners, err := m.bq.GetCategoryOwners(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load category owners: %w", err)
	}
	if !canEditCategory(u.Email, owners[bqT.Category]) {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Not authorized to edit this category")
	}

	term := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("term"))
	description := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("description"))
	hidden := r.FormValue("hidden") == "on"

	if term == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Term name is required")
	}

	if err := m.bq.UpdateCommonTerm(ctx, id, term, description, u.Email, hidden); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to update term: %w", err)
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, "/tools/unifi-words?cat="+categoryAnchor(bqT.Category))
	return nil
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — HISTORY

func (m *module) termHistoryLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	id := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("id"))

	var history []CommonTerm
	var termName string
	if id != "" {
		bqRows, err := m.bq.GetTermHistory(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR loading term history: %v", err)
		} else {
			for _, t := range bqRows {
				history = append(history, commonTermFromBQ(t))
			}
			if len(history) > 0 {
				termName = history[0].Term
			}
		}
	}

	return termHistoryPage(termHistoryData{
		r:             r,
		u:             u,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		TermName:      termName,
		History:       history,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}
```

```templ
package commonterms

import (

	"ujuzi/core/uj"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"

// =============================================
// COMMON TERMS LIST PAGE

templ commonTermsPage(d commonTermsData) {

		<!-- Page header -->
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
			<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
					<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
				</a>
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150" title="Back to Home">
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg">Unifi Words</span>
			</div>
			<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
				@termSearchInline()
				<div id="term-search-data" data-terms={ d.TermsJSON } class="hidden"></div>
				<script type="module" src="/assets/scripts/term_search.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Tab strip -->
		<div class="bg-white border-b border-gray-200">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex gap-1 pt-2 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden">
					for i, cat := range d.Categories {
						<button
							id={ fmt.Sprintf("tab-btn-%s", categoryAnchor(cat)) }
							data-tab-btn={ categoryAnchor(cat) }
							data-anchor={ categoryAnchor(cat) }
							onclick="showTab(this.dataset.anchor)"
							title={ cat }
							class={ tabBtnClass(i == 0) }
						>{ cat }</button>
					}
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Content -->
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 py-6 mb-12">
			if len(d.Categories) == 0 {
				<p class="text-gray-400 text-center py-20">No terms found.</p>
			} else {
				for i, cat := range d.Categories {
					<div
						id={ fmt.Sprintf("tab-content-%s", categoryAnchor(cat)) }
						data-tab-content
						class={ tabPanelClass(i == 0) }
					>
						if d.CanEdit {
							<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
								<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
									<span>Owner:</span>
									<span class="font-medium text-gray-700">{ d.CategoryOwners[cat] }</span>
								</div>
								if canEditCategory(d.u.Email, d.CategoryOwners[cat]) {
									<a
										href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/unifi-words/new") }
										class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
										title="Add a new term"
									>
										<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4">
											<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 4.5v15m7.5-7.5h-15"/>
										</svg>
										Add term
									</a>
								}
							</div>
						}
						<div class="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
							<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
								<thead class="bg-gray-50">
									<tr>
										<th class="pl-6 pr-2 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap w-24">Term ID</th>
										<th class="pl-3 pr-2 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Term</th>
										<th class="pl-3 pr-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Description</th>
										if d.CanEdit {
											<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider w-28">Last Updated</th>
											<th class="px-6 py-3 w-32"></th>
										}
									</tr>
								</thead>
								<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
									for _, t := range d.TermsByCategory[cat] {
										<tr
											id={ fmt.Sprintf("row-%s", t.ID) }
											data-term={ t.Term }
											data-description={ t.Description }
											data-section={ categoryAnchor(cat) }
											class={ "transition-colors duration-700", templ.KV("opacity-50 bg-gray-50", t.Hidden) }
										>
											<td class="pl-6 pr-2 py-4 align-top whitespace-nowrap">
												<span class="font-mono text-xs text-gray-400 bg-gray-100 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5">{ t.ID }</span>
											</td>
											<td class="pl-3 pr-2 py-4 align-top whitespace-nowrap">
												<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
													<p class="font-semibold text-gray-900 text-lg">{ t.Term }</p>
													if t.Hidden {
														<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-gray-200 text-gray-600">Hidden</span>
													}
												</div>
											</td>
											<td class="pl-3 pr-6 py-4 align-top">
												<div class="prose prose-base max-w-none text-gray-700">
													@templ.Raw(renderMarkdown(t.Description))
												</div>
											</td>
											if d.CanEdit {
												<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap align-top">{ t.Created }</td>
												<td class="px-6 py-4 text-right whitespace-nowrap align-top">
													<a
														href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/unifi-words/history?id=%s", url.QueryEscape(t.ID))) }
														class="text-sm text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition-colors mr-3"
													>History</a>
													if canEditCategory(d.u.Email, d.CategoryOwners[cat]) {
														<a
															href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/unifi-words/%s/edit", t.ID)) }
															class="text-sm font-medium text-green-x-dark hover:text-green-x-light transition-colors"
														>Edit →</a>
													}
												</td>
											}
										</tr>
									}
								</tbody>
							</table>
						</div>
					</div>
				}
			}
		</div>
		<script>
			const TAB_ACTIVE   = ['font-semibold','bg-gray-200','text-gray-900'];
			const TAB_INACTIVE = ['bg-gray-100','text-gray-600','hover:bg-gray-200','hover:text-gray-800'];

			function showTab(anchor) {
				document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-content]').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
				document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-btn]').forEach(btn => {
					btn.classList.remove(...TAB_ACTIVE);
					btn.classList.add(...TAB_INACTIVE);
				});
				const panel = document.getElementById('tab-content-' + anchor);
				const btn   = document.getElementById('tab-btn-'     + anchor);
				if (panel) panel.classList.remove('hidden');
				if (btn)   { btn.classList.remove(...TAB_INACTIVE); btn.classList.add(...TAB_ACTIVE); }
			}

			function closeTermSearch(e) {
				const o = document.getElementById('term-search-overlay');
				if (!o) return;
				if (!e || e.target === o) {
					o.classList.add('hidden');
				}
			}

			document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
				if (e.key === 'Escape') closeTermSearch();
			});

			function goToTerm(rowId, section) {
				closeTermSearch();
				if (section) showTab(section);
				const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
				if (!row) return;
				setTimeout(() => {
					row.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
					row.classList.add('bg-green-100');
					setTimeout(() => row.classList.remove('bg-green-100'), 2500);
				}, 50);
			}
		</script>
	}
}

// Header search box; wired by term_search.js.
templ termSearchInline() {
	<div class="relative">

			id="term-search-trigger"
			type="text"
			placeholder="Search terms..."

			class="px-3 rounded-full border border-white bg-transparent placeholder:text-white/80 text-white text-center appearance-none outline-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-white focus:bg-white/10"
			style="width: clamp(10rem, 28dvw, 20rem); height: 2.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem;"
			aria-label="Search common terms"
		/>
		<div
			id="term-search-dropdown"
			class="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-72 origin-top-right rounded-md bg-white shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5 hidden z-50 overflow-hidden"
		></div>
	</div>
}

templ termEditPage(d termEditData) {
	@layout.Html("Edit Term") {
		<!-- Page header -->
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light text-white pt-10 pb-16 md:pt-16">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
					<div>
						<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, d.BackURL) } class="text-white/70 hover:text-white text-sm mb-2 inline-block transition-colors">
							← Back to Common Terms
						</a>
						<h1 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold">Edit Term</h1>
						<p class="mt-1 text-white/80 text-sm">{ d.Term.Term }</p>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Form -->
		<div class="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 -mt-8 mb-20">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				<div class="mb-6 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-800">
					Saving creates a new version of this term. The previous version is kept in history.
				</div>
				<form
					method="POST"
					action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/unifi-words/%s", d.Term.ID)) }
					class="space-y-6"
				>
					<!-- Category (immutable — encoded in the ID) -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Category</label>
						<input
							type="text"
							value={ fmt.Sprintf("%s — %s", d.Term.ID, d.Term.Category) }
							readonly
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"
						/>
					</div>
					<!-- Term Name -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Term <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
						<input
							type="text"
							name="term"
							value={ d.Term.Term }
							required
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"
						/>
					</div>
					@markdownDescriptionField(d.Term.Description)
					@hiddenField(d.Term.Hidden)
					<!-- Last edited by (read-only display) -->
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Last edited by (set to you on save)</label>
						<input
							type="text"
							value={ d.u.Email }
							readonly
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"
						/>
					</div>
					<!-- Actions -->
					<div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
						<a
							href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, d.BackURL) }
							class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
						>
							Cancel
						</a>
						<button
							type="submit"
							class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors"
						>
							Save Changes
						</button>
					</div>
				</form>
			</div>
		</div>
		<script src="/assets/scripts/commonterm_preview.js?v=1.0.0"></script>
	}
}

// hiddenField is the shared Hidden toggle used by the add and edit forms. When
// set, the term is excluded from the embedded view and greyed out in the tool.
templ hiddenField(checked bool) {
	<label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none">
		<input
			type="checkbox"
			name="hidden"
			checked?={ checked }
			class="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-green-x-dark focus:ring-green-x-dark"
		/>
		<span class="text-sm text-gray-700">Hidden — keep out of the embedded view and grey out in the tool</span>
	</label>
}

// markdownDescriptionField is the shared Description editor used by the add and
// edit forms: a textarea wired to a live, goldmark-rendered preview pane.
templ markdownDescriptionField(value string) {
	<div>
		<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
			<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Description</label>
			<span class="text-xs text-gray-400">Markdown supported — preview updates as you type</span>
		</div>
		<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
			<textarea
				id="md-input"
				name="description"
				rows="12"
				class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark resize-y"
			>{ value }</textarea>
			<div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 overflow-auto">
				<p class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 mb-2">Preview</p>
				<div id="md-preview" class="prose prose-base max-w-none text-gray-700"></div>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
}
```
