```go
package creditpolicy

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime/multipart"
	"net/http"
	"path"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

// BitbucketClient reads files from and commits files to a Bitbucket Cloud
// repository via the REST API 2.0. It replaces the local git clone that the
// credit-policy module previously maintained.
type BitbucketClient struct {
	baseURL string // e.g. "https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0/repositories/unibos/credit-policy-config"
	branch  string // e.g. "master"
	auth    string // raw credential: "user:app-password" or "x-token-auth:<token>"
	http    *http.Client
}

// NewBitbucketClient builds a client from the repo URL and auth credential.
// repoURL is the HTTPS clone URL (e.g. "https://bitbucket.org/unibos/credit-policy-config.git").
func NewBitbucketClient(repoURL, branch, auth string) *BitbucketClient {
	workspace, slug := parseRepoURL(repoURL)
	return &BitbucketClient{
		baseURL: fmt.Sprintf("https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0/repositories/%s/%s", workspace, slug),
		branch:  branch,
		auth:    auth,
		http:    &http.Client{},
	}
}

// ListCountries returns the sorted country codes discovered under country/ in
// the repository. Replaces the old discoverCountryCodes that read from disk.
func (c *BitbucketClient) ListCountries(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error) {
	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/src/%s/country/?pagelen=100", c.baseURL, c.branch)

	var codes []string
	for url != "" {
		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		c.setAuth(req)

		resp, err := c.http.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bitbucket list countries: %w", err)
		}
		defer resp.Body.Close()

		if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
			body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bitbucket list countries: %s: %s", resp.Status, body)
		}

		var page struct {
			Values []struct {
				Path string `json:"path"`
				Type string `json:"type"`
			} `json:"values"`
			Next string `json:"next"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&page); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bitbucket list countries: decode: %w", err)
		}
		for _, v := range page.Values {
			if v.Type == "commit_directory" {
				codes = append(codes, path.Base(v.Path))
			}
		}
		url = page.Next
	}

	sort.Strings(codes)
	return codes, nil
}

// ReadFile fetches a single file from the repository at the configured branch.
// path is relative to the repo root (e.g. "country/ke/platform.yml").
func (c *BitbucketClient) ReadFile(ctx context.Context, filePath string) ([]byte, error) {
	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/src/%s/%s", c.baseURL, c.branch, filePath)

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	c.setAuth(req)

	resp, err := c.http.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("bitbucket read %s: %w", filePath, err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("bitbucket read %s: %s: %s", filePath, resp.Status, body)
	}

	return io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
}

// CommitFiles creates a single commit on the configured branch with the given
// file contents. files is keyed by repo-relative path (e.g. "country/ke/platform.yml").
// Returns the new commit SHA.
func (c *BitbucketClient) CommitFiles(ctx context.Context, files map[string][]byte, message, authorName, authorEmail string) (string, error) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	w := multipart.NewWriter(&buf)

	if err := w.WriteField("branch", c.branch); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := w.WriteField("message", message); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	author := fmt.Sprintf("%s <%s>", authorName, authorEmail)
	if err := w.WriteField("author", author); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	for filePath, content := range files {
		if err := w.WriteField(filePath, string(content)); err != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("bitbucket commit: write field %s: %w", filePath, err)
		}
	}
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/src", c.baseURL)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, url, &buf)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", w.FormDataContentType())
	c.setAuth(req)

	resp, err := c.http.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("bitbucket commit: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated && resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return "", fmt.Errorf("bitbucket commit: %s: %s", resp.Status, body)
	}

	sha, err := c.latestCommitSHA(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("bitbucket commit succeeded but could not read SHA: %w", err)
	}
	return sha, nil
}

// latestCommitSHA fetches the HEAD commit SHA on the configured branch.
func (c *BitbucketClient) latestCommitSHA(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/refs/branches/%s", c.baseURL, c.branch)

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	c.setAuth(req)

	resp, err := c.http.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return "", fmt.Errorf("bitbucket branch info: %s: %s", resp.Status, body)
	}

	var branch struct {
		Target struct {
			Hash string `json:"hash"`
		} `json:"target"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&branch); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return branch.Target.Hash, nil
}

// setAuth adds the appropriate Authorization header based on the credential format.
func (c *BitbucketClient) setAuth(req *http.Request) {
	if strings.HasPrefix(c.auth, "x-token-auth:") {
		token := strings.TrimPrefix(c.auth, "x-token-auth:")
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	} else {
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(c.auth)))
	}
}

// parseRepoURL extracts workspace and repo slug from a Bitbucket HTTPS URL.
// e.g. "https://bitbucket.org/unibos/credit-policy-config.git" -> ("unibos", "credit-policy-config")
func parseRepoURL(rawURL string) (workspace, slug string) {
	rawURL = strings.TrimSuffix(rawURL, ".git")
	rawURL = strings.TrimPrefix(rawURL, "https://bitbucket.org/")
	rawURL = strings.TrimPrefix(rawURL, "http://bitbucket.org/")
	parts := strings.SplitN(rawURL, "/", 2)
	if len(parts) == 2 {
		return parts[0], parts[1]
	}
	return rawURL, ""
}
```

```go
package creditpolicy

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/mid"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/webx"
)

type module struct {
	l            *log.Logger
	sessionStore auth.Store
	dbs          *country.DBs
	bb           *BitbucketClient

	approvers     []string
	autoApprovers []string // submitters whose own submission counts as their first approval
	quorum        int
	bq            *bq.Service
	bqPending     bq.CreditPolicyPendingTable
	publishCfg    PublishConfig

	cache *configCache
}

// cacheTTL keeps loaded config in memory so that view → edit → preview
// within a session reuses the same fetch. Invalidated explicitly on publish
// so approved changes show up immediately. Long enough to cover a typical
// editing session, short enough that out-of-band Bitbucket edits surface
// within an hour.
const cacheTTL = 1 * time.Hour

// configCache holds per-country pricingConfig plus the country list.
// Each entry's cfg only contains data for that one country (loadPricingConfig
// is called with a focused cc); the country list inside is the full list.
type configCache struct {
	mu      sync.RWMutex
	entries map[string]cachedEntry // keyed by cc; "" key holds the country-list-only entry
}

type cachedEntry struct {
	cfg    pricingConfig
	expiry time.Time
}

func newConfigCache() *configCache {
	return &configCache{entries: make(map[string]cachedEntry)}
}

func (c *configCache) get(cc string) (pricingConfig, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.entries[cc]
	if !ok || time.Now().After(e.expiry) {
		return pricingConfig{}, false
	}
	return e.cfg, true
}

func (c *configCache) put(cc string, cfg pricingConfig) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.entries[cc] = cachedEntry{cfg: cfg, expiry: time.Now().Add(cacheTTL)}
}

// invalidate drops the cached entry for cc (called after a successful
// publish to that country) plus the country-list-only entry, since a new
// country could in principle have been added.
func (c *configCache) invalidate(cc string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	delete(c.entries, cc)
	delete(c.entries, "")
}

// loadConfig fetches the country list plus YAML for the given country in
// parallel, with a 1-hour in-memory cache. Pass an empty cc when only the
// country list is needed (e.g. approvals pages).
func (m *module) loadConfig(ctx context.Context, cc string) (pricingConfig, error) {
	if cfg, ok := m.cache.get(cc); ok {
		return cfg, nil
	}
	cfg, err := loadPricingConfig(ctx, m.bb, cc)
	if err != nil {
		return cfg, err
	}
	m.cache.put(cc, cfg)
	return cfg, nil
}

// InitModule wires the credit-policy tool: constructs the Bitbucket API
// client, registers routes.
func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	approversCSV string,
	autoApproversCSV string,
	quorum int,
	bqService *bq.Service,
	bqPending bq.CreditPolicyPendingTable,
	publishCfg PublishConfig,
) {
	splitCSV := func(s string) []string {
		var out []string
		for _, a := range strings.Split(s, ",") {
			if a = strings.TrimSpace(a); a != "" {
				out = append(out, a)
			}
		}
		return out
	}

	bb := NewBitbucketClient(publishCfg.GitRepoURL, publishCfg.GitBranch, publishCfg.BitbucketAuth)

	m := &module{
		l:             l,
		sessionStore:  sessionStore,
		dbs:           dbs,
		bb:            bb,
		approvers:     splitCSV(approversCSV),
		autoApprovers: splitCSV(autoApproversCSV),
		quorum:        quorum,
		bq:            bqService,
		bqPending:     bqPending,
		publishCfg:    publishCfg,
		cache:         newConfigCache(),
	}

	pricingMid := stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)

	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/credit-policy", m.pricingLoader, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/credit-policy/preview", m.pricingPreviewHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/credit-policy/submit", m.pricingSubmitHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/credit-policy/approvals", m.pricingApprovalsLoader, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/credit-policy/approvals/{id}", m.pricingApprovalDetailLoader, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/credit-policy/approve/{id}", m.pricingApproveHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/credit-policy/cancel/{id}", m.pricingCancelHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/credit-policy/republish/{id}", m.pricingRepublishHandler, pricingMid...)

	// Back-compat aliases for the old /tools/pricing tool.
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/pricing", m.pricingLoader, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/pricing/preview", m.pricingPreviewHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/pricing/submit", m.pricingSubmitHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/pricing/approvals", m.pricingApprovalsLoader, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/pricing/approvals/{id}", m.pricingApprovalDetailLoader, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/pricing/approve/{id}", m.pricingApproveHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/pricing/cancel/{id}", m.pricingCancelHandler, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/pricing/republish/{id}", m.pricingRepublishHandler, pricingMid...)

	// Unified approvals queue alias.
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/approvals", m.pricingApprovalsLoader, pricingMid...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/approvals/{id}", m.pricingApprovalDetailLoader, pricingMid...)
}

func stdMid(l *log.Logger, additionalMid ...web.Middleware) []web.Middleware {
	m := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	}
	return append(m, additionalMid...)
}
```

## File: modules\tools\creditpolicy\pending.go
```go
package creditpolicy

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/bigquery"

	"ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/core/yamledit"
)

// =============================================
// PENDING CHANGE TYPES

// Status values for PendingChange.Status. Mirrored as the STATUS column on
// INSIGHTS.CREDIT_POLICY_PENDING.
const (
	StatusPending            = "pending"
	StatusCancelled          = "cancelled"
	StatusApplied            = "applied"
	StatusAppliedPendingPush = "applied_pending_push"
	StatusFailed             = "failed"
)

// Tools that may appear in PendingChange.Tools — informational labels for the
// approvals UI ("which areas were touched"). The lock is per-country, not
// per-tool, so multiple Tools entries on a single change is normal.
const (
	ToolPricing      = "pricing"
	ToolProvisioning = "provisioning"
	ToolThrottle     = "throttle"
)

// PendingChange is the in-memory mirror of a CreditPolicyPendingRow. The
// approvals UI works against PendingChange; the BQ row is hydrated from /
// dehydrated to this shape via pendingChangeFromRow / pendingChangeToRow.
//
// Diffs and FieldChanges are stored as JSON STRING columns in BQ — this
// keeps the schema stable when those types gain new fields.
type PendingChange struct {
	ID               string
	Tools            []string
	Country          string
	SubmittedAt      time.Time
	SubmittedByEmail string
	SubmittedByName  string
	Status           string
	Approvals        []string
	Diffs            []DiffEntry
	FieldChanges     []yamledit.FieldChange

	// Populated by the publisher.
	AppliedAt          *time.Time
	PublishedCommitSHA string
	Error              string
	FailedAt           *time.Time

	// UpdatedAt mirrors the BQ column — last mutation timestamp.
	UpdatedAt time.Time
}

type DiffEntry struct {
	Section  string `json:"section"`   // "acquisition" | "behaviour" | "platform" | "throttle" | "booster"
	ScoreKey string `json:"score_key"` // e.g. "aa1"; empty for global-section fields
	Field    string `json:"field"`     // human label e.g. "Normal Rate"
	OldValue string `json:"old_value"`
	NewValue string `json:"new_value"`
}

// =============================================
// ROW ↔ STRUCT CONVERTERS

// pendingChangeToRow serialises a PendingChange for INSERT/UPDATE.
// Diffs and FieldChanges go into JSON STRING columns; nullable fields are
// wrapped in bigquery.Null* helpers so omitted values write as SQL NULL.
func pendingChangeToRow(ch PendingChange, now time.Time) (bq.CreditPolicyPendingRow, error) {
	diffsJSON, err := json.Marshal(ch.Diffs)
	if err != nil {
		return bq.CreditPolicyPendingRow{}, fmt.Errorf("marshal diffs: %w", err)
	}
	fcJSON, err := json.Marshal(ch.FieldChanges)
	if err != nil {
		return bq.CreditPolicyPendingRow{}, fmt.Errorf("marshal field changes: %w", err)
	}

	row := bq.CreditPolicyPendingRow{
		ChangeID:         ch.ID,
		Country:          ch.Country,
		Status:           ch.Status,
		SubmittedAt:      ch.SubmittedAt,
		SubmittedByEmail: ch.SubmittedByEmail,
		SubmittedByName:  nullStringOrEmpty(ch.SubmittedByName),
		ToolsCSV:         nullStringOrEmpty(strings.Join(ch.Tools, ",")),
		ApprovalsCSV:     nullStringOrEmpty(strings.Join(ch.Approvals, ",")),
		ApprovalCount:    int64(len(ch.Approvals)),
		DiffsJSON:        string(diffsJSON),
		FieldChangesJSON: string(fcJSON),
		AppliedAt:        nullTimestampOrZero(ch.AppliedAt),
		PublishedCommitSHA: nullStringOrEmpty(ch.PublishedCommitSHA),
		FailedAt:           nullTimestampOrZero(ch.FailedAt),
		ErrorMessage:       nullStringOrEmpty(ch.Error),
		UpdatedAt:          now,
	}
	return row, nil
}

// pendingChangeFromRow deserialises a BQ row into the in-memory shape.
func pendingChangeFromRow(row bq.CreditPolicyPendingRow) (PendingChange, error) {
	ch := PendingChange{
		ID:                 row.ChangeID,
		Country:            row.Country,
		Status:             row.Status,
		SubmittedAt:        row.SubmittedAt,
		SubmittedByEmail:   row.SubmittedByEmail,
		SubmittedByName:    nullStringValue(row.SubmittedByName),
		Tools:              splitCSV(nullStringValue(row.ToolsCSV)),
		Approvals:          splitCSV(nullStringValue(row.ApprovalsCSV)),
		PublishedCommitSHA: nullStringValue(row.PublishedCommitSHA),
		Error:              nullStringValue(row.ErrorMessage),
		UpdatedAt:          row.UpdatedAt,
	}
	if row.AppliedAt.Valid {
		t := row.AppliedAt.Timestamp
		ch.AppliedAt = &t
	}
	if row.FailedAt.Valid {
		t := row.FailedAt.Timestamp
		ch.FailedAt = &t
	}
	if row.DiffsJSON != "" {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(row.DiffsJSON), &ch.Diffs); err != nil {
			return ch, fmt.Errorf("unmarshal diffs: %w", err)
		}
	}
	if row.FieldChangesJSON != "" {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(row.FieldChangesJSON), &ch.FieldChanges); err != nil {
			return ch, fmt.Errorf("unmarshal field changes: %w", err)
		}
	}
	return ch, nil
}

func pendingChangesFromRows(rows []bq.CreditPolicyPendingRow) ([]PendingChange, error) {
	out := make([]PendingChange, 0, len(rows))
	for _, r := range rows {
		ch, err := pendingChangeFromRow(r)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out = append(out, ch)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func nullStringOrEmpty(s string) bigquery.NullString {
	if s == "" {
		return bigquery.NullString{}
	}
	return bigquery.NullString{StringVal: s, Valid: true}
}

func nullStringValue(n bigquery.NullString) string {
	if !n.Valid {
		return ""
	}
	return n.StringVal
}

func nullTimestampOrZero(t *time.Time) bigquery.NullTimestamp {
	if t == nil || t.IsZero() {
		return bigquery.NullTimestamp{}
	}
	return bigquery.NullTimestamp{Timestamp: *t, Valid: true}
}

func splitCSV(s string) []string {
	if s == "" {
		return nil
	}
	parts := strings.Split(s, ",")
	out := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, p := range parts {
		if p = strings.TrimSpace(p); p != "" {
			out = append(out, p)
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

```go
// UnmarshalYAML handles two YAML forms for a client score entry:
//
//	wrapped:  {product: [{product_name: [...], ...}]}
//	direct:   [{product_name: [...], ...}]
//
// Some countries use the direct form without the "product:" key.
func (cs *plClientScore) UnmarshalYAML(unmarshal func(interface{}) error) error {
	var wrapped struct {
		Products []plProduct `yaml:"product"`
	}
	if err := unmarshal(&wrapped); err == nil && len(wrapped.Products) > 0 {
		cs.Products = wrapped.Products
		return nil
	}
	var direct []plProduct
	if err := unmarshal(&direct); err == nil {
		cs.Products = direct
		return nil
	}
	return nil
}

type plProduct struct {
	ProductName         string      `yaml:"product_name"`
	NormalInterestRate  float64     `yaml:"normal_interest_rate"`
	ArrearsInterestRate float64     `yaml:"arrears_interest_rate"`
	MaxTerm             int         `yaml:"max_term"`

	MinLoanAmountLimit       platformMinLoan `yaml:"min_loan_amount_limit"`
	MaxCashDisbursementLimit float64         `yaml:"max_cash_disbursement_limit"`
	// Pointer/nil-gated: most countries charge a statement fee, SA charges a
	// monthly fee instead — each renders only where its key is present.
	StatementFee *float64 `yaml:"statement_fee"`
	MonthlyFee   *float64 `yaml:"monthly_fee"`
	Rounding     *float64 `yaml:"rounding"`
	// Pointer so a null/missing YAML node stays nil instead of decoding to
	// a zero struct. Some countries (e.g. ZA) have `withdrawal_charges:`
	// with the body commented out; the Mobile Money Fee + cash tiers render
	// only when this is non-nil.
	WithdrawalCharges *platformWithdrawal `yaml:"withdrawal_charges"`
	CollectionCharges []platformTier      `yaml:"collection_charges"`
	InitiationCharges *platformInitiation `yaml:"initiation_charges"`
	// Pointer/nil-gated like WithdrawalCharges: recovery_charges is a
	// heterogeneous YAML sequence absent in many countries' files.
	RecoveryCharges *platformRecovery `yaml:"recovery_charges"`
}

type platformMinLoan struct {
	Products []platformProduct `yaml:"product"`
}

type platformProduct struct {
	ProductName           []string `yaml:"product_name"`
	LoanTermFromInclusive int      `yaml:"loan_term_from_inclusive"`
	LoanTermToInclusive   int      `yaml:"loan_term_to_inclusive"`
	MinLoanAmount         float64  `yaml:"min_loan_amount"`
}

// minLoanTier is one term-banded minimum loan amount (SA's tiered form).
// ProdIdx is the product entry's index — the publisher addresses the leaf by it.
type minLoanTier struct {
	TermFrom int
	ProdIdx  int
	Amount   float64
}

// buildMinLoanTiers returns the term-banded min-loan tiers, ordered by term
// descending. Returns nil for the flat single-amount form used by every other
// country (callers fall back to the first non-zero amount in that case). Only
// entries carrying loan-term bounds count as tiers, so a country that merely
// lists several product groups isn't mistaken for tiered.
func buildMinLoanTiers(ml platformMinLoan) []minLoanTier {
	var tiers []minLoanTier
	for i, prod := range ml.Products {
		if prod.MinLoanAmount > 0 && (prod.LoanTermFromInclusive > 0 || prod.LoanTermToInclusive > 0) {
			tiers = append(tiers, minLoanTier{TermFrom: prod.LoanTermFromInclusive, ProdIdx: i, Amount: prod.MinLoanAmount})
		}
	}
	if len(tiers) < 2 {
		return nil
	}
	sort.Slice(tiers, func(a, b int) bool { return tiers[a].TermFrom > tiers[b].TermFrom })
	return tiers
}

type platformWithdrawal struct {
	MobileMoney float64        `yaml:"mobile_money"`
	EFT         float64        `yaml:"eft"`
	Cash        []platformTier `yaml:"cash"`
}

type platformTier struct {
	Tier               int     `yaml:"tier"`
	ValueFromInclusive float64 `yaml:"value_from_inclusive"`
	ValueToInclusive   float64 `yaml:"value_to_inclusive"`
	CashWithdrawFee    float64 `yaml:"cash_withdraw_fee"`
	CollectionFee      float64 `yaml:"collection_fee"`
}

// platformInitiation is SA's initiation charge: a rules engine we don't
// interpret, summarised by a human-readable `display` string shown verbatim.
// It's a YAML mapping (not the tiered list shape of the other charges).
type platformInitiation struct {
	Display string `yaml:"display"`
}

// platformRecovery flattens the recovery_charges sequence:
//
//	recovery_charges:
//	  - maximum_of:
//	      - {percentage: 0.10, of: balance}
//	      - {fixed_fee: 200.00}
//	  - subject_to_in_duplum: true
//	  - when: write_off
//
// The fee is max(percentage of balance, fixed_fee). The *Idx fields capture
// each leaf's position in the sequence so the publisher can address it — the
// edit paths must match the file's actual ordering, and yamledit cannot create
// sequence elements that don't already exist.
type platformRecovery struct {
	Percentage float64
	FixedFee   float64
	InDuplum   bool
	When       string
	Of         string

	maxOfIdx    int
	pctIdx      int
	feeIdx      int
	inDuplumIdx int
	whenIdx     int
}

func (rc *platformRecovery) UnmarshalYAML(unmarshal func(interface{}) error) error {
	var items []map[string]interface{}
	if err := unmarshal(&items); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rc.maxOfIdx, rc.pctIdx, rc.feeIdx, rc.inDuplumIdx, rc.whenIdx = -1, -1, -1, -1, -1
	for i, item := range items {
		if mo, ok := item["maximum_of"]; ok {
			rc.maxOfIdx = i
			if list, ok := mo.([]interface{}); ok {
				for j, e := range list {
					m, ok := toStringMap(e)
					if !ok {
						continue
					}
					if v, ok := m["percentage"]; ok {
						rc.Percentage = toFloat64(v)
						rc.pctIdx = j
					}
					if v, ok := m["of"]; ok {
						rc.Of, _ = v.(string)
					}
					if v, ok := m["fixed_fee"]; ok {
						rc.FixedFee = toFloat64(v)
						rc.feeIdx = j
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if v, ok := item["subject_to_in_duplum"]; ok {
			rc.inDuplumIdx = i
			rc.InDuplum, _ = v.(bool)
		}
		if v, ok := item["when"]; ok {
			rc.whenIdx = i
			rc.When, _ = v.(string)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// toStringMap normalises a yaml.v2 nested node (map[interface{}]interface{})
// into a string-keyed map.
func toStringMap(v interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, bool) {
	switch m := v.(type) {
	case map[string]interface{}:
		return m, true
	case map[interface{}]interface{}:
		out := make(map[string]interface{}, len(m))
		for k, val := range m {
			if ks, ok := k.(string); ok {
				out[ks] = val
			}
		}
		return out, true
	}
	return nil, false
}

// CONFIG + LOAD

type pricingConfig struct {
	pl        plRoot
	platform  platformRoot
	scr       scrRoot
	prov      provRoot
	tnb       map[string]tnbRoot // keyed by country code; absent when the country lacks the file
	testSplit *testSplitRoot     // global/global_test_split.yml; nil when absent
	codes     []string
}

// loadPricingConfig loads YAML for the given country in parallel. If cc is
// empty, only the country list is fetched (cfg.codes populated, maps empty).
// Pass the selected country code to avoid loading data for countries the page
// never renders — the previous "load everything" approach made every page
// load take 25+ sequential API calls (~20 seconds).
func loadPricingConfig(ctx context.Context, bb *BitbucketClient, cc string) (pricingConfig, error) {
	codes, err := bb.ListCountries(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return pricingConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("discover countries: %w", err)
	}

	cfg := pricingConfig{
		pl:       make(plRoot),
		platform: make(platformRoot),
		scr:      make(scrRoot),
		prov:     make(provRoot),
		tnb:      make(map[string]tnbRoot),
		codes:    codes,
	}
	if cc == "" {
		return cfg, nil
	}
	// Validate cc is real before issuing reads.
	known := false
	for _, c := range codes {
		if c == cc {
			known = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !known {
		return cfg, nil
	}

	// Read all five YAML files for the focused country in parallel. Each
	// goroutine populates an isolated piece of cfg, so no locking required.
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	read := func(file string, parse func([]byte)) {
		defer wg.Done()
		data, err := bb.ReadFile(ctx, "country/"+cc+"/"+file)
		if err != nil || data == nil {
			return
		}
		parse(data)
	}

	wg.Add(6)
	// global_test_split.yml lives under global/, not country/<cc>/, so it
	// bypasses the read helper (which hard-codes the country prefix).
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		data, err := bb.ReadFile(ctx, "global/global_test_split.yml")
		if err != nil || data == nil {
			return
		}
		var root testSplitRoot
		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &root) == nil {
			cfg.testSplit = &root
		}
	}()
	go read(pricingFile, func(data []byte) {
		var root plRoot
		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &root) == nil {
			for k, v := range root {
				cfg.pl[k] = v
			}
		}
	})
	go read(platformFile, func(data []byte) {
		var root platformRoot
		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &root) == nil {
			for k, v := range root {
				cfg.platform[k] = v
			}
		}
	})
	go read(scrFile, func(data []byte) {
		var root scrRoot
		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &root) == nil {
			for k, v := range root {
				cfg.scr[k] = v
			}
		}
	})
	go read(provFile, func(data []byte) {
		var root provRoot
		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &root) == nil {
			for k, v := range root {
				cfg.prov[k] = v
			}
		}
	})
	go read(throttleFile, func(data []byte) {
		var root map[string]tnbRoot
		if yaml.Unmarshal(data, &root) == nil {
			if v, ok := root[cc]; ok {
				cfg.tnb[cc] = v
			}
		}
	})
	wg.Wait()

	return cfg, nil
}

// =============================================
// HANDLER

func (m *module) pricingLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if r.URL.Query().Get("mode") == "edit" {
		return m.pricingEditLoader(w, r)
	}
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	selectedCountry := getCountryParam(r)
	cfg, err := m.loadConfig(ctx, selectedCountry)
	if err != nil {
		return creditPolicyUnavailablePage(r, err.Error()).Render(ctx, w)
	}

	countryOptions := buildCountryOptions(cfg)
	if !optionExists(countryOptions, selectedCountry) && len(countryOptions) > 0 {
		// Requested country doesn't exist (e.g. user profile CC isn't in
		// the repo). Reload with the first valid one.
		selectedCountry = countryOptions[0].Value
		if cfg, err = m.loadConfig(ctx, selectedCountry); err != nil {
			return creditPolicyUnavailablePage(r, err.Error()).Render(ctx, w)
		}
	}
	for i := range countryOptions {
		countryOptions[i].Selected = countryOptions[i].Value == selectedCountry
	}

	selectedSection := r.URL.Query().Get("section")
	validSections := map[string]bool{"cutoffs": true, "limits": true, "terms": true, "interest-rate": true, "fees": true}
	if !validSections[selectedSection] {
		selectedSection = "limits"
	}

	selectedParent := r.URL.Query().Get("parent")
	validParents := map[string]bool{"pricing": true, "provisioning": true, "throttle": true}
	if !validParents[selectedParent] {
		selectedParent = "pricing"
	}

	d := pricingPageData{
		r:               r,
		SelectedCountry: selectedCountry,
		SelectedSection: selectedSection,
		SelectedParent:  selectedParent,
		UserCountries:   userCountriesFromCfg(cfg),
		CountryOptions:  countryOptions,
	}

	// Load pricing_and_limits data for both types
	if c, ok := cfg.pl[selectedCountry]; ok {
		if acq, ok := c.ScorecardType["acquisition"]; ok {
			d.AcqProducts = collectProducts(acq)
			d.AcqRows = buildScoreRows(acq, d.AcqProducts, selectedCountry)
			d.AcqLimitRows = buildLimitRows(acq, d.AcqProducts)
		}
		if bhv, ok := c.ScorecardType["behaviour"]; ok {
			d.BhvProducts = collectProducts(bhv)
			d.BhvRows = buildScoreRows(bhv, d.BhvProducts, selectedCountry)
			d.BhvLimitRows = buildLimitRows(bhv, d.BhvProducts)
		}
	}

	// Load score cutoff ranges
	if c, ok := cfg.scr[selectedCountry]; ok {
		if acq, ok := c.ScorecardType["acquisition"]; ok {
			d.AcqCutoffs = buildCutoffRows(acq)
		}
		if bhv, ok := c.ScorecardType["behaviour"]; ok {
			d.BhvCutoffs = buildCutoffRows(bhv)
		}
	}

	// Load platform fees
	if p, ok := cfg.platform[selectedCountry]; ok {
		var flats []feeItem
		if feeActive(p.MonthlyFee) {
			flats = append(flats, feeItem{Label: "Monthly Fee", Value: formatCurrency(*p.MonthlyFee)})
		}
		if feeActive(p.StatementFee) {
			flats = append(flats, feeItem{Label: "Statement Fee", Value: formatCurrency(*p.StatementFee)})
		}
		if w := p.WithdrawalCharges; w != nil {
			d.CashTiers = buildCashTierRows(w.Cash)
			if w.MobileMoney > 0 {
				flats = append(flats, feeItem{Label: "Mobile Money Fee", Value: formatCurrency(w.MobileMoney)})
			}
			if w.EFT > 0 {
				flats = append(flats, feeItem{Label: "EFT Fee", Value: formatCurrency(w.EFT)})
			}
		}
		if p.Rounding != nil {
			val := "None"
			if *p.Rounding > 0 {
				val = formatCurrency(*p.Rounding)
			}
			flats = append(flats, feeItem{Label: "Rounding Amount", Value: val})
		}
		d.FeeSlots = chunkFees(flats, 4)
		d.CollectionTiers = buildCollectionTierRows(p.CollectionCharges)
		if p.InitiationCharges != nil {
			d.InitiationDisplay = formatInitiationDisplay(p.InitiationCharges.Display)
		}
		if rc := p.RecoveryCharges; rc != nil {
			of := rc.Of
			if of == "" {
				of = "balance"
			}
			d.Recovery = recoveryView{
				Present:  true,
				Formula:  fmt.Sprintf("Max(%s of %s, %s)", formatPct(rc.Percentage), of, formatCurrency(rc.FixedFee)),
				When:     capitalise(strings.ReplaceAll(rc.When, "_", " ")),
				InDuplum: yesNo(rc.InDuplum),
			}
		}
		d.MaxCashDisb = p.MaxCashDisbursementLimit
		if d.MinLoanTiers = buildMinLoanTiers(p.MinLoanAmountLimit); len(d.MinLoanTiers) == 0 {
			for _, prod := range p.MinLoanAmountLimit.Products {
				if prod.MinLoanAmount > 0 {
					d.MinLoanAmount = prod.MinLoanAmount
					break
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Load provisioning
	if pc, ok := cfg.prov[selectedCountry]; ok {
		if acq, ok := pc.ScorecardType["acquisition"]; ok {
			d.AcqProvRows = buildProvisionViewRows(acq)
		}
		if bhv, ok := pc.ScorecardType["behaviour"]; ok {
			d.BhvProvRows = buildProvisionViewRows(bhv)
		}
	}

	// Load booster + throttle
	if tnb, ok := cfg.tnb[selectedCountry]; ok {
		d.Booster = buildBoosterViewTable(tnb.Booster)
		d.ThrottleLimit = formatThrottleLimit(tnb.Throttle.ThrottleLimit)
		d.ThrottleBasis = tnb.Throttle.ThrottleBasis
	}

	d.CoreTestSplit = buildCoreTestSplit(cfg.testSplit, selectedCountry)

	if n, err := m.bq.CountPending(ctx, m.bqPending); err == nil {
		d.PendingCount = n
	} else {
		m.l.Printf("WARN count pending: %v", err)
	}
	if row, err := m.bq.PendingForCountry(ctx, m.bqPending, selectedCountry); err == nil && row != nil {
		d.PendingForCountry = true
		d.PendingChangeID = row.ChangeID
	} else if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("WARN pending for country: %v", err)
	}
	d.Submitted = r.URL.Query().Get("submitted") == "1"
	d.IsApprover = m.isApprover(u.Email)

	return pricingPage(d).Render(ctx, w)
}

// =============================================
// HELPERS

func collectProducts(st plScorecardType) []string {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	var products []string
	for _, scoreKey := range sortedKeys(st.ClientScore) {
		for _, prod := range st.ClientScore[scoreKey].Products {
			name := prod.ProductName
			if name != "" && !seen[name] {
				seen[name] = true
				products = append(products, name)
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(products)
	return products
}

func buildScoreRows(st plScorecardType, products []string, cc string) []scoreRow {
	var rows []scoreRow
	for _, scoreKey := range sortedKeys(st.ClientScore) {
		score := st.ClientScore[scoreKey]

		// Build map: product name → its plProduct entry
		productMap := make(map[string]plProduct)
		for _, p := range score.Products {
			productMap[p.ProductName] = p
		}

		// One productRate per column
		rates := make([]productRate, len(products))
		for i, pName := range products {
			if p, ok := productMap[pName]; ok {
				rates[i] = productRate{
					Normal:  formatInterestRate(cc, pName, p.NormalInterestRate),
					Arrears: formatInterestRate(cc, pName, p.ArrearsInterestRate),
				}
			}
		}

		// Core/test and max term from first product entry
		var maxTermStr, coreRBL, coreGSM, testRBL, testGSM string
		if len(score.Products) > 0 {
			first := score.Products[0]
			if first.MaxTerm > 0 {
				maxTermStr = fmt.Sprintf("%d", first.MaxTerm)
			}
			core := extractTranche(first.Core)
			test := extractTranche(first.Test)
			if core.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit > 0 {
				coreRBL = formatWholeNumber(core.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit)
				coreGSM = formatGSM(core.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement)
			}
			if test.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit > 0 {
				testRBL = formatWholeNumber(test.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit)
				testGSM = formatGSM(test.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement)
			}
		}

		rows = append(rows, scoreRow{
			Category:     strings.ToUpper(scoreKey),
			ScoreKey:     scoreKey,
			ProductRates: rates,
			MaxTerm:      maxTermStr,
			CoreRBL:      coreRBL,
			CoreGSM:      coreGSM,
			TestRBL:      testRBL,
			TestGSM:      testGSM,
		})
	}
	return rows
}

// extractTranche normalises both the object form and the list form that the YAML uses for core/test.
func extractTranche(v interface{}) plTranche {
	if v == nil {
		return plTranche{}
	}
	switch t := v.(type) {
	case map[interface{}]interface{}:
		return plTranche{
			Split:                              toFloat64(t["split"]),
			RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit:      toFloat64(t["rule_based_max_disbursement_limit"]),
			GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement: toFloat64(t["gross_salary_multiple_max_disbursement_limit"]),
		}
	case []interface{}:
		if len(t) > 0 {
			if m, ok := t[0].(map[interface{}]interface{}); ok {
				return plTranche{
					Split:                              toFloat64(m["split"]),
					RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit:      toFloat64(m["rule_based_max_disbursement_limit"]),
					GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement: toFloat64(m["gross_salary_multiple_max_disbursement_limit"]),
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return plTranche{}
}

func toFloat64(v interface{}) float64 {
	switch f := v.(type) {
	case float64:
		return f
	case int:
		return float64(f)
	}
	return 0
}

func buildCashTierRows(tiers []platformTier) []feeTierRow {
	var rows []feeTierRow
	for i, t := range tiers {
		var rangeStr string
		if i == len(tiers)-1 {
			rangeStr = fmt.Sprintf("%s+", formatCurrency(t.ValueFromInclusive))
		} else {
			rangeStr = fmt.Sprintf("%s \u2013 %s", formatCurrency(t.ValueFromInclusive), formatCurrency(t.ValueToInclusive))
		}
		rows = append(rows, feeTierRow{Range: rangeStr, Fee: formatCurrency(t.CashWithdrawFee)})
	}
	return rows
}

func buildCollectionTierRows(tiers []platformTier) []feeTierRow {
	var rows []feeTierRow
	for i, t := range tiers {
		var rangeStr string
		if i == len(tiers)-1 {
			rangeStr = fmt.Sprintf("%s+", formatCurrency(t.ValueFromInclusive))
		} else {
			rangeStr = fmt.Sprintf("%s \u2013 %s", formatCurrency(t.ValueFromInclusive), formatCurrency(t.ValueToInclusive))
		}
		rows = append(rows, feeTierRow{Range: rangeStr, Fee: formatCurrency(t.CollectionFee)})
	}
	return rows
}

// chunkFees groups single-value fee pills into rows of `size`, so each row
// renders as one card (two pills tall) matching a tiered-fee card's footprint.
func chunkFees(items []feeItem, size int) [][]feeItem {
	var out [][]feeItem
	for i := 0; i < len(items); i += size {
		end := i + size
		if end > len(items) {
			end = len(items)
		}
		out = append(out, items[i:end])
	}
	return out
}

func buildCoreTestSplit(ts *testSplitRoot, cc string) coreTestSplitView {
	if ts == nil {
		return coreTestSplitView{}
	}
	var rows []coreTestRow
	var group []string
	add := func(label string, core, test []testSplitEntry) {
		c := findSplitEntry(core, cc)
		t := findSplitEntry(test, cc)
		if c == nil || t == nil {
			return
		}
		if group == nil {
			group = c.Countries
		}
		rows = append(rows, coreTestRow{
			Scorecard: label,
			CoreRange: fmt.Sprintf("%d – %d", c.ValueFrom, c.ValueTo),
			TestRange: fmt.Sprintf("%d – %d", t.ValueFrom, t.ValueTo),
		})
	}
	add("Acquisition", ts.Core.Acquisition, ts.Test.Acquisition)
	add("Behaviour", ts.Core.Behaviour, ts.Test.Behaviour)
	if len(rows) == 0 {
		return coreTestSplitView{}
	}
	return coreTestSplitView{Present: true, Countries: formatCountryGroup(group, cc), Rows: rows}
}

func findSplitEntry(entries []testSplitEntry, cc string) *testSplitEntry {
	for i := range entries {
		for _, c := range entries[i].Countries {
			if c == cc {
				return &entries[i]
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// formatCountryGroup renders the country codes uppercased, with the viewed
// country first and the rest alphabetical (e.g. "ZM, KE, TZ, UG").
func formatCountryGroup(codes []string, viewed string) string {
	var rest []string
	for _, c := range codes {
		if c != viewed {
			rest = append(rest, c)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(rest)
	ordered := append([]string{viewed}, rest...)
	for i, c := range ordered {
		ordered[i] = strings.ToUpper(c)
	}
	return strings.Join(ordered, ", ")
}

func buildCutoffRows(st scrScorecardType) []cutoffRow {
	var rows []cutoffRow
	for _, key := range sortedKeys(st.ClientScore) {
		cs := st.ClientScore[key]
		rows = append(rows, cutoffRow{
			Category: strings.ToUpper(key),
			ScoreKey: key,
			MinScore: cs.ScoreRangeFrom,
			MaxScore: cs.ScoreRangeTo,
		})
	}
	return rows
}

func buildLimitRows(st plScorecardType, products []string) []limitRow {
	var rows []limitRow
	for _, key := range sortedKeys(st.ClientScore) {
		score := st.ClientScore[key]
		if len(score.Products) == 0 {
			continue
		}

		// Build map: product name → plProduct
		productMap := make(map[string]plProduct)
		for _, p := range score.Products {
			productMap[p.ProductName] = p
		}

		limits := make([]productLimitData, len(products))
		for i, pName := range products {
			if p, ok := productMap[pName]; ok {
				core := extractTranche(p.Core)
				test := extractTranche(p.Test)
				limits[i] = productLimitData{
					MaxTerm: fmt.Sprintf("%d", p.MaxTerm),
					CoreRBL: formatWholeNumber(core.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit),
					CoreGSM: formatGSM(core.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement),
					TestRBL: formatWholeNumber(test.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit),
					TestGSM: formatGSM(test.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement),
				}
			}
		}

		rows = append(rows, limitRow{
			Category:      strings.ToUpper(key),
			ScoreKey:      key,
			ProductLimits: limits,
		})
	}
	return rows
}

func buildCountryOptions(cfg pricingConfig) []pricingOption {
	var opts []pricingOption
	for _, code := range cfg.codes {
		opts = append(opts, pricingOption{Value: code, Label: countryName(code)})
	}
	return opts
}

func optionExists(opts []pricingOption, val string) bool {
	for _, o := range opts {
		if o.Value == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// displayCountry renders the country column for approvals lists. Resolves
// ISO codes through countryName.
func displayCountry(code string) string {
	return countryName(code)
}

// userCountriesFromCfg returns the credit-policy countries (those with on-disk
// data) as []country.Country, ordered by Code, for the flag dropdown.
func userCountriesFromCfg(cfg pricingConfig) []country.Country {
	out := make([]country.Country, 0, len(cfg.codes))
	for _, code := range cfg.codes {
		out = append(out, country.Country{Code: code, Name: countryName(code)})
	}
	return out
}

func countryName(code string) string {
	for _, c := range country.List {
		if c.Code == code {
			return c.Name
		}
	}
	return strings.ToUpper(code)
}

func labelProduct(name string) string {
	name = strings.ReplaceAll(name, "_and_", " & ")
	name = strings.ReplaceAll(name, "_", " ")
	words := strings.Fields(name)
	for i, w := range words {
		if len(w) > 0 {
			words[i] = strings.ToUpper(w[:1]) + w[1:]
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(words, " ")
}

func capitalise(s string) string {
	if s == "" {
		return s
	}
	words := strings.Fields(strings.ReplaceAll(s, "-", " "))
	for i, w := range words {
		if len(w) > 0 {
			words[i] = strings.ToUpper(w[:1]) + w[1:]
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(words, " ")
}

func formatPct(f float64) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f%%", f*100)
}

func yesNo(b bool) string {
	if b {
		return "Yes"
	}
	return "No"
}

// feeActive reports whether an optional flat fee (statement, monthly, rounding)
// is in force. The key is often present-but-zero (e.g. SA's statement_fee: 0.00),
// so a fee counts only when present and positive — a zero neither displays nor edits.
func feeActive(f *float64) bool { return f != nil && *f > 0 }

// sastLoc is South Africa Standard Time (UTC+2, no DST). Submission times are
// stored in UTC; the approvals UI renders them in SAST.
var sastLoc = time.FixedZone("SAST", 2*60*60)

func formatSAST(t time.Time) string {
	return t.In(sastLoc).Format("2 Jan 2006 15:04") + " SAST"
}

// repoLinked reports whether a product's interest rate is quoted as a fixed
// margin over the repo rate (ZA unsecured): the YAML stores only the margin,
// the repo component is added downstream, so the UI annotates it with "+ repo".
func repoLinked(cc, product string) bool {
	return cc == country.ZA && product == "unsecured"
}

func formatInterestRate(cc, product string, f float64) string {
	s := formatPct(f)
	if repoLinked(cc, product) {
		return s + " + repo"
	}
	return s
}

// formatPct4 is used for provisioning rates. Underlying YAML stores up to
// 4 decimals (e.g. 0.1189) but display rounds to 2 for readability.
// Name kept for now to avoid renaming all call sites.
func formatPct4(f float64) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%.2f%%", f*100)
}

// groupThousands inserts a comma every three digits, e.g. "1000000" -> "1,000,000".
func groupThousands(digits string) string {
	n := len(digits)
	if n <= 3 {
		return digits
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	pre := n % 3
	if pre == 0 {
		pre = 3
	}
	b.WriteString(digits[:pre])
	for i := pre; i < n; i += 3 {
		b.WriteByte(',')
		b.WriteString(digits[i : i+3])
	}
	return b.String()
}

func formatCurrency(f float64) string {
	if f == 0 {
		return "0.00"
	}
	whole := int64(f)
	frac := int64((f-float64(whole))*100 + 0.5)
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s.%02d", groupThousands(fmt.Sprintf("%d", whole)), frac)
}

// initListItemRE matches a " N. " list marker so the initiation display, which
// arrives as a single folded line, can be broken into one line per item.
var initListItemRE = regexp.MustCompile(`\s+(\d+\.\s)`)

// formatInitiationDisplay puts each numbered item on its own line. Author-set
// newlines (literal YAML block) are respected as-is; otherwise we break before
// each " N. " marker so a folded/single-line value still renders as a list.
func formatInitiationDisplay(s string) string {
	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
	if s == "" || strings.Contains(s, "\n") {
		return s
	}
	return initListItemRE.ReplaceAllString(s, "\n$1")
}

func formatWholeNumber(f float64) string {
	n := int64(math.Round(f))
	if n == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	return groupThousands(fmt.Sprintf("%d", n))
}

// formatGSM displays the gross-salary-multiple as a percentage to match
// the provisioning style — YAML stores fractions (e.g. 0.55), UI shows
// "55.00%".
func formatGSM(f float64) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%.2f%%", f*100)
}

func sortedKeys[M ~map[string]V, V any](m M) []string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(m))
	for k := range m {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	return keys
}

// =============================================
// EDIT HELPERS

func buildEditRows(st plScorecardType, stype string, products []string) []editScoreRow {
	var rows []editScoreRow
	for _, key := range sortedKeys(st.ClientScore) {
		score := st.ClientScore[key]
		if len(score.Products) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		productMap := make(map[string]plProduct)
		for _, p := range score.Products {
			productMap[p.ProductName] = p
		}
		editProds := make([]editProductData, len(products))
		for i, pName := range products {
			editProds[i].ProductName = pName // always set name so header renders
			if p, ok := productMap[pName]; ok {
				core := extractTranche(p.Core)
				test := extractTranche(p.Test)
				editProds[i] = editProductData{
					ProductName: pName,
					Normal:      p.NormalInterestRate,
					Arrears:     p.ArrearsInterestRate,
					MaxTerm:     p.MaxTerm,
					CoreRBL:     core.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit,
					CoreGSM:     core.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement,
					TestRBL:     test.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit,
					TestGSM:     test.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement,
				}
			}
		}
		rows = append(rows, editScoreRow{
			Category:      strings.ToUpper(key),
			ScoreKey:      key,
			ScorecardType: stype,
			Products:      editProds,
		})
	}
	return rows
}

func buildPlatformEditTiers(p platformCountry) (cash []editTierRow, collection []editTierRow) {
	if p.WithdrawalCharges != nil {
		for i, t := range p.WithdrawalCharges.Cash {
			rangeStr := tierRangeStr(i, len(p.WithdrawalCharges.Cash), t.ValueFromInclusive, t.ValueToInclusive)
			cash = append(cash, editTierRow{Index: i, Range: rangeStr, Fee: t.CashWithdrawFee})
		}
	}
	for i, t := range p.CollectionCharges {
		rangeStr := tierRangeStr(i, len(p.CollectionCharges), t.ValueFromInclusive, t.ValueToInclusive)
		collection = append(collection, editTierRow{Index: i, Range: rangeStr, Fee: t.CollectionFee})
	}
	return
}

func tierRangeStr(i, total int, from, to float64) string {
	if i == total-1 {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s+", formatCurrency(from))
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s \u2013 %s", formatCurrency(from), formatCurrency(to))
}

// File names used in the credit-policy repo.
const (
	pricingFile  = "pricing_and_limits.yml"
	platformFile = "platform.yml"
	scrFile      = "score_category_ranges.yml"
	provFile     = "provision.yml"
	throttleFile = "score_category_booster_and_throttle.yml"
)

// trancheKind reports whether a product's "core"/"test" subtree is encoded as
// a mapping (single tranche) or a sequence of tranches. Path generation differs.
func trancheKind(v interface{}) (isList bool) {
	_, ok := v.([]interface{})
	return ok
}

// computeChanges compares submitted values against the loaded config for one country.
// Returns the cell-diff map and DiffEntry slice that the UI needs, plus a structured
// FieldChange slice the publisher consumes (one per changed scalar in the YAML).
func (m *module) computeChanges(cc string, getValue func(key string) string, cfg pricingConfig) (map[string]cellDiff, []DiffEntry, []yamledit.FieldChange) {
	diffCells := make(map[string]cellDiff)
	var diffs []DiffEntry
	var fieldChanges []yamledit.FieldChange

	record := func(fkey, label, section, scoreKey, file string, oldVal, newVal float64, display func(float64) string, raw string, path []string) {
		diffCells[fkey] = cellDiff{Old: display(oldVal), New: display(newVal)}
		diffs = append(diffs, DiffEntry{
			Section:  section,
			ScoreKey: scoreKey,
			Field:    label,
			OldValue: display(oldVal),
			NewValue: display(newVal),
		})
		fieldChanges = append(fieldChanges, yamledit.FieldChange{
			File:     file,
			Path:     path,
			OldValue: strconv.FormatFloat(oldVal, 'f', -1, 64),
			NewValue: raw,
		})
	}

	// recordStr is the non-numeric counterpart to record: the YAML raw value
	// (e.g. "write_off", "true") differs from its display, so old/new are
	// passed as the literal scalar strings the publisher writes.
	recordStr := func(fkey, label, section, file, oldRaw, newRaw string, display func(string) string, path []string) {
		diffCells[fkey] = cellDiff{Old: display(oldRaw), New: display(newRaw)}
		diffs = append(diffs, DiffEntry{
			Section:  section,
			Field:    label,
			OldValue: display(oldRaw),
			NewValue: display(newRaw),
		})
		fieldChanges = append(fieldChanges, yamledit.FieldChange{
			File:     file,
			Path:     path,
			OldValue: oldRaw,
			NewValue: newRaw,
		})
	}

	displayPct := formatPct
	displayCurrency := formatCurrency
	displayMonths := func(f float64) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%d months", int(f)) }
	displayGSM := func(f float64) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%.2f%%", f*100) }
	displayInt := func(f float64) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%d", int(f)) }
	displayWhen := func(s string) string { return capitalise(strings.ReplaceAll(s, "_", " ")) }
	displayDuplum := func(s string) string { return yesNo(s == "true") }

	// pricing_and_limits.yml: per-product fields keyed by scorecard type and score key.
	if c, ok := cfg.pl[cc]; ok {
		for _, stype := range []string{"acquisition", "behaviour"} {
			st, ok := c.ScorecardType[stype]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			for _, key := range sortedKeys(st.ClientScore) {
				score := st.ClientScore[key]
				for prodIdx, p := range score.Products {
					pName := p.ProductName
					core := extractTranche(p.Core)
					test := extractTranche(p.Test)

					prodPath := func(leaf ...string) []string {
						base := []string{cc, "scorecard_type", stype, "client_score", key, "product", strconv.Itoa(prodIdx)}
						return append(base, leaf...)
					}
					tranchePath := func(branch string, isList bool, leaf string) []string {
						p := prodPath(branch)
						if isList {
							p = append(p, "0")
						}
						return append(p, leaf)
					}

					type leaf struct {
						suffix  string
						label   string
						current float64
						display func(float64) string
						path    []string
					}
					leaves := []leaf{
						{"normal", "Normal Rate", p.NormalInterestRate, displayPct, prodPath("normal_interest_rate")},
						{"arrears", "Arrears Rate", p.ArrearsInterestRate, displayPct, prodPath("arrears_interest_rate")},
						{"max_term", "Max Term", float64(p.MaxTerm), displayMonths, prodPath("max_term")},
						{"core_rbl", "Core RBL", core.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit, displayCurrency, tranchePath("core", trancheKind(p.Core), "rule_based_max_disbursement_limit")},
						{"core_gsm", "Core GSM", core.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement, displayGSM, tranchePath("core", trancheKind(p.Core), "gross_salary_multiple_max_disbursement_limit")},
						{"test_rbl", "Test RBL", test.RuleBasedMaxDisbursementLimit, displayCurrency, tranchePath("test", trancheKind(p.Test), "rule_based_max_disbursement_limit")},
						{"test_gsm", "Test GSM", test.GrossSalaryMultipleMaxDisbursement, displayGSM, tranchePath("test", trancheKind(p.Test), "gross_salary_multiple_max_disbursement_limit")},
					}
					for _, l := range leaves {
						fkey := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s_%s", stype, key, pName, l.suffix)
						raw := getValue(fkey)
						if raw == "" {
							continue
						}
						newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
						if err != nil || math.Abs(newVal-l.current) < 1e-9 {
							continue
						}
						label := l.label + " (" + labelProduct(pName) + ")"
						record(fkey, label, stype, strings.ToUpper(key), pricingFile, l.current, newVal, l.display, raw, l.path)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// platform.yml: flat fees + cash/collection tier fees + min-loan (flat first
	// non-zero entry, or per-tier for SA's term-banded form).
	if p, ok := cfg.platform[cc]; ok {
		minLoanTiers := buildMinLoanTiers(p.MinLoanAmountLimit)
		minLoanIdx, minLoan := -1, 0.0
		if len(minLoanTiers) == 0 {
			for i, prod := range p.MinLoanAmountLimit.Products {
				if prod.MinLoanAmount > 0 {
					minLoanIdx, minLoan = i, prod.MinLoanAmount
					break
				}
			}
		}

		type flat struct {
			fkey    string
			label   string
			current float64
			path    []string
			emit    bool
		}
		// Each flat fee is editable only where it's in force (present + positive):
		// statement vs monthly vs mobile money are mutually country-specific.
		statementCurrent, statementEmit := 0.0, false
		if feeActive(p.StatementFee) {
			statementCurrent, statementEmit = *p.StatementFee, true
		}
		monthlyCurrent, monthlyEmit := 0.0, false
		if feeActive(p.MonthlyFee) {
			monthlyCurrent, monthlyEmit = *p.MonthlyFee, true
		}
		roundingCurrent, roundingEmit := 0.0, false
		if p.Rounding != nil {
			roundingCurrent, roundingEmit = *p.Rounding, true
		}
		mobileMoneyCurrent, mobileEmit := 0.0, false
		eftCurrent, eftEmit := 0.0, false
		if w := p.WithdrawalCharges; w != nil {
			if w.MobileMoney > 0 {
				mobileMoneyCurrent, mobileEmit = w.MobileMoney, true
			}
			if w.EFT > 0 {
				eftCurrent, eftEmit = w.EFT, true
			}
		}
		flats := []flat{
			{"platform_monthly_fee", "Monthly Fee", monthlyCurrent, []string{cc, "monthly_fee"}, monthlyEmit},
			{"platform_rounding", "Rounding Amount", roundingCurrent, []string{cc, "rounding"}, roundingEmit},
			{"platform_statement_fee", "Statement Fee", statementCurrent, []string{cc, "statement_fee"}, statementEmit},
			{"platform_mobile_money", "Mobile Money Fee", mobileMoneyCurrent, []string{cc, "withdrawal_charges", "mobile_money"}, mobileEmit},
			{"platform_eft", "EFT Fee", eftCurrent, []string{cc, "withdrawal_charges", "eft"}, eftEmit},
			{"platform_max_cash_disb", "Max Cash Disbursement", p.MaxCashDisbursementLimit, []string{cc, "max_cash_disbursement_limit"}, true},
			{"platform_min_loan", "Min Loan Amount", minLoan, []string{cc, "min_loan_amount_limit", "product", strconv.Itoa(minLoanIdx), "min_loan_amount"}, minLoanIdx >= 0},
		}
		for _, f := range flats {
			raw := getValue(f.fkey)
			if raw == "" || !f.emit {
				continue
			}
			newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
			if err != nil || math.Abs(newVal-f.current) < 1e-9 {
				continue
			}
			record(f.fkey, f.label, "platform", "", platformFile, f.current, newVal, displayCurrency, raw, f.path)
		}

		for _, t := range minLoanTiers {
			fkey := fmt.Sprintf("platform_min_loan_tier_%d", t.ProdIdx)
			raw := getValue(fkey)
			if raw == "" {
				continue
			}
			newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
			if err != nil || math.Abs(newVal-t.Amount) < 1e-9 {
				continue
			}
			path := []string{cc, "min_loan_amount_limit", "product", strconv.Itoa(t.ProdIdx), "min_loan_amount"}
			record(fkey, fmt.Sprintf("Min Loan Amount (%dm term)", t.TermFrom), "platform", "", platformFile, t.Amount, newVal, displayCurrency, raw, path)
		}

		var cashTiers []platformTier
		if p.WithdrawalCharges != nil {
			cashTiers = p.WithdrawalCharges.Cash
		}
		for i, t := range cashTiers {
			fkey := fmt.Sprintf("platform_cash_tier_%d_fee", i)
			raw := getValue(fkey)
			if raw == "" {
				continue
			}
			newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
			if err != nil || math.Abs(newVal-t.CashWithdrawFee) < 1e-9 {
				continue
			}
			path := []string{cc, "withdrawal_charges", "cash", strconv.Itoa(i), "cash_withdraw_fee"}
			record(fkey, fmt.Sprintf("Cash Withdrawal Tier %d Fee", i+1), "platform", "", platformFile, t.CashWithdrawFee, newVal, displayCurrency, raw, path)
		}
		for i, t := range p.CollectionCharges {
			fkey := fmt.Sprintf("platform_collection_tier_%d_fee", i)
			raw := getValue(fkey)
			if raw == "" {
				continue
			}
			newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
			if err != nil || math.Abs(newVal-t.CollectionFee) < 1e-9 {
				continue
			}
			path := []string{cc, "collection_charges", strconv.Itoa(i), "collection_fee"}
			record(fkey, fmt.Sprintf("Collection Tier %d Fee", i+1), "platform", "", platformFile, t.CollectionFee, newVal, displayCurrency, raw, path)
		}

		if rc := p.RecoveryCharges; rc != nil {
			recPath := func(seg ...string) []string {
				return append([]string{cc, "recovery_charges"}, seg...)
			}
			if rc.maxOfIdx >= 0 && rc.pctIdx >= 0 {
				if raw := getValue("platform_recovery_percentage"); raw != "" {
					if newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64); err == nil && math.Abs(newVal-rc.Percentage) >= 1e-9 {
						path := recPath(strconv.Itoa(rc.maxOfIdx), "maximum_of", strconv.Itoa(rc.pctIdx), "percentage")
						record("platform_recovery_percentage", "Recovery Percentage", "platform", "", platformFile, rc.Percentage, newVal, displayPct, raw, path)
					}
				}
			}
			if rc.maxOfIdx >= 0 && rc.feeIdx >= 0 {
				if raw := getValue("platform_recovery_fixed_fee"); raw != "" {
					if newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64); err == nil && math.Abs(newVal-rc.FixedFee) >= 1e-9 {
						path := recPath(strconv.Itoa(rc.maxOfIdx), "maximum_of", strconv.Itoa(rc.feeIdx), "fixed_fee")
						record("platform_recovery_fixed_fee", "Recovery Fixed Fee", "platform", "", platformFile, rc.FixedFee, newVal, displayCurrency, raw, path)
					}
				}
			}
			if rc.whenIdx >= 0 {
				if raw := getValue("platform_recovery_when"); raw != "" && raw != rc.When {
					path := recPath(strconv.Itoa(rc.whenIdx), "when")
					recordStr("platform_recovery_when", "Recovery When", "platform", platformFile, rc.When, raw, displayWhen, path)
				}
			}
			if rc.inDuplumIdx >= 0 {
				newDuplum := getValue("platform_recovery_in_duplum") == "true"
				if newDuplum != rc.InDuplum {
					path := recPath(strconv.Itoa(rc.inDuplumIdx), "subject_to_in_duplum")
					recordStr("platform_recovery_in_duplum", "Recovery In Duplum", "platform", platformFile, strconv.FormatBool(rc.InDuplum), strconv.FormatBool(newDuplum), displayDuplum, path)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// score_category_ranges.yml: from/to per scorecard type + key.
	if c, ok := cfg.scr[cc]; ok {
		for _, stype := range []string{"acquisition", "behaviour"} {
			st, ok := c.ScorecardType[stype]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			for _, key := range sortedKeys(st.ClientScore) {
				cs := st.ClientScore[key]
				type cutoff struct {
					suffix  string
					label   string
					current float64
					yamlKey string
				}
				cutoffs := []cutoff{
					{"score_from", "Score From", float64(cs.ScoreRangeFrom), "score_range_from_inclusive"},
					{"score_to", "Score To", float64(cs.ScoreRangeTo), "score_range_to_inclusive"},
				}
				for _, co := range cutoffs {
					fkey := fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s", stype, key, co.suffix)
					raw := getValue(fkey)
					if raw == "" {
						continue
					}
					newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
					if err != nil || math.Abs(newVal-co.current) < 1 {
						continue
					}
					path := []string{cc, "scorecard_type", stype, "client_score", key, co.yamlKey}
					record(fkey, co.label, stype, strings.ToUpper(key), scrFile, co.current, newVal, displayInt, raw, path)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Provisioning + Booster/Throttle fields share the same accumulators.
	computeProvisioningFields(cc, getValue, cfg, diffCells, &diffs, &fieldChanges)
	computeThrottleFields(cc, getValue, cfg, diffCells, &diffs, &fieldChanges)

	return diffCells, diffs, fieldChanges
}

func (m *module) buildDiffCells(r *http.Request, cc string, cfg pricingConfig) (map[string]cellDiff, []DiffEntry, []yamledit.FieldChange) {
	return m.computeChanges(cc, r.FormValue, cfg)
}

func (m *module) buildDiffCellsFromMap(cc string, values map[string]string, cfg pricingConfig) (map[string]cellDiff, []DiffEntry, []yamledit.FieldChange) {
	return m.computeChanges(cc, func(k string) string { return values[k] }, cfg)
}

// =============================================
// EDIT / PREVIEW / SUBMIT HANDLERS

func (m *module) pricingEditLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	// Editing the credit policy is restricted to the approver list.
	// Non-approvers are bounced back to the read-only view.
	if !m.isApprover(u.Email) {
		http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", getCountryParam(r)), http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}

	activeCountry := getCountryParam(r)
	cfg, err := m.loadConfig(ctx, activeCountry)
	if err != nil {
		return creditPolicyUnavailablePage(r, err.Error()).Render(ctx, w)
	}
	activeSection := r.URL.Query().Get("section")
	validSections := map[string]bool{"cutoffs": true, "limits": true, "terms": true, "interest-rate": true, "fees": true}
	if !validSections[activeSection] {
		activeSection = "limits"
	}

	pendingByCountry, perr := m.loadPendingByCountry(ctx)
	if perr != nil {
		m.l.Printf("WARN list pending for edit page: %v", perr)
	}

	var panels []countryEditPanel
	for _, cc := range cfg.codes {
		panel := countryEditPanel{
			CC:    cc,
			Label: countryName(cc),
		}
		if id, ok := pendingByCountry[cc]; ok {
			panel.HasPending = true
			panel.PendingID = id
		}

		if c, ok := cfg.pl[cc]; ok {
			if st, ok := c.ScorecardType["acquisition"]; ok {
				prods := collectProducts(st)
				panel.AcqEditRows = buildEditRows(st, "acquisition", prods)
			}
			if st, ok := c.ScorecardType["behaviour"]; ok {
				prods := collectProducts(st)
				panel.BhvEditRows = buildEditRows(st, "behaviour", prods)
			}
		}

		if p, ok := cfg.platform[cc]; ok {
			panel.CashTiers, panel.CollectionTiers = buildPlatformEditTiers(p)
			if feeActive(p.StatementFee) {
				panel.HasStatement = true
				panel.StatementFee = *p.StatementFee
			}
			if feeActive(p.MonthlyFee) {
				panel.HasMonthly = true
				panel.MonthlyFee = *p.MonthlyFee
			}
			if p.Rounding != nil {
				panel.HasRounding = true
				panel.RoundingAmount = *p.Rounding
			}
			if w := p.WithdrawalCharges; w != nil {
				if w.MobileMoney > 0 {
					panel.HasMobileMoney = true
					panel.MobileMoneyFee = w.MobileMoney
				}
				if w.EFT > 0 {
					panel.HasEFT = true
					panel.EFTFee = w.EFT
				}
			}
			panel.MaxCashDisb = p.MaxCashDisbursementLimit
			if rc := p.RecoveryCharges; rc != nil {
				panel.HasRecovery = true
				panel.RecoveryPct = rc.Percentage
				panel.RecoveryFee = rc.FixedFee
				panel.RecoveryInDuplum = rc.InDuplum
				panel.RecoveryWhen = rc.When
			}
			if panel.MinLoanTiers = buildMinLoanTiers(p.MinLoanAmountLimit); len(panel.MinLoanTiers) == 0 {
				for _, prod := range p.MinLoanAmountLimit.Products {
					if prod.MinLoanAmount > 0 {
						panel.MinLoanAmount = prod.MinLoanAmount
						break
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if c, ok := cfg.scr[cc]; ok {
			if acq, ok := c.ScorecardType["acquisition"]; ok {
				panel.AcqCutoffs = buildCutoffRows(acq)
			}
			if bhv, ok := c.ScorecardType["behaviour"]; ok {
				panel.BhvCutoffs = buildCutoffRows(bhv)
			}
		}

		if pc, ok := cfg.prov[cc]; ok {
			if acq, ok := pc.ScorecardType["acquisition"]; ok {
				panel.AcqProvRows = buildProvisionEditRows(acq, "acquisition")
			}
			if bhv, ok := pc.ScorecardType["behaviour"]; ok {
				panel.BhvProvRows = buildProvisionEditRows(bhv, "behaviour")
			}
		}

		if tnb, ok := cfg.tnb[cc]; ok {
			panel.Booster = buildBoosterEditTable(tnb.Booster)
			panel.ThrottleLimit = tnb.Throttle.ThrottleLimit
			panel.ThrottleBasis = tnb.Throttle.ThrottleBasis
		}

		panels = append(panels, panel)
	}

	// Determine active country: use first available if not specified or invalid.
	validCC := false
	for _, p := range panels {
		if p.CC == activeCountry {
			validCC = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !validCC && len(panels) > 0 {
		activeCountry = panels[0].CC
	}

	return pricingAllCountriesEditPage(allCountriesEditPageData{
		r:             r,
		CountryPanels: panels,
		UserCountries: userCountriesFromCfg(cfg),
		UserEmail:     u.Email,
		ActiveCountry: activeCountry,
		ActiveSection: activeSection,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) pricingPreviewHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	// Use ParseMultipartForm — the edit page sends form data via fetch as
	// multipart/form-data, which ParseForm alone doesn't decode. After
	// ParseForm runs r.Form is non-nil, so FormValue skips its lazy
	// multipart parse and every field returns "". ParseMultipartForm
	// covers both content types.
	if err := r.ParseMultipartForm(32 << 20); err != nil && err != http.ErrNotMultipart {
		return err
	}

	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !m.isApprover(u.Email) {
		http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", r.FormValue("country")), http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}

	cc := r.FormValue("country")
	cfg, err := m.loadConfig(ctx, cc)
	if err != nil {
		return creditPolicyUnavailablePage(r, err.Error()).Render(ctx, w)
	}

	_, diffs, fieldChanges := m.buildDiffCells(r, cc, cfg)
	diffsJSON, _ := json.Marshal(diffs)
	fieldChangesJSON, _ := json.Marshal(fieldChanges)

	d := previewPageData{
		r:                r,
		SelectedCountry:  cc,
		UserCountries:    userCountriesFromCfg(cfg),
		Diffs:            diffs,
		DiffsJSON:        string(diffsJSON),
		FieldChangesJSON: string(fieldChangesJSON),
	}

	// Modal fetch from the edit page sets X-Partial; everything else falls
	// through to the full-page version (kept as a no-JS fallback).
	if r.Header.Get("X-Partial") == "1" {
		return pricingPreviewPartial(d).Render(ctx, w)
	}
	return pricingPreviewPage(d).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) pricingSubmitHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !m.isApprover(u.Email) {
		http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", r.FormValue("country")), http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}

	cc := r.FormValue("country")
	if cc == "" {
		http.Error(w, "country required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return nil
	}

	existing, err := m.bq.PendingForCountry(ctx, m.bqPending, cc)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("submit: lookup existing pending: %w", err)
	}
	if existing != nil {
		http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", cc), http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}

	var diffs []DiffEntry
	if raw := r.FormValue("diffs_json"); raw != "" {
		_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &diffs)
	}
	var fieldChanges []yamledit.FieldChange
	if raw := r.FormValue("field_changes_json"); raw != "" {
		_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &fieldChanges)
	}
	if len(fieldChanges) == 0 {
		http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", cc), http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	change := PendingChange{
		ID:               fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", now.Format("20060102-150405"), cc),
		Tools:            toolsFromFieldChanges(fieldChanges),
		Country:          cc,
		SubmittedAt:      now,
		SubmittedByEmail: u.Email,
		SubmittedByName:  u.Name,
		Status:           StatusPending,
		Approvals:        []string{},
		Diffs:            diffs,
		FieldChanges:     fieldChanges,
	}

	// Auto-approve: members of the auto-approver list have their own
	// submission count as their first approval. If that meets quorum, we
	// publish immediately so the user doesn't have to click Approve.
	autoApproved := m.isApprover(u.Email) && m.isAutoApprover(u.Email)
	if autoApproved {
		change.Approvals = []string{u.Email}
	}

	row, err := pendingChangeToRow(change, now)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("submit: build row: %w", err)
	}
	if err := m.bq.InsertPending(ctx, m.bqPending, row); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("submit: insert pending: %w", err)
	}

	if autoApproved && len(change.Approvals) >= m.quorum {
		if pubErr := m.publishChange(ctx, &change); pubErr != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR auto-publishing change %s: %v", change.ID, pubErr)
		}
		if perr := m.persistPending(ctx, change); perr != nil {
			return perr
		}
	}

	http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s&submitted=1", cc), http.StatusSeeOther)
	return nil
}

// toolsFromFieldChanges derives the informational `Tools` slice from the set
// of files touched in a change. Used purely for UI labelling.
func toolsFromFieldChanges(fieldChanges []yamledit.FieldChange) []string {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, fc := range fieldChanges {
		switch fc.File {
		case provFile:
			seen[ToolProvisioning] = true
		case throttleFile:
			seen[ToolThrottle] = true
		default:
			seen[ToolPricing] = true
		}
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
	for _, t := range []string{ToolPricing, ToolProvisioning, ToolThrottle} {
		if seen[t] {
			out = append(out, t)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// =============================================
// APPROVALS HANDLERS

func (m *module) pricingApprovalsLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	// Approvals pages only need the country list (for the dropdown), not
	// any per-country YAML. Pass empty cc to skip the file reads.
	cfg, err := m.loadConfig(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		return creditPolicyUnavailablePage(r, err.Error()).Render(ctx, w)
	}

	rows, err := m.bq.ListPending(ctx, m.bqPending, "")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("approvals list: %w", err)
	}
	changes, err := pendingChangesFromRows(rows)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("approvals deserialize: %w", err)
	}

	return pricingApprovalsPage(approvalsPageData{
		r:             r,
		UserCountries: userCountriesFromCfg(cfg),
		ActiveCountry: firstCountryCode(cfg),
		Changes:       changes,
		IsApprover:    m.isApprover(u.Email),
		Quorum:        m.quorum,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) pricingApprovalDetailLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	id := r.PathValue("id")
	row, err := m.bq.GetPending(ctx, m.bqPending, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("approval detail: %w", err)
	}
	if row == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("change %q not found", id)
	}
	change, err := pendingChangeFromRow(*row)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("approval detail deserialize: %w", err)
	}

	alreadyApproved := false
	for _, email := range change.Approvals {
		if email == u.Email {
			alreadyApproved = true
			break
		}
	}

	// Approvals detail only needs the country list (for the dropdown).
	cfg, err := m.loadConfig(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		return creditPolicyUnavailablePage(r, err.Error()).Render(ctx, w)
	}
	return pricingApprovalDetailPage(approvalDetailData{
		r:               r,
		UserCountries:   userCountriesFromCfg(cfg),
		ActiveCountry:   ifCountryReal(change.Country, firstCountryCode(cfg)),
		Change:          change,
		CountryLabel:    displayCountry(change.Country),
		IsApprover:      m.isApprover(u.Email),
		AlreadyApproved: alreadyApproved,
		IsSubmitter:     u.Email == change.SubmittedByEmail,
		Quorum:          m.quorum,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

// getCountryParam reads the active country from the URL. The flag dropdown
// (country.CCDropdown) submits as `?cc=`; older internal links use `?country=`.
// Both are accepted; `?cc=` wins when both are present. Falls back to the
// user's profile country (auth.User.CC) when neither is set, so navigating
// into the tool from elsewhere doesn't snap to alphabetical-first.
func getCountryParam(r *http.Request) string {
	if cc := r.URL.Query().Get("cc"); cc != "" {
		return cc
	}
	if cc := r.URL.Query().Get("country"); cc != "" {
		return cc
	}
	return auth.FromCtx(r.Context()).User.CC
}

// firstCountryCode returns the first country code in cfg.codes (or "" if none).
// Used to pick a default flag when no country context is available.
func firstCountryCode(cfg pricingConfig) string {
	if len(cfg.codes) > 0 {
		return cfg.codes[0]
	}
	return ""
}

// ifCountryReal returns cc if it's a real country code, else fallback.
func ifCountryReal(cc, fallback string) string {
	if cc == "" {
		return fallback
	}
	return cc
}

func (m *module) pricingApproveHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !m.isApprover(u.Email) {
		http.Error(w, "Not authorized to approve", http.StatusForbidden)
		return nil
	}

	id := r.PathValue("id")
	row, err := m.bq.GetPending(ctx, m.bqPending, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("approve: get: %w", err)
	}
	if row == nil || row.Status != StatusPending {
		http.Redirect(w, r, "/tools/credit-policy/approvals", http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}
	change, err := pendingChangeFromRow(*row)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("approve: deserialize: %w", err)
	}

	// Submitters cannot approve their own change — second-person sign-off
	// is the whole point of the approval step.
	if change.SubmittedByEmail == u.Email {
		http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/approvals/%s", id), http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}

	for _, email := range change.Approvals {
		if email == u.Email {
			http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/approvals/%s", id), http.StatusSeeOther)
			return nil
		}
	}

	change.Approvals = append(change.Approvals, u.Email)
	if len(change.Approvals) >= m.quorum {
		if pubErr := m.publishChange(ctx, &change); pubErr != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR publishing change %s: %v", id, pubErr)
		}
	}
	if perr := m.persistPending(ctx, change); perr != nil {
		return perr
	}

	http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/approvals/%s", id), http.StatusSeeOther)
	return nil
}

func (m *module) pricingCancelHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	id := r.PathValue("id")
	row, err := m.bq.GetPending(ctx, m.bqPending, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cancel: get: %w", err)
	}
	if row == nil || row.Status != StatusPending || row.SubmittedByEmail != u.Email {
		http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", idCountry(id)), http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}
	change, err := pendingChangeFromRow(*row)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cancel: deserialize: %w", err)
	}
	change.Status = StatusCancelled
	if perr := m.persistPending(ctx, change); perr != nil {
		return perr
	}

	http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", idCountry(id)), http.StatusSeeOther)
	return nil
}

// pricingRepublishHandler retries the git push for a change that previously
// reached applied_pending_push or failed *after* BQ already succeeded.
// Only approvers may call this, and only for the eligible statuses.
func (m *module) pricingRepublishHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	if !m.isApprover(u.Email) {
		http.Error(w, "Not authorized to republish", http.StatusForbidden)
		return nil
	}

	id := r.PathValue("id")
	row, err := m.bq.GetPending(ctx, m.bqPending, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("republish: get: %w", err)
	}
	if row == nil {
		http.Redirect(w, r, "/tools/credit-policy/approvals", http.StatusSeeOther)
		return nil
	}
	change, err := pendingChangeFromRow(*row)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("republish: deserialize: %w", err)
	}
	if pubErr := m.republishChange(ctx, &change); pubErr != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR republishing %s: %v", id, pubErr)
	}
	if perr := m.persistPending(ctx, change); perr != nil {
		return perr
	}
	http.Redirect(w, r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/approvals/%s", id), http.StatusSeeOther)
	return nil
}

// persistPending writes the post-mutation state back to BQ. Used by every
// handler that mutates an existing pending change (approve / cancel /
// republish). The publisher mutates the in-memory PendingChange; the
// caller is responsible for persisting.
func (m *module) persistPending(ctx context.Context, ch PendingChange) error {
	row, err := pendingChangeToRow(ch, time.Now().UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("persist pending: build row: %w", err)
	}
	if err := m.bq.UpdatePending(ctx, m.bqPending, row); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("persist pending: update: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// loadPendingByCountry returns a country→change_id map of currently-pending
// changes. Used by the edit page to mark per-country panels as locked.
func (m *module) loadPendingByCountry(ctx context.Context) (map[string]string, error) {
	rows, err := m.bq.ListPending(ctx, m.bqPending, StatusPending)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make(map[string]string, len(rows))
	for _, r := range rows {
		out[r.Country] = r.ChangeID
	}
	return out, nil
}

// shortSHA returns the first 8 characters of a commit SHA for display.
// sectionOrDefault returns a fallback when no section param is set; used by
// templ tab links so the user lands on a sensible default after switching parent.
func sectionOrDefault(s string) string {
	if s == "" {
		return "limits"
	}
	return s
}

func shortSHA(sha string) string {
	if len(sha) < 8 {
		return sha
	}
	return sha[:8]
}

// idCountry extracts the country code from a change ID formatted as "YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-cc".
func idCountry(id string) string {
	parts := strings.SplitN(id, "-", 3)
	if len(parts) == 3 {
		return parts[2]
	}
	return ""
}

func (m *module) isApprover(email string) bool {
	for _, a := range m.approvers {
		if a == email {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// isAutoApprover reports whether the submitter's own submission should count
// as their first approval (skipping the explicit Approve click). Only
// meaningful for emails that are ALSO in m.approvers — non-approvers cannot
// auto-approve themselves into a publish.
func (m *module) isAutoApprover(email string) bool {
	for _, a := range m.autoApprovers {
		if a == email {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
```

```templ
package creditpolicy

			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex gap-1 pt-2">
					@viewSectionBtn(d.SelectedSection, "limits", "Limits")
					@viewSectionBtn(d.SelectedSection, "cutoffs", "Cutoffs")
					@viewSectionBtn(d.SelectedSection, "terms", "Terms")
					@viewSectionBtn(d.SelectedSection, "interest-rate", "Interest Rate")

				</div>

				</div>

			<!-- Provisioning parent -->
			<div data-parent-panel="provisioning" hidden?={ d.SelectedParent != "provisioning" }>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
					@provisionViewTable("Acquisition", d.AcqProvRows)
					@provisionViewTable("Behaviour", d.BhvProvRows)
				</div>
			</div>
			<!-- Booster & Throttle parent -->
			<div data-parent-panel="throttle" hidden?={ d.SelectedParent != "throttle" }>
				<div class="space-y-6">
					@throttleViewCard(d.ThrottleLimit, d.ThrottleBasis)
					@boosterViewSection(d.Booster)
				</div>
			</div>
```
