```templ
		<script>
			(function() {
				var cfg = document.getElementById('view-config');
				var activeParent = cfg ? cfg.dataset.activeParent : 'pricing';
				var activeSection = cfg ? cfg.dataset.activeSection : 'limits';

				function showSection(section) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-panel]').forEach(function(p) { p.hidden = true; });
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-panel="' + section + '"]').forEach(function(sp) { sp.hidden = false; });
				}

				function showParent(parent) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-parent-panel]').forEach(function(p) {
						p.hidden = (p.dataset.parentPanel !== parent);
					});
					var sectionStrip = document.querySelector('[data-section-strip]');
					if (sectionStrip) sectionStrip.hidden = (parent !== 'pricing');
				}

				function updateParentTabs(parent) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-parent-btn]').forEach(function(b) {
						var on = b.dataset.parentBtn === parent;
						b.className = on
							? 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px'
							: 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors';
					});
				}

				function updateSectionTabs(section) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-btn]').forEach(function(b) {
						var on = b.dataset.sectionBtn === section;
						b.className = on
							? 'px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px'
							: 'px-5 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors';
					});
				}

				document.querySelectorAll('[data-parent-btn]').forEach(function(btn) {
					btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
						activeParent = this.dataset.parentBtn;
						showParent(activeParent);
						updateParentTabs(activeParent);
						var u = new URL(window.location);
						u.searchParams.set('parent', activeParent);
						history.replaceState({}, '', u.toString());
					});
				});

				document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-btn]').forEach(function(btn) {
					btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
						activeSection = this.dataset.sectionBtn;
						showSection(activeSection);
						updateSectionTabs(activeSection);
						var u = new URL(window.location);
						u.searchParams.set('section', activeSection);
						history.replaceState({}, '', u.toString());
					});
				});
			})();
		</script>
	}
}

templ viewParentTabBtn(parent, label string, active bool) {
	if active {
		<button type="button" data-parent-btn={ parent } class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px">{ label }</button>
	} else {
		<button type="button" data-parent-btn={ parent } class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors">{ label }</button>
	}
}

templ viewSectionBtn(active, section, label string) {
	if active == section {
		<button type="button" data-section-btn={ section } class="px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px">{ label }</button>
	} else {
		<button type="button" data-section-btn={ section } class="px-5 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors">{ label }</button>
	}
}

templ subTab(r *http.Request, country, active, section, label string) {
	if active == section {
		<a
			href={ uj.SafeHref(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s&section=%s", country, section)) }
			class="px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px"
		>{ label }</a>
	} else {
		<a
			href={ uj.SafeHref(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s&section=%s", country, section)) }
			class="px-5 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors"
		>{ label }</a>
	}
}

// parentTab renders one of the parent tabs (Pricing & Limits / Provisioning /
// Throttle & Boosting) on the gray strip below the header. activeParent is
// the parent currently being viewed; tabParent is the parent this tab
// represents. section is the pricing-side subsection (preserved when switching
// back into Pricing).
templ parentTab(r *http.Request, country, activeParent, tabParent, label, section string) {
	if activeParent == tabParent {
		<span class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px">{ label }</span>
	} else if tabParent == "pricing" {
		<a
			href={ uj.SafeHref(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s&section=%s", country, sectionOrDefault(section))) }
			class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors"
		>{ label }</a>
	} else if tabParent == "provisioning" {
		<a
			href={ uj.SafeHref(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s&parent=provisioning", country)) }
			class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors"
		>{ label }</a>
	} else {
		<a
			href={ uj.SafeHref(r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s&parent=throttle", country)) }
			class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors"
		>{ label }</a>
	}
}

templ termsTable(title string, products []string, rows []limitRow) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ title }</h3>
		</div>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Score</th>
							for _, prod := range products {
								<th class="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-l border-gray-200 bg-gray-50">{ capitalise(prod) }</th>
							}
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, row := range rows {
							<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
								<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{ row.Category }</td>
								for i := range products {
									if i < len(row.ProductLimits) {
										<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-center text-gray-700 border-l border-gray-200">{ row.ProductLimits[i].MaxTerm }</td>
									} else {
										<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-400 border-l border-gray-200">&#x2014;</td>
									}
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

// =============================================
// SECTION: INTEREST RATE
templ interestRateSection(d pricingPageData) {
	<div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
		@interestRateTable("Acquisition", d.AcqProducts, d.AcqRows)
		@interestRateTable("Behaviour", d.BhvProducts, d.BhvRows)
	</div>
}

templ interestRateTable(title string, products []string, rows []scoreRow) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ title }</h3>
		</div>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider" rowspan="2">Score</th>
							for _, prod := range products {
								<th class="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-l border-gray-200 bg-gray-50" colspan="2">{ capitalise(prod) }</th>
							}
						</tr>
						<tr>
							for range products {
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 text-center border-l border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/50">Normal</th>
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 text-center bg-gray-50/50">Arrears</th>
							}
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, row := range rows {
							<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
								<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{ row.Category }</td>
								for _, rate := range row.ProductRates {
									<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-700 text-center border-l border-gray-200">{ rate.Normal }</td>
									<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-700 text-center">{ rate.Arrears }</td>
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

// =============================================
// SECTION: FEES
templ feeTierTable(rangeHeader string, rows []feeTierRow) {
	<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
		<thead class="bg-gray-50">
			<tr>
				<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">{ rangeHeader }</th>
				<th class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Fee</th>
			</tr>
		</thead>
		<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
			for _, row := range rows {
				<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
					<td class="px-6 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700">{ row.Range }</td>
					<td class="px-6 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 text-right">{ row.Fee }</td>
				</tr>
			}
		</tbody>
	</table>
}

templ editTierTable(title, namePrefix string, rows []editTierRow, disabled bool) {
	<div>
		<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-3">{ title }</p>
		<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
			<thead class="bg-gray-50">
				<tr>
					<th class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Range</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-2 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase">Fee</th>
				</tr>
			</thead>
			<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
				for _, t := range rows {
					<tr>
						<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-600">{ t.Range }</td>
						<td class="px-2 py-1 text-right">
							<input
								type="number"
								step="0.01"
								min="0"
								name={ fmt.Sprintf("platform_%s_tier_%d_fee", namePrefix, t.Index) }
								value={ strconv.FormatFloat(t.Fee, 'f', -1, 64) }
								disabled?={ disabled }
								class="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark text-right disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
							/>
						</td>
					</tr>
				}
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
}

templ feesSection(d pricingPageData) {
	<div class="space-y-6">
		<!-- Tiered fees — each card renders only where its data exists -->
		<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
			if len(d.CashTiers) > 0 {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
					<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
						<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Cash Withdrawal Fee</h3>
					</div>
					@feeTierTable("Amount Range", d.CashTiers)
				</div>
			}
			if len(d.CollectionTiers) > 0 {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
					<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
						<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Collection Fee</h3>
					</div>
					@feeTierTable("Balance Range", d.CollectionTiers)
				</div>
			}
			if d.InitiationDisplay != "" {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
					<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
						<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Initiation Fee</h3>
					</div>
					<div class="px-6 py-4">
						<p class="text-sm text-gray-700 whitespace-pre-line">{ d.InitiationDisplay }</p>
					</div>
				</div>
			}
			if d.Recovery.Present {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
					<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
						<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Recovery Fee</h3>
					</div>
					<dl class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
						<div class="flex justify-between px-6 py-3">
							<dt class="text-sm text-gray-500">Fee</dt>
							<dd class="text-sm text-gray-900 text-right">{ d.Recovery.Formula }</dd>
						</div>
						<div class="flex justify-between px-6 py-3">
							<dt class="text-sm text-gray-500">When</dt>
							<dd class="text-sm text-gray-900 text-right">{ d.Recovery.When }</dd>
						</div>
						<div class="flex justify-between px-6 py-3">
							<dt class="text-sm text-gray-500">Subject to In Duplum</dt>
							<dd class="text-sm text-gray-900 text-right">{ d.Recovery.InDuplum }</dd>
						</div>
					</dl>
				</div>
			}
			if d.CoreTestSplit.Present {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
					<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
						<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ fmt.Sprintf("Core / Test Split (%s)", d.CoreTestSplit.Countries) }</h3>
					</div>
					<dl class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, row := range d.CoreTestSplit.Rows {
							<div class="px-6 py-3">
								<p class="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">{ row.Scorecard }</p>
								<div class="flex justify-between">
									<span class="text-sm text-gray-500">Core</span>
									<span class="text-sm text-gray-900">{ row.CoreRange }</span>
								</div>
								<div class="flex justify-between">
									<span class="text-sm text-gray-500">Test</span>
									<span class="text-sm text-gray-900">{ row.TestRange }</span>
								</div>
							</div>
						}
					</dl>
				</div>
			}
			for _, slot := range d.FeeSlots {
				<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col divide-y divide-gray-100">
					for _, row := range chunkFees(slot, 2) {
						<div class="flex-1 px-6 py-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6">
							for _, fee := range row {
								<div>
									<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">{ fee.Label }</p>
									<p class="text-lg text-gray-900">{ fee.Value }</p>
								</div>
							}
						</div>
					}
				</div>
			}
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col divide-y divide-gray-100">
				<div class="flex-1 px-6 py-5">
					<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Min Loan Amount</p>
					if len(d.MinLoanTiers) > 0 {
						<ul class="space-y-0.5 mt-1">
							for _, t := range d.MinLoanTiers {
								<li class="flex justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
									<span class="text-gray-500">{ fmt.Sprintf("%dm term", t.TermFrom) }</span>
									<span class="text-gray-900">{ formatCurrency(t.Amount) }</span>
								</li>
							}
						</ul>
					} else {
						<p class="text-lg text-gray-900">{ formatCurrency(d.MinLoanAmount) }</p>
					}
				</div>
				<div class="flex-1 px-6 py-5">
					<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Max Cash Disbursement</p>
					<p class="text-lg text-gray-900">{ formatCurrency(d.MaxCashDisb) }</p>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
}

templ otherSection(d pricingPageData) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 px-6 py-12 flex justify-center items-center">
		<p class="text-sm text-gray-400">Nothing here yet.</p>
	</div>

// =============================================
// EDIT PAGE (all countries + sections in DOM)
templ pricingAllCountriesEditPage(d allCountriesEditPageData) {
	@layout.Html("Credit Policy — Edit") {
		<div id="edit-config" data-active-cc={ d.ActiveCountry } data-active-section={ d.ActiveSection } hidden></div>
		<!-- Sticky edit banner -->
		<div class="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-amber-50 border-b border-amber-200 shadow-sm">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-2 md:px-3 xl:px-0 py-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
				<span class="text-amber-700 font-semibold text-sm shrink-0">✎ Edit Mode — { countryName(d.ActiveCountry) }</span>
				<div class="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
					<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s&section=%s", d.ActiveCountry, d.ActiveSection)) } class="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-amber-700 border border-amber-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-amber-100 transition-colors">Discard</a>
					<button id="preview-changes-btn" type="button" disabled class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold bg-red-x-dark text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-x-light transition-colors disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:hover:bg-red-x-dark">Preview Changes →</button>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		@creditPolicyHeader(d.r, "Edit Credit Policy", d.ActiveCountry, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy?country=%s", d.ActiveCountry), d.UserCountries) {
		}
		<!-- Parent tabs (Pricing & Limits / Provisioning / Throttle & Boosting) -->
		<div class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex gap-1 pt-2">
					@editParentTabBtn("pricing", "Pricing & Limits", true)
					@editParentTabBtn("provisioning", "Provisioning", false)
					@editParentTabBtn("throttle", "Throttle & Boosting", false)
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Section tabs (visible only inside Pricing parent) -->
		<div data-section-strip class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex gap-1 pt-2">
					@editSectionTab(d.ActiveSection, "limits", "Limits")
					@editSectionTab(d.ActiveSection, "cutoffs", "Cutoffs")
					@editSectionTab(d.ActiveSection, "terms", "Terms")
					@editSectionTab(d.ActiveSection, "interest-rate", "Interest Rate")
					@editSectionTab(d.ActiveSection, "fees", "Fees & Other")
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Per-country banners (foreign-author draft, pending approval) live
		     OUTSIDE the main edit form because they each contain their own
		     <form>; nesting them would break HTML parsing of the outer form. -->
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-2 md:px-3 xl:px-0 pt-4">
			for _, panel := range d.CountryPanels {
				@editCountryBanner(panel, d.UserEmail, panel.CC == d.ActiveCountry)
			}
		</div>
		<!-- Only the active country's panel is rendered. Form-key names are
		     not country-scoped (e.g. "acquisition_a1_unsecured_normal"), so
		     including hidden panels would submit ALL countries' values under
		     the same name — and r.Form.Get returns the first, producing
		     phantom diffs against the active country's YAML. Country
		     switching does a server reload, so one panel is sufficient. -->
		<!-- novalidate: YAML-loaded values may not match input step= constraints
		     (e.g. interest rate 0.2775 with step="0.001"); the browser would
		     refuse to submit and try to focus a hidden invalid field. The
		     server validates with strconv.ParseFloat. -->
		<form id="credit-policy-edit-form" method="POST" novalidate class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-2 md:px-3 xl:px-0 py-6 mb-12">
			<input type="hidden" name="country" value={ d.ActiveCountry }/>
			<input type="hidden" name="section" value={ d.ActiveSection }/>
			for _, panel := range d.CountryPanels {
				if panel.CC == d.ActiveCountry {
					@editCountryPanel(panel, d.ActiveSection, d.UserEmail, true)
				}
			}
		</form>
		<!-- Preview modal — populated by fetch when "Preview Changes" is clicked.
		     Lives outside the edit form so the form (and all its in-progress
		     state) stays intact while the modal is open.
		     Display toggled via inline style: combining the HTML `hidden`
		     attribute with Tailwind's `flex` class doesn't work — `flex`
		     wins the cascade and the overlay stays visible, covering and
		     blocking the entire page. -->
		<div id="preview-modal" style="display:none" class="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/50 items-center justify-center p-4">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl overflow-hidden" id="preview-modal-body"></div>
		</div>
		<!-- JS — client-side parent + section tab toggling -->
		<script>
			(function() {
				var cfg = document.getElementById('edit-config');
				var activeSection = cfg ? cfg.dataset.activeSection : 'limits';
				var activeParent = 'pricing';

				function showSection(section) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-panel]').forEach(function(p) { p.hidden = true; });
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-panel="' + section + '"]').forEach(function(sp) { sp.hidden = false; });
				}

				function updateSectionTabs(section) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-btn]').forEach(function(b) {
						var on = b.dataset.sectionBtn === section;
						b.className = on
							? 'px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px'
							: 'px-5 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors';
					});
				}

				function showParent(parent) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-parent-panel]').forEach(function(p) {
						p.hidden = (p.dataset.parentPanel !== parent);
					});
					var sectionStrip = document.querySelector('[data-section-strip]');
					if (sectionStrip) sectionStrip.hidden = (parent !== 'pricing');
				}

				function updateParentTabs(parent) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-parent-btn]').forEach(function(b) {
						var on = b.dataset.parentBtn === parent;
						b.className = on
							? 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px'
							: 'px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors';
					});
				}

				document.querySelectorAll('[data-section-btn]').forEach(function(btn) {
					btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
						activeSection = this.dataset.sectionBtn;
						showSection(activeSection);
						updateSectionTabs(activeSection);
						var u = new URL(window.location);
						u.searchParams.set('section', activeSection);
						history.replaceState({}, '', u.toString());
					});
				});

				document.querySelectorAll('[data-parent-btn]').forEach(function(btn) {
					btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
						activeParent = this.dataset.parentBtn;
						showParent(activeParent);
						updateParentTabs(activeParent);
					});
				});

				// Preview Changes button: only enable once an input has actually
				// changed. Comparison is against each control's defaultValue /
				// defaultChecked / defaultSelected (which reflects what was
				// rendered on this page load), so refresh resets the dirty state.
				var previewBtn = document.getElementById('preview-changes-btn');
				var editForm = document.getElementById('credit-policy-edit-form');
				var modal = document.getElementById('preview-modal');
				var modalBody = document.getElementById('preview-modal-body');

				if (editForm) {
					// Swallow Enter inside text/number inputs — it otherwise
					// submits the form (which we now drive explicitly via the
					// Preview button) and would destroy the in-progress draft.
					editForm.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
						if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
						var t = (e.target.tagName || '').toUpperCase();
						if (t === 'INPUT' || t === 'SELECT') {
							var typ = (e.target.type || '').toLowerCase();
							if (typ !== 'submit' && typ !== 'button') {
								e.preventDefault();
							}
						}
					});
				}

				if (previewBtn && editForm) {
					var checkDirty = function() {
						for (var i = 0; i < editForm.elements.length; i++) {
							var el = editForm.elements[i];
							var t = (el.tagName || '').toUpperCase();
							if (t === 'INPUT' || t === 'TEXTAREA') {
								if (el.type === 'hidden' || el.type === 'submit' || el.type === 'button') continue;
								if (el.type === 'checkbox' || el.type === 'radio') {
									if (el.checked !== el.defaultChecked) return true;
								} else if (el.value !== el.defaultValue) {
									return true;
								}
							} else if (t === 'SELECT') {
								var orig = '';
								for (var j = 0; j < el.options.length; j++) {
									if (el.options[j].defaultSelected) { orig = el.options[j].value; break; }
								}
								if (el.value !== orig) return true;
							}
						}
						return false;
					};
					var update = function() { previewBtn.disabled = !checkDirty(); };
					editForm.addEventListener('input', update);
					editForm.addEventListener('change', update);
				}

				// Modal: open via fetch (keeps the edit form alive underneath),
				// close on backdrop click / Esc / any [data-preview-close] button.
				// We toggle inline `display` rather than the `hidden` attribute
				// because Tailwind's `flex` class would override `[hidden]`.
				function isModalOpen() { return modal && modal.style.display !== 'none'; }
				function closeModal() {
					if (!modal) return;
					modal.style.display = 'none';
					modalBody.innerHTML = '';
				}
				function openPreview() {
					if (!modal || !modalBody || !editForm) return;
					var formData = new FormData(editForm);
					previewBtn.disabled = true;
					fetch('/tools/credit-policy/preview', {
						method: 'POST',
						headers: { 'X-Partial': '1' },
						body: formData,
						credentials: 'same-origin'
					}).then(function(r) {
						if (!r.ok) throw new Error('preview ' + r.status);
						return r.text();
					}).then(function(html) {
						modalBody.innerHTML = html;
						modal.style.display = 'flex';
						modalBody.querySelectorAll('[data-preview-close]').forEach(function(btn) {
							btn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
						});
					}).catch(function(err) {
						alert('Could not load preview: ' + err.message);
					}).finally(function() {
						previewBtn.disabled = false;
					});
				}
				if (previewBtn) previewBtn.addEventListener('click', openPreview);
				if (modal) {
					modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === modal) closeModal(); });
				}
				document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
					if (e.key === 'Escape' && isModalOpen()) closeModal();
				});
			})();
		</script>
	}
}

templ editSectionTab(active, section, label string) {
	if active == section {
		<button type="button" data-section-btn={ section } class="px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px">{ label }</button>
	} else {
		<button type="button" data-section-btn={ section } class="px-5 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors">{ label }</button>
	}
}

templ editParentTabBtn(parent, label string, active bool) {
	if active {
		<button type="button" data-parent-btn={ parent } class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-red-x-dark bg-white border-t border-l border-r border-gray-200 rounded-t-lg -mb-px">{ label }</button>
	} else {
		<button type="button" data-parent-btn={ parent } class="px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors">{ label }</button>
	}
}

// editCountryBanner renders the per-country pending-approval notice.
// It lives outside the main edit form because the Withdraw button is its
// own <form>, and a nested <form> would prematurely close the outer one
// during HTML parsing.
templ editCountryBanner(panel countryEditPanel, userEmail string, isActive bool) {
	<div data-country-banner data-cc={ panel.CC } class={ templ.KV("hidden", !isActive) }>
		if panel.HasPending {
			<div class="mb-4 px-4 py-2 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-amber-800 flex items-center justify-between">
				<span>A change for { panel.Label } is pending approval — edits are disabled.</span>
				<div class="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
					<a href="/tools/credit-policy/approvals" class="font-semibold underline">View approvals →</a>
					<form method="POST" action={ templ.SafeURL(fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/cancel/%s", panel.PendingID)) } class="inline">
						<button type="submit" class="px-3 py-1 text-sm font-medium text-red-700 border border-red-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors">Withdraw</button>
					</form>
				</div>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

templ editCountryPanel(panel countryEditPanel, activeSection, userEmail string, isActive bool) {
	<div
		id={ "panel-" + panel.CC }
		data-country-panel
		data-cc={ panel.CC }
		class={ templ.KV("hidden", !isActive) }
	>
		<!-- Pricing parent — section sub-tabs + content -->
		<div data-parent-panel="pricing">
			<!-- Cutoffs -->
			<div data-section-panel="cutoffs" hidden?={ activeSection != "cutoffs" }>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
					@editCutoffsTable("Acquisition", "acquisition", panel.AcqCutoffs, panel.HasPending)
					@editCutoffsTable("Behaviour", "behaviour", panel.BhvCutoffs, panel.HasPending)
				</div>
			</div>
			<!-- Limits -->
			<div data-section-panel="limits" hidden?={ activeSection != "limits" }>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
					@editLimitsTable("Acquisition", panel.AcqEditRows, panel.HasPending)
					@editLimitsTable("Behaviour", panel.BhvEditRows, panel.HasPending)
				</div>
			</div>
			<!-- Terms -->
			<div data-section-panel="terms" hidden?={ activeSection != "terms" }>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
					@editTermsTable("Acquisition", panel.AcqEditRows, panel.HasPending)
					@editTermsTable("Behaviour", panel.BhvEditRows, panel.HasPending)
				</div>
			</div>
			<!-- Interest Rate -->
			<div data-section-panel="interest-rate" hidden?={ activeSection != "interest-rate" }>
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
					@editInterestRateTable("Acquisition", panel.CC, panel.AcqEditRows, panel.HasPending)
					@editInterestRateTable("Behaviour", panel.CC, panel.BhvEditRows, panel.HasPending)
				</div>
			</div>
			<!-- Fees -->
			<div data-section-panel="fees" hidden?={ activeSection != "fees" }>
				@editFeesSection(panel)
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Provisioning parent — hidden by default -->
		<div data-parent-panel="provisioning" hidden>
			<div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
				@provisionEditTable("Acquisition", panel.AcqProvRows)
				@provisionEditTable("Behaviour", panel.BhvProvRows)
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Booster & Throttle parent — hidden by default -->
		<div data-parent-panel="throttle" hidden>
			<div class="space-y-6">
				@throttleEditCard(panel.ThrottleLimit, panel.ThrottleBasis)
				@boosterEditSection(panel.Booster)
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
}

// =============================================
// EDIT SECTION: CUTOFFS
templ editCutoffsTable(title, stype string, rows []cutoffRow, disabled bool) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ title }</h3>
		</div>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {
			<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
				<thead class="bg-gray-50">
					<tr>
						<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Score</th>
						<th class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Min Score</th>
						<th class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Max Score</th>
					</tr>
				</thead>
				<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
					for _, row := range rows {
						<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
							<td class="px-6 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{ row.Category }</td>
							<td class="px-3 py-1 text-right">
								<input
									type="number"
									step="1"
									min="0"
									name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_score_from", stype, row.ScoreKey) }
									value={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", row.MinScore) }
									disabled?={ disabled }
									class="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400 text-right"
								/>
							</td>
							<td class="px-3 py-1 text-right">
								<input
									type="number"
									step="1"
									min="0"
									name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_score_to", stype, row.ScoreKey) }
									value={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", row.MaxScore) }
									disabled?={ disabled }
									class="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400 text-right"
								/>
							</td>
						</tr>
					}
				</tbody>
			</table>
		}
	</div>
}

// =============================================
// EDIT SECTION: LIMITS
templ editLimitsTable(title string, rows []editScoreRow, disabled bool) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ title }</h3>
		</div>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider" rowspan="2">Score</th>
							for _, prod := range rows[0].Products {
								<th class="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-l border-gray-200" colspan="4">{ labelProduct(prod.ProductName) }</th>
							}
						</tr>
						<tr>
							for range rows[0].Products {
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 border-l border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/50">Core RBL</th>
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 bg-gray-50/50">Core GSM</th>
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 bg-gray-50/50">Test RBL</th>
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 bg-gray-50/50">Test GSM</th>
							}
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, row := range rows {
							<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
								<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{ row.Category }</td>
								for _, prod := range row.Products {
									<td class="px-2 py-1 border-l border-gray-200">
										<input
											type="number"
											step="1"
											min="0"
											name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s_core_rbl", row.ScorecardType, row.ScoreKey, prod.ProductName) }
											value={ strconv.FormatFloat(prod.CoreRBL, 'f', 0, 64) }
											disabled?={ disabled }
											class="w-28 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
										/>
									</td>
									<td class="px-2 py-1">
										<input
											type="number"
											step="0.01"
											min="0"
											name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s_core_gsm", row.ScorecardType, row.ScoreKey, prod.ProductName) }
											value={ strconv.FormatFloat(prod.CoreGSM, 'f', -1, 64) }
											disabled?={ disabled }
											class="w-20 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
										/>
									</td>
									<td class="px-2 py-1">
										<input
											type="number"
											step="1"
											min="0"
											name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s_test_rbl", row.ScorecardType, row.ScoreKey, prod.ProductName) }
											value={ strconv.FormatFloat(prod.TestRBL, 'f', 0, 64) }
											disabled?={ disabled }
											class="w-28 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
										/>
									</td>
									<td class="px-2 py-1">
										<input
											type="number"
											step="0.01"
											min="0"
											name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s_test_gsm", row.ScorecardType, row.ScoreKey, prod.ProductName) }
											value={ strconv.FormatFloat(prod.TestGSM, 'f', -1, 64) }
											disabled?={ disabled }
											class="w-20 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
										/>
									</td>
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

					<thead class="bg-gray-50">

							<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Score</th>

					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">

templ editInterestRateTable(title, cc string, rows []editScoreRow, disabled bool) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ title }</h3>
		</div>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider" rowspan="2">Score</th>
							for _, prod := range rows[0].Products {
								<th class="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-l border-gray-200" colspan="2">{ labelProduct(prod.ProductName) }</th>
							}
						</tr>
						<tr>
							for range rows[0].Products {
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 text-center border-l border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/50">Normal</th>
								<th class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 text-center bg-gray-50/50">Arrears</th>
							}
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, row := range rows {
							<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
								<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{ row.Category }</td>
								for _, prod := range row.Products {
									<td class="px-2 py-1 border-l border-gray-200">
										<div class="flex items-center gap-1">
											<input
												type="number"
												step="0.001"
												min="0"
												max="1"
												name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s_normal", row.ScorecardType, row.ScoreKey, prod.ProductName) }
												value={ strconv.FormatFloat(prod.Normal, 'f', -1, 64) }
												disabled?={ disabled }
												class="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
											/>
											if repoLinked(cc, prod.ProductName) {
												<span class="text-xs text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap">+ repo</span>
											}
										</div>
									</td>
									<td class="px-2 py-1">
										<div class="flex items-center gap-1">
											<input
												type="number"
												step="0.001"
												min="0"
												max="1"
												name={ fmt.Sprintf("%s_%s_%s_arrears", row.ScorecardType, row.ScoreKey, prod.ProductName) }
												value={ strconv.FormatFloat(prod.Arrears, 'f', -1, 64) }
												disabled?={ disabled }
												class="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
											/>
											if repoLinked(cc, prod.ProductName) {
												<span class="text-xs text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap">+ repo</span>
											}
										</div>
									</td>
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

// =============================================
// EDIT SECTION: FEES
templ editFeesSection(panel countryEditPanel) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-5 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Platform Fees</h2>
		</div>
		<div class="p-6 space-y-6">
			<!-- Flat fees -->
			<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
				if panel.HasMonthly {
					<div>
						<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Monthly Fee</label>
						<input
							type="number"
							step="0.01"
							min="0"
							name="platform_monthly_fee"
							value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.MonthlyFee, 'f', -1, 64) }
							disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
						/>
					</div>
				}
				if panel.HasRounding {
					<div>
						<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Rounding Amount</label>
						<input
							type="number"
							step="0.01"
							min="0"
							name="platform_rounding"
							value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.RoundingAmount, 'f', -1, 64) }
							disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
						/>
					</div>
				}
				if panel.HasStatement {
					<div>
						<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Statement Fee</label>
						<input
							type="number"
							step="0.01"
							min="0"
							name="platform_statement_fee"
							value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.StatementFee, 'f', -1, 64) }
							disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
						/>
					</div>
				}
				if panel.HasMobileMoney {
					<div>
						<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Mobile Money Fee</label>
						<input
							type="number"
							step="0.01"
							min="0"
							name="platform_mobile_money"
							value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.MobileMoneyFee, 'f', -1, 64) }
							disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
						/>
					</div>
				}
				if panel.HasEFT {
					<div>
						<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">EFT Fee</label>
						<input
							type="number"
							step="0.01"
							min="0"
							name="platform_eft"
							value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.EFTFee, 'f', -1, 64) }
							disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
						/>
					</div>
				}
				<div>
					<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Min Loan Amount</label>
					if len(panel.MinLoanTiers) > 0 {
						<div class="space-y-2">
							for _, t := range panel.MinLoanTiers {
								<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
									<span class="text-xs text-gray-400 w-16 shrink-0">{ fmt.Sprintf("%dm term", t.TermFrom) }</span>
									<input
										type="number"
										step="0.01"
										min="0"
										name={ fmt.Sprintf("platform_min_loan_tier_%d", t.ProdIdx) }
										value={ strconv.FormatFloat(t.Amount, 'f', -1, 64) }
										disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
										class="flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
									/>
								</div>
							}
						</div>
					} else {
						<input
							type="number"
							step="0.01"
							min="0"
							name="platform_min_loan"
							value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.MinLoanAmount, 'f', -1, 64) }
							disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
							class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
						/>
					}
				</div>
				<div>
					<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Max Cash Disbursement</label>
					<input
						type="number"
						step="0.01"
						min="0"
						name="platform_max_cash_disb"
						value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.MaxCashDisb, 'f', -1, 64) }
						disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
						class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
					/>
				</div>
			</div>
			<!-- Tiered fees -->
			if len(panel.CashTiers) > 0 || len(panel.CollectionTiers) > 0 {
				<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
					if len(panel.CashTiers) > 0 {
						@editTierTable("Cash Withdrawal Tiers", "cash", panel.CashTiers, panel.HasPending)
					}
					if len(panel.CollectionTiers) > 0 {
						@editTierTable("Collection Tiers", "collection", panel.CollectionTiers, panel.HasPending)
					}
				</div>
			}
			if panel.HasRecovery {
				<div>
					<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-3">Recovery Charge</p>
					<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
						<div>
							<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Percentage</label>
							<input
								type="number"
								step="0.001"
								min="0"
								max="1"
								name="platform_recovery_percentage"
								value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.RecoveryPct, 'f', -1, 64) }
								disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
								class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
							/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Fixed Fee</label>
							<input
								type="number"
								step="0.01"
								min="0"
								name="platform_recovery_fixed_fee"
								value={ strconv.FormatFloat(panel.RecoveryFee, 'f', -1, 64) }
								disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
								class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
							/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">When</label>
							<input
								type="text"
								name="platform_recovery_when"
								value={ panel.RecoveryWhen }
								disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
								class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
							/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Subject to In Duplum</label>
							<label class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
								<input
									type="checkbox"
									name="platform_recovery_in_duplum"
									value="true"
									checked?={ panel.RecoveryInDuplum }
									disabled?={ panel.HasPending }
									class="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-red-x-dark focus:ring-red-x-dark disabled:opacity-50"
								/>
								<span class="text-sm text-gray-600">In duplum applies</span>
							</label>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	</div>
}

// PREVIEW — flat list of proposed changes, same shape as the Proposed
// Changes table on the approval-detail page.
//
// pricingPreviewPartial is rendered into the in-page modal via fetch — no
// layout wrapper. pricingPreviewPage wraps the same partial in a full
// layout for the (rarely-used) direct navigation fallback.
templ pricingPreviewPartial(d previewPageData) {
	<div class="flex flex-col h-full max-h-[90vh]">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
			<div>
				<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Review Changes — { countryName(d.SelectedCountry) }</h2>
				if len(d.Diffs) > 0 {
					<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{ fmt.Sprintf("%d field(s) changed", len(d.Diffs)) }</p>
				}
			</div>
			<button type="button" data-preview-close class="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 text-2xl leading-none px-2">&times;</button>
		</div>
		<div class="flex-1 overflow-auto">
			if len(d.Diffs) == 0 {
				<div class="px-6 py-12 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">No changes detected.</div>
			} else {
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50 sticky top-0">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Section</th>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Score</th>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Field</th>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Current</th>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Proposed</th>
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, diff := range d.Diffs {
							<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
								<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ capitalise(diff.Section) }</td>
								<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ diff.ScoreKey }</td>
								<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ diff.Field }</td>
								<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ diff.OldValue }</td>
								<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-green-700">{ diff.NewValue }</td>
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			}
		</div>
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 shrink-0 bg-gray-50">
			<button type="button" data-preview-close class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-white transition-colors">Back to Edit</button>
			if len(d.Diffs) > 0 {
				<form method="POST" action="/tools/credit-policy/submit" class="inline">
					<input type="hidden" name="country" value={ d.SelectedCountry }/>
					<input type="hidden" name="diffs_json" value={ d.DiffsJSON }/>
					<input type="hidden" name="field_changes_json" value={ d.FieldChangesJSON }/>
					<button type="submit" class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold bg-amber-400 text-amber-900 rounded-lg hover:bg-amber-300 transition-colors">Submit for Approval &rarr;</button>
				</form>
			}
		</div>
	</div>
}

		}
		<div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 mt-6 mb-12 space-y-4">
			<!-- Metadata card -->
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl px-6 py-5 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-sm">
				<div>
					<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Submitted By</p>
					<p class="text-gray-900 font-medium">{ d.Change.SubmittedByName }</p>
					<p class="text-gray-400 text-xs">{ d.Change.SubmittedByEmail }</p>
				</div>
				<div>
					<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Date</p>
					<p class="text-gray-900">{ formatSAST(d.Change.SubmittedAt) }</p>
				</div>
				<div>
					<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Status</p>
					@statusBadge(d.Change.Status)
					if d.Change.PublishedCommitSHA != "" {
						<p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">commit { shortSHA(d.Change.PublishedCommitSHA) }</p>
					}
				</div>
				<div>
					<p class="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Approvals</p>
					<p class="text-gray-900">{ fmt.Sprintf("%d of %d required", len(d.Change.Approvals), d.Quorum) }</p>
					for _, email := range d.Change.Approvals {
						<p class="text-xs text-gray-500">✓ { email }</p>
					}
				</div>
			</div>
			<!-- Diff table -->
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden">
				<div class="px-6 py-5 border-b border-gray-100">
					<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Proposed Changes</h2>
				</div>
				<div class="overflow-x-auto">
					<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
						<thead class="bg-gray-50">
							<tr>
								<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Section</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Score</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Field</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Current</th>
								<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Proposed</th>
							</tr>
						</thead>
						<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
							for _, diff := range d.Change.Diffs {
								<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
									<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ capitalise(diff.Section) }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ diff.ScoreKey }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ diff.Field }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-400 line-through">{ diff.OldValue }</td>
									<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-green-700">{ diff.NewValue }</td>
								</tr>
							}
						</tbody>
					</table>
				</div>
				if d.Change.Status == StatusPending {
					<div class="px-6 py-5 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
						if d.IsSubmitter {
							<form method="POST" action={ templ.SafeURL(fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/cancel/%s", d.Change.ID)) }>
								<button type="submit" class="px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-red-700 border border-red-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors">Withdraw Change</button>
							</form>
						} else {
							<span></span>
						}
						if d.IsApprover {
							if d.IsSubmitter {
								<span class="px-6 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">You can't approve your own change</span>
							} else if d.AlreadyApproved {
								<span class="px-6 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">You have approved this change</span>
							} else {
								<form method="POST" action={ templ.SafeURL(fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/approve/%s", d.Change.ID)) }>
									<button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2 text-sm font-semibold bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 transition-colors">Approve →</button>
								</form>
							}
						}
					</div>
				}
				if d.Change.Status == StatusAppliedPendingPush || d.Change.Status == StatusFailed || d.Change.Status == StatusApplied {
					<div class="px-6 py-5 border-t border-gray-100">
						if d.Change.Error != "" {
							<div class="mb-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-sm text-red-800">
								<p class="font-medium mb-1">Last publish error</p>
								<p class="font-mono text-xs">{ d.Change.Error }</p>
							</div>
						}
						if d.IsApprover && d.Change.Status != StatusApplied {
							<form method="POST" action={ templ.SafeURL(fmt.Sprintf("/tools/credit-policy/republish/%s", d.Change.ID)) }>
								<button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2 text-sm font-semibold bg-amber-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-amber-600 transition-colors">Republish →</button>
							</form>
						}
					</div>
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

templ statusBadge(status string) {
	switch status {
		case StatusApplied:
			<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-green-100 text-green-800">Applied</span>
		case StatusAppliedPendingPush:
			<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-orange-100 text-orange-800">Applied — Push pending</span>
		case StatusFailed:
			<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-red-100 text-red-800">Failed</span>
		case StatusCancelled:
			<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">Cancelled</span>
		default:
			<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">Pending</span>
	}
}
```

## File: modules\tools\creditpolicy\provisioning.go
```go
package creditpolicy

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"sort"
	"strconv"

	"ujuzi/core/yamledit"
)

// =============================================
// YAML STRUCTS — provision.yml

type provRoot map[string]provCountry

type provCountry struct {
	ScorecardType map[string]provScorecardType `yaml:"scorecard_type"`
}

type provScorecardType struct {
	// Stage is keyed by integer in YAML; yaml.v2 unmarshals it into int keys.
	Stage map[int][]provRecency `yaml:"stage"`
}

type provRecency struct {
	Recency       int     `yaml:"recency"`
	ProvisionRate float64 `yaml:"provision_rate"`
}

// =============================================
// VIEW MODELS — used by partial templates inside the unified credit-policy page

// provisionViewRow models one stage row in a country/scorecard table.
type provisionViewRow struct {
	Stage int      // 1..3
	Cells []string // formatted percentages, one per recency in order
}

// provisionEditRow models one stage row with inputs for editing.
type provisionEditRow struct {
	Stage int
	Cells []provisionEditCell
}

type provisionEditCell struct {
	Recency  int
	Stage    int
	Stype    string  // "acquisition" | "behaviour"
	FormKey  string  // form input name
	RawValue float64 // current value as stored in YAML
}

// =============================================
// VIEW/EDIT BUILDERS

func buildProvisionViewRows(st provScorecardType) []provisionViewRow {
	stages := make([]int, 0, len(st.Stage))
	for s := range st.Stage {
		stages = append(stages, s)
	}
	sort.Ints(stages)

	var rows []provisionViewRow
	for _, stage := range stages {
		entries := st.Stage[stage]
		cells := make([]string, len(entries))
		for i, e := range entries {
			cells[i] = formatPct4(e.ProvisionRate)
		}
		rows = append(rows, provisionViewRow{Stage: stage, Cells: cells})
	}
	return rows
}

func buildProvisionEditRows(st provScorecardType, stype string) []provisionEditRow {
	stages := make([]int, 0, len(st.Stage))
	for s := range st.Stage {
		stages = append(stages, s)
	}
	sort.Ints(stages)

	var rows []provisionEditRow
	for _, stage := range stages {
		entries := st.Stage[stage]
		cells := make([]provisionEditCell, len(entries))
		for i, e := range entries {
			cells[i] = provisionEditCell{
				Recency:  e.Recency,
				Stage:    stage,
				Stype:    stype,
				FormKey:  fmt.Sprintf("provisioning_%s_stage_%d_recency_%d", stype, stage, e.Recency),
				RawValue: e.ProvisionRate,
			}
		}
		rows = append(rows, provisionEditRow{Stage: stage, Cells: cells})
	}
	return rows
}

// =============================================
// CHANGE COMPUTER (called by the unified computeChanges)

// computeProvisioningFields walks the submitted form values for the
// per-country provision file and appends to the supplied accumulators.
func computeProvisioningFields(cc string, getValue func(string) string, cfg pricingConfig,
	diffCells map[string]cellDiff, diffs *[]DiffEntry, fieldChanges *[]yamledit.FieldChange) {

	pc, ok := cfg.prov[cc]
	if !ok {
		return
	}

	display := formatPct4
	for _, stype := range []string{"acquisition", "behaviour"} {
		st, ok := pc.ScorecardType[stype]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		stages := make([]int, 0, len(st.Stage))
		for s := range st.Stage {
			stages = append(stages, s)
		}
		sort.Ints(stages)

		for _, stage := range stages {
			entries := st.Stage[stage]
			for idx, e := range entries {
				fkey := fmt.Sprintf("provisioning_%s_stage_%d_recency_%d", stype, stage, e.Recency)
				raw := getValue(fkey)
				if raw == "" {
					continue
				}
				newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
				if err != nil || math.Abs(newVal-e.ProvisionRate) < 1e-9 {
					continue
				}

				diffCells[fkey] = cellDiff{Old: display(e.ProvisionRate), New: display(newVal)}
				*diffs = append(*diffs, DiffEntry{
					Section:  stype,
					ScoreKey: fmt.Sprintf("Stage %d / Recency %d", stage, e.Recency),
					Field:    "Provision Rate",
					OldValue: display(e.ProvisionRate),
					NewValue: display(newVal),
				})
				*fieldChanges = append(*fieldChanges, yamledit.FieldChange{
					File:     provFile,
					Path:     []string{cc, "scorecard_type", stype, "stage", strconv.Itoa(stage), strconv.Itoa(idx), "provision_rate"},
					OldValue: strconv.FormatFloat(e.ProvisionRate, 'f', -1, 64),
					NewValue: raw,
				})
			}
		}
	}
}
```

## File: modules\tools\creditpolicy\provisioning.templ
```templ
package creditpolicy

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

// =============================================
// PROVISION PARTIALS — used by the unified credit-policy page

templ provisionViewTable(title string, rows []provisionViewRow) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ title }</h3>
		</div>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Stage</th>
							for r := 0; r < numRecency(rows); r++ {
								<th class="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-l border-gray-200">{ fmt.Sprintf("Recency %d", r) }</th>
							}
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, row := range rows {
							<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
								<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{ fmt.Sprintf("Stage %d", row.Stage) }</td>
								for _, c := range row.Cells {
									<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-center text-gray-700 border-l border-gray-200">{ c }</td>
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

templ provisionEditTable(title string, rows []provisionEditRow) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{ title }</h3>
		</div>
		if len(rows) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Stage</th>
							for r := 0; r < numEditRecency(rows); r++ {
								<th class="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-l border-gray-200">{ fmt.Sprintf("Recency %d", r) }</th>
							}
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, row := range rows {
							<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
								<td class="px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{ fmt.Sprintf("Stage %d", row.Stage) }</td>
								for _, c := range row.Cells {
									<td class="px-2 py-1 text-center border-l border-gray-200">
										<input
											type="number"
											step="0.0001"
											min="0"
											max="1"
											name={ c.FormKey }
											value={ strconv.FormatFloat(c.RawValue, 'f', -1, 64) }
											class="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-sm text-right border border-gray-200 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-red-x-dark"
										/>
									</td>
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

// =============================================
// HELPERS

func numRecency(rows []provisionViewRow) int {
	if len(rows) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return len(rows[0].Cells)
}

func numEditRecency(rows []provisionEditRow) int {
	if len(rows) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return len(rows[0].Cells)
}
```

```go
package creditpolicy

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/bigquery"
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"

	"ujuzi/core/bq"
	"ujuzi/core/yamledit"
)

// PublishConfig groups the dependencies the credit-policy publisher needs.
type PublishConfig struct {
	BQHistory      bq.CreditPolicyTable
	BQActive       bq.CreditPolicyActiveTable
	GitRepoURL     string
	GitBranch      string
	GitAuthorName  string
	GitAuthorEmail string
	BitbucketAuth  string
}

// creditPolicyFiles is the set of YAML files we snapshot into BQ on every
// publish. Kept in column-order to match CreditPolicySnapshotRow.
var creditPolicyFiles = []string{
	"old_score_category_map.yml",
	"platform.yml",
	"pricing_and_limits.yml",
	"product_name_map.yml",
	"provision.yml",
	"score_category_ranges.yml",
	"score_category_booster_and_throttle.yml",
}

func (m *module) publishChange(ctx context.Context, ch *PendingChange) error {
	return m.runPublish(ctx, ch)
}

func (m *module) republishChange(ctx context.Context, ch *PendingChange) error {
	if len(ch.FieldChanges) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("republish: change %s has no field changes", ch.ID)
	}
	return m.runPublish(ctx, ch)
}

// runPublish is the publish pipeline:
//  1. Read changed files from Bitbucket API
//  2. Apply YAML edits in memory
//  3. Insert BQ snapshot (all 7 files for the country)
//  4. Commit modified files to Bitbucket via API (atomic)
func (m *module) runPublish(ctx context.Context, ch *PendingChange) error {
	if len(ch.FieldChanges) == 0 {
		return m.markFailed(ch, "no field changes recorded — change cannot be published")
	}
	if ch.Country == "" {
		return m.markFailed(ch, "publish: country missing on pending change")
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()

	byFile := make(map[string][]yamledit.FieldChange)
	for _, fc := range ch.FieldChanges {
		byFile[fc.File] = append(byFile[fc.File], fc)
	}

	// Read changed files from Bitbucket, apply edits in memory.
	modified := make(map[string][]byte, len(byFile))
	for file, changes := range byFile {
		repoPath := "country/" + ch.Country + "/" + file
		src, err := m.bb.ReadFile(ctx, repoPath)
		if err != nil {
			return m.markFailed(ch, fmt.Sprintf("read %s: %v", repoPath, err))
		}
		if src == nil {
			return m.markFailed(ch, fmt.Sprintf("file not found: %s", repoPath))
		}
		newYAML, err := yamledit.ApplyChanges(src, changes)
		if err != nil {
			return m.markFailed(ch, fmt.Sprintf("apply changes to %s: %v", repoPath, err))
		}
		modified[repoPath] = newYAML
	}

	// BQ snapshot: read all 7 files for the country (using modified versions where available).
	bqExists, bqErr := m.bq.CreditPolicyChangeExists(ctx, m.publishCfg.BQHistory, ch.ID)
	if bqErr != nil {
		return m.markFailed(ch, fmt.Sprintf("bq existence check: %v", bqErr))
	}
	if !bqExists {
		row, err := m.buildSnapshotRow(ctx, ch, now, modified)
		if err != nil {
			return m.markFailed(ch, fmt.Sprintf("build snapshot: %v", err))
		}
		if err := m.bq.InsertCreditPolicySnapshot(ctx, m.publishCfg.BQHistory, row); err != nil {
			return m.markFailed(ch, fmt.Sprintf("bq insert: %v", err))
		}
	}

	ch.AppliedAt = &now

	// Bitbucket API commit — single atomic call with all modified files.
	commitMsg := buildCommitMessage(ch, len(modified))
	sha, err := m.bb.CommitFiles(ctx, modified, commitMsg, m.publishCfg.GitAuthorName, m.publishCfg.GitAuthorEmail)
	if err != nil {
		ch.Status = StatusFailed
		ch.Error = err.Error()
		failedAt := time.Now().UTC()
		ch.FailedAt = &failedAt
		m.l.Printf("WARN publish %s: BQ succeeded but commit failed: %v", ch.ID, err)
		return err
	}
	ch.PublishedCommitSHA = sha
	ch.Status = StatusApplied
	ch.Error = ""
	ch.FailedAt = nil

	if uErr := m.bq.UpdateCreditPolicyCommitSHA(ctx, m.publishCfg.BQHistory, ch.ID, sha); uErr != nil {
		m.l.Printf("WARN updating commit_sha on BQ row: %v", uErr)
	}

	// Refresh the active-state row. A failure here is logged, not fatal: the
	// history row and commit have already landed, so the publish succeeded.
	if policyJSON, err := buildActivePolicyJSON(ctx, m.bb, ch.Country, modified); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("WARN building active policy JSON for %s: %v", ch.Country, err)
	} else {
		row := bq.CreditPolicyActiveRow{
			Country:        ch.Country,
			PolicyJSON:     string(policyJSON),
			ActiveChangeID: bigquery.NullString{StringVal: ch.ID, Valid: true},
			CommitSHA:      bigquery.NullString{StringVal: sha, Valid: true},
			UpdatedAt:      now,
		}
		if err := m.bq.UpsertActivePolicy(ctx, m.publishCfg.BQActive, row); err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("WARN upserting active policy for %s: %v", ch.Country, err)
		}
	}

	// Drop the stale cached YAML so the next page load reflects this
	// commit instead of pre-publish values.
	m.cache.invalidate(ch.Country)

	return nil
}

// buildSnapshotRow reads all credit-policy YAML files for ch.Country,
// substituting in-memory modified versions where available.
func (m *module) buildSnapshotRow(ctx context.Context, ch *PendingChange, approvedAt time.Time, modified map[string][]byte) (bq.CreditPolicySnapshotRow, error) {
	read := func(file string) bigquery.NullString {
		repoPath := "country/" + ch.Country + "/" + file
		if data, ok := modified[repoPath]; ok {
			return bigquery.NullString{StringVal: string(data), Valid: true}
		}
		data, err := m.bb.ReadFile(ctx, repoPath)
		if err != nil || data == nil {
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("WARN snapshot read %s: %v", repoPath, err)
			}
			return bigquery.NullString{}
		}
		return bigquery.NullString{StringVal: string(data), Valid: true}
	}
	row := bq.CreditPolicySnapshotRow{
		ChangeID:                            ch.ID,
		Country:                             ch.Country,
		Status:                              StatusApplied,
		SubmittedByEmail:                    ch.SubmittedByEmail,
		SubmittedByName:                     ch.SubmittedByName,
		SubmittedAt:                         ch.SubmittedAt,
		ApprovedAt:                          approvedAt,
		ApproversCSV:                        strings.Join(ch.Approvals, ","),
		CommitSHA:                           bigquery.NullString{},
		OldScoreCategoryMapYAML:             read("old_score_category_map.yml"),
		PlatformYAML:                        read("platform.yml"),
		PricingAndLimitsYAML:                read("pricing_and_limits.yml"),
		ProductNameMapYAML:                  read("product_name_map.yml"),
		ProvisionYAML:                       read("provision.yml"),
		ScoreCategoryRangesYAML:             read("score_category_ranges.yml"),
		ScoreCategoryBoosterAndThrottleYAML: read("score_category_booster_and_throttle.yml"),
	}
	return row, nil
}

// buildActivePolicyJSON assembles the active-state document for one country:
// every policy file parsed from YAML to JSON, keyed by filename stem. In-memory
// modified versions take precedence over Bitbucket master; files the country
// doesn't ship are omitted. yaml.v3 (not the v2 used elsewhere in this package)
// is required — v2 decodes maps as map[interface{}]interface{}, which
// json.Marshal rejects.
func buildActivePolicyJSON(ctx context.Context, bb *BitbucketClient, cc string, modified map[string][]byte) ([]byte, error) {
	policy := make(map[string]json.RawMessage, len(creditPolicyFiles))
	for _, file := range creditPolicyFiles {
		repoPath := "country/" + cc + "/" + file
		data, ok := modified[repoPath]
		if !ok {
			var err error
			if data, err = bb.ReadFile(ctx, repoPath); err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", repoPath, err)
			}
		}
		if data == nil {
			continue
		}
		var v any
		if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &v); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", repoPath, err)
		}
		jb, err := json.Marshal(normalizeYAML(v))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("marshal %s: %w", repoPath, err)
		}
		policy[strings.TrimSuffix(file, ".yml")] = jb
	}
	return json.Marshal(policy)
}

// normalizeYAML makes a decoded YAML value JSON-marshalable. YAML mappings
// with any non-string key (e.g. numeric buckets in provision.yml) decode to
// map[interface{}]interface{}, which json.Marshal rejects; this stringifies
// every map key recursively.
func normalizeYAML(v any) any {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case map[interface{}]interface{}:
		m := make(map[string]any, len(x))
		for k, val := range x {
			m[fmt.Sprint(k)] = normalizeYAML(val)
		}
		return m
	case map[string]interface{}:
		for k, val := range x {
			x[k] = normalizeYAML(val)
		}
		return x
	case []interface{}:
		for i, val := range x {
			x[i] = normalizeYAML(val)
		}
		return x
	default:
		return v
	}
}

// BackfillActivePolicy seeds the active table from current Bitbucket master for
// every country. One-shot, idempotent (MERGE upsert). Returns the country codes
// it wrote so callers can report. ACTIVE_CHANGE_ID is set to "backfill".
func BackfillActivePolicy(ctx context.Context, bb *BitbucketClient, svc *bq.Service, t bq.CreditPolicyActiveTable) ([]string, error) {
	codes, err := bb.ListCountries(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("list countries: %w", err)
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	for _, cc := range codes {
		policyJSON, err := buildActivePolicyJSON(ctx, bb, cc, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("build active policy %s: %w", cc, err)
		}
		row := bq.CreditPolicyActiveRow{
			Country:        cc,
			PolicyJSON:     string(policyJSON),
			ActiveChangeID: bigquery.NullString{StringVal: "backfill", Valid: true},
			UpdatedAt:      now,
		}
		if err := svc.UpsertActivePolicy(ctx, t, row); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("upsert active policy %s: %w", cc, err)
		}
	}
	return codes, nil
}

func (m *module) markFailed(ch *PendingChange, msg string) error {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ch.Status = StatusFailed
	ch.Error = msg
	ch.FailedAt = &now
	return fmt.Errorf("publish: %s", msg)
}

func buildCommitMessage(ch *PendingChange, fileCount int) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s: credit policy update (%s)\n\n", ch.Country, ch.ID)
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Submitted-by: %s\n", ch.SubmittedByEmail)
	if len(ch.Approvals) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Approved-by: %s\n", strings.Join(ch.Approvals, ", "))
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Diffs: %d field(s) across %d file(s)\n", len(ch.FieldChanges), fileCount)
	return b.String()
}
```
