```go
package creditpolicy

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"sort"
	"strconv"

	"ujuzi/core/yamledit"
)

// =============================================
// VIEW MODELS — booster matrix shared between view, edit, and preview templates

// boosterViewTable is the read-only booster matrix — one row per source score
// key, one column per inactive-period bucket.
type boosterViewTable struct {
	Buckets []boosterBucketHeader
	Rows    []boosterScoreViewRow
}

type boosterBucketHeader struct {
	Index     int
	MonthFrom int
	MonthTo   int
	Countries []string
	Label     string // "Inactive 4 Months"
}

type boosterScoreViewRow struct {
	SrcKey string
	Cells  []string // dst key per bucket (in Buckets order)
}

// boosterEditTable mirrors boosterViewTable for the edit form.
type boosterEditTable struct {
	Buckets   []boosterEditBucketHeader
	Rows      []boosterScoreEditRow
	ScoreOpts []string
}

type boosterEditBucketHeader struct {
	Index        int
	MonthFromKey string
	MonthFrom    int
	MonthToKey   string
	MonthTo      int
	Countries    []string
	Label        string
}

type boosterScoreEditRow struct {
	SrcKey string
	Cells  []boosterEditCell
}

type boosterEditCell struct {
	BucketIndex int
	DstKey      string
	FormKey     string
}

// =============================================
// VIEW/EDIT BUILDERS

func buildBoosterViewTable(buckets []tnbBooster) boosterViewTable {
	srcKeys := collectBoosterScoreKeys(buckets)

	headers := make([]boosterBucketHeader, 0, len(buckets))
	for i, b := range buckets {
		headers = append(headers, boosterBucketHeader{
			Index:     i,
			MonthFrom: b.InactivePeriod.MonthFromInclusive,
			MonthTo:   b.InactivePeriod.MonthToInclusive,
			Countries: b.Countries,
			Label:     fmt.Sprintf("Inactive %d Months", b.InactivePeriod.MonthFromInclusive),
		})
	}

	rows := make([]boosterScoreViewRow, 0, len(srcKeys))
	for _, src := range srcKeys {
		cells := make([]string, len(buckets))
		for i, b := range buckets {
			cells[i] = b.ClientScore[src]
		}
		rows = append(rows, boosterScoreViewRow{SrcKey: src, Cells: cells})
	}
	return boosterViewTable{Buckets: headers, Rows: rows}
}

func buildBoosterEditTable(buckets []tnbBooster) boosterEditTable {
	srcKeys := collectBoosterScoreKeys(buckets)

	headers := make([]boosterEditBucketHeader, 0, len(buckets))
	for i, b := range buckets {
		headers = append(headers, boosterEditBucketHeader{
			Index:        i,
			MonthFromKey: fmt.Sprintf("booster_%d_month_from", i),
			MonthFrom:    b.InactivePeriod.MonthFromInclusive,
			MonthToKey:   fmt.Sprintf("booster_%d_month_to", i),
			MonthTo:      b.InactivePeriod.MonthToInclusive,
			Countries:    b.Countries,
			Label:        fmt.Sprintf("Inactive %d Months", b.InactivePeriod.MonthFromInclusive),
		})
	}

	rows := make([]boosterScoreEditRow, 0, len(srcKeys))
	for _, src := range srcKeys {
		cells := make([]boosterEditCell, len(buckets))
		for i, b := range buckets {
			cells[i] = boosterEditCell{
				BucketIndex: i,
				DstKey:      b.ClientScore[src],
				FormKey:     fmt.Sprintf("booster_%d_score_%s", i, src),
			}
		}
		rows = append(rows, boosterScoreEditRow{SrcKey: src, Cells: cells})
	}
	return boosterEditTable{Buckets: headers, Rows: rows, ScoreOpts: srcKeys}
}

// collectBoosterScoreKeys returns the union of source keys across all buckets,
// sorted. Used both as the source-key column ("a1, a2, ...") and the dropdown
// option set (since target keys come from the same domain).
func collectBoosterScoreKeys(buckets []tnbBooster) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, b := range buckets {
		for k := range b.ClientScore {
			seen[k] = true
		}
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
	for k := range seen {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	return keys
}

func formatThrottleLimit(f float64) string {
	if f == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	return strconv.FormatFloat(f, 'f', -1, 64)
}

// =============================================
// CHANGE COMPUTER (called by the unified computeChanges)

// computeThrottleFields walks the submitted form values for the per-country
// booster/throttle file and appends to the supplied accumulators.
func computeThrottleFields(cc string, getValue func(string) string, cfg pricingConfig,
	diffCells map[string]cellDiff, diffs *[]DiffEntry, fieldChanges *[]yamledit.FieldChange) {

	tnb, ok := cfg.tnb[cc]
	if !ok {
		return
	}

	displayFloat := func(f float64) string { return strconv.FormatFloat(f, 'f', -1, 64) }
	displayInt := func(f float64) string { return strconv.Itoa(int(f)) }

	// Throttle scalars.
	{
		fkey := "throttle_limit"
		raw := getValue(fkey)
		if raw != "" {
			if newVal, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64); err == nil &&
				math.Abs(newVal-tnb.Throttle.ThrottleLimit) >= 1e-9 {
				diffCells[fkey] = cellDiff{Old: displayFloat(tnb.Throttle.ThrottleLimit), New: displayFloat(newVal)}
				*diffs = append(*diffs, DiffEntry{
					Section: "throttle", Field: "Throttle Limit",
					OldValue: displayFloat(tnb.Throttle.ThrottleLimit), NewValue: displayFloat(newVal),
				})
				*fieldChanges = append(*fieldChanges, yamledit.FieldChange{
					File:     throttleFile,
					Path:     []string{cc, "throttle", "throttle_limit"},
					OldValue: strconv.FormatFloat(tnb.Throttle.ThrottleLimit, 'f', -1, 64),
					NewValue: raw,
				})
			}
		}
	}
	{
		fkey := "throttle_basis"
		raw := getValue(fkey)
		if raw != "" && raw != tnb.Throttle.ThrottleBasis {
			diffCells[fkey] = cellDiff{Old: tnb.Throttle.ThrottleBasis, New: raw}
			*diffs = append(*diffs, DiffEntry{
				Section: "throttle", Field: "Throttle Basis",
				OldValue: tnb.Throttle.ThrottleBasis, NewValue: raw,
			})
			*fieldChanges = append(*fieldChanges, yamledit.FieldChange{
				File:     throttleFile,
				Path:     []string{cc, "throttle", "throttle_basis"},
				OldValue: tnb.Throttle.ThrottleBasis,
				NewValue: raw,
			})
		}
	}

	// Booster buckets.
	for i, b := range tnb.Booster {
		monthFields := []struct {
			fkey    string
			label   string
			yamlKey string
			current int
		}{
			{fmt.Sprintf("booster_%d_month_from", i), fmt.Sprintf("Bucket %d Month From", i+1), "month_from_inclusive", b.InactivePeriod.MonthFromInclusive},
			{fmt.Sprintf("booster_%d_month_to", i), fmt.Sprintf("Bucket %d Month To", i+1), "month_to_inclusive", b.InactivePeriod.MonthToInclusive},
		}
		for _, mf := range monthFields {
			raw := getValue(mf.fkey)
			if raw == "" {
				continue
			}
			newVal, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
			if err != nil || newVal == mf.current {
				continue
			}
			diffCells[mf.fkey] = cellDiff{Old: displayInt(float64(mf.current)), New: displayInt(float64(newVal))}
			*diffs = append(*diffs, DiffEntry{
				Section: "booster", Field: mf.label,
				OldValue: displayInt(float64(mf.current)), NewValue: displayInt(float64(newVal)),
			})
			*fieldChanges = append(*fieldChanges, yamledit.FieldChange{
				File:     throttleFile,
				Path:     []string{cc, "booster", strconv.Itoa(i), "inactive_period", mf.yamlKey},
				OldValue: strconv.Itoa(mf.current),
				NewValue: raw,
			})
		}

		// Score-mapping cells.
		srcKeys := make([]string, 0, len(b.ClientScore))
		for k := range b.ClientScore {
			srcKeys = append(srcKeys, k)
		}
		sort.Strings(srcKeys)
		for _, src := range srcKeys {
			cur := b.ClientScore[src]
			fkey := fmt.Sprintf("booster_%d_score_%s", i, src)
			raw := getValue(fkey)
			if raw == "" || raw == cur {
				continue
			}
			diffCells[fkey] = cellDiff{Old: cur, New: raw}
			*diffs = append(*diffs, DiffEntry{
				Section:  "booster",
				ScoreKey: stringsToUpper(src),
				Field:    fmt.Sprintf("Bucket %d Score %s", i+1, stringsToUpper(src)),
				OldValue: cur, NewValue: raw,
			})
			*fieldChanges = append(*fieldChanges, yamledit.FieldChange{
				File:     throttleFile,
				Path:     []string{cc, "booster", strconv.Itoa(i), "client_score", src},
				OldValue: cur,
				NewValue: raw,
			})
		}
	}
}

// headerBackHref picks the chevron destination for creditPolicyHeader,
// defaulting to "/" (Ujuzi home) when the caller didn't supply one.
func headerBackHref(s string) string {
	if s == "" {
		return "/"
	}
	return s
}

// stringsToUpper is a tiny shim that avoids importing "strings" just for
// ToUpper inside this file.
func stringsToUpper(s string) string {
	out := make([]byte, len(s))
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		c := s[i]
		if c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' {
			c -= 32
		}
		out[i] = c
	}
	return string(out)
}
```

```templ
package creditpolicy

import (
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/ui/layout"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
)

// =============================================
// SHARED CHROME — used by the unified credit-policy page

// creditPolicyHeader renders the slim red header bar matching campaigns/common_terms.
// children is the slot for action buttons (Edit, Approvals, Withdraw, etc).
// backHref controls the chevron destination — defaults to "/" (Ujuzi home);
// pages that have a natural parent (e.g. approvals -> credit policy) should
// pass that path so the chevron acts as a contextual back, not a home button.
templ creditPolicyHeader(r *http.Request, title, cc, backHref string, userCountries []country.Country) {
	<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">
		<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
			<a href={ uj.SafeHref(r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity shrink-0" title="Ujuzi Home">
				<img class="w-8" src="/assets/img/baobab-2.svg" alt="Ujuzi Home"/>
			</a>
			<a href={ uj.SafeHref(r, headerBackHref(backHref)) } class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150" title="Back">
				<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
					<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"></path>
				</svg>
			</a>
			<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg">{ title }</span>
		</div>
		<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
			{ children... }
			@country.CCDropdown(cc, userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(r))
		</div>
	</div>
}

templ creditPolicyApprovalsLink(r *http.Request) {
	<a
		href={ uj.SafeHref(r, "/tools/approvals") }
		class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white text-sm font-medium border border-white/30 transition-colors"
	>Approvals</a>
}

// creditPolicyUnavailablePage is rendered when the Bitbucket API is
// unreachable. Surfaces the error so an admin can diagnose from the page.
//
// Auto-reloads every 5 seconds via JS so the page recovers on its own
// once the next git fetch succeeds (the per-view sync coalesces with the
// 60-second background ticker, so something will retry).
templ creditPolicyUnavailablePage(r *http.Request, gitErr string) {
	@layout.Html("Credit Policy — unavailable") {
		@creditPolicyHeader(r, "Credit Policy", "", "", nil) {
		}
		<div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 py-12 mb-12">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-red-200 overflow-hidden">
				<div class="px-8 py-6 border-b border-gray-100 bg-red-50">
					<h1 class="text-xl font-bold text-red-900">Credit policy data is unavailable</h1>
					<p class="text-sm text-red-800 mt-2">
						The git sync to Bitbucket is failing. We can't show or edit policy values until it recovers — Bitbucket master is the source of truth and we never display stale data.
					</p>
				</div>
				<div class="px-8 py-6 space-y-4">
					if gitErr != "" {
						<div>
							<div class="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 mb-2 font-semibold">Last error</div>
							<pre class="px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200 text-xs text-gray-800 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">{ gitErr }</pre>
						</div>
					} else {
						<p class="text-sm text-gray-600">No error captured yet — initial sync may still be in progress.</p>
					}
					<p class="text-sm text-gray-600">
						This page reloads every 5 seconds; once the next git fetch succeeds, the credit policy will load again.
					</p>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<script>
			setTimeout(function() { location.reload(); }, 5000);
		</script>
	}
}

// creditPolicyTabs renders the parent-tabs strip in a gray bar below the
// header. activeParent identifies the current tab; section is the pricing
// sub-section preserved when switching back into Pricing.
templ creditPolicyTabs(r *http.Request, cc, activeParent, section string) {
	<div class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
			<div class="flex gap-1 pt-2">
				@parentTab(r, cc, activeParent, "pricing", "Pricing & Limits", section)
				@parentTab(r, cc, activeParent, "provisioning", "Provisioning", section)
				@parentTab(r, cc, activeParent, "throttle", "Throttle & Boosting", section)
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
}

templ boosterViewSection(t boosterViewTable) {
	<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Booster</h3>
			<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Score remap applied after a period of inactivity.</p>
		</div>
		if len(t.Rows) == 0 || len(t.Buckets) == 0 {
			<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-12">
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-400">No data available.</p>
			</div>
		} else {

							for _, b := range t.Buckets {
								<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider border-l border-gray-200">{ b.Label }</th>
							}
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">

								for _, c := range row.Cells {
									<td class="px-6 py-1.5 text-sm text-gray-700 border-l border-gray-200">{ strings.ToUpper(c) }</td>
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}
```

```go
package creditpolicy

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v2"
)

const zaPlatformYAML = `
za:
  min_loan_amount_limit:
    product:
      - product_name: [short_term, unsecured]
        loan_term_from_inclusive: 1
        loan_term_to_inclusive:   3
        min_loan_amount: 250.00
      - product_name: [short_term, unsecured]
        loan_term_from_inclusive: 3
        loan_term_to_inclusive: 5
        min_loan_amount: 500.00
      - product_name: [short_term, unsecured]
        loan_term_from_inclusive: 6
        loan_term_to_inclusive: 99999
        min_loan_amount: 1000.00
  max_cash_disbursement_limit: 0.00
  statement_fee: 0.00
  monthly_fee: 60.00
  initiation_charges:
    display: "Max of R1050 or 15% for first R1000, then 10% for next R1000 and 15% if more than R1300"
    rules:
      - name: "percentage_of_principal_up_to_amount"
        priority: 100
        enabled: true
        trigger:
          field: "principalAmount"
          operator: ">"
          value: 0.00
        calculation:
          tiers:
            - name: "base_tier"
              up_to: 1000.00
              rate: 0.15
            - name: "remainder_tier"
              above: 1000.00
              rate: 0.10
          surcharges:
            - name: "new_legislation"
              condition:
                field: "principalAmount"
                operator: ">="
                value: 1300.00
              flat_fee: 15.00
          caps:
            max_total_fee: 1050.00
  withdrawal_charges:
  collection_charges:
  recovery_charges:
  interest_rate_limits:
    repo_rate_cap: true
    repo_rate: 0.0700
`

func TestZAPlatformParses(t *testing.T) {
	var root platformRoot
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(zaPlatformYAML), &root); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal failed (the bug): %v", err)
	}
	p, ok := root["za"]
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("za missing from parsed root")
	}
	if p.InitiationCharges == nil || p.InitiationCharges.Display == "" {
		t.Fatalf("initiation display not parsed: %+v", p.InitiationCharges)
	}
	if p.MonthlyFee == nil || *p.MonthlyFee != 60 {
		t.Fatalf("monthly fee wrong: %v", p.MonthlyFee)
	}
	if !feeActive(p.MonthlyFee) {
		t.Fatal("monthly should be active")
	}
	if feeActive(p.StatementFee) {
		t.Fatal("statement (0.00) should NOT be active")
	}
	if p.WithdrawalCharges != nil || p.CollectionCharges != nil || p.RecoveryCharges != nil {
		t.Fatal("null charge blocks should stay nil")
	}
	tiers := buildMinLoanTiers(p.MinLoanAmountLimit)
	if len(tiers) != 3 || tiers[0].TermFrom != 6 || tiers[0].Amount != 1000 {
		t.Fatalf("min-loan tiers wrong: %+v", tiers)
	}
	t.Logf("OK: display=%q monthly=%v statement_active=%v tiers=%d",
		p.InitiationCharges.Display, *p.MonthlyFee, feeActive(p.StatementFee), len(tiers))
}

const withdrawalYAML = `
ke:
  withdrawal_charges:
    mobile_money: 2000.00
    eft: 3000.00
    cash:
      - tier: 1
        value_from_inclusive: 0.00
        value_to_inclusive:   199999.99
        cash_withdraw_fee:    12000.00
      - tier: 2
        value_from_inclusive: 200000.00
        value_to_inclusive:   399999.99
        cash_withdraw_fee:    14000.00
`

func TestWithdrawalEFTParses(t *testing.T) {
	var root platformRoot
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(withdrawalYAML), &root); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal failed: %v", err)
	}
	w := root["ke"].WithdrawalCharges
	if w == nil {
		t.Fatal("withdrawal_charges nil")
	}
	if w.MobileMoney != 2000 || w.EFT != 3000 {
		t.Fatalf("mobile/eft wrong: mm=%v eft=%v", w.MobileMoney, w.EFT)
	}
	if len(w.Cash) != 2 || w.Cash[0].CashWithdrawFee != 12000 {
		t.Fatalf("cash tiers wrong: %+v", w.Cash)
	}
}

func TestGroupThousands(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]string{
		"1000000": "1,000,000",
		"1234567": "1,234,567",
		"100":     "100",
		"1000":    "1,000",
		"12345":   "12,345",
	}
	for in, want := range cases {
		if got := groupThousands(in); got != want {
			t.Errorf("groupThousands(%q)=%q want %q", in, got, want)
		}
	}
	if got := formatCurrency(1000000); got != "1,000,000.00" {
		t.Errorf("formatCurrency(1000000)=%q want 1,000,000.00", got)
	}
}

func TestFormatInitiationDisplay(t *testing.T) {
	in := "1. R0 to R1000 = 15% of principal amount 2. > R1000 = R150 + 10% of amount above R1000 3. if the value is more than R1300, then add additional R15 surcharge Max Fee Capped: R1050"
	got := formatInitiationDisplay(in)
	lines := strings.Split(got, "\n")
	if len(lines) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("want 3 lines, got %d: %q", len(lines), got)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(lines[0], "1.") || !strings.HasPrefix(lines[1], "2.") || !strings.HasPrefix(lines[2], "3.") {
		t.Fatalf("lines not split on markers: %q", lines)
	}
	// Author-supplied newlines are left untouched.
	withNL := "a\nb"
	if formatInitiationDisplay(withNL) != withNL {
		t.Errorf("existing newlines should be preserved")
	}
}

const testSplitYAML = `

  behaviour:
    - countries: [zm, ug, ke, tz]
      value_from_inclusive: 0
      value_to_inclusive: 799
    - countries: [za]
      value_from_inclusive: 0

  acquisition:

      value_to_inclusive: 749
    - scorecard_key: acq
      countries: [za]
      value_from_inclusive: 0
      value_to_inclusive: 749
test:
  behaviour:
    - countries: [zm, ug, ke, tz]
      value_from_inclusive: 800
      value_to_inclusive: 999
    - countries: [za]
      value_from_inclusive: 800
      value_to_inclusive: 999
  acquisition:
    - countries: [zm, ug, ke, tz]
      value_from_inclusive: 750
      value_to_inclusive: 999
    - countries: [za]
      value_from_inclusive: 750
      value_to_inclusive: 999
`

func TestBuildCoreTestSplit(t *testing.T) {
	var ts testSplitRoot
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(testSplitYAML), &ts); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	v := buildCoreTestSplit(&ts, "zm")
	if !v.Present || v.Countries != "ZM, KE, TZ, UG" {
		t.Fatalf("countries=%q present=%v", v.Countries, v.Present)
	}
	if len(v.Rows) != 2 || v.Rows[0].Scorecard != "Acquisition" ||
		v.Rows[0].CoreRange != "0 – 749" || v.Rows[0].TestRange != "750 – 999" ||
		v.Rows[1].CoreRange != "0 – 799" || v.Rows[1].TestRange != "800 – 999" {
		t.Fatalf("rows wrong: %+v", v.Rows)
	}
	if za := buildCoreTestSplit(&ts, "za"); za.Countries != "ZA" {
		t.Fatalf("za group=%q want ZA", za.Countries)
	}
}
```

## File: modules\tools\dashboardconfig\dashboardconfig.go
```go
// Package dashboardconfig serves the /tools/dashboard-config page — a UI
// for editing the four lists that drive the home dashboard (favorites,
// L2 dashboards, L2 lists, and the tools column).
//
// The page reads from and writes to the dashboardConfig Firestore
// collection via base.DashboardConfigCache. Access is allowlist-driven
// via the cache's own tool entry (the "Dashboard Config" toolEntry's
// AllowedEmails) — the same gate that decides who sees the tile in the
// View More overlay.
package dashboardconfig

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/mid"
	"github.com/Rockup-Consulting/std/core/web"

	"ujuzi/core/auth"
	"ujuzi/core/country"
	"ujuzi/core/uj"
	"ujuzi/core/webx"
	"ujuzi/modules/base"
)

type module struct {
	l     *log.Logger
	fsDb  *firestore.Client
	dbs   *country.DBs
	cache *base.DashboardConfigCache
}

func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	fsDb *firestore.Client,
	cache *base.DashboardConfigCache,
) {
	m := &module{l: l, fsDb: fsDb, dbs: dbs, cache: cache}

	// GET needs country context for the CC dropdown; POST does not — and
	// dbs.Mid 303-redirects when `cc` is missing on the request, which
	// would silently swallow the form body. Same pattern as the dataform
	// admin tool: GET uses dbs.Mid, POST does not.
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/dashboard-config", m.loader, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/dashboard-config", m.action, stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid)...)
}

func stdMid(l *log.Logger, additionalMid ...web.Middleware) []web.Middleware {
	m := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	}
	return append(m, additionalMid...)
}

// hasAccess looks up the "Dashboard Config" tool in the cache and checks
// whether u is on its AllowedEmails. Mirrors the gate used by the View
// More overlay so the tile and the page stay in sync.
func (m *module) hasAccess(u auth.User) bool {
	for _, t := range m.cache.Tools() {
		if t.URL != "/tools/dashboard-config" {
			continue
		}
		for _, e := range t.AllowedEmails {
			if strings.EqualFold(u.Email, e) {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	return false
}

func (m *module) loader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)

	if !m.hasAccess(u) {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	return page(pageData{
		R:             r,
		U:             u,
		CC:            c.Code,
		UserCountries: userCountries,
		Favorites:     m.cache.Favorites(),
		Dashboards:    m.cache.Dashboards(),
		Lists:         m.cache.Lists(),
		Tools:         m.cache.Tools(),
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) action(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	if !m.hasAccess(u) {
		return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/")
	}

	kind := base.DashboardConfigKind(r.FormValue("_kind"))
	switch kind {
	case base.KindFavorite, base.KindDashboard, base.KindList, base.KindTool:
		// ok
	default:
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid kind")
	}

	raw := r.FormValue("entries_json")
	if raw == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "missing entries_json")
	}

	var entries []base.DashboardConfigEntry
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &entries); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("dashboard-config: failed to decode entries_json: %v", err)
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid entries_json")
	}

	if err := m.cache.ReplaceKind(ctx, kind, entries); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("dashboard-config: ReplaceKind(%s) failed: %v", kind, err)
		return err
	}

	m.l.Printf("dashboard-config: %s replaced %d entries by %s", kind, len(entries), u.Email)
	return uj.Redirect(w, r, "/tools/dashboard-config?tab="+string(kind))
}
```

```templ
package dashboardconfig

type pageData struct {
	R             *http.Request
	U             auth.User
	CC            string
	UserCountries []country.Country
	Favorites     []base.DashboardConfigEntry
	Dashboards    []base.DashboardConfigEntry
	Lists         []base.DashboardConfigEntry
	Tools         []base.DashboardConfigEntry
}

// entriesJSON serializes the entries slice for embedding in a data
// attribute. The client-side JS reads this on page load to render
// initial rows, then re-emits a fresh JSON blob into entries_json when
// the user clicks Save.
func entriesJSON(entries []base.DashboardConfigEntry) string {
	if entries == nil {
		entries = []base.DashboardConfigEntry{}
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(entries)
	if err != nil {
		return "[]"
	}
	return string(b)
}

					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>

			<div class="flex items-center gap-x-3 mb-4">

				<button
					type="button"
					id="dc-help-btn"
					class="rounded-full border border-gray-300 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 hover:border-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700"
					onclick="(function(){var p=document.getElementById('dc-help-panel');p.classList.toggle('hidden');})()"
				>How to use</button>

				<p><strong>Dashboards</strong> — Looker entries inside the View More overlay. Looked up by <em>Report Title</em> same as favorites.</p>
				<p><strong>Lists</strong> — Jasper entries inside the View More overlay. <em>Extension</em> is the last segment of the Jasper path (e.g. <code class="font-mono text-xs bg-white rounded px-1">Sales_List</code>).</p>

templ tabButton(kind string, label string, active bool) {
	<button
		type="button"
		data-tab={ kind }
		class={ tabBtnClass(active) }
	>{ label }</button>
}

func tabBtnClass(active bool) string {
	base := "dc-tab whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 py-3 px-1 text-sm font-medium"
	if active {
		return base + " border-gray-900 text-gray-900"
	}
	return base + " border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:border-gray-300 hover:text-gray-700"
}

// kindForm renders one tab's editable table + save button. The form
// submits via the dc-save() JS function, which serializes the visible
// rows into entries_json before submission.
templ kindForm(r *http.Request, kind base.DashboardConfigKind, label string, entries []base.DashboardConfigEntry) {
	<form
		method="POST"
		action="/tools/dashboard-config"
		class="dc-form"
		data-kind={ string(kind) }
	>
		<input type="hidden" name="_kind" value={ string(kind) }/>
		<input type="hidden" name="entries_json" class="dc-entries-json" value=""/>
		<div class="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
			<div class="overflow-x-auto">
				<table class="min-w-full text-sm">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="w-8 px-3 py-2"></th>
							@kindHeaders(kind)
							<th class="w-8 px-3 py-2"></th>
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="dc-tbody divide-y divide-gray-100" data-kind={ string(kind) }>
						for _, e := range entries {
							@kindRow(kind, e)
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
			if len(entries) == 0 {
				<p class="text-sm text-gray-400 italic px-4 py-3 border-t border-gray-100">No entries yet — click "Add row" to start.</p>
			}
			<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-t border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
				<button
					type="button"
					class="dc-add-btn rounded-md bg-white border border-gray-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
					data-kind={ string(kind) }
				>+ Add { label }</button>
				<button
					type="submit"
					class="rounded-md bg-gray-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-700"
				>Save { label }</button>
			</div>
		</div>
	</form>
}

// emailChips renders a chip-style multi-value input for tool AllowedEmails.
// Each existing email is a removable pill; the trailing <input> lets the
// user type a new email — Enter, comma, or blur commits it as a new chip.
// serializeForm walks the chips (not the input) when posting.
templ emailChips(emails []string) {
	<div class="dc-emails flex flex-wrap gap-1 items-center min-h-[2.25rem] rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 bg-white focus-within:border-gray-500" tabindex="-1">
		for _, em := range emails {
			@emailChip(em)
		}
		<input
			type="email"
			class="dc-email-input flex-1 min-w-[10rem] outline-none border-0 p-0 text-sm bg-transparent"
			placeholder="Add email…"
			autocomplete="off"
		/>
	</div>
}

templ emailChip(email string) {
	<span class="dc-chip inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-full pl-2 pr-1 py-0.5 text-xs text-gray-800" data-email={ email }>
		<span class="dc-chip-text">{ email }</span>
		<button type="button" class="dc-chip-remove text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600 leading-none w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center" title="Remove">
			<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-3 w-3" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2.5" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
		</button>
	</span>
}

templ kindHeaders(kind base.DashboardConfigKind) {
	switch kind {
		case base.KindFavorite, base.KindDashboard:
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Label</th>
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Report Title</th>
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase w-24">MinLevel</th>
		case base.KindList:
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Label</th>
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Extension</th>
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase w-24">MinLevel</th>
		case base.KindTool:
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Label</th>
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">URL</th>
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Description</th>
			<th class="px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">Allowed Emails</th>
	}
}

templ kindRow(kind base.DashboardConfigKind, e base.DashboardConfigEntry) {
	<tr class="dc-row" data-id={ e.ID }>
		<td class="px-3 py-2 align-middle">
			<span class="dc-drag cursor-grab text-gray-400 select-none" title="Drag to reorder">
				<svg class="h-4 w-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M7 4a1 1 0 000 2h6a1 1 0 100-2H7zM7 9a1 1 0 000 2h6a1 1 0 100-2H7zM7 14a1 1 0 000 2h6a1 1 0 100-2H7z"/></svg>
			</span>
		</td>
		switch kind {
			case base.KindFavorite, base.KindDashboard:
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-label w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ e.Label }/></td>
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-reporttitle w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ e.ReportTitle }/></td>
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="number" min="1" max="5" class="dc-minlevel w-20 rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", e.MinLevel) }/></td>
			case base.KindList:
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-label w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ e.Label }/></td>
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-extension w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ e.Extension }/></td>
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="number" min="1" max="5" class="dc-minlevel w-20 rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", e.MinLevel) }/></td>
			case base.KindTool:
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-label w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ e.Label }/></td>
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-url w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ e.URL }/></td>
				<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-description w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value={ e.Description }/></td>
				<td class="px-3 py-2">
					@emailChips(e.AllowedEmails)
				</td>
		}
		<td class="px-3 py-2 align-middle text-right">
			<button type="button" class="dc-delete text-gray-300 hover:text-red-600" title="Remove row">
				<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
			</button>
		</td>
	</tr>
}

templ pageScript() {
	<script>
		(function () {
			// ── Tab switching ─────────────────────────────────────────────
			var tabs  = document.querySelectorAll('.dc-tab');
			var panels = document.querySelectorAll('.dc-panel');
			function showTab(name) {
				tabs.forEach(function (t) {
					var active = t.dataset.tab === name;
					t.classList.toggle('border-gray-900', active);
					t.classList.toggle('text-gray-900', active);
					t.classList.toggle('border-transparent', !active);
					t.classList.toggle('text-gray-500', !active);
				});
				panels.forEach(function (p) {
					p.classList.toggle('hidden', p.id !== 'dc-panel-' + name);
				});
			}
			tabs.forEach(function (t) { t.addEventListener('click', function () { showTab(t.dataset.tab); }); });

			// Open the tab named in ?tab= (used by the action handler after save)
			var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
			var initial = params.get('tab');
			if (initial && document.getElementById('dc-panel-' + initial)) { showTab(initial); }

			// ── Row template per kind ─────────────────────────────────────
			function makeRow(kind) {
				var tr = document.createElement('tr');
				tr.className = 'dc-row';
				tr.dataset.id = '';
				var drag = '<td class="px-3 py-2 align-middle"><span class="dc-drag cursor-grab text-gray-400 select-none" title="Drag to reorder"><svg class="h-4 w-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M7 4a1 1 0 000 2h6a1 1 0 100-2H7zM7 9a1 1 0 000 2h6a1 1 0 100-2H7zM7 14a1 1 0 000 2h6a1 1 0 100-2H7z"/></svg></span></td>';
				var del = '<td class="px-3 py-2 align-middle text-right"><button type="button" class="dc-delete text-gray-300 hover:text-red-600" title="Remove row"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button></td>';
				var mid;
				if (kind === 'favorite' || kind === 'dashboard') {
					mid = '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-label w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm"/></td>'
					    + '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-reporttitle w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm"/></td>'
					    + '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="number" min="1" max="5" class="dc-minlevel w-20 rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value="1"/></td>';
				} else if (kind === 'list') {
					mid = '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-label w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm"/></td>'
					    + '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-extension w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm"/></td>'
					    + '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="number" min="1" max="5" class="dc-minlevel w-20 rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm" value="2"/></td>';
				} else if (kind === 'tool') {
					mid = '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-label w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm"/></td>'
					    + '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-url w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm"/></td>'
					    + '<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="text" class="dc-description w-full rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-sm"/></td>'
					    + '<td class="px-3 py-2">'
					    +   '<div class="dc-emails flex flex-wrap gap-1 items-center min-h-[2.25rem] rounded border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 bg-white focus-within:border-gray-500" tabindex="-1">'
					    +     '<input type="email" class="dc-email-input flex-1 min-w-[10rem] outline-none border-0 p-0 text-sm bg-transparent" placeholder="Add email…" autocomplete="off"/>'
					    +   '</div>'
					    + '</td>';
				}
				tr.innerHTML = drag + mid + del;
				return tr;
			}

			// ── Add row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
			document.querySelectorAll('.dc-add-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
				btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
					var kind = btn.dataset.kind;
					var tbody = document.querySelector('.dc-tbody[data-kind="' + kind + '"]');
					tbody.appendChild(makeRow(kind));
				});
			});

			// ── Delete row (event delegation, handles dynamic rows) ──────
			document.querySelectorAll('.dc-tbody').forEach(function (tbody) {
				tbody.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
					var btn = ev.target.closest('.dc-delete');
					if (!btn) return;
					var tr = btn.closest('tr');
					if (tr) tr.remove();
				});
			});

			// ── Email chips ──────────────────────────────────────────────
			// Event-delegated handlers cover both server-rendered and
			// dynamically-added rows. The chip element carries the email
			// in data-email; serializeForm reads that, not the input.
			function makeChip(email) {
				var span = document.createElement('span');
				span.className = 'dc-chip inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-full pl-2 pr-1 py-0.5 text-xs text-gray-800';
				span.dataset.email = email;
				span.innerHTML = '<span class="dc-chip-text"></span>'
					+ '<button type="button" class="dc-chip-remove text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600 leading-none w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center" title="Remove">'
					+   '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-3 w-3" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2.5" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/></svg>'
					+ '</button>';
				span.querySelector('.dc-chip-text').textContent = email;
				return span;
			}
			function commitEmail(container, raw) {
				var email = (raw || '').trim().replace(/,$/, '').trim();
				if (email === '') return;
				// Allow multiple at once (paste "a@x.com, b@y.com")
				var parts = email.split(/[,\s]+/).map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
				var existing = {};
				container.querySelectorAll('.dc-chip').forEach(function (c) { existing[c.dataset.email.toLowerCase()] = true; });
				var input = container.querySelector('.dc-email-input');
				parts.forEach(function (p) {
					if (existing[p.toLowerCase()]) return;
					existing[p.toLowerCase()] = true;
					container.insertBefore(makeChip(p), input);
				});
				input.value = '';
			}
			document.body.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
				if (!ev.target.classList || !ev.target.classList.contains('dc-email-input')) return;
				if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ',' || ev.key === 'Tab') {
					if (ev.target.value.trim() === '') return; // Tab with empty input → let it focus next field
					ev.preventDefault();
					commitEmail(ev.target.parentElement, ev.target.value);
				} else if (ev.key === 'Backspace' && ev.target.value === '') {
					// Backspace on empty input removes the last chip
					var chips = ev.target.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.dc-chip');
					if (chips.length > 0) chips[chips.length - 1].remove();
				}
			});
			document.body.addEventListener('blur', function (ev) {
				if (!ev.target.classList || !ev.target.classList.contains('dc-email-input')) return;
				if (ev.target.value.trim() !== '') commitEmail(ev.target.parentElement, ev.target.value);
			}, true);
			document.body.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
				// Click ✕ on a chip to remove it
				var rm = ev.target.closest('.dc-chip-remove');
				if (rm) {
					var chip = rm.closest('.dc-chip');
					if (chip) chip.remove();
					return;
				}
				// Click anywhere on the chip container focuses the input
				var cont = ev.target.closest('.dc-emails');
				if (cont && !ev.target.closest('.dc-chip')) {
					var inp = cont.querySelector('.dc-email-input');
					if (inp) inp.focus();
				}
			});

			// ── Serialize on submit ───────────────────────────────────────
			function serializeForm(form) {
				var kind = form.dataset.kind;
				var rows = form.querySelectorAll('.dc-tbody tr.dc-row');
				var out = [];
				rows.forEach(function (tr) {
					var entry = { ID: tr.dataset.id || '' };
					if (kind === 'favorite' || kind === 'dashboard') {
						entry.Label       = tr.querySelector('.dc-label').value.trim();
						entry.ReportTitle = tr.querySelector('.dc-reporttitle').value.trim();
						entry.MinLevel    = parseInt(tr.querySelector('.dc-minlevel').value, 10) || 1;
					} else if (kind === 'list') {
						entry.Label     = tr.querySelector('.dc-label').value.trim();
						entry.Extension = tr.querySelector('.dc-extension').value.trim();
						entry.MinLevel  = parseInt(tr.querySelector('.dc-minlevel').value, 10) || 1;
					} else if (kind === 'tool') {
						entry.Label       = tr.querySelector('.dc-label').value.trim();
						entry.URL         = tr.querySelector('.dc-url').value.trim();
						entry.Description = tr.querySelector('.dc-description').value.trim();
						// Commit any pending text in the chip input before reading chips
						var emailInput = tr.querySelector('.dc-email-input');
						if (emailInput && emailInput.value.trim() !== '') {
							commitEmail(emailInput.parentElement, emailInput.value);
						}
						entry.AllowedEmails = Array.prototype.map.call(
							tr.querySelectorAll('.dc-chip'),
							function (c) { return c.dataset.email; }
						);
						entry.MinLevel = 0;
					}
					// Skip rows where the user removed all content
					if (entry.Label === '') return;
					out.push(entry);
				});
				form.querySelector('.dc-entries-json').value = JSON.stringify(out);
			}
			document.querySelectorAll('.dc-form').forEach(function (f) {
				f.addEventListener('submit', function () { serializeForm(f); });
			});

			// ── SortableJS (loaded from CDN, same as dataform) ────────────
			var s = document.createElement('script');
			s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.2/Sortable.min.js';
			s.onload = function () {
				document.querySelectorAll('.dc-tbody').forEach(function (tbody) {
					Sortable.create(tbody, { handle: '.dc-drag', animation: 150 });
				});
			};
			document.head.appendChild(s);
		})();
	</script>
}
```

```go
package datadictionary

// =============================================
// MODULE

type module struct {
	l   *log.Logger
	dbs *country.DBs
	bq  *bqpkg.Service
}

func InitModule(
	l *log.Logger,
	app *web.App,
	sessionStore auth.Store,
	dbs *country.DBs,
	bqService *bqpkg.Service,
) {
	m := &module{l: l, dbs: dbs, bq: bqService}
	std := stdMid(l, sessionStore.Mid, dbs.Mid(l))

	// Main page
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary", m.pageLoader, std...)
	// History
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary/history", m.historyLoader, std...)
	// Feature CRUD
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary/feature/new", m.featureNewLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/feature/new", m.featureNewAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary/feature/{id}/edit", m.featureEditLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/feature/delete/{id}", m.featureDeleteAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/feature/{id}", m.featureEditAction, std...)
	// Identifier CRUD
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/new", m.identifierNewLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/new", m.identifierNewAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/{id}/edit", m.identifierEditLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/delete/{id}", m.identifierDeleteAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/{id}", m.identifierEditAction, std...)
	// Naming convention CRUD
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary/naming/new", m.namingNewLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/naming/new", m.namingNewAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodGet, "/tools/data-dictionary/naming/{id}/edit", m.namingEditLoader, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/naming/delete/{id}", m.namingDeleteAction, std...)
	app.Handle(http.MethodPost, "/tools/data-dictionary/naming/{id}", m.namingEditAction, std...)
}

func stdMid(l *log.Logger, additionalMid ...web.Middleware) []web.Middleware {
	m := []web.Middleware{
		mid.Log(l),
		mid.CatchErr(l),
		webx.MidCatchConnDrop(l),
		mid.CatchPanic(),
		mid.TryGzip,
	}
	return append(m, additionalMid...)
}

// =============================================
// HELPERS

func renderMarkdown(s string) string {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := goldmark.Convert([]byte(s), &buf); err != nil {
		return html.EscapeString(s)
	}
	return buf.String()
}

func tabAnchor(tab string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(tab) {
		if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
			b.WriteRune(r)
		} else {
			b.WriteRune('-')
		}
	}
	return b.String()
}

func tabBtnClass(active bool) string {
	base := "px-5 py-2 text-sm max-w-36 truncate shrink-0 rounded-t-lg transition-colors"
	if active {
		return base + " font-semibold bg-gray-200 text-gray-900"
	}
	return base + " bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200 hover:text-gray-800"
}

func tabPanelClass(active bool) string {
	if active {
		return ""
	}
	return "hidden"
}

func featureFromBQ(e bqpkg.BQFeatureEntry) FeatureEntry {
	out := FeatureEntry{
		ID:                  e.ID,
		FieldName:           e.FieldName,
		EnglishName:         e.EnglishName,
		Domain:              e.Domain,
		TimeWindow:          e.TimeWindow,
		DataType:            e.DataType,
		CountryAvailability: e.CountryAvailability,
		Description:         e.Description,
		Derivation:          e.Derivation,
		LegacyNames:         e.LegacyNames,
		Owner:               e.Owner,
		Active:              e.Active,
	}
	if e.Created.Valid {
		out.Created = e.Created.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02")
	}
	return out
}

func identifierFromBQ(e bqpkg.BQIdentifierEntry) IdentifierEntry {
	out := IdentifierEntry{

var namingTypeLabel = map[string]string{
	"DOMAIN":      "1. Domain",
	"ENTITY":      "2. Entity",

// =============================================
// HANDLER — MAIN PAGE

func (m *module) pageLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	bqFeatures, err := m.bq.GetActiveFeatureEntries(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading feature store: %v", err)
		bqFeatures = nil
	}

	bqIdentifiers, err := m.bq.GetActiveIdentifierEntries(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading identifiers: %v", err)
		bqIdentifiers = nil
	}

	bqNaming, err := m.bq.GetActiveNamingConvention(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("ERROR loading naming convention: %v", err)
		bqNaming = nil
	}

	// Flat features list.
	var features []FeatureEntry
	for _, e := range bqFeatures {
		features = append(features, featureFromBQ(e))
	}

	// Flat identifiers list.
	var identifiers []IdentifierEntry
	for _, e := range bqIdentifiers {
		identifiers = append(identifiers, identifierFromBQ(e))
	}

	// Group naming convention by type.
	namingByType := make(map[string][]NamingConventionEntry)
	for _, n := range bqNaming {
		entry := namingFromBQ(n)
		namingByType[entry.ComponentType] = append(namingByType[entry.ComponentType], entry)
	}
	var namingTypes []string
	for _, t := range namingTypeOrder {
		if _, ok := namingByType[t]; ok {
			namingTypes = append(namingTypes, t)
		}
	}

	// Fixed 4 tabs.
	tabs := []string{"Scoring Features", "Identifiers & Dates", "Naming Conventions", "Overview"}

	editMode := r.URL.Query().Get("edit") == "1"

	activeTab := r.URL.Query().Get("tab")
	validTab := false
	for _, tab := range tabs {
		if tabAnchor(tab) == activeTab {
			validTab = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !validTab {
		activeTab = tabAnchor(tabs[0])
	}

	var editToggleURL string
	if editMode {
		editToggleURL = "/tools/data-dictionary?tab=" + activeTab
	} else {
		editToggleURL = "/tools/data-dictionary?tab=" + activeTab + "&edit=1"
	}

	// Search JSON.
	var items []searchItem
	for _, e := range features {
		items = append(items, searchItem{
			ID:      "row-" + e.ID,
			Term:    e.FieldName,
			Desc:    e.EnglishName + " — " + e.Description,
			Section: tabAnchor("Scoring Features"),
		})
	}
	for _, e := range identifiers {
		items = append(items, searchItem{
			ID:      "row-" + e.ID,
			Term:    e.FieldName,
			Desc:    e.Meaning,
			Section: tabAnchor("Identifiers & Dates"),
		})
	}
	searchJSON, _ := json.Marshal(items)

	// Build naming lookup JSON for the feature decoder on the Overview tab.
	type namingLookup struct {
		Code string `json:"code"`
		Name string `json:"name"`
		Desc string `json:"desc"`
		Type string `json:"type"`
	}
	var allNaming []namingLookup
	for _, entries := range namingByType {
		for _, n := range entries {
			allNaming = append(allNaming, namingLookup{Code: n.Code, Name: n.Name, Desc: n.Description, Type: n.ComponentType})
		}
	}
	namingJSON, _ := json.Marshal(allNaming)

	return dataDictPage(pageData{
		r:             r,
		u:             u,
		cc:            c.Code,
		userCountries: userCountries,
		Tabs:          tabs,
		Features:      features,
		Identifiers:   identifiers,
		ActiveTab:     activeTab,
		EditMode:      editMode,
		EditToggleURL: editToggleURL,
		EntriesJSON:   string(searchJSON),
		CanEdit:       true,
		NamingByType:  namingByType,
		NamingTypes:   namingTypes,
		NamingJSON:    string(namingJSON),
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) featureEditLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	bqE, err := m.bq.GetFeatureEntry(ctx, r.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load feature entry: %w", err)
	}
	if bqE == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Entry not found")
	}

	return featureEditPage(featureEditData{
		r: r, u: u, cc: c.Code, userCountries: userCountries,
		Entry:   featureFromBQ(*bqE),
		BackURL: "/tools/data-dictionary?edit=1",
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) featureEditAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	id := r.PathValue("id")

	bqE, err := m.bq.GetFeatureEntry(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load feature entry: %w", err)
	}
	if bqE == nil {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Entry not found")
	}

	fieldName := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("field_name"))
	if fieldName == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Field name is required")
	}

	if err := m.bq.DeactivateFeatureEntry(ctx, id); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to deactivate feature entry: %w", err)
	}

	if err := m.bq.InsertFeatureEntry(ctx, featureFromForm(r, u.Email, fieldName)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert feature entry: %w", err)
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, "/tools/data-dictionary")
	return nil
}

		Entry: NamingConventionEntry{}, BackURL: "/tools/data-dictionary?tab=overview", IsNew: true,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}

func (m *module) namingNewAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User

	code := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("code"))
	if code == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Code is required")
	}
	componentType := strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("component_type"))
	if componentType == "" {
		return web.Text(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Component type is required")
	}

	if err := m.bq.InsertNamingConventionEntry(ctx, namingFromForm(r, u.Email, code)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert naming entry: %w", err)
	}

	uj.Redirect(w, r, "/tools/data-dictionary?tab=overview")
	return nil
}

func namingFromForm(r *http.Request, email, code string) bqpkg.BQNamingConvention {
	return bqpkg.BQNamingConvention{
		ID:            randx.UID(),
		ComponentType: strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("component_type")),
		Code:          code,
		Name:          strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("name")),
		Description:   strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("description")),
		Owner:         email,
		Created:       bigquery.NullTimestamp{Timestamp: time.Now(), Valid: true},
		Active:        true,
	}
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — DELETE

func (m *module) featureDeleteAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	id := r.PathValue("id")
	m.l.Printf("DELETE feature: id=%q starting", id)
	if err := m.bq.DeactivateFeatureEntry(r.Context(), id); err != nil {
		m.l.Printf("DELETE feature: id=%q ERROR: %v", id, err)
		http.Error(w, "delete failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return nil
	}
	m.l.Printf("DELETE feature: id=%q done", id)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	return nil
}

func (m *module) identifierDeleteAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if err := m.bq.DeactivateIdentifierEntry(r.Context(), r.PathValue("id")); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete identifier entry: %w", err)
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	return nil
}

func (m *module) namingDeleteAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	if err := m.bq.DeactivateNamingConventionEntry(r.Context(), r.PathValue("id")); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete naming entry: %w", err)
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	return nil
}

// =============================================
// HANDLERS — HISTORY

func (m *module) historyLoader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	ctx := r.Context()
	u := auth.FromCtx(ctx).User
	c := country.FromCtx(ctx)
	userCountries := m.dbs.GetUserCachedUserCountries(ctx, u)

	fieldName := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("field"))
	historyType := r.URL.Query().Get("type")

	if historyType == "identifier" {
		var history []IdentifierEntry
		if fieldName != "" {
			bqRows, err := m.bq.GetIdentifierHistory(ctx, fieldName)
			if err != nil {
				m.l.Printf("ERROR loading identifier history: %v", err)
			} else {
				for _, e := range bqRows {
					history = append(history, identifierFromBQ(e))
				}
			}
		}
		return identifierHistoryPage(identifierHistoryData{
			r: r, u: u, cc: c.Code, userCountries: userCountries,
			FieldName: fieldName, History: history,
		}).Render(ctx, w)
	}

	// Default: feature history
	var history []FeatureEntry
	if fieldName != "" {
		bqRows, err := m.bq.GetFeatureHistory(ctx, fieldName)
		if err != nil {
			m.l.Printf("ERROR loading feature history: %v", err)
		} else {
			for _, e := range bqRows {
				history = append(history, featureFromBQ(e))
			}
		}
	}
	return featureHistoryPage(featureHistoryData{
		r: r, u: u, cc: c.Code, userCountries: userCountries,
		FieldName: fieldName, History: history,
	}).Render(ctx, w)
}
```

```templ
script deleteEntry(action string, rowID string) {
	if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this entry?")) return;
	const cc = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("cc");
	const url = cc ? action + "?cc=" + encodeURIComponent(cc) : action;
	fetch(url, { method: "POST" }).then(resp => {
		if (resp.ok) {
			const row = document.getElementById(rowID);
			if (row) row.remove();
		}
	});
}

templ dataDictPage(d pageData) {
	@layout.Html("Data Dictionary") {
		<!-- Page header -->
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light flex items-center justify-between px-4 h-14 z-50">

				</a>
				<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/") } class="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-x-dark transition-all duration-150" title="Back to Home">
					<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" class="w-5 h-5">
						<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/>
					</svg>
				</a>
				<span class="text-white font-semibold text-lg">Data Dictionary</span>
			</div>
			<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
				<button onclick="openDictSearch()" class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors border border-white/30">Search</button>
				if d.EditMode {
					<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, d.EditToggleURL) } class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white text-red-x-dark text-sm font-medium transition-colors">Exit Edit</a>
				} else {
					<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, d.EditToggleURL) } class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors border border-white/30">Edit</a>
				}
				@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Tab strip -->
		<div class="bg-white border-b border-gray-200">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex gap-1 pt-2 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden">
					for i, tab := range d.Tabs {
						<button
							id={ fmt.Sprintf("tab-btn-%s", tabAnchor(tab)) }
							data-tab-btn={ tabAnchor(tab) }
							onclick="showTab(this.dataset.tabBtn)"
							title={ tab }
							class={ tabBtnClass(i == 0) }
						>{ tab }</button>
					}
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Content -->
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 py-6 mb-12">
			if len(d.Tabs) == 0 {
				<p class="text-gray-400 text-center py-20">No data dictionary entries found.</p>
			} else {
				for i, tab := range d.Tabs {
					<div id={ fmt.Sprintf("tab-content-%s", tabAnchor(tab)) } data-tab-content class={ tabPanelClass(i == 0) }>
						if tab == "Overview" {
							@overviewPanel(d)

							@namingPanel(d)
						} else if tab == "Scoring Features" {
							@featuresPanel(d)
						} else if tab == "Identifiers & Dates" {
							@keysPanel(d)
						}
					</div>
				}
			}
		</div>
		<!-- Search overlay -->
		<div id="dict-search-overlay" class="hidden fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-24 px-4" onclick="closeDictSearch(event)">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
				<div class="p-4 border-b border-gray-100">
					<input id="dict-search-input" type="text" placeholder="Search fields..." oninput="filterDictSearch(this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
				</div>
				<ul id="dict-search-results" class="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-gray-100"></ul>
				<div id="dict-search-empty" class="hidden py-10 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">No fields found</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<script>
			const TAB_ACTIVE   = ['font-semibold','bg-gray-200','text-gray-900'];
			const TAB_INACTIVE = ['bg-gray-100','text-gray-600','hover:bg-gray-200','hover:text-gray-800'];
			function showTab(anchor) {
				document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-content]').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
				document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-btn]').forEach(btn => { btn.classList.remove(...TAB_ACTIVE); btn.classList.add(...TAB_INACTIVE); });
				const panel = document.getElementById('tab-content-' + anchor);
				const btn   = document.getElementById('tab-btn-'     + anchor);
				if (panel) panel.classList.remove('hidden');
				if (btn)   { btn.classList.remove(...TAB_INACTIVE); btn.classList.add(...TAB_ACTIVE); }
			}
			function openDictSearch() {
				document.getElementById('dict-search-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
				const input = document.getElementById('dict-search-input');
				input.value = ''; filterDictSearch(''); setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 50);
			}
			function closeDictSearch(e) {
				if (!e || e.target === document.getElementById('dict-search-overlay'))
					document.getElementById('dict-search-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
			}
			document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDictSearch(); });
			function filterDictSearch(query) {
				const q = query.toLowerCase();
				const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[data-field]');
				const list = document.getElementById('dict-search-results');
				const empty = document.getElementById('dict-search-empty');
				list.innerHTML = ''; let count = 0;
				rows.forEach(row => {
					const field = row.dataset.field || '';
					const desc  = row.dataset.description || '';
					if (!q || field.toLowerCase().includes(q) || desc.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
						const li = document.createElement('li');
						li.className = 'px-5 py-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors';
						li.innerHTML = '<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">' + escapeHtml(field) + '</p><p class="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">' + escapeHtml(desc) + '</p>';
						li.addEventListener('click', () => goToField(row.id, row.dataset.section));
						list.appendChild(li); count++;
					}
				});
				empty.classList.toggle('hidden', count > 0);
				list.classList.toggle('hidden', count === 0);
			}
			function goToField(rowId, section) {
				closeDictSearch();
				if (section) showTab(section);
				const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
				if (!row) return;
				setTimeout(() => { row.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}); row.classList.add('bg-green-100'); setTimeout(() => row.classList.remove('bg-green-100'), 2500); }, 50);
			}
			function escapeHtml(s) { return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }
		</script>
	}
}

				<span class="px-2 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 rounded text-xs font-mono">ZA_DEM_FEATURES_202503</span>

	<div class="mb-8 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-6">
		<h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3">Feature Naming Convention</h2>

		<div class="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4 mb-4 font-mono text-sm text-gray-800">
			<span class="font-bold">[DOMAIN]</span>_<span class="font-bold">[ENTITY]</span>_<span class="font-bold">[METRIC]</span>_<span class="font-bold">[AGGREGATION]</span>_<span class="font-bold">[TIME_WINDOW]</span>
		</div>
		<p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-4">All names are uppercase and underscore-separated. Not every component is required — shorter names are preferred where the meaning remains unambiguous.</p>
		<div class="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg p-4">
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-amber-900 mb-2">Worked Example</h3>
			<p class="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-amber-900 mb-2">DLQ_CD1_CNT_24M</p>
			<p class="text-sm text-amber-800 mb-3">Number of cycles in the past 24 months with contractual delinquency of 1 or worse</p>
			<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-xs">
				<div class="bg-white/60 rounded p-2"><span class="font-mono font-bold text-amber-900">DLQ</span><p class="text-amber-700">Domain = delinquency</p></div>
				<div class="bg-white/60 rounded p-2"><span class="font-mono font-bold text-amber-900">CD1</span><p class="text-amber-700">Entity = contractual delinquency, level &ge;1</p></div>
				<div class="bg-white/60 rounded p-2"><span class="font-mono font-bold text-amber-900">CNT</span><p class="text-amber-700">Aggregation = count</p></div>
				<div class="bg-white/60 rounded p-2"><span class="font-mono font-bold text-amber-900">24M</span><p class="text-amber-700">Window = past 24 months</p></div>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
	<!-- Feature name decoder -->
	<div class="rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-6">
		<h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-green-900 mb-3">Feature Name Decoder</h2>
		<p class="text-sm text-green-800 mb-4">Paste or type a feature name to break it down into its components.</p>
		<input
			id="decoder-input"
			type="text"
			placeholder="e.g. DLQ_CD1_CNT_24M"
			oninput="decodeFeature(this.value)"
			class="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-green-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono uppercase focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark bg-white"
		/>
		<div id="decoder-result" class="mt-4 hidden">
			<div id="decoder-cards" class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-2"></div>
			<div id="decoder-unknown" class="mt-3 hidden rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-amber-800"></div>
		</div>
		<div id="decoder-empty" class="mt-4 hidden text-sm text-green-700 italic">No components recognised. Check the naming convention reference on the Naming Conventions tab.</div>
	</div>
	<div id="naming-json-data" class="hidden" data-naming={ d.NamingJSON }></div>
	<script>
		const namingLookup = {};
		(function() {
			const raw = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('naming-json-data').dataset.naming || '[]');
			raw.forEach(n => { namingLookup[n.code] = n; });
		})();

		const TYPE_LABELS = { 'DOMAIN': 'Domain', 'ENTITY': 'Entity', 'METRIC': 'Metric', 'AGGREGATION': 'Aggregation', 'TIME_WINDOW': 'Window' };
		const TYPE_COLORS = {
			'DOMAIN':      'bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-900',
			'ENTITY':      'bg-purple-50 border-purple-200 text-purple-900',
			'METRIC':      'bg-teal-50 border-teal-200 text-teal-900',
			'AGGREGATION': 'bg-orange-50 border-orange-200 text-orange-900',
			'TIME_WINDOW': 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-900',
		};

		const TIME_SUFFIXES = ['24MA','24M','12M','6M','3M','1M'];

		function tryMatchToken(tok) {
			if (namingLookup[tok]) return [namingLookup[tok]];
			for (const sfx of TIME_SUFFIXES) {
				if (tok.length > sfx.length && tok.endsWith(sfx)) {
					const prefix = tok.slice(0, -sfx.length);
					const hits = [];
					if (namingLookup[prefix]) hits.push(namingLookup[prefix]);
					if (namingLookup[sfx]) hits.push(namingLookup[sfx]);
					if (hits.length > 0) return hits;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		function decodeFeature(val) {
			const input = val.trim().toUpperCase();
			const result = document.getElementById('decoder-result');
			const cards = document.getElementById('decoder-cards');
			const unknown = document.getElementById('decoder-unknown');
			const empty = document.getElementById('decoder-empty');

			if (!input) { result.classList.add('hidden'); empty.classList.add('hidden'); return; }

			const parts = input.split('_');
			// First pass: greedy multi-part matching, collecting unmatched tokens with their indices.
			const resolved = []; // {matches: [...]} or {raw: "TOKEN", idx: n}
			let i = 0;
			while (i < parts.length) {
				let found = false;
				for (let len = Math.min(3, parts.length - i); len >= 1; len--) {
					const candidate = parts.slice(i, i + len).join('_');
					if (namingLookup[candidate]) {
						resolved.push({matches: [namingLookup[candidate]]});
						i += len; found = true; break;
					}
				}
				if (!found) { resolved.push({raw: parts[i], idx: i}); i++; }
			}

			// Second pass: try to resolve unmatched tokens.
			// a) Try combining consecutive unmatched tokens (e.g. VS + AVG → VS_AVG).
			// b) Try splitting tokens with embedded time window suffixes (e.g. AVG12M → AVG + 12M).
			for (let j = 0; j < resolved.length; j++) {
				if (!resolved[j].raw) continue;
				// Try combining with next unmatched
				if (j + 1 < resolved.length && resolved[j+1].raw) {
					const combined = resolved[j].raw + '_' + resolved[j+1].raw;
					if (namingLookup[combined]) {
						resolved.splice(j, 2, {matches: [namingLookup[combined]]});
						j--; continue;
					}
					// Try combined with time suffix split on the second part
					const hits2 = tryMatchToken(resolved[j+1].raw);
					if (hits2) {
						const prefix = resolved[j].raw + '_' + hits2[0].code;
						// Check if the first unmatched + first hit code form a valid code
						// e.g. VS + AVG (from AVG12M) → VS_AVG
						// We need to rebuild: if hits2 split the token, the prefix was already extracted
						// Simpler: try combining current raw with each prefix from suffix-split
						for (const sfx of TIME_SUFFIXES) {
							const tok2 = resolved[j+1].raw;
							if (tok2.length > sfx.length && tok2.endsWith(sfx)) {
								const pre = tok2.slice(0, -sfx.length);
								const combo = resolved[j].raw + '_' + pre;
								if (namingLookup[combo]) {
									const m = [namingLookup[combo]];
									if (namingLookup[sfx]) m.push(namingLookup[sfx]);
									resolved.splice(j, 2, {matches: m});
									j--; break;
								}
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				// Try splitting this single token on time suffix
				const hits = tryMatchToken(resolved[j].raw);
				if (hits) { resolved.splice(j, 1, {matches: hits}); j--; continue; }
			}

			const matched = [];
			const unmatched = [];
			resolved.forEach(r => {
				if (r.matches) matched.push(...r.matches);
				else unmatched.push(r.raw);
			});

			if (matched.length === 0) {
				result.classList.add('hidden');
				empty.classList.remove('hidden');
				return;
			}

			empty.classList.add('hidden');
			result.classList.remove('hidden');
			cards.innerHTML = '';

			matched.forEach(m => {
				const color = TYPE_COLORS[m.type] || 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-900';
				const label = TYPE_LABELS[m.type] || m.type;
				const card = document.createElement('div');
				card.className = 'rounded-lg border p-3 ' + color;
				card.innerHTML = '<p class="font-mono font-bold text-sm">' + escapeHtml(m.code) + '</p>' +
					'<p class="text-xs font-semibold mt-1 opacity-70">' + escapeHtml(label) + '</p>' +
					'<p class="text-sm mt-1">' + escapeHtml(m.name) + '</p>' +
					'<p class="text-xs mt-0.5 opacity-80">' + escapeHtml(m.desc) + '</p>';
				cards.appendChild(card);
			});

			if (unmatched.length > 0) {
				unknown.classList.remove('hidden');
				unknown.textContent = 'Unrecognised parts: ' + unmatched.join(', ');
			} else {
				unknown.classList.add('hidden');
			}
		}
	</script>
}

// =============================================
// NAMING CONVENTIONS TAB

templ namingPanel(d pageData) {
	<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
		<div></div>
		<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/data-dictionary/naming/new") } class="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">+ Add Convention Entry</a>
	</div>
	for _, compType := range d.NamingTypes {
		<div class="mb-6">
			<h3 class="text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-3">{ NamingTypeLabel(compType) }</h3>
			<div class="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
				<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
					<thead class="bg-gray-50">
						<tr>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider w-24">Code</th>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider w-48">Name</th>
							<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Description</th>
						</tr>
					</thead>
					<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
						for _, n := range d.NamingByType[compType] {
							<tr id={ fmt.Sprintf("row-%s", n.ID) } class="relative group hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
								<td class="px-6 py-3 font-mono font-semibold text-gray-900 text-sm">{ n.Code }</td>
								<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-700">{ n.Name }</td>
								<td class="px-6 py-3 text-sm text-gray-500">{ n.Description }</td>
								if d.EditMode {
									<td class="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 hidden group-hover:flex items-center gap-1 pr-3 bg-gradient-to-l from-white via-white to-transparent pl-8">
										<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/data-dictionary/naming/%s/edit", n.ID)) } class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">Edit</a>
										<button onclick={ deleteEntry(fmt.Sprintf("/tools/data-dictionary/naming/delete/%s", n.ID), fmt.Sprintf("row-%s", n.ID)) } class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">Delete</button>
									</td>
								}
							</tr>
						}
					</tbody>
				</table>
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

// =============================================
// SCORING FEATURES TAB

templ featuresPanel(d pageData) {
	<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
		<div></div>
		<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/data-dictionary/feature/new") } class="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">+ Add Feature</a>
	</div>
	<div class="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
			<thead class="bg-gray-50">
				<tr>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Field Name</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">English Name</th>
					<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Domain</th>
					<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Window</th>
					<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Type</th>
					<th class="px-3 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Country</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider min-w-[16rem]">Description</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Derivation</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Legacy</th>
				</tr>
			</thead>
			<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
				for _, e := range d.Features {
					<tr id={ fmt.Sprintf("row-%s", e.ID) } data-field={ e.FieldName } data-description={ e.EnglishName + " — " + e.Description } data-section={ tabAnchor("Scoring Features") } class="relative group transition-colors duration-700">
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top whitespace-nowrap"><p class="font-mono font-semibold text-gray-900 text-sm">{ e.FieldName }</p></td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-700">{ e.EnglishName }</td>
						<td class="px-3 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-500 font-mono">{ e.Domain }</td>
						<td class="px-3 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-500 font-mono">{ e.TimeWindow }</td>
						<td class="px-3 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-500 font-mono">{ e.DataType }</td>
						<td class="px-3 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-500">{ e.CountryAvailability }</td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-600 min-w-[16rem]"><div class="prose prose-sm max-w-none">@templ.Raw(renderMarkdown(e.Description))</div></td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top max-w-xs">
							if e.Derivation != "" {
								<pre class="text-xs bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono text-gray-700"><code>{ e.Derivation }</code></pre>
							}
						</td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono">{ e.LegacyNames }</td>
						if d.EditMode {
							<td class="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 hidden group-hover:flex items-center gap-1 pr-3 bg-gradient-to-l from-white via-white to-transparent pl-8">
								<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/data-dictionary/feature/%s/edit", e.ID)) } class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">Edit</a>
								<button onclick={ deleteEntry(fmt.Sprintf("/tools/data-dictionary/feature/delete/%s", e.ID), fmt.Sprintf("row-%s", e.ID)) } class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">Delete</button>
							</td>
						}
					</tr>
				}
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
}
```
