// IDENTIFIERS & DATES TAB

templ keysPanel(d pageData) {
	<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
		<div></div>
		<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/new") } class="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">+ Add Identifier</a>
	</div>
	<p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4">These are NEVER predictive features. Operational keys and system dates are retained for joins/partitioning; raw event dates and lagged intermediates should be dropped before modelling.</p>
	<div class="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
		<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
			<thead class="bg-gray-50">
				<tr>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Field Name</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Legacy Name</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Type</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">Country</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Meaning</th>
					<th class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Use</th>
				</tr>
			</thead>
			<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
				for _, e := range d.Identifiers {
					<tr id={ fmt.Sprintf("row-%s", e.ID) } data-field={ e.FieldName } data-description={ e.Meaning } data-section={ tabAnchor("Identifiers & Dates") } class="relative group transition-colors duration-700">
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top whitespace-nowrap"><p class="font-mono font-semibold text-gray-900 text-sm">{ e.FieldName }</p></td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono">{ e.LegacyName }</td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-500 font-mono">{ e.DataType }</td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-500">{ e.CountryAvailability }</td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-600">{ e.Meaning }</td>
						<td class="px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-gray-500">{ e.UseCase }</td>
						if d.EditMode {
							<td class="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 hidden group-hover:flex items-center gap-1 pr-3 bg-gradient-to-l from-white via-white to-transparent pl-8">
								<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, fmt.Sprintf("/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/%s/edit", e.ID)) } class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">Edit</a>
								<button onclick={ deleteEntry(fmt.Sprintf("/tools/data-dictionary/identifier/delete/%s", e.ID), fmt.Sprintf("row-%s", e.ID)) } class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">Delete</button>
							</td>
						}
					</tr>
				}
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
}

// =============================================
// FEATURE EDIT PAGE

templ featureEditPage(d featureEditData) {
	@layout.Html(featureEditTitle(d.IsNew)) {
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light text-white pt-10 pb-16 md:pt-16">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
					<div>
						<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, d.BackURL) } class="text-white/70 hover:text-white text-sm mb-2 inline-block transition-colors">&#8592; Back to Data Dictionary</a>
						if d.IsNew {
							<h1 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold">Add New Feature</h1>
						} else {
							<h1 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold">Edit Feature</h1>
							<p class="mt-1 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono">{ d.Entry.FieldName }</p>
						}
					</div>
					@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 -mt-8 mb-20">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				if !d.IsNew {
					<div class="mb-6 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-800">Saving will deactivate the current version and create a new one. The old version will remain in history.</div>
				}
				<form method="POST" action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, featureFormAction(d.IsNew, d.Entry.ID)) } class="space-y-5">
					<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Field Name <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
							<input type="text" name="field_name" value={ d.Entry.FieldName } required class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">English Name</label>
							<input type="text" name="english_name" value={ d.Entry.EnglishName } class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
					</div>
					<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Domain</label>
							<input type="text" name="domain" value={ d.Entry.Domain } class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Time Window</label>
							<input type="text" name="time_window" value={ d.Entry.TimeWindow } class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Data Type</label>
							<input type="text" name="data_type" value={ d.Entry.DataType } class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Country Availability</label>
						<input type="text" name="country_availability" value={ d.Entry.CountryAvailability } class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Description</label>
						<textarea name="description" rows="3" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark resize-none">{ d.Entry.Description }</textarea>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Derivation / SQL Logic</label>
						<textarea name="derivation" rows="3" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark resize-none">{ d.Entry.Derivation }</textarea>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Legacy Names</label>
						<input type="text" name="legacy_names" value={ d.Entry.LegacyNames } class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark" placeholder="Pipe-separated, e.g. AR024 | AZ024"/>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Owner (updated to you on save)</label>
						<input type="text" value={ d.u.Email } readonly class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"/>
					</div>
					<div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
						<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, d.BackURL) } class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">Cancel</a>
						<button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">Save</button>
					</div>
				</form>
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

templ namingEditPage(d namingEditData) {

						if d.IsNew {
							<h1 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold">Add Convention Entry</h1>
						} else {
							<h1 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold">Edit Convention Entry</h1>
							<p class="mt-1 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono">{ d.Entry.ComponentType } / { d.Entry.Code }</p>
						}
					</div>
					@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 -mt-8 mb-20">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-6 md:p-8">
				if !d.IsNew {
					<div class="mb-6 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-800">Saving will deactivate the current version and create a new one.</div>
				}
				<form method="POST" action={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, namingFormAction(d.IsNew, d.Entry.ID)) } class="space-y-5">
					<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Component Type <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
							if d.IsNew {
								<select name="component_type" required class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark">
									<option value="">Select...</option>
									<option value="DOMAIN">DOMAIN</option>
									<option value="ENTITY">ENTITY</option>
									<option value="METRIC">METRIC</option>
									<option value="AGGREGATION">AGGREGATION</option>

							}
						</div>
						<div>
							<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Code <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
							<input type="text" name="code" value={ d.Entry.Code } required class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm font-mono focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
						</div>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Name</label>
						<input type="text" name="name" value={ d.Entry.Name } class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark"/>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Description</label>
						<textarea name="description" rows="3" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-x-dark resize-none">{ d.Entry.Description }</textarea>
					</div>
					<div>
						<label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Owner (updated to you on save)</label>
						<input type="text" value={ d.u.Email } readonly class="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 text-gray-500 text-sm"/>
					</div>
					<div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
						<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, d.BackURL) } class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">Cancel</a>
						<button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg bg-green-x-dark hover:bg-green-x-light text-white text-sm font-medium transition-colors">Save</button>
					</div>
				</form>
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

// =============================================
// FEATURE HISTORY PAGE

templ featureHistoryPage(d featureHistoryData) {
	@layout.Html("Field History") {
		<div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-x-dark to-red-x-light text-white pt-10 pb-16 md:pt-16">
			<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0">
				<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
					<div>
						<a href={ uj.SafeHref(d.r, "/tools/data-dictionary") } class="text-white/70 hover:text-white text-sm mb-2 inline-block transition-colors">&#8592; Back to Data Dictionary</a>
						<h1 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold">History</h1>
						if d.FieldName != "" {
							<p class="mt-1 text-white/80 text-sm font-mono">{ d.FieldName }</p>
						}
					</div>
					@country.CCDropdown(d.cc, d.userCountries, uj.IsEmbedded(d.r))
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<div class="max-w-8xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 xl:px-0 -mt-8 mb-20">
			<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden">
				<div class="px-6 py-5 border-b border-gray-100">
					<h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
						if d.FieldName != "" {
							{ fmt.Sprintf("All versions of \"%s\"", d.FieldName) }
						} else {
							Version History
						}
					</h2>
				</div>
				if len(d.History) == 0 {
					<div class="flex justify-center items-center py-20"><p class="text-gray-400">No history found for this field.</p></div>
				} else {
					<div class="overflow-x-auto">
						<table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-100">
							<thead class="bg-gray-50">
								<tr>
									<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider w-48">Field Name</th>
									<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Description</th>
									<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider w-40">Owner</th>
									<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider w-28">Date</th>
									<th class="px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider w-20">Status</th>
								</tr>
							</thead>
							<tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-100">
								for _, e := range d.History {
									<tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
										<td class="px-6 py-4 font-mono font-semibold text-gray-900 text-sm whitespace-nowrap">{ e.FieldName }</td>
										<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600">{ e.Description }</td>
										<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-500 truncate max-w-xs">{ e.Owner }</td>
										<td class="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-400 whitespace-nowrap">{ e.Created }</td>
										<td class="px-6 py-4">
											if e.Active {
												<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">Active</span>
											} else {
												<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-gray-100 text-gray-500">Inactive</span>
											}
										</td>
									</tr>
								}
							</tbody>
						</table>
					</div>
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}
